senses.en: a visible mass of tiny water drops in the sky
a mass of smoke, dust, or similar material in air
to make thoughts or judgment less clear

ex.en: A dark cloud drifted slowly across the afternoon sky.
ex.zh: 一朵乌云缓缓飘过午后的天空。

ex.en: Strong emotions can cloud public judgment when communities debate the benefits and risks of new technologies.
ex.zh: 当社区讨论新技术的利弊时，强烈的情绪可能影响公众的判断。

col: a cloud of dust｜一团尘土
cloud someone's judgment｜影响某人的判断
tip: cloud作动词可指使判断不清，如cloud your judgment。

senses.en: A place where people read or borrow books and other materials.
An organised collection of books, recordings, or digital resources.

ex.en: I borrowed three books from the library after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，我从图书馆借了三本书。

ex.en: Public libraries support lifelong learning by providing free access to books, digital resources, and quiet study spaces.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供书籍、数字资源和安静的学习空间来支持终身学习。

tip: library是借阅书籍的图书馆，bookshop是售书的书店。

senses.en: the day after Wednesday and before Friday

ex.en: We usually meet for lunch at home on Thursday.
ex.zh: 我们通常周四在家一起吃午饭。

ex.en: The university will host a public discussion on sustainable transport next Thursday evening.
ex.zh: 这所大学将于下周四晚举办一场关于可持续交通的公众讨论会。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；具体某天前用on。

senses.en: Inside a building, or into a building.

ex.en: We stayed indoors and played chess during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间，我们待在室内下棋。

ex.en: Children who spend most of their time indoors may have fewer opportunities for physical activity.
ex.zh: 大部分时间待在室内的孩子可能较少有机会进行体育活动。

col: keep pets indoors｜把宠物养在室内
tip: indoors是副词；修饰名词用indoor，如indoor sports。

senses.en: A room used mainly for sleeping.

ex.en: My bedroom gets plenty of sunlight in the morning.
ex.zh: 我的卧室早晨阳光很充足。

ex.en: Children who share a bedroom may develop cooperation skills, but they also need sufficient privacy as they grow.
ex.zh: 共用卧室的孩子可能会培养合作能力，但随着成长，他们也需要足够的隐私。

tip: 可数名词；a two-bedroom flat指两居室公寓。

senses.en: items worn to cover the body

ex.en: Your clean clothes are drying outside in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 你洗干净的衣服正在外面晒太阳。

ex.en: Buying durable clothes rather than frequently replacing cheap garments can reduce household waste and save resources.
ex.zh: 购买耐穿的衣服，而不是频繁更换廉价服装，可以减少家庭垃圾并节约资源。

tip: 只有复数形式；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

senses.en: A round shape whose edge is equally distant from its centre.
A group of people connected by friendship or shared interests.
To move around something or draw a ring around it.

ex.en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
ex.zh: 孩子们在草地上围坐成一圈。

ex.en: Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.
ex.zh: 参加社区活动可以帮助老年人扩大社交圈，减少孤独感。

tip: circle是圆或圆圈；cycle才常指循环或周期。

senses.en: Used politely to ask someone to repeat what they said.
To forgive someone or officially release them from punishment.
Official forgiveness for a crime, or forgiveness for an offence.

ex.en: Pardon? I couldn't hear you over the washing machine.
ex.zh: 请再说一遍？洗衣机太吵，我没听清。

ex.en: A legal pardon can help someone rebuild their life, although public acceptance may take longer.
ex.zh: 法律上的赦免可以帮助一个人重建生活，但获得公众接纳可能需要更久。

col: I beg your pardon｜请再说一遍；对不起
tip: 没听清时可说Pardon?，语调通常上扬。

senses.en: with care and attention

ex.en: Please read the questions carefully.
ex.zh: 请仔细阅读题目。

ex.en: She carefully carried the glass across the room.
ex.zh: 她小心地把玻璃杯端过房间。

tip: carefully 修饰动词，表示做事仔细小心；反义词是 carelessly。
scene: A student reading a paper closely with a pencil in hand, concentrating.

senses.en: having great physical power or force
not easily broken or damaged
great in intensity, influence, or convincing power

ex.en: My brother is strong enough to lift this sofa.
ex.zh: 我哥哥力气很大，能抬起这张沙发。

ex.en: There is strong evidence that regular physical activity improves both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 有充分证据表明，规律的体育活动能改善心理健康并提高学业表现。

tip: strong at表示擅长；strong通常是形容词。

senses.en: always, or very often

ex.en: He plays computer games all the time.
ex.zh: 他一直都在玩电脑游戏。

ex.en: The baby cries all the time at night.
ex.zh: 宝宝夜里一直哭。

tip: all the time 强调“一直、频繁”，口语中很常用。
scene: A boy glued to a computer screen at home while the clock shows late evening.

senses.en: in or to this place

ex.en: Come here and look at this picture.
ex.zh: 过来看看这张画。

ex.en: Your keys are here on the table.
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在桌上这里。

tip: here you are 是“给你”的口语表达，递交东西时用。
scene: A child pointing to a picture on a table, calling a friend over.

senses.en: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.
An organized group with a particular purpose.
The main or central part of something.

ex.en: My whole body aches after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很长一段路，现在我全身酸痛。

ex.en: An independent body should monitor water quality and publish its findings for the public.
ex.zh: 应由一个独立机构监测水质，并向公众公布调查结果。

col: a body of evidence｜一系列证据
the body of an essay｜文章正文
tip: body可指机构；文章的body指正文部分。

senses.en: A solid piece of material with fairly flat sides.
To stop movement or prevent something from happening.
An area between streets, or a large building.

ex.en: The sculptor carved a bird from a block of wood.
ex.zh: 雕刻家用一块木头雕出了一只鸟。

ex.en: Poorly parked vehicles can block access to public buildings, creating difficulties for wheelchair users.
ex.zh: 停放不当的车辆可能堵住公共建筑的入口，给轮椅使用者带来困难。

col: a block of flats｜一栋公寓楼
a block of ice｜一大块冰
tip: a block of flats指公寓楼，是英式常用表达。

senses.en: one of twelve yearly divisions, or roughly four weeks

ex.en: I put aside a little money every month.
ex.zh: 我每个月都会存下一点钱。

ex.en: Offering employees one additional day off each month could improve wellbeing without significantly reducing overall productivity.
ex.zh: 每月给员工额外一天假期，可以改善他们的身心状态，而不会显著降低整体生产效率。

tip: last、next、every month前通常不加介词。

senses.en: without difficulty or much effort
by a clear margin, especially in comparisons
with a strong possibility of something happening

ex.en: This small suitcase fits easily beneath the train seat.
ex.zh: 这个小行李箱轻轻松松就能放到火车座位下面。

ex.en: Public information should be presented clearly so that people with different literacy levels can easily understand it.
ex.zh: 公共信息应清晰呈现，让识字水平不同的人都能轻松理解。

col: easily accessible｜容易获取或到达的
easily the best｜无疑是最好的
tip: easily可修饰最高级：easily the best表示远胜其他。

senses.en: To allow someone to do something or something to happen.
To allow someone to use property in exchange for rent.

ex.en: Please let me know when you arrive home safely.
ex.zh: 你平安到家后请告诉我。

ex.en: Schools should let students explore different subjects before requiring them to choose a specialist pathway.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生先探索不同学科，再要求他们选择专业方向。

tip: let sb do sth中不加to；过去式、过去分词均为let。

senses.en: water that comes from underground with minerals in it

ex.en: Can I have a bottle of mineral water, please?
ex.zh: 请给我一瓶矿泉水。

ex.en: He drinks mineral water instead of soft drinks.
ex.zh: 他喝矿泉水而不是软饮料。

col: a bottle of mineral water｜一瓶矿泉水
tip: mineral water 指天然矿泉水；sparkling water 是气泡水。
scene: A bottle of mineral water with droplets on it in a picnic basket.

senses.en: A small amount or piece of something.
The smallest unit of information stored by a computer.

ex.en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
ex.zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。

ex.en: Even a small bit of practical experience can help students understand difficult scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 即使只有少量实践经验，也能帮助学生理解困难的科学概念。

tip: a bit of接名词；a bit可修饰形容词；bit也是bite过去式。

senses.en: A collection of recorded music released as one product.
A book for keeping photographs, stamps or similar collections.

ex.en: Her new album kept us singing all afternoon.
ex.zh: 她的新专辑让我们跟着唱了整整一个下午。

ex.en: Digital platforms allow independent musicians to release an album without relying on a traditional record company.
ex.zh: 数字平台让独立音乐人无需依赖传统唱片公司就能发行专辑。

tip: 音乐专辑用album；单曲用single。

senses.en: a small round disc that stores music or data

ex.en: This CD has my favourite songs on it.
ex.zh: 这张光盘里有我最喜欢的歌。

ex.en: Do you still buy CDs or do you stream music?
ex.zh: 你还买光盘吗，还是在线听音乐？

tip: CD 是 compact disc 的缩写，复数形式是 CDs。
scene: A shiny music CD lying on a table next to a music player.

senses.en: used when a female does something to herself

ex.en: She made the cake herself.
ex.zh: 蛋糕是她自己做的。

ex.en: She looked at herself in the mirror.
ex.zh: 她照了照镜子。

tip: by herself 表示“独自、靠自己”；反身代词指代主语的自己。
scene: A girl looking at her reflection in a full-length mirror.

senses.en: Brought into the world as a baby
Having a natural ability for a particular activity

ex.en: My little sister was born on a snowy morning.
ex.zh: 我的小妹妹出生在一个下雪的早晨。

ex.en: Children born in rural areas may face greater difficulties accessing specialist healthcare than those in cities.
ex.zh: 与城市儿童相比，出生在农村的儿童获得专科医疗服务可能更加困难。

col: be born into a family｜出生在某个家庭
a born leader｜天生的领导者
tip: 出生用be born；过去出生说was/were born。

senses.en: a coloured substance spread on surfaces for protection or decoration
to cover a surface with paint
to create a picture using paint

ex.en: There is blue paint all over your hands.
ex.zh: 你的双手沾满了蓝色颜料。

ex.en: Schools should allow children to paint regularly, as creative activities can support emotional development and self-expression.
ex.zh: 学校应让孩子经常绘画，因为创意活动有助于情感发展和自我表达。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: paint多指用颜料画；draw多指用铅笔等画线条。

senses.en: to move over snow wearing long narrow boards on your feet
a long narrow board worn on a foot for travelling over snow

ex.en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
ex.zh: 我们在一处平缓的雪坡上学会了滑雪。

ex.en: Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.
ex.zh: 在山地度假区滑雪的游客促进了当地就业，但也可能增加环境压力。

col: a pair of skis｜一副滑雪板
tip: 过去式skied，现在分词skiing；ski复数为skis。

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable.

senses.zh: 令人惊叹的；令人敬畏的
senses.en: Causing great admiration, wonder, or sometimes fear.

ex.en: The mountain view from our tent was absolutely awesome.
ex.zh: 从我们的帐篷望出去，山景简直棒极了。

ex.en: The awesome power of volcanic eruptions highlights the importance of effective monitoring systems in nearby communities.
ex.zh: 火山喷发令人敬畏的威力凸显了周边社区建立有效监测系统的重要性。

tip: 表示“超棒”时较口语；正式写作宜选更具体的词。

senses.en: funny or connected with comedy
a publication telling stories through sequences of pictures
a performer who entertains people by making them laugh

ex.en: His comic dance had everyone laughing at the party.
ex.zh: 他那滑稽的舞蹈逗得聚会上的每个人都笑了。

ex.en: Comic characters can make educational programmes more engaging and help children remember important information.
ex.zh: 滑稽的角色可以让教育节目更有吸引力，帮助儿童记住重要信息。

tip: comic可指喜剧相关；comical侧重滑稽可笑。

senses.en: the person speaking or writing

ex.en: I am eleven years old.
ex.zh: 我十一岁。

ex.en: I like playing basketball with my friends.
ex.zh: 我喜欢和朋友们打篮球。

tip: 英语中 I 永远大写；宾格是 me。
scene: A girl pointing to herself and smiling in front of a mirror.

senses.en: To do something with a tool, resource, or method.
The act of employing something for a purpose.
A purpose something serves or a way it can help.

ex.en: Can I use your scissors to open this package?
ex.zh: 我可以用你的剪刀打开这个包裹吗？

ex.en: Governments should encourage people to use public transport by making services more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 政府应提高公共交通服务的可靠性和可负担性，鼓励人们使用公共交通。

col: use public transport｜使用公共交通
a wide range of uses｜多种用途
tip: 动词读/juːz/，名词读/juːs/。

senses.en: A period of sixty seconds, or a very short time
A written record of what happened at a meeting
Extremely small in size or amount

ex.en: Wait a minute while I find my keys.
ex.zh: 等一下，我找找钥匙。

ex.en: Even a minute of regular classroom discussion can encourage students to reflect on what they have learned.
ex.zh: 即使每次只进行一分钟的常规课堂讨论，也能鼓励学生反思所学内容。

col: at the last minute｜在最后一刻
tip: 会议记录用复数minutes；形容词“微小的”重音在后。

senses.en: a person who shows tourists around a place

ex.en: The tour guide showed us around the old town.
ex.zh: 导游带我们游览了老城。

ex.en: Our tour guide speaks three languages.
ex.zh: 我们的导游会说三种语言。

tip: tour guide 是带游客参观的导游。
scene: A tour guide with a flag leading tourists through an old town.

senses.en: Used to emphasise something surprising or unexpected.
Flat, regular, or equal in amount or level.
Divisible by two without leaving a remainder.

ex.en: Everyone joined the dance, even our shy uncle.
ex.zh: 大家都加入了舞蹈，连我们害羞的叔叔也不例外。

ex.en: Even small improvements in public transport can make daily travel easier for people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通只有小幅改善，也能让行动不便者的日常出行更加轻松。

tip: even if表假设“即使”；even though表事实“尽管”。

senses.en: Used after a number to give the exact hour.

ex.en: Please meet me outside the library at three o'clock.
ex.zh: 请三点整在图书馆外面和我见面。

ex.en: Starting school at nine o'clock rather than earlier may help teenagers concentrate better during morning lessons.
ex.zh: 将上学时间定在九点而非更早，可能有助于青少年在上午上课时更专注。

tip: 只用于整点；写作o'clock，不用连字符。

senses.en: plan how something will look or work before making it
the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan
a decorative pattern on an object or surface

ex.en: My cousin designed a wooden desk for her bedroom.
ex.zh: 我表姐为自己的卧室设计了一张木书桌。

ex.en: Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.
ex.zh: 城市应设计既能促进社交互动、又方便残障人士使用的公共空间。

col: be designed to do something｜旨在做某事
tip: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

senses.en: giving much light or having a strong, clear colour
quick to learn and understand things
promising success or showing happiness

ex.en: Bright sunlight streamed through the kitchen window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，明亮的阳光从厨房窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Access to quality education can give young people a bright future regardless of their family background.
ex.zh: 无论家庭背景如何，获得优质教育都能让年轻人拥有光明的未来。

tip: 形容光线强用bright；形容房间暗用dim。

senses.en: A person who manages workers or runs a business.
To order people around in an annoying or controlling way.

ex.en: My boss let me leave early for my appointment.
ex.zh: 我的上司允许我提前下班去赴约。

ex.en: A supportive boss can improve employee satisfaction by offering constructive feedback and recognising individual contributions.
ex.zh: 支持员工的上司可以通过提供建设性反馈和认可个人贡献来提高员工满意度。

col: talk to your boss｜与你的上司交谈
a supportive boss｜支持员工的上司
be your own boss｜自己当老板
boss someone around｜对某人指手画脚
tip: boss较口语；作动词常用boss someone around。

senses.en: title for a doctor or someone with a doctorate

ex.en: Dr Smith will see you at ten.
ex.zh: 史密斯医生十点见你。

ex.en: She wants to become a Dr when she grows up.
ex.zh: 她长大后想成为博士。

tip: Dr 是 doctor 的缩写，用在姓名前表示尊称。
scene: A doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope smiling in a clinic.

senses.en: A place where ships load, unload, or shelter.
A physical connection point or virtual channel for computer communication.
The left side of a ship or aircraft, facing forward.

ex.en: We watched fishing boats returning to the port.
ex.zh: 我们看着渔船返回港口。

ex.en: Expanding the port could increase international trade, but it may also damage nearby marine habitats.
ex.zh: 扩建港口可能促进国际贸易，但也可能破坏附近的海洋生境。

tip: port指左舷时，反义词是starboard（右舷）。

senses.en: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.

ex.en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后都练习小提琴。

ex.en: Learning the violin can help children develop concentration, although regular lessons may be expensive for some families.
ex.zh: 学习小提琴有助于儿童培养专注力，但定期上课对某些家庭来说可能费用较高。

col: a violin concerto｜小提琴协奏曲
tip: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。

senses.en: to try to find something

ex.en: I am looking for my keys. Have you seen them?
ex.zh: 我在找我的钥匙，你看见了吗？

ex.en: She is looking for a summer job.
ex.zh: 她在找暑期工作。

tip: look for 是“寻找”的过程；find 是“找到”的结果。
scene: A girl searching through her bag looking for her keys.

senses.en: divide or remove something using a sharp tool
reduce the amount, size, or length of something
an opening made by something sharp, or a reduction

ex.en: She cut the apple into slices for her brother.
ex.zh: 她把苹果切成片给弟弟吃。

ex.en: Local councils can cut energy costs by installing efficient lighting in public buildings.
ex.zh: 地方议会可以通过在公共建筑内安装节能照明设备来削减能源开支。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为cut；现在分词为cutting。

senses.en: A hand covering with separate sections for fingers and thumb.

ex.en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我在厨房椅子下面找到了丢失的那只手套。

ex.en: Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.
ex.zh: 医护人员在接诊不同患者之间应更换一次性手套，以降低传播感染的风险。

col: a pair of gloves｜一副手套
tip: 一副手套用 a pair of gloves，注意 gloves 用复数。

senses.en: to finish doing something or filling in information
having every necessary part, with nothing missing
total, without any limit or exception

ex.en: I completed the puzzle just before dinner was ready.
ex.zh: 我刚拼好拼图，晚饭就做好了。

ex.en: Students who complete vocational training often gain practical skills that help them enter the workforce more confidently.
ex.zh: 完成职业培训的学生往往能获得实用技能，从而更有信心地进入职场。

tip: complete a form指填写完表格，不是制作表格。

senses.en: Keep information in your mind or bring it back.
Not forget to do something necessary.
Honour someone or something from the past.

ex.en: I still remember the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
ex.zh: 我至今还记得祖母厨房里的气味。

ex.en: Students often remember new vocabulary more effectively when they use it in meaningful conversations.
ex.zh: 学生在有意义的对话中使用新词汇，往往能更有效地记住它们。

col: remember to do something｜记得去做某事
remember doing something｜记得做过某事
tip: remember to do是记得去做；doing是记得做过。

senses.en: to touch someone or something with your lips affectionately
an affectionate touch made with the lips

ex.en: She kissed her daughter gently before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 她上班前轻轻亲了亲女儿。

ex.en: In some cultures, a kiss on the cheek is a common greeting between close friends.
ex.zh: 在一些文化中，亲吻脸颊是亲密朋友之间常见的问候方式。

col: kiss someone goodbye｜亲吻某人道别
give someone a kiss｜亲某人一下
a kiss on the cheek｜脸颊上的一吻
tip: 吻某人的脸颊用 kiss someone on the cheek。

senses.en: to stop sleeping, or make someone stop sleeping
the disturbed water left behind a moving boat
a gathering to remember someone who has recently died

ex.en: Please wake me before you leave for work.
ex.zh: 请在你出门上班前叫醒我。

ex.en: People who wake at consistent times may find it easier to maintain healthy sleep patterns.
ex.zh: 在固定时间醒来的人可能更容易保持健康的睡眠规律。

col: in the wake of｜紧随……之后；受……影响
tip: 过去式woke，过去分词woken；常与up连用。

senses.en: liquid obtained from fruit or vegetables

ex.en: She squeezed fresh orange juice into a glass.
ex.zh: 她把鲜橙汁挤进了玻璃杯里。

ex.en: Although fruit juice contains vitamins, eating whole fruit usually provides more fibre and helps limit sugar intake.
ex.zh: 虽然果汁含有维生素，但吃完整的水果通常能摄入更多膳食纤维，并有助于限制糖分摄入。

tip: juice通常不可数；点餐时a juice可指一杯果汁。

senses.en: Room available for something, or a gap between things
The vast area beyond Earth's atmosphere
To arrange things with gaps between them

ex.en: There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
ex.zh: 我的自行车旁边有足够的地方放你的车。

ex.en: Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的社区增加绿地，可以改善居民身心健康并鼓励户外锻炼。

tip: 泛指空间、太空时不可数；具体车位等可数。

senses.en: Used to make an adjective, adverb, or statement stronger.
In fact, rather than only apparently or supposedly.
Used in questions to express surprise or doubt.

ex.en: This soup is really hot, so let it cool.
ex.zh: 这汤非常烫，先让它凉一凉吧。

ex.en: Before expanding online education, policymakers should consider whether digital courses really meet the needs of disadvantaged learners.
ex.zh: 在扩大在线教育之前，政策制定者应考虑数字课程是否真正满足弱势学习者的需求。

tip: not really通常表示“不太”，语气比直接说no缓和。

senses.en: used to show surprise, understanding or interest

ex.en: Oh, I didn't know you were here!
ex.zh: 哦，我不知道你在这里！

ex.en: Oh, I see. Thank you for explaining.
ex.zh: 哦，我明白了。谢谢你解释。

tip: oh 是语气词，表达惊讶、顿悟等情绪。
scene: A girl looking surprised with her hand near her mouth saying oh.

senses.en: to be careful to avoid danger

ex.en: Look out! There's a car coming.
ex.zh: 小心！有车来了。

ex.en: Look out for wet floors after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后注意湿滑的地面。

tip: look out 用于提醒危险，类似 watch out。
scene: A child at a street corner warning a friend as a car approaches.

senses.en: To cook food using dry heat, especially in an oven.
Cooked using dry heat in an oven or over a fire.
A large piece of roasted meat, or a meal containing it.

ex.en: We usually roast potatoes with garlic and fresh herbs.
ex.zh: 我们通常用大蒜和新鲜香草烤土豆。

ex.en: Families can roast seasonal vegetables at home to prepare nutritious meals without relying on highly processed foods.
ex.zh: 家庭可以在家烤时令蔬菜，做出营养丰富的饭菜，而不必依赖高度加工的食品。

tip: roast多用于肉和蔬菜；烤面包、蛋糕通常用bake。

senses.en: a large natural stream of water flowing towards another water body

ex.en: We watched ducks swimming across the river this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我们看着鸭子游过河面。

ex.en: Protecting river ecosystems requires cooperation between farming communities, local industries, and environmental agencies.
ex.zh: 保护河流生态系统需要农业社区、当地企业和环境机构之间的合作。

tip: 河名通常带the，如the River Nile。

senses.en: A large animal used for riding, racing, or pulling loads.

ex.en: The brown horse gently took an apple from my hand.
ex.zh: 那匹棕色的马轻轻地吃走了我手里的苹果。

ex.en: Before motor vehicles became widespread, horses played a central role in farming and transporting goods.
ex.zh: 在机动车普及之前，马在农业和货物运输中发挥着核心作用。

tip: 骑马用ride a horse；on horseback表示骑在马上。

senses.en: a meal eaten around the middle of the day
to eat a meal around midday

ex.en: We ate lunch under a tree beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边的一棵树下吃了午饭。

ex.en: Providing nutritious school lunches can improve children's concentration and support healthier eating habits over time.
ex.zh: 提供营养丰富的学校午餐可以提高儿童的专注力，并帮助他们逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 泛指吃午餐用have lunch，通常不加冠词。

senses.en: used to ask politely or talk about habits

ex.en: Would you like some tea?
ex.zh: 你想喝点茶吗？

ex.en: When I was young, I would play here every day.
ex.zh: 小时候我每天都会在这里玩。

tip: would like 是“想要”的礼貌说法；Would you like...? 是邀请。
scene: A host offering a cup of tea to a guest with a smile.

senses.en: following the length or direction of something
forward from one place towards another
with someone when they go somewhere

ex.en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边散步，看着水里的鸭子。

ex.en: Planting trees along busy roads can provide shade for pedestrians and improve the appearance of urban areas.
ex.zh: 在繁忙道路沿线植树可以为行人遮阴，并改善城市面貌。

col: bring someone along｜带某人一起来
tip: along沿着长线走；across强调从一边横穿到另一边。

senses.en: having greater than average height

ex.en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午，一棵高大的树为我们的花园遮阴。

ex.en: Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.
ex.zh: 高层建筑可以容纳更多居民，但需要精心规划，以保留阳光和公共空间。

tip: 人、树、楼通常用tall；山通常用high。

senses.en: in addition to something already mentioned

ex.en: My sister plays tennis and also enjoys swimming.
ex.zh: 我姐姐打网球，也喜欢游泳。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free books, but they also offer valuable spaces for community learning.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费书籍，也为社区学习提供宝贵的空间。

col: not only ... but also｜不仅……而且
tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；不是连词。

senses.en: an outer garment worn for warmth or protection
a layer of paint or another covering substance
cover a surface with a layer of something

ex.en: Hang your wet coat by the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 把你的湿外套挂在厨房门边。

ex.en: Applying a protective coat to metal structures can reduce maintenance costs and extend their useful life.
ex.zh: 给金属结构涂上保护层可以降低维护成本，延长其使用寿命。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: 动词常用coat A with B，意为给A涂上B。

senses.en: to tolerate something unpleasant or carry a heavy responsibility
a large, heavily built mammal with thick fur
to have or display a particular feature or mark

ex.en: I can't bear the noise of that old fan.
ex.zh: 我受不了那台旧风扇的噪声。

ex.en: Low-income households often bear the greatest burden when the cost of essential goods rises.
ex.zh: 生活必需品价格上涨时，低收入家庭往往承受最沉重的负担。

tip: 过去式bore；过去分词通常borne；出生用born。

senses.en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and money
The medal awarded for first place in a competition
Made of gold or having its yellow colour

ex.en: My grandmother keeps her gold ring in a wooden box.
ex.zh: 我奶奶把她的金戒指放在一个木盒里。

ex.en: Demand for gold can increase during economic uncertainty, as investors seek assets they consider relatively safe.
ex.zh: 经济不确定时期，投资者会寻求他们认为相对安全的资产，黄金需求因此可能上升。

tip: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。

senses.en: the job of washing the dishes

ex.en: It's your turn to do the washing-up tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚轮到你洗碗了。

ex.en: The washing-up is done and the kitchen is clean.
ex.zh: 碗洗完了，厨房很干净。

tip: do the washing-up 是“洗碗”的英式说法。
scene: Clean dishes drying on a rack above a kitchen sink.

senses.en: a thin, flat piece cut from something larger
to cut something into thin, flat pieces
a share or portion of something

ex.en: She put a slice of lemon in my tea.
ex.zh: 她在我的茶里放了一片柠檬。

ex.en: Housing costs consume a large slice of household income, leaving many families with little money for leisure.
ex.zh: 住房开支占据家庭收入的很大一部分，使许多家庭几乎没有钱用于休闲。

col: a slice of bread｜一片面包
a slice of the market｜一部分市场份额
tip: slice强调切出的片；piece泛指一块或一件。

senses.en: A very large animal with a long trunk and large ears.

ex.en: The elephant sprayed water over its back with its trunk.
ex.zh: 大象用鼻子把水喷到自己的背上。

ex.en: Protecting elephant habitats requires cooperation between conservation organisations, local communities, and governments across national borders.
ex.zh: 保护大象栖息地需要保护组织、当地社区和各国政府开展跨国合作。

col: a herd of elephants｜一群大象
tip: 复数为elephants；象鼻用trunk，不用nose。

senses.en: moving or happening at high speed
at high speed or within a short time
to eat no food for a period of time

ex.en: We caught a fast train and arrived before lunch.
ex.zh: 我们赶上了一班快车，在午饭前就到了。

ex.en: Fast internet connections allow rural businesses to reach wider markets and compete with companies in major cities.
ex.zh: 高速网络连接使乡村企业能够进入更广阔的市场，并与大城市的公司竞争。

tip: fast本身可作副词，不能说fastly。

senses.en: in what way; used in questions

ex.en: How do you go to school?
ex.zh: 你怎么去上学？

ex.en: How beautiful the flowers are!
ex.zh: 这些花多漂亮啊！

tip: how many + 可数名词；how much + 不可数名词或问价格。
scene: A child asking a question with a raised hand in a classroom.

senses.en: showing where someone or something starts or originates
showing what causes something
showing separation, difference, or distance

ex.en: This postcard came from my cousin in the mountains.
ex.zh: 这张明信片是住在山区的表亲寄来的。

ex.en: Students from rural communities may face additional barriers when applying to universities in major cities.
ex.zh: 来自农村社区的学生申请大城市的大学时，可能面临额外障碍。

col: from start to finish｜从头到尾
tip: from表示起点，常与表示终点的to搭配。

senses.en: At a fast speed or after only a short time.

ex.en: We quickly packed our bags when the taxi arrived.
ex.zh: 出租车一到，我们就迅速收拾好了行李。

ex.en: Cities must respond quickly to extreme weather events to protect vulnerable residents and maintain essential services.
ex.zh: 城市必须迅速应对极端天气事件，以保护弱势居民并维持基本服务。

tip: quickly是副词，修饰动作；quick是形容词，修饰名词。

senses.en: a smaller amount of something
to a smaller degree or extent
a smaller amount

ex.en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
ex.zh: 这次请在我的茶里少放点糖。

ex.en: Households can use less energy by improving insulation and choosing appliances that consume electricity more efficiently.
ex.zh: 家庭可以通过改善隔热措施和选用更节能的电器来减少能源消耗。

tip: 修饰不可数名词用less；可数名词复数通常用fewer。

senses.en: Damaged by being split or separated into pieces.
Not working properly because of damage.
Spoken with difficulty and frequent pauses or errors.

ex.en: She carefully swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
ex.zh: 她小心地把碎玻璃扫进簸箕里。

ex.en: Repairing broken household appliances rather than replacing them can reduce waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
ex.zh: 维修损坏的家用电器而非更换它们，可以减少废弃物并节约宝贵的自然资源。

col: a broken promise｜未兑现的承诺
tip: 也是break的过去分词；过去式为broke。

senses.en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees

ex.en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走进森林深处。

ex.en: Protecting natural forests helps preserve biodiversity and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 保护天然森林有助于维护生物多样性，并减少大气中的二氧化碳含量。

tip: forest通常指大片森林；wood也可指较小树林。

senses.en: finely chopped meat enclosed in a thin, tube-shaped skin

ex.en: We grilled sausages and served them with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们烤了香肠，配上新鲜蔬菜端上桌。

ex.en: Consumers are increasingly choosing vegetarian sausages as they seek alternatives to traditional meat products.
ex.zh: 随着消费者寻找传统肉制品的替代品，越来越多人开始选择素香肠。

tip: 单根香肠可数；sausage meat指香肠肉馅，不可数。

senses.en: Something people do for enjoyment, learning, or a particular purpose.
The state of being busy or doing things.

ex.en: Painting is my favourite activity on rainy afternoons.
ex.zh: 下雨的午后，我最喜欢的活动是画画。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several long-term illnesses.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以改善心理健康，并降低患多种慢性疾病的风险。

tip: 具体活动可数；泛指活跃或活动量时不可数。

senses.en: an animal like a small horse with long ears

ex.en: A grey donkey carried baskets along the narrow mountain path.
ex.zh: 一头灰驴驮着篮子走在狭窄的山路上。

ex.en: In some rural communities, donkeys remain important for transporting goods where roads are unsuitable for vehicles.
ex.zh: 在一些乡村社区，道路不适合车辆通行，驴仍是运输货物的重要工具。

tip: 指动物时donkey最常用；用来称呼人有贬义。

senses.en: A settlement usually larger than a village but smaller than a city
The central area where people go shopping or do business

ex.en: Our town has a bakery beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们镇的老桥旁有一家面包店。

ex.en: Improving public transport in a small town can help residents access jobs and essential services.
ex.zh: 改善小城镇的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会和基本服务。

tip: go into town指去市中心，此时town前不加冠词。

senses.en: living or growing naturally, without human care
showing strong excitement or uncontrolled behaviour
natural places where animals and plants live freely

ex.en: We spotted wild deer drinking beside the forest stream.
ex.zh: 我们看见野鹿在森林的小溪旁喝水。

ex.en: Protecting wild animals requires governments to preserve habitats and reduce illegal trade across national borders.
ex.zh: 保护野生动物需要各国政府保护栖息地，并减少跨境非法贸易。

tip: 表示“在野外”用in the wild，不能漏掉the。

senses.en: not having, using, or being accompanied by someone or something
not doing the action mentioned

ex.en: I left the house without my keys this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我出门时没带钥匙。

ex.en: Cities cannot achieve lasting reductions in air pollution without investing in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 如果不投资可靠的公共交通，城市就无法持久地减少空气污染。

col: without saying a word｜一言不发地
tip: without 是介词，后接名词、代词或动词-ing。

senses.en: informal word for father

ex.en: My dad cooks dinner on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我爸爸周日做晚饭。

ex.en: Dad, can I play outside?
ex.zh: 爸爸，我能去外面玩吗？

tip: dad 是口语中称呼爸爸的常用词；mum 是妈妈。
scene: A father cooking in a kitchen while a child watches happily.

senses.en: an image made by drawing, painting, or taking a photograph
an idea or description of what a situation is like
to form an image of someone or something in your mind

ex.en: She hung a picture of the sea above her bed.
ex.zh: 她在床头上方挂了一幅海景画。

ex.en: Survey results provide a clearer picture of how housing costs affect the wellbeing of young adults.
ex.zh: 调查结果更清楚地呈现了住房成本如何影响年轻成年人的幸福感。

col: picture yourself doing something｜想象自己做某事
tip: take a picture是拍照；draw a picture是画画。

senses.en: a young person who has not yet become an adult
someone's son or daughter, regardless of age

ex.en: The child carefully carried a bowl of water outside.
ex.zh: 那个孩子小心翼翼地端着一碗水走到外面。

ex.en: Every child should have access to quality education, regardless of family income or place of residence.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都应享有优质教育，不论其家庭收入或居住地点如何。

tip: 复数是children；childish偏贬义，childlike指天真如孩童。

senses.en: the middle part of a city where shops and offices are

ex.en: The museum is in the city centre.
ex.zh: 博物馆在市中心。

ex.en: We took the bus to the city centre.
ex.zh: 我们坐公交车去市中心。

tip: city centre 是英式说法；美式常说 downtown。
scene: A busy city centre street with shops, a museum and people walking.

senses.en: The currency used by many countries in the European Union.

ex.en: I found a euro in my coat pocket today.
ex.zh: 今天我在外套口袋里发现了一枚一欧元硬币。

ex.en: Using the euro allows tourists to visit several European countries without exchanging money at each border.
ex.zh: 使用欧元让游客能够游览多个欧洲国家，而不必每过一次边境就兑换货币。

tip: 普通英语中复数通常为euros；并非所有欧盟国家都用欧元。

senses.en: Caring about others and willing to help them.
A group of things sharing similar features.

ex.en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
ex.zh: 我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to be kind to others, helping create a more supportive learning environment.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生善待他人，帮助营造更有支持性的学习环境。

col: be kind to someone｜善待某人
tip: 形容词常接to；种类用a kind of加名词。

senses.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for books.

ex.en: She keeps her favourite novels in a wooden bookcase.
ex.zh: 她把最喜欢的小说放在一个木书柜里。

ex.en: Placing accessible bookcases in classrooms can encourage children to read independently during their free time.
ex.zh: 在教室里摆放方便取书的书柜，可以鼓励孩子在空闲时间自主阅读。

col: a bookcase full of books｜装满书的书柜
tip: bookcase指整件书柜，bookshelf指书架或一层搁板。

senses.en: a tool with bristles used for cleaning, painting or arranging hair
to clean, paint or arrange something using a brush
to touch something lightly while moving past it

ex.en: Use a soft brush to clean your muddy shoes.
ex.zh: 用软毛刷清理你沾满泥的鞋子。

ex.en: Children should learn to brush their teeth properly, as good habits can prevent many dental problems.
ex.zh: 儿童应学会正确刷牙，因为良好的习惯可以预防许多牙齿问题。

tip: brush against表示轻擦；brush up on表示温习。

senses.en: outside a building, in the open air
the natural world away from buildings

ex.en: The weather is warm enough to eat outdoors tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚天气够暖和，可以在户外吃饭。

ex.en: Spending time outdoors can improve children's wellbeing and encourage greater interest in protecting the natural environment.
ex.zh: 在户外活动能改善儿童的身心健康，并增强他们保护自然环境的兴趣。

tip: outdoors是副词；修饰名词用outdoor，如outdoor activities。

senses.en: Easy to understand or do; not complicated.
Plain and without unnecessary decoration or extra features.

ex.en: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
ex.zh: 这道简单的菜只需十分钟就能做好。

ex.en: Schools should provide simple instructions so that all students can complete classroom tasks independently.
ex.zh: 学校应提供简单易懂的说明，让所有学生都能独立完成课堂任务。

tip: simple可指容易或朴素，不一定表示简陋。

senses.en: not anything; no thing at all
not at all, used to strengthen certain comparisons

ex.en: I opened the fridge, but there was nothing inside.
ex.zh: 我打开冰箱，里面却什么也没有。

ex.en: Without affordable public transport, some residents have nothing to rely on except their own cars.
ex.zh: 如果没有价格合理的公共交通，一些居民除了自己的汽车便无可依靠。

tip: nothing本身含否定意义，通常不再与not连用。

senses.en: the day after Monday and before Wednesday

ex.en: We usually have dinner together on Tuesday evenings.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期二晚上一起吃饭。

ex.en: The community centre offers free language classes every Tuesday to help newcomers settle into the area.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周二提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者适应当地生活。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；every Tuesday前不用on。

senses.en: Up to now, especially in questions and negative statements.
But, despite what has just been stated.
Used to emphasize a further increase or addition.

ex.en: I haven't finished dinner yet, so please wait.
ex.zh: 我还没吃完晚饭，请等一下。

ex.en: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper, yet many countries still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源正在变得更便宜，然而许多国家仍严重依赖化石燃料。

tip: 表示“还未”常用于否定句末；疑问句中可表示“已经”。

senses.en: Below the ground, or operating secretly.
Below the ground, or in a hidden, secret way.
A railway system running mainly beneath a city.

ex.en: We left our car in an underground garage.
ex.zh: 我们把车停在了地下车库。

ex.en: Underground transport systems can ease congestion, although constructing tunnels requires substantial investment and careful planning.
ex.zh: 地铁交通系统能缓解拥堵，但隧道建设需要大量投资和周密规划。

tip: 名词表地铁主要用于英式英语，此时重音在首音节。

senses.en: unwilling to work or make an effort
relaxed and involving little activity

ex.en: I felt too lazy to cook dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我懒得做饭。

ex.en: Students who struggle with homework should not automatically be considered lazy, as learning difficulties may be involved.
ex.zh: 不应一概认为做作业有困难的学生懒惰，因为这可能涉及学习障碍。

tip: lazy afternoon指悠闲的午后，不一定含贬义。

senses.en: used to ask about the reason for something
introduces the reason for a situation or action

ex.en: Why are your shoes still wet this morning?
ex.zh: 为什么你的鞋今天早上还是湿的？

ex.en: Researchers need to understand why some students leave education before completing their secondary school qualifications.
ex.zh: 研究人员需要了解，为什么有些学生尚未取得中学学历就离开了学校。

tip: 间接疑问句用陈述语序：I know why he left。

senses.en: Making someone feel afraid or nervous.

ex.en: That scary noise was just a branch against the window.
ex.zh: 那个吓人的声音只不过是树枝在碰窗户。

ex.en: Starting school can be scary for young children, so teachers should create a welcoming environment.
ex.zh: 开始上学可能让年幼的孩子害怕，因此教师应营造友善的环境。

tip: scary形容事物吓人；scared形容人感到害怕。

senses.en: a covering worn on the head for protection or decoration

ex.en: I grabbed my hat before stepping into the sunshine.
ex.zh: 走到阳光下之前，我拿起了帽子。

ex.en: Wearing a wide-brimmed hat can reduce sun exposure, particularly for people who spend long hours working outdoors.
ex.zh: 戴宽檐帽可以减少日晒，对长时间在户外工作的人尤其有用。

tip: 戴着帽子用wear；戴上帽子的动作用put on。

senses.en: A structure animals build to hold eggs or raise their young.
Build or occupy a nest.

ex.en: A small bird carried twigs to its nest.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟把细树枝衔回巢里。

ex.en: Protecting trees where rare birds nest is essential for maintaining biodiversity in areas affected by urban development.
ex.zh: 在受城市开发影响的地区，保护珍稀鸟类筑巢的树木对维持生物多样性至关重要。

tip: nest既可作名词鸟巢，也可作动词筑巢。

senses.en: A person who works, especially for pay.

ex.en: A worker in orange overalls repaired the broken fence.
ex.zh: 一名穿橙色工作服的工人修好了破损的围栏。

ex.en: Employers should provide every worker with appropriate training and equipment to reduce the risk of workplace injuries.
ex.zh: 雇主应为每位员工提供适当的培训和设备，以降低工伤风险。

tip: 不只指体力劳动者，也可指医护等职业工作者。

senses.en: the son of your son or daughter

ex.en: Her grandson visits every Sunday and helps with cooking.
ex.zh: 她的孙子每周日都来看她，并帮忙做饭。

ex.en: Regular contact with a grandson or granddaughter can help older adults feel more socially connected.
ex.zh: 经常与孙辈联系能帮助老年人增强与社会的联系感。

col: youngest grandson｜最小的孙子或外孙
eldest grandson｜最大的孙子或外孙
tip: 不区分父系与母系，既指孙子也指外孙。

senses.zh: 在任何地方；去任何地方
senses.en: in or to any place
in any place, used in questions and negative statements

ex.en: You can sit anywhere you like in this room.
ex.zh: 在这个房间里，你想坐哪儿都行。

ex.en: Reliable internet access allows employees to work from anywhere, reducing the need for daily commuting.
ex.zh: 可靠的网络连接使员工能够在任何地方工作，减少了每天通勤的必要。

tip: 不定副词，通常不直接作名词；anywhere else指别处。

senses.en: a piece of jewellery worn on the ear

ex.en: She wears gold earrings to the party.
ex.zh: 她戴着金耳环去参加聚会。

ex.en: I lost one of my earrings.
ex.zh: 我丢了一只耳环。

tip: earring 复数 earrings；一对耳环说 a pair of earrings。
scene: A pair of gold earrings lying on a jewellery box on a dressing table.

senses.en: To continue having something rather than giving it away.
To stay, or make something stay, in a particular state.
To continue doing something or do it repeatedly.

ex.en: You can keep the umbrella until the rain stops.
ex.zh: 雨停之前，你可以继续留着这把伞用。

ex.en: Governments should keep public transport affordable to encourage residents to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 政府应使公共交通保持价格实惠，鼓励居民不开私家车出行。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为kept；继续做用keep doing。

senses.en: happening later than planned

ex.en: The train is delayed by twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 火车延误二十分钟。

ex.en: Our flight was delayed because of the weather.
ex.zh: 我们的航班因为天气延误了。

tip: delayed 常用于交通：航班/火车延误。注意：延迟的航班说 delayed flight。
scene: An airport screen showing a delayed flight next to a waiting passenger.

senses.en: On the side opposite the right.
Towards or on the side opposite the right.
Still available or remaining after others have gone or been used.

ex.en: I carry my shopping bag in my left hand.
ex.zh: 我用左手提购物袋。

ex.en: Drivers should check their mirrors carefully before turning left, especially where cyclists share the road.
ex.zh: 驾驶员左转前应仔细查看后视镜，尤其是在与骑行者共用道路的地方。

tip: 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词；表剩余时置于名词后。

senses.en: The sport of riding waves while standing on a board.
The activity of browsing websites on the internet.

ex.en: We went surfing at the beach early this morning.
ex.zh: 今天一大早我们去海滩冲浪了。

ex.en: The growing popularity of surfing can support coastal economies while increasing pressure on fragile marine environments.
ex.zh: 冲浪运动日益流行，既能促进沿海经济，也会加大脆弱海洋环境承受的压力。

tip: 运动用go surfing；网上浏览也可说surf the internet。

senses.en: to move something into a particular place or position
to express something in a particular way
to cause someone or something to enter a particular state

ex.en: Please put your wet umbrella beside the door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿雨伞放在门旁边。

ex.en: Rising housing costs put considerable pressure on young people who are starting their careers.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本给刚开始职业生涯的年轻人带来很大压力。

col: put something in place｜落实某项安排
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为put；放置义通常需接地点。

senses.en: the day after Saturday and before Monday

ex.en: We usually cook a big lunch together on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期日一起做一顿丰盛的午餐。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Sunday allows people with busy weekday schedules to access essential community services.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆星期日开放，让工作日忙碌的人也能享用重要的社区服务。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；on Sunday，但next Sunday不用on。

senses.en: To prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost.
To use less of something or keep money for later.
To keep something for future use, especially computer data.

ex.en: The lifeguard saved a child from the deep water.
ex.zh: 救生员从深水中救起了一个孩子。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can save commuters time and reduce household travel costs.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以节省通勤者的时间，并降低家庭出行成本。

tip: save money既可指省钱，也可指存钱。

senses.en: used to say something is possible

ex.en: She might come to the party, but she's not sure.
ex.zh: 她可能会来参加聚会，但还不确定。

ex.en: It might snow tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天可能会下雪。

tip: might 表示可能性，比 may 更不确定。
scene: A girl looking at a cloudy sky wondering if it might snow.

senses.en: a lightweight manufactured material that can form many different shapes
made of plastic
able to be shaped or changed easily

ex.en: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
ex.zh: 这个午餐盒由结实的再生塑料制成。

ex.en: Reducing single-use plastic packaging could protect marine ecosystems and lower the costs of managing household waste.
ex.zh: 减少一次性塑料包装可以保护海洋生态系统，并降低生活垃圾处理成本。

tip: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

senses.en: Unusual or unexpected in a way that seems surprising
Not known or experienced before

ex.en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
ex.zh: 橱柜里传出一阵奇怪的声音。

ex.en: Customs that seem strange to visitors may reflect important social values within the local community.
ex.zh: 在游客看来奇怪的习俗，可能体现了当地社区重要的社会价值观。

tip: strange 可指奇怪，也可指陌生；stranger 是陌生人。

senses.en: Most recent or newest.
The most recent news, developments, or products.

ex.en: Have you heard the latest news about our neighbour?
ex.zh: 你听说关于我们邻居的最新消息了吗？

ex.en: The latest research suggests that regular physical activity can improve both memory and mental health.
ex.zh: 最新研究表明，规律运动可以改善记忆力和心理健康。

tip: latest指最新；last常指上一个或最后一个。

senses.en: a long reptile without legs
to move or extend along a winding path

ex.en: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
ex.zh: 一条小蛇悄悄滑过干草丛。

ex.en: Although snakes often cause fear, they help maintain ecological balance by controlling populations of rodents and other animals.
ex.zh: 虽然蛇常令人恐惧，但它们通过控制啮齿动物及其他动物的数量，帮助维持生态平衡。

tip: 作动词表示蜿蜒，常搭配through或along。

senses.en: a tall cupboard used for storing clothes
all the clothes that a person owns

ex.en: Her winter coats fill most of the wardrobe.
ex.zh: 她的冬季外套占了衣柜的大部分空间。

ex.en: Building a smaller wardrobe with durable clothing can reduce the environmental impact of fashion consumption.
ex.zh: 减少衣物数量并选择耐穿的服装，可以降低时尚消费对环境的影响。

tip: 既指衣柜，也可指某人拥有的全部衣物。

senses.en: a document showing that something has been paid for
the act of receiving something
money received by a business or organisation

ex.en: Keep your receipt in case the shoes don't fit.
ex.zh: 留好收据，以防鞋子不合脚。

ex.en: Businesses should issue a receipt for every purchase to protect consumers and maintain accurate financial records.
ex.zh: 商家应为每笔购买开具收据，以保护消费者并保留准确的财务记录。

tip: p不发音；表示收入时通常用复数receipts。

senses.en: a building where people pay to stay in rooms

ex.en: Our hotel room overlooks a quiet sandy beach.
ex.zh: 我们住的酒店房间可以俯瞰一片宁静的沙滩。

ex.en: Building a new hotel near the station could create jobs and attract more visitors to the area.
ex.zh: 在车站附近新建一家酒店可以创造就业机会，并吸引更多游客前来。

tip: 表示住酒店可用stay at或stay in a hotel。

senses.en: to become husband and wife

ex.en: They are going to get married next spring.
ex.zh: 他们明年春天要结婚了。

ex.en: My cousin got married last weekend.
ex.zh: 我表哥上周末结婚了。

tip: get married 表示“结婚”的动作；be married 表示“已婚”状态。
scene: A happy couple in wedding clothes cutting a cake in a garden.

senses.en: Clothing hanging from the waist, without separate sections for legs.
To move around the edge of something.
To avoid dealing directly with a difficult subject.

ex.en: Her blue skirt swayed as she walked upstairs.
ex.zh: 她上楼时，蓝色裙子轻轻摆动。

ex.en: Public discussions often skirt the issue of who should pay for environmental protection.
ex.zh: 公共讨论往往回避谁应承担环保费用这一问题。

col: skirt the edge of｜沿……边缘行进
tip: skirt是裙子；dress通常指连衣裙。

senses.en: to become an adult

ex.en: She grew up in a small town near the sea.
ex.zh: 她在海边的一个小镇长大。

ex.en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
ex.zh: 你长大后想做什么？

tip: grow up 表示“长大成人”；grown-up 是名词“成年人”。
scene: A photo album showing a baby growing into a smiling adult.

senses.en: An edge or surface of something, or the space beside it.
One aspect of something or one group in a disagreement.
To support one person or group in a disagreement.

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the side door.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在侧门旁。

ex.en: Public debates should consider both sides of an issue before any major policy decision is made.
ex.zh: 在作出任何重大政策决定之前，公共讨论都应考虑问题的正反两面。

col: the other side of the argument｜争论的另一面
tip: side with表示支持某方；side by side表示并排。

senses.en: A hoofed animal, often with horns, kept for milk or meat.

ex.en: A curious goat poked its head through the fence.
ex.zh: 一只好奇的山羊把头探出了围栏。

ex.en: Raising goats can provide rural families with a reliable source of milk and additional income.
ex.zh: 饲养山羊可以为农村家庭提供稳定的奶源和额外收入。

col: a herd of goats｜一群山羊
tip: goat是山羊，sheep是绵羊；替罪羊用scapegoat。

senses.en: Attractive and pleasant to look at.
To a fairly large degree, especially in informal speech.

ex.en: We found a pretty cottage beside a quiet stream.
ex.zh: 我们在一条安静的小溪边发现了一座漂亮的小屋。

ex.en: Although pretty public gardens attract visitors, cities must also ensure that these spaces remain accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 虽然漂亮的公共花园能吸引游客，但城市也必须确保居民能方便地使用这些空间。

col: a pretty dress｜漂亮的连衣裙
tip: 作副词表示“相当”时偏口语，正式写作可用fairly。

senses.en: To reach the place you were travelling to.
For an event or a particular time to come.

ex.en: Our guests arrived just as dinner was ready.
ex.zh: 我们的客人恰好在晚饭准备好时到了。

ex.en: Reliable public transport helps employees arrive at work on time and reduces dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通有助于员工准时上班，并减少对私家车的依赖。

col: arrive at the station｜到达车站
arrive in a city｜抵达城市
arrive at a conclusion｜得出结论
tip: 小地点用 at，城市国家用 in；home 前不加介词。

senses.en: more than is wanted, needed, or suitable
in addition; also

ex.en: This soup is too hot to eat now.
ex.zh: 这汤现在太烫，还不能喝。

ex.en: Public transport cannot attract more passengers if fares are too high for regular commuters.
ex.zh: 如果票价对日常通勤者而言过高，公共交通就无法吸引更多乘客。

col: too tired to work｜累得无法工作
tip: too强调超过合适程度；very只强调程度高。

senses.en: Easy to understand, see, or hear
Free from cloud, dirt, or anything blocking light
To remove unwanted things from a place

ex.en: The instructions were clear, so I assembled the shelf easily.
ex.zh: 说明很清楚，所以我轻松地组装好了架子。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should provide clear advice that people from different educational backgrounds can easily understand.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传应提供明确的建议，让不同教育背景的人都能轻松理解。

col: crystal clear｜清澈透明的；非常清楚的
tip: make it clear that…表示明确说明……。

senses.en: A website or page with regularly added posts.
To write and publish posts on a blog.

ex.en: She writes a blog about growing vegetables at home.
ex.zh: 她写一个介绍在家种菜的博客。

ex.en: A well-researched blog can make scientific information more accessible to readers without specialist knowledge.
ex.zh: 一个研究充分的博客可以让没有专业知识的读者更容易理解科学信息。

col: blog about something｜写关于某事的博客
tip: 一篇博文叫a blog post；blog常指整个博客。

senses.en: using electronic systems that store and process information as digits

ex.en: She keeps digital copies of all her family photos.
ex.zh: 她保存着所有家庭照片的电子副本。

ex.en: Improving digital skills can help older adults access public services and maintain contact with distant relatives.
ex.zh: 提高数字技能可以帮助老年人使用公共服务，并与远方亲属保持联系。

tip: digital侧重数字技术；表示“数字上的”常用numerical。

senses.en: Showing respect and consideration for other people.

ex.en: The polite child held the door open for us.
ex.zh: 那个有礼貌的孩子为我们扶着门。

ex.en: Polite communication in the workplace can reduce misunderstandings and help employees build stronger professional relationships.
ex.zh: 职场中的礼貌沟通可以减少误解，并帮助员工建立更牢固的工作关系。

col: polite to someone｜对某人有礼貌
tip: 对某人有礼貌用be polite to，不用polite with。

senses.en: A hard, usually transparent material used for windows and containers.
A drinking container, or the amount it holds.
Lenses held in a frame worn to improve sight.

ex.en: The ball hit the window and shattered the glass.
ex.zh: 球砸中了窗户，把玻璃打碎了。

ex.en: Recycling glass reduces demand for raw materials and can lower energy consumption in the manufacturing sector.
ex.zh: 回收玻璃能减少对原材料的需求，并可降低制造业的能源消耗。

tip: 玻璃不可数，玻璃杯可数；眼镜用复数glasses。

senses.en: Used to connect alternatives or choices
Used to introduce what happens if something is not done

ex.en: Would you like rice or noodles with your vegetables?
ex.zh: 蔬菜配米饭还是面条，你想选哪一种？

ex.en: Governments must improve public transport or face increasing congestion and air pollution in major cities.
ex.zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则大城市将面临日益严重的拥堵和空气污染。

tip: 否定句中连接并列项常用or，不用and。

senses.en: A very large sea mammal that breathes air.

ex.en: A whale surfaced beside our boat and sprayed water.
ex.zh: 一头鲸在我们船旁浮出水面，喷出了水雾。

ex.en: Protecting whale populations requires international cooperation because these marine mammals migrate across vast areas of ocean.
ex.zh: 保护鲸类种群需要国际合作，因为这些海洋哺乳动物会跨越广阔海域迁徙。

tip: 鲸是哺乳动物，不是鱼；复数通常为whales。

senses.en: eggs beaten and cooked flat in a pan

ex.en: She made a cheese omelette for breakfast.
ex.zh: 她做了奶酪煎蛋卷当早餐。

ex.en: I'd like an omelette with mushrooms, please.
ex.zh: 请给我一份蘑菇煎蛋卷。

tip: omelette 是摊开的煎蛋饼，可加奶酪、蔬菜等。
scene: A golden omelette with cheese on a plate on a breakfast table.

senses.en: the sport of riding waves on a surfboard

ex.en: Surfboarding is popular at the seaside.
ex.zh: 海边很流行冲浪。

ex.en: She practises surfboarding every summer.
ex.zh: 她每年夏天练习冲浪。

tip: surfboarding 与 surfing 都指冲浪运动。
scene: A surfer riding a big wave on a surfboard at the beach.

senses.en: A device that captures sound for recording or making it louder.

ex.en: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear.
ex.zh: 请对着麦克风讲话，让大家都能听见。

ex.en: Using a microphone during lectures can help students hear clearly, particularly in large classrooms with poor acoustics.
ex.zh: 讲课时使用麦克风可以帮助学生听清内容，尤其是在声学条件较差的大教室里。

col: speak into a microphone｜对着麦克风讲话
tip: microphone收音；speaker播放声音，勿混淆。

senses.en: a musical instrument played by hitting its stretched surface
a large cylindrical container for storing liquids or other materials
to play a drum or tap something repeatedly

ex.en: The little boy beat the drum with both hands.
ex.zh: 小男孩用双手敲鼓。

ex.en: Learning to play the drum can help children develop coordination and participate in group performances.
ex.zh: 学习打鼓能帮助儿童培养协调能力，并参与集体表演。

tip: play the drums常指打鼓；drum也可指大圆桶。

senses.en: on one occasion only
at a time in the past
as soon as something happens or becomes true

ex.en: I water this little cactus once every two weeks.
ex.zh: 我每两周给这株小仙人掌浇一次水。

ex.en: Once reliable public transport becomes available, more commuters may choose to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 一旦有了可靠的公共交通，更多通勤者可能会选择不开车出门。

tip: once引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: treating people equally or reasonably
having pale skin or light hair
an event where people display or sell goods and services

ex.en: We took turns choosing games to keep things fair.
ex.zh: 我们轮流选游戏，以保证公平。

ex.en: A fair education system should give every child access to quality teaching, regardless of family income.
ex.zh: 公平的教育制度应让每个孩子都能获得优质教学，不受家庭收入影响。

tip: fair指待遇公平；fairly还可表示“相当”。

senses.en: a clothing item covering the foot and lower leg

ex.en: One blue sock was hiding under the bed.
ex.zh: 一只蓝袜子藏在床底下。

ex.en: Choosing durable socks made from recycled materials can help consumers reduce clothing waste over time.
ex.zh: 选择用再生材料制作的耐穿袜子，有助于消费者逐渐减少衣物浪费。

col: a pair of socks｜一双袜子
tip: 一双袜子说a pair of socks，sock为可数名词。

senses.en: a written message sent to a person or organisation
a written symbol representing a sound in an alphabet

ex.en: A letter from my sister arrived this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我收到了姐姐寄来的信。

ex.en: Writing a formal letter of complaint can encourage companies to address problems with their services.
ex.zh: 撰写正式投诉信可以促使企业处理其服务中存在的问题。

tip: letter既指信，也指字母；character还可指汉字等字符。

senses.en: Not good in quality or not satisfactory.
Serious, unpleasant, or likely to cause harm.
Behaving wrongly or breaking accepted rules.

ex.en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。

ex.en: Bad air quality can discourage outdoor exercise and increase health risks among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会使人减少户外锻炼，并增加儿童和老年人的健康风险。

col: bad for your health｜有害健康
tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；badly是副词。

senses.en: to return to a place, or to get something again

ex.en: What time did you get back from school?
ex.zh: 你几点从学校回来的？

ex.en: I got my money back from the shop.
ex.zh: 我从商店拿回了钱。

tip: get back 可指“返回”或“收回”；get back home 回家。
scene: A girl walking back home through the front door carrying a school bag.

senses.en: The activity or skill of producing words on a surface.
The way someone's handwritten words look.
Written work, especially books, articles or literary material.

ex.en: I do most of my writing before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我的写作大多在早餐前完成。

ex.en: Regular writing practice helps students organise complex ideas and communicate their arguments more clearly.
ex.zh: 经常练习写作有助于学生组织复杂的想法，并更清楚地表达论点。

tip: writing通常不可数；也是write的现在分词，需去e。

senses.en: On or towards a higher floor of a building.
Located on a higher floor of a building.

ex.en: I left my glasses upstairs beside the bed.
ex.zh: 我把眼镜落在楼上的床边了。

ex.en: Moving bedrooms upstairs can provide greater privacy in homes where the ground floor is used for work.
ex.zh: 在底层用于办公的住宅中，把卧室搬到楼上可以提供更多私密空间。

tip: 作副词时前面不加to：go upstairs。

senses.en: a game where players hit a small ball over a net on a table

ex.en: We play table tennis in the school hall.
ex.zh: 我们在学校大厅里打乒乓球。

ex.en: Table tennis is a fast and exciting game.
ex.zh: 乒乓球是一项快速刺激的运动。

tip: table tennis 即乒乓球，也叫 ping-pong。
scene: Two players playing table tennis with paddles and a small white ball.

senses.en: a polite greeting used in the morning

ex.en: Good morning, class!
ex.zh: 同学们，早上好！

ex.en: She wished us good morning as we came in.
ex.zh: 我们进来时她向我们问早安。

tip: good morning 用于早晨的问候（到中午前）。
scene: A teacher greeting students with a smile at the classroom door in the morning.

senses.en: The part of your face used for smelling and breathing.
The front part of an aircraft or similar vehicle.

ex.en: My nose turned red in the cold wind.
ex.zh: 我的鼻子在冷风中冻红了。

ex.en: Wearing a mask over the nose and mouth can reduce exposure to airborne dust.
ex.zh: 戴口罩遮住口鼻可以减少吸入空气中的灰尘。

col: the nose of an aircraft｜飞机机头
tip: 擤鼻涕用blow your nose，不用clean。

senses.en: a breakfast food made from grains, often eaten with milk
a plant grown for grain, or the grain it produces

ex.en: She poured cold milk over her bowl of cereal.
ex.zh: 她把冷牛奶倒进盛着早餐麦片的碗里。

ex.en: Farmers may need to grow different cereal crops as changing rainfall patterns affect agricultural production.
ex.zh: 随着降雨模式变化影响农业生产，农民可能需要种植不同的谷类作物。

col: a bowl of cereal｜一碗麦片
tip: 早餐食品泛指时常不可数；指谷物种类可用cereals。

senses.en: A small animal with six legs and three main body sections.

ex.en: A tiny green insect landed on my sleeve.
ex.zh: 一只绿色的小昆虫落在了我的袖子上。

ex.en: Many insect species pollinate crops, making their protection essential for food production and healthy ecosystems.
ex.zh: 许多昆虫物种为农作物授粉，因此保护它们对粮食生产和健康的生态系统至关重要。

tip: 可数名词；蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于昆虫。

senses.en: a card mailed without an envelope, often showing a picture

ex.en: She sent me a postcard from a seaside village.
ex.zh: 她从一个海边村庄给我寄来了一张明信片。

ex.en: Although digital messages are faster, sending a postcard can create a more personal connection between travellers and their families.
ex.zh: 虽然电子信息传递得更快，但寄明信片能让旅行者与家人之间的联系更具人情味。

tip: 寄给某人可说send someone a postcard或用to引出收件人。

senses.en: Communication with someone, or physical touching between things.
To communicate with someone by calling, writing, or another method.
Someone you know who can offer help or information.

ex.en: Please contact the receptionist if you lose your key.
ex.zh: 如果你丢了钥匙，请联系接待员。

ex.en: Regular contact with family members can reduce loneliness among older people who live alone.
ex.zh: 经常与家人联系可以减轻独居老年人的孤独感。

col: keep in contact with｜与……保持联系
tip: 动词contact直接接人，不加with；名词后可加with。

senses.en: A person responsible for running a business, team, or department.

ex.en: The manager helped a new employee arrange the shelves.
ex.zh: 经理帮一位新员工整理了货架。

ex.en: An effective manager encourages open communication and ensures that employees have sufficient resources to complete their tasks.
ex.zh: 高效的管理者鼓励开放沟通，并确保员工有充足的资源完成任务。

tip: manager指管理者；management可指管理工作或管理层。

senses.en: the body part containing the brain, eyes, and mouth
the person in charge of a group or organisation
to move or travel in a particular direction

ex.en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
ex.zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。

ex.en: Cyclists should wear suitable helmets to reduce the risk of head injuries when travelling on busy roads.
ex.zh: 骑车人在繁忙道路上行驶时应佩戴合适的头盔，以降低头部受伤的风险。

tip: head for＋地点表示“朝某地去”。

senses.en: On the day before today.
The day immediately before today.

ex.en: I left my umbrella on the bus yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天把雨伞落在公交车上了。

ex.en: The transport survey published yesterday suggests that commuters increasingly prefer cycling to driving in city centres.
ex.zh: 昨天发布的交通调查表明，在市中心通勤的人越来越倾向于骑车而非开车。

tip: yesterday前通常不用介词，常与一般过去时连用。

senses.en: A woman who serves food and drinks in a restaurant.

ex.en: The waitress brought us warm bread and fresh soup.
ex.zh: 女服务员给我们端来了温热的面包和新鲜的汤。

ex.en: Working as a waitress can help students develop communication skills while earning money to support their studies.
ex.zh: 当餐厅服务员能帮助学生培养沟通能力，同时赚钱支付学习费用。

col: work as a waitress｜当女服务员
a friendly waitress｜友善的女服务员
ask the waitress｜询问女服务员
tip: waitress特指女性；server可不区分性别。

senses.en: A thing that is not named or specified.

ex.en: There is something soft inside this little box.
ex.zh: 这个小盒子里有个柔软的东西。

ex.en: Learning something new every day can help adults remain curious and adapt to changes in the workplace.
ex.zh: 每天学习一点新东西，有助于成年人保持好奇心并适应职场变化。

tip: 修饰词放后面，如something useful；作主语用单数。

senses.en: An animal kept at home for company and pleasure.
To gently touch an animal with your hand.

ex.en: Our pet rabbit loves hiding under the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们的宠物兔喜欢躲在厨房桌子下面。

ex.en: Caring for a pet can help children develop responsibility and learn to recognise the needs of others.
ex.zh: 照顾宠物能帮助儿童培养责任感，并学会察觉他人的需求。

tip: 动词过去式为petted；英式英语中抚摸也常用stroke。

senses.en: without anyone else present
without other people or their help
only, excluding everything or everyone else

ex.en: I was alone in the kitchen when the kettle boiled.
ex.zh: 水壶里的水烧开时，厨房里只有我一个人。

ex.en: Governments cannot solve environmental problems alone, as lasting progress also requires cooperation from businesses and individual citizens.
ex.zh: 政府无法独力解决环境问题，因为持久的进步也需要企业和公民个人的合作。

tip: alone指独自，不一定孤独；lonely强调孤独感。

senses.en: very angry
behaving or thinking in an unreasonable or foolish way
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something

ex.en: Dad was mad because I broke his favourite cup.
ex.zh: 爸爸很生气，因为我打碎了他最喜欢的杯子。

ex.en: Although some residents are mad about football, public sports funding should support a wider range of activities.
ex.zh: 虽然一些居民热衷足球，但公共体育资金应支持更广泛的活动。

tip: mad at表示生气；mad about可表示痴迷。

senses.en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal.
An organised event in which people try to win.

ex.en: Our school is holding a painting competition next Friday.
ex.zh: 我们学校下周五要举办绘画比赛。

ex.en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
ex.zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。

tip: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

senses.en: To end an activity or prevent something from happening.
A place where buses or other vehicles regularly collect passengers.
An interruption of movement or a brief stay somewhere.

ex.en: We stopped walking when the rain became heavier.
ex.zh: 雨越下越大，我们便停下了脚步。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to stop traffic congestion from becoming worse as populations grow.
ex.zh: 随着人口增长，城市应改善公共交通，防止交通拥堵进一步恶化。

col: stop someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
tip: stop doing是停止做；stop to do是停下去做。

senses.en: A period away from work or study for rest or travel.
An officially recognised day when many people do not work.
To spend time away from home for pleasure.

ex.en: We spent our holiday swimming and exploring quiet villages.
ex.zh: 我们假期里游泳，还探访了宁静的村庄。

ex.en: Flexible holiday arrangements can improve employee wellbeing while allowing businesses to maintain essential services throughout the year.
ex.zh: 灵活的休假安排可以改善员工福祉，同时让企业全年维持基本服务。

tip: 英式on holiday指度假；美式通常说on vacation。

senses.en: The forward part or outward-facing surface of something.
Located at or near the forward part of something.
A boundary where masses of warm and cold air meet.

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the front door.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在前门旁。

ex.en: Placing bicycle racks at the front of public buildings can encourage more residents to cycle.
ex.zh: 在公共建筑前部设置自行车架，可以鼓励更多居民骑车出行。

col: at the front of｜在……的前部
tip: in front of指外部前方；at the front of指前部。

senses.en: to talk about something and exchange ideas
to examine a subject in speech or writing

ex.en: Let's discuss our holiday plans over dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我们边吃晚饭边商量度假计划吧。

ex.en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
ex.zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。

col: discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事
tip: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

senses.en: A small amount of food eaten between main meals.
To eat small amounts of food between main meals.

ex.en: I packed an apple and some nuts for a snack.
ex.zh: 我装了一个苹果和一些坚果，留着当零食吃。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating habits by offering nutritious snacks instead of foods high in sugar.
ex.zh: 学校可以提供营养丰富的点心来代替高糖食品，从而鼓励更健康的饮食习惯。

col: snack on nuts｜吃坚果当零食
tip: 动词常用snack on sth，表示吃某物当零食。

senses.en: An object with strings used to hit balls in sports.
A loud, unpleasant noise.

ex.en: I left my tennis racket beside the court.
ex.zh: 我把网球拍落在球场边了。

ex.en: Providing basic equipment, such as a racket, can make school sports more accessible to children.
ex.zh: 提供球拍等基本器材，可以让更多孩子参与学校体育活动。

tip: 球拍也可拼作racquet；喧闹声只用racket。

senses.en: The dark part of each day when the sun is down.

ex.en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。

ex.en: Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.
ex.zh: 夜间过多的人造光会扰乱睡眠规律，并影响城市野生动物的行为。

col: a good night's sleep｜一夜好眠
tip: 泛指夜间用at night；last night前不加介词。

senses.en: say something to get information or an answer
say that you want someone to do or give something
invite someone to come somewhere or join an activity

ex.en: I asked the driver where the bus stopped.
ex.zh: 我问司机公交车在哪里停。

ex.en: Schools should ask students for feedback before introducing major changes to classroom teaching methods.
ex.zh: 学校在对课堂教学方法作出重大调整前，应征求学生的反馈。

col: ask someone to do something｜请某人做某事
ask someone over｜邀请某人来家里
tip: ask for接想要的东西；ask someone to do表示请某人做。

senses.en: A short coat covering the upper body and arms.
An outer cover that protects a book or object.

ex.en: I grabbed my jacket before stepping into the cold.
ex.zh: 我抓起外套，才走进寒冷的室外。

ex.en: A durable jacket made from recycled materials can offer consumers a more sustainable clothing choice.
ex.zh: 用再生材料制成的耐穿夹克可以为消费者提供更可持续的服装选择。

tip: jacket通常是短外套，不专指羽绒服。

senses.en: Having good things happen by chance.
Believed to bring good fortune.

ex.en: We were lucky to catch the last bus home.
ex.zh: 我们很幸运，赶上了回家的末班公交车。

ex.en: Although some entrepreneurs benefit from lucky opportunities, long-term business success usually requires careful planning and consistent effort.
ex.zh: 虽然一些创业者受益于偶然的机遇，但企业的长期成功通常需要周密规划和持续努力。

col: a lucky break｜好运带来的机会
tip: “有幸做某事”用be lucky to do something。

senses.en: Trousers made from strong cotton cloth, usually denim.

ex.en: These jeans are still wet from the wash.
ex.zh: 这条牛仔裤洗后还没干。

ex.en: Allowing employees to wear jeans may create a more relaxed workplace without necessarily reducing professional standards.
ex.zh: 允许员工穿牛仔裤可能营造更轻松的工作环境，而不一定降低职业标准。

col: a pair of jeans｜一条牛仔裤
tip: jeans用复数；一条用a pair of jeans。

senses.en: a friend you write letters to but may never meet

ex.en: I have a penfriend in Australia.
ex.zh: 我有一个澳大利亚的笔友。

ex.en: She wrote a letter to her penfriend in English.
ex.zh: 她用英语给笔友写了一封信。

tip: penfriend 是英式说法，pen pal 是美式说法。
scene: A girl writing a letter at a desk with a world map behind her.

senses.en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised
someone or something that provides a good example to follow
a person who displays clothes or poses for artists

ex.en: He built a model of a bridge from cardboard.
ex.zh: 他用硬纸板做了一座桥的模型。

ex.en: Researchers use a computer model to predict how rising temperatures may affect regional water supplies.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用计算机模型预测气温上升可能如何影响区域供水。

tip: model还可作动词，表示建模或当模特。

senses.en: letters and parcels sent or delivered through a postal service
to send a letter or parcel through a postal service

ex.en: The mail arrived just as we finished breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们刚吃完早饭，邮件就到了。

ex.en: Although digital communication is widespread, many rural residents still depend on mail for essential documents.
ex.zh: 尽管数字通信已很普及，许多农村居民仍依赖邮政收取重要文件。

col: send by mail｜通过邮政寄送
tip: mail作“邮件”通常不可数；英式日常也常用post。

senses.en: Burning that produces heat and light, sometimes causing damage.
To make someone leave their job.
To shoot a gun or launch a weapon.

ex.en: We warmed our hands by the fire after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们在炉火旁暖手。

ex.en: Regular safety inspections can reduce the risk of fire in older residential buildings with outdated electrical systems.
ex.zh: 定期安全检查可以降低电气系统老化的旧住宅楼发生火灾的风险。

tip: catch fire指开始着火；be on fire指正在燃烧。

senses.en: a female sibling
a woman who belongs to a religious community

ex.en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
ex.zh: 我妹妹总是借穿我最喜欢的蓝色毛衣。

ex.en: Children who regularly share responsibilities with a brother or sister may develop stronger cooperation skills at home.
ex.zh: 经常与兄弟姐妹分担责任的孩子，可能会在家中培养出更强的合作能力。

tip: sister不分姐姐妹妹；需用older或younger说明年龄关系。

senses.en: thin clothes covering the legs worn by women or children

ex.en: She wore red tights with her dress.
ex.zh: 她穿着红色连裤袜配连衣裙。

ex.en: A pair of tights is in the laundry basket.
ex.zh: 洗衣篮里有一条连裤袜。

col: a pair of tights｜一条连裤袜
tip: tights 常用复数；一条说 a pair of tights。
scene: A pair of red tights hanging over a chair in a bedroom.

senses.en: To design or make something that did not exist before.
To make up a story or excuse that is untrue.

ex.en: My sister invented a clever tool for picking apples.
ex.zh: 我姐姐发明了一种巧妙的摘苹果工具。

ex.en: Engineers must invent affordable technologies that help rural communities gain access to clean drinking water.
ex.zh: 工程师必须发明价格可负担的技术，帮助农村社区获得清洁饮用水。

tip: invent是创造新事物；discover是发现已有事物。

senses.en: to find something or learn something previously unknown

ex.en: We discovered a quiet beach behind the cliffs.
ex.zh: 我们在悬崖后面发现了一片安静的海滩。

ex.en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
ex.zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。

col: discover a new species｜发现新物种
tip: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

senses.en: also; in addition

ex.en: She speaks French, and she speaks German as well.
ex.zh: 她会说法语，也会说德语。

ex.en: I'll have a coffee, and a cake as well, please.
ex.zh: 请给我一杯咖啡，再来一块蛋糕。

tip: as well 放在句末，too 常放句末，also 常放句中。
scene: A café table with a cup of coffee and a slice of chocolate cake.

senses.en: to move or travel somewhere

ex.en: We go to school by bike.
ex.zh: 我们骑自行车上学。

ex.en: Let's go to the park this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午我们去公园吧。

tip: go 的过去式是 went，过去分词是 gone/been。
scene: Two children riding bikes along a road towards a school.

senses.en: a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine

ex.en: He rides his motorbike to work every day.
ex.zh: 他每天骑摩托车上班。

ex.en: The motorbike stopped in front of the café.
ex.zh: 摩托车停在咖啡馆前面。

tip: motorbike 是英式口语说法；motorcycle 更正式。
scene: A red motorbike parked on a street with a helmet on the seat.

senses.en: The coldest season, between autumn and spring.
To spend the winter in a particular place.

ex.en: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
ex.zh: 冬天寒风来袭时，我们会穿上厚外套。

ex.en: Warmer winters can disrupt natural ecosystems by changing the seasonal behaviour of plants and migrating animals.
ex.zh: 更暖的冬季可能改变植物和迁徙动物的季节性行为，从而扰乱自然生态系统。

tip: 泛指在冬天用in winter；具体某年可用in the winter of…。

senses.en: a trained professional who diagnoses and treats illnesses
a person who has earned the highest university degree
to change something dishonestly to deceive people

ex.en: The doctor listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
ex.zh: 我描述症状时，医生认真地听着。

ex.en: Governments should train more doctors to ensure that rural communities have reliable access to healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应培养更多医生，确保农村社区能够稳定获得医疗服务。

col: a doctor of philosophy｜哲学博士
tip: 看医生常说see a doctor；动词doctor可指篡改。

senses.en: A large waterbird with a long neck, usually white

ex.en: A white swan glided silently across the lake.
ex.zh: 一只白天鹅悄无声息地游过湖面。

ex.en: Protecting wetland habitats benefits swan populations while also preserving the wider ecosystems on which many other species depend.
ex.zh: 保护湿地栖息地有益于天鹅种群，同时也能保护许多其他物种赖以生存的更广泛生态系统。

col: a pair of swans｜一对天鹅
tip: 可数名词，复数swans；幼天鹅称cygnet。

senses.en: Flat bread baked with toppings such as tomato sauce and cheese.

ex.en: We shared a mushroom pizza after the film.
ex.zh: 电影结束后，我们分着吃了一张蘑菇比萨。

ex.en: Although pizza is convenient, its nutritional value depends largely on the ingredients and portion size.
ex.zh: 虽然比萨方便食用，但其营养价值主要取决于食材和食用份量。

col: a slice of pizza｜一片比萨
tip: 整张可数：a pizza；泛指食物可说some pizza。

senses.en: cooked in very hot water

ex.en: I like boiled eggs for breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐我喜欢吃煮鸡蛋。

ex.en: She made boiled potatoes for dinner.
ex.zh: 她晚饭做了煮土豆。

tip: boiled 指用开水煮过的；fried 是煎的，roasted 是烤的。
scene: Two boiled eggs in an egg cup on a breakfast table with toast.

senses.en: a large sports venue with seating around a central area

ex.en: Fans filled the stadium before the football match began.
ex.zh: 足球比赛开始前，球迷们就坐满了体育场。

ex.en: Building a new stadium may attract visitors, but its long-term maintenance costs require careful consideration.
ex.zh: 修建新体育场或许能吸引游客，但其长期维护费用需要仔细考虑。

col: packed stadium｜座无虚席的体育场
tip: 复数可用stadiums或stadia，前者更常见。

senses.en: A child who attends school.
The dark opening in the eye that lets light enter.

ex.en: Each pupil brought a leaf to the science lesson.
ex.zh: 每个学生都带了一片树叶来上科学课。

ex.en: Smaller classes may allow teachers to give each pupil more individual support and useful feedback.
ex.zh: 小班教学可能让教师为每个学生提供更多个别指导和有用的反馈。

tip: 英式英语常指中小学生；大学生用 student。

senses.en: Unable to find the way, or unable to be found.
Unable to understand something or decide what to do.
Past tense and past participle of lose.

ex.en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
ex.zh: 我们在老城区步行时迷路了。

ex.en: Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.
ex.zh: 缺少明确指导时，大学新生在选择影响未来职业的课程时可能会感到迷茫。

tip: get lost可指迷路；单独用作命令语气粗鲁。

senses.en: Two matching things, or one object with two connected parts.
Two people who are together or work together.
To put people or things together in groups of two.

ex.en: I left my favourite pair of gloves on the bus.
ex.zh: 我把最喜欢的那双手套落在公交车上了。

ex.en: Teachers often pair students with different strengths to encourage cooperation and improve learning outcomes.
ex.zh: 教师常将各有所长的学生配成一组，以鼓励合作并改善学习成效。

col: a pair of scissors｜一把剪刀
work in pairs｜两人一组工作
pair up with someone｜与某人结成一组
tip: a pair of shoes作主语时，谓语用单数。

senses.en: a person who studies at a school, college, or university

ex.en: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
ex.zh: 一名学生把背包落在了图书馆的书桌下面。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that every student can access affordable housing and appropriate support throughout their studies.
ex.zh: 大学应确保每位学生在整个求学期间都能获得负担得起的住宿及适当支持。

tip: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

senses.en: Used when you are both the subject and object.
Used to emphasize the person being addressed.

ex.en: Be careful not to cut yourself with that knife.
ex.zh: 用那把刀时要小心，别割伤自己。

ex.en: Preparing meals yourself can reduce household spending while giving you greater control over nutritional quality.
ex.zh: 亲自做饭可以减少家庭开支，同时让你更好地把控营养质量。

tip: 对应单数you；对多人说“你们自己”用yourselves。

senses.en: The amount of money needed to buy something.
Something unpleasant experienced to achieve or obtain something else.
To decide how much money something will cost.

ex.en: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
ex.zh: 这周新鲜草莓的价格降了。

ex.en: Rising food prices place considerable pressure on families with limited incomes, particularly in urban areas.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨给低收入家庭带来很大压力，在城市地区尤其如此。

tip: 价格高低用high或low；物品贵便宜用expensive或cheap。

senses.en: a place or institution where legal cases are heard
an area for playing sports such as tennis or basketball
to seek something desirable or risk something harmful

ex.en: She will appear in court on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 她将于星期一上午出庭。

ex.en: Local councils should provide public tennis courts so that more residents can exercise regularly.
ex.zh: 地方议会应提供公共网球场，让更多居民能够经常锻炼。

tip: in court指在法庭上；on court指在球场上。

senses.en: Final in a sequence, or most recent before the present.
To continue for a period or remain usable.
After everyone else, or on the most recent previous occasion.

ex.en: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
ex.zh: 我在午夜前刚好赶上了回家的末班车。

ex.en: Products that last longer can reduce household spending and limit the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 更耐用的产品可以减少家庭开支，并减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量。

tip: last week指上周；the last week可指最后一周。

senses.en: Used to express that something is definitely true.
Used to agree politely to a request.

ex.en: This warm coat will certainly keep you comfortable outside.
ex.zh: 这件暖和的大衣肯定能让你在外面也舒舒服服的。

ex.en: Improved public transport would certainly benefit commuters, although its success would depend on reliable services and affordable fares.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通无疑会惠及通勤者，但成效取决于服务是否可靠、票价是否合理。

col: will certainly help｜肯定会有帮助
tip: 常置于实义动词前、be后；也可单独礼貌回应请求。

senses.en: Having very little money or few possessions
Of low quality or lacking something necessary
Deserving sympathy because of an unfortunate situation

ex.en: The poor family could barely afford fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 这户贫困家庭几乎买不起新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Poor public transport can limit employment opportunities for people living far from major urban centres.
ex.zh: 公共交通不便可能限制远离主要城市中心的居民的就业机会。

tip: poor at表示不擅长；poor in表示缺乏。

senses.en: used to say something is necessary

ex.en: I have to get up early tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天必须早起。

ex.en: Do we have to wear a uniform at school?
ex.zh: 我们在学校必须穿校服吗？

tip: have to 表客观需要，must 表主观必须；否定 don't have to 是“不必”。
scene: A student in a school uniform looking at an alarm clock.

senses.en: A room or building equipped for exercise and sport.
Physical exercise taught or practised at school.

ex.en: I usually go to the gym before work.
ex.zh: 我通常在上班前去健身房。

ex.en: Affordable gym membership can encourage regular exercise, although safe outdoor spaces are equally important for public health.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的健身房会员服务能鼓励定期锻炼，不过安全的户外空间对公共健康同样重要。

col: go to the gym｜去健身房
tip: gym是gymnasium的简称；去健身房用go to the gym。

senses.en: the presence of different things rather than only one kind
a particular type of something

ex.en: We add variety to lunch with different colourful vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们用各种色彩鲜艳的蔬菜让午餐更丰富。

ex.en: Schools should offer a wide variety of activities to support students with different interests.
ex.zh: 学校应提供丰富多样的活动，以支持兴趣各异的学生。

col: a wide variety of｜各种各样的
a variety of reasons｜多种原因
tip: 多样性为不可数义；表示一种品种时可数。

senses.en: The possibility that someone or something will be harmed.
Someone or something that may cause harm.

ex.en: Keep away from the edge; there's a danger of falling.
ex.zh: 离边缘远一点，有掉下去的危险。

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads pose a serious danger to cyclists, particularly in areas without dedicated cycling lanes.
ex.zh: 维护不善的道路对骑车人构成严重威胁，尤其是在没有专用自行车道的地区。

col: pose a danger to｜对……构成威胁
tip: in danger指处于危险中；dangerous指会带来危险。

senses.en: Located, used, or happening inside a building.

ex.en: Our hotel has an indoor pool beside the gym.
ex.zh: 我们酒店的健身房旁边有一个室内游泳池。

ex.en: Indoor sports facilities allow children to remain physically active regardless of weather conditions throughout the year.
ex.zh: 室内运动设施让孩子们全年都能保持运动，不受天气条件影响。

col: indoor air quality｜室内空气质量
tip: indoor作定语；indoors作副词，如stay indoors。

senses.en: The activity of understanding written words.
A measurement shown by an instrument.
An occasion when someone reads a written work aloud.

ex.en: Reading before bed helps me relax after a busy day.
ex.zh: 忙碌一天后，睡前阅读能让我放松下来。

ex.en: Regular reading exposes students to varied vocabulary and helps them develop stronger critical thinking skills.
ex.zh: 经常阅读能让学生接触丰富的词汇，并帮助他们提高批判性思维能力。

tip: 表示阅读活动通常不可数；表示读数或朗诵会可数。

senses.en: A stringed musical instrument played by plucking or strumming.

ex.en: My sister plays the guitar beside the window every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在窗边弹吉他。

ex.en: Learning to play the guitar can help students develop patience, coordination, and confidence through regular practice.
ex.zh: 学习弹吉他能帮助学生通过规律练习培养耐心、协调能力和自信。

tip: 表示弹吉他，通常说play the guitar。

senses.en: Using, producing, or relating to electricity.
Full of excitement and energy.

ex.en: Our electric kettle boils water in two minutes.
ex.zh: 我们的电水壶两分钟就能把水烧开。

ex.en: Electric buses can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their power comes from renewable sources.
ex.zh: 电动公交车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源供电时。

tip: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

senses.en: The star that gives Earth light and heat.
The light and warmth coming from the sun.
Sit or lie where sunlight warms your body.

ex.en: The sun appeared just as we reached the beach.
ex.zh: 我们刚到海滩，太阳就出来了。

ex.en: Energy from the sun can provide a renewable alternative to fossil fuels in regions with suitable conditions.
ex.zh: 在条件适宜的地区，太阳能可以成为化石燃料的可再生替代能源。

tip: 指太阳通常用the sun；in the sun表示在阳光下。

senses.en: An insect with hard outer wings covering its flying wings.

ex.en: A shiny beetle crawled slowly across the garden path.
ex.zh: 一只发亮的甲虫缓缓爬过花园小径。

ex.en: Some beetle species help maintain healthy forests by breaking down dead wood and recycling nutrients.
ex.zh: 一些甲虫通过分解枯木和循环利用养分，帮助维持森林健康。

tip: 指甲虫；不要用它表示“近视的人”。

senses.en: feeling strong displeasure about something unfair, wrong, or unpleasant

ex.en: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
ex.zh: 有人弄坏了他的自行车，他感到很生气。

ex.en: Residents became angry about the council's decision to close the only library in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 市政委员会决定关闭社区唯一的图书馆，居民们对此感到愤怒。

tip: 生某人的气用angry with；因某事生气用about。

senses.en: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.

ex.en: The aeroplane flew low over the sandy beach.
ex.zh: 飞机低空飞过沙滩上方。

ex.en: Travelling by aeroplane connects distant communities, but its environmental impact has encouraged debate about alternative transport.
