tip: umbrella term指涵盖多个相关概念的统称。

senses.en: later than an event or time
following the time when something happens
behind or following someone or something

ex.en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。

ex.en: After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。

tip: 介词后接名词或动名词；连词后接完整从句。

senses.en: On different sides of something or surrounding it.
Approximately, rather than exactly.
In or to various places within an area.

ex.en: We sat around the fire and watched the stars.
ex.zh: 我们围坐在火堆旁看星星。

ex.en: Planting trees around school buildings can provide shade and reduce indoor temperatures during hot weather.
ex.zh: 在教学楼周围种树可以提供遮阴，并在炎热天气下降低室内温度。

col: around the corner｜在拐角处；即将到来
tip: around可表大约；around ten即十点或十个左右。

senses.en: Shows who or what performs an action in passive sentences.
Using a particular method or means.
No later than a particular time.

ex.en: This wooden bowl was made by my grandfather.
ex.zh: 这个木碗是我祖父做的。

ex.en: Urban air quality can be improved by expanding public transport and encouraging residents to cycle more often.
ex.zh: 扩大公共交通服务并鼓励居民更多骑车，可以改善城市空气质量。

col: by the end of｜不迟于……结束时
tip: by表示截止时间；until表示状态持续到某时。

senses.en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king.
The main egg-laying female in a social insect colony.
The chess piece that moves any distance in any direction.

ex.en: The queen waved to the crowd from her carriage.
ex.zh: 女王从马车里向人群挥手。

ex.en: In some constitutional monarchies, the queen performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
ex.zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，女王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。

tip: queen 可指统治国家的女王，也可指国王的妻子。

senses.zh: 祖父母或外祖父母之一
senses.en: The father or mother of one of your parents.

ex.en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
ex.zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
ex.zh: 当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: visit your grandparents｜探望祖父母或外祖父母
tip: 单数指一位祖辈；复数可指祖父母或外祖父母。

senses.en: from inside to outside

ex.en: She took a book out of her bag.
ex.zh: 她从包里拿出一本书。

ex.en: He ran out of the room in a hurry.
ex.zh: 他匆忙跑出房间。

tip: out of 表示“从…出来”；反义词是 into（进入）。
scene: A girl taking a book out of her school bag at a desk.

senses.en: Kind, welcoming, and pleasant towards other people.
A sports match played outside an official competition.

ex.en: Our new neighbour is friendly and always waves hello.
ex.zh: 我们的新邻居很友善，总是挥手打招呼。

ex.en: Friendly staff can improve patients' experiences and encourage them to seek medical advice earlier.
ex.zh: 亲切的工作人员能改善患者的就医体验，并鼓励他们更早寻求医疗建议。

col: friendly towards newcomers｜对新来者友好
tip: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词，不是副词。

senses.en: the science of matter, energy, forces, and their interactions

ex.en: Our physics teacher showed us how magnets attract iron.
ex.zh: 我们的物理老师演示了磁铁如何吸引铁。

ex.en: A strong understanding of physics can help engineers develop safer buildings and more efficient transport systems.
ex.zh: 扎实的物理学知识能帮助工程师设计更安全的建筑和更高效的交通系统。

col: the laws of physics｜物理定律
tip: 虽以s结尾，仍作不可数名词，谓语用单数。

senses.en: measuring a large distance from one side to the other
including many different people, things, or possibilities
as far open as possible

ex.en: The sofa will not fit through this wide doorway.
ex.zh: 即使门口这么宽，这张沙发也搬不进去。

ex.en: Universities should offer a wide range of courses to meet students' different interests and career goals.
ex.zh: 大学应提供种类丰富的课程，以满足学生不同的兴趣和职业目标。

col: a wide range of｜各种各样的
tip: wide表示张开程度；widely常表示广泛地。

senses.en: Make someone or something ready for an activity or situation
Make food, a document, or a plan ready for use

ex.en: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上出门前都会准备好午餐。

ex.en: Schools should prepare students for employment by developing practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 学校应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，让学生为就业做好准备。

col: prepare for an exam｜准备考试
tip: prepare for后接名词；prepare to后接动词原形。

senses.en: to move through the air using wings
to travel in or control an aircraft
a small insect with two wings, often found near food

ex.en: Small birds fly over our garden every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早晨都有小鸟飞过我们的花园。

ex.en: Choosing to travel by train rather than fly can significantly reduce the environmental impact of short journeys.
ex.zh: 短途出行选择火车而非飞机，可以显著减少对环境的影响。

col: a swarm of flies｜一群苍蝇
tip: 动词变化fly–flew–flown；苍蝇复数为flies。

senses.en: a large cup with a handle, usually for hot drinks
to attack someone in public and steal from them

ex.en: I warmed my hands around a mug of tea.
ex.zh: 我双手捧着一大杯茶取暖。

ex.en: Providing reusable mugs in offices can reduce the waste generated by disposable cups each day.
ex.zh: 在办公室提供可重复使用的杯子，可以减少每天由一次性杯子产生的垃圾。

col: a mug of coffee｜一大杯咖啡
tip: mug通常有柄、较大；作动词可指拦路抢劫。

senses.en: Having a low temperature or feeling a lack of warmth.
A common illness causing sneezing, coughing, and a runny nose.
Showing little friendliness, affection, or sympathy.

ex.en: My hands were cold, so I put on gloves.
ex.zh: 我的手很冷，于是戴上了手套。

ex.en: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。

tip: “觉得冷”用be cold；“感冒了”用have a cold。

senses.en: a camera that stores photos electronically

ex.en: She took lots of photos with her digital camera.
ex.zh: 她用数码相机拍了很多照片。

ex.en: A digital camera is easy to use for beginners.
ex.zh: 数码相机对初学者来说很容易使用。

tip: digital camera 存照片用内存卡，不依赖胶卷。
scene: A small silver digital camera in someone's hands at a tourist spot.

senses.en: A coat that keeps your clothes dry in the rain.

ex.en: I grabbed my raincoat before stepping into the rain.
ex.zh: 走进雨中之前，我一把拿起了雨衣。

ex.en: Travellers visiting regions with unpredictable weather should carry a lightweight raincoat to stay comfortable during outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 前往天气多变地区的旅行者应携带轻便雨衣，以便在户外活动时保持舒适。

col: put on a raincoat｜穿上雨衣
tip: 英美英语都使用raincoat，并非仅限美式。

senses.en: Clothing covering the waist and legs, with separate leg sections.

ex.en: These trousers are too long, so I need them shortened.
ex.zh: 这条裤子太长了，我需要把它改短。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear formal trousers, while others allow more casual clothing in the workplace.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式长裤，另一些则允许员工在工作场所穿得更休闲。

col: a pair of trousers｜一条长裤
tip: 用复数：trousers are；一条用a pair of trousers。

senses.en: A book containing personal accounts of daily events and feelings.
A book used to record appointments and future plans.

ex.en: I write in my diary before going to bed.
ex.zh: 我睡前会写日记。

ex.en: Keeping a learning diary encourages students to reflect on their progress and identify difficulties.
ex.zh: 坚持写学习日记能鼓励学生反思自己的进步并发现困难。

tip: diary是日记，dairy是乳制品；注意字母顺序。

senses.en: used for direction, receiving, or with verbs

ex.en: We walked to the park.
ex.zh: 我们走到公园。

ex.en: I want to learn English.
ex.zh: 我想学英语。

tip: to 表方向“到…”；也用于动词不定式 to do。
scene: A path leading from houses to a green park.

senses.en: to keep something in your hands or arms
to organise an event or meeting
to have enough space for something or someone

ex.en: Could you hold my bag while I tie my shoes?
ex.zh: 我系鞋带时，你能帮我拿一下包吗？

ex.en: Local councils should hold public meetings before making major changes to transport services.
ex.zh: 地方议会在对交通服务作出重大调整之前，应当召开公众会议。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为held；举行会议用hold。

senses.en: the teacher in charge of a school

ex.en: The headteacher gave a speech at the school assembly.
ex.zh: 校长在全校集会上讲话。

ex.en: Our headteacher knows every student by name.
ex.zh: 我们的校长知道每个学生的名字。

tip: headteacher 是英式说法，美式常说 principal。
scene: A headteacher in a suit speaking to students in a school hall.

senses.en: someone who grows crops or raises animals on a farm

ex.en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
ex.zh: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。

ex.en: Small farmers need reliable access to water and affordable technology to maintain production during dry periods.
ex.zh: 小农户需要可靠的水源和负担得起的技术，才能在干旱期间维持生产。

tip: farmer指人，farm指农场，farming指农业生产。

senses.en: used to show purpose, who receives, or duration

ex.en: This gift is for you.
ex.zh: 这份礼物是给你的。

ex.en: We stayed in London for three days.
ex.zh: 我们在伦敦待了三天。

col: for a long time｜很长时间
tip: for 后接时间段表示“持续多久”；since 后接时间点表示“自从”。
scene: A wrapped gift with a ribbon being handed to a smiling girl.

senses.en: a young cat

ex.en: The kitten is playing with a ball of wool.
ex.zh: 小猫在玩毛线球。

ex.en: We adopted a kitten from the animal shelter.
ex.zh: 我们从动物收容所领养了一只小猫。

tip: kitten 是小猫；成年猫是 cat。
scene: A tiny orange kitten playing with a ball of wool on a carpet.

senses.en: A drink made from roasted beans, or the beans and powder.

ex.en: I drink coffee with milk before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 我上班出门前会喝一杯加奶咖啡。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may threaten coffee production, affecting the incomes of farmers in several developing countries.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能威胁咖啡生产，影响一些发展中国家农民的收入。

col: a cup of coffee｜一杯咖啡
tip: 通常不可数；点单时two coffees指两杯咖啡。

senses.en: to stop a machine or light working

ex.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
ex.zh: 离开时请关灯。

ex.en: He turned off the TV and went to bed.
ex.zh: 他关掉电视上床睡觉。

tip: turn off 与 switch off 同义；反义 turn on。
scene: A hand switching off a lamp in a bedroom.

senses.en: A covering for the foot, usually with a firm sole.

ex.en: There was a small stone inside my shoe.
ex.zh: 我的鞋里有一颗小石子。

ex.en: Comfortable shoes are essential for workers who spend most of their working day standing.
ex.zh: 对于工作时大部分时间都站着的员工来说，舒适的鞋子至关重要。

tip: 一双鞋用a pair of shoes，shoe为可数名词。

senses.en: From or relating to a country other than your own.
Present where it does not naturally belong.
Unfamiliar to someone or inconsistent with something.

ex.en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢在空闲时间学习外语。

ex.en: Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.
ex.zh: 外国投资可以创造就业机会，但政府应确保当地社区也能从经济增长中受益。

tip: foreign to可指对某人陌生，或与某事不相符。

senses.en: a bicycle or, informally, a motorcycle
to travel somewhere by bicycle

ex.en: I locked my bike outside the corner shop.
ex.zh: 我把自行车锁在街角商店外面。

ex.en: Encouraging commuters to travel by bike could reduce urban congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 鼓励通勤者骑自行车出行可以缓解城市拥堵，并改善公众健康。

tip: by bike不加冠词；ride a bike中的a不能省。

senses.en: used when people do something to themselves

ex.en: They made the dinner themselves.
ex.zh: 晚餐是他们自己做的。

ex.en: The children enjoyed themselves at the party.
ex.zh: 孩子们在聚会上玩得很开心。

tip: by themselves 表示“独自”；enjoy oneself 是“玩得开心”。
scene: Children laughing and enjoying themselves at a birthday party.

senses.en: Small in size or young in age.
Not much; almost no amount of something.
Only slightly or not very much.

ex.en: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟落在我们厨房的窗台上。

ex.en: Many rural schools have little access to digital resources, which can widen existing educational inequalities.
ex.zh: 许多农村学校很难获得数字资源，这可能加剧现有的教育不平等。

tip: little加不可数名词表示几乎没有；a little表示有一点。

senses.en: A narrow board with small wheels, ridden standing up.
To move or perform tricks on a skateboard.

ex.en: He carried his skateboard home when the rain started.
ex.zh: 开始下雨时，他抱着滑板回家了。

ex.en: Providing dedicated areas for skateboard users can encourage physical activity while reducing conflicts with pedestrians in public spaces.
ex.zh: 为滑板使用者提供专用区域，可以鼓励体育活动，同时减少公共空间中与行人的冲突。

tip: skateboard无扶手；scooter通常有扶手。

senses.en: a wide road designed for fast travel over long distances

ex.en: We left the motorway and stopped for lunch.
ex.zh: 我们驶离高速公路，停下来吃午饭。

ex.en: Building a new motorway may reduce journey times, but it can also damage nearby wildlife habitats.
ex.zh: 修建新的高速公路可能缩短行程时间，但也会破坏附近的野生动物栖息地。

col: join the motorway｜驶入高速公路
tip: 主要用于英式英语；美式常用freeway。

senses.en: Having a taste like sugar or honey.
Kind, gentle, or thoughtful.
A small piece of sugary food eaten as a treat.

ex.en: These strawberries are sweet enough to eat without sugar.
ex.zh: 这些草莓已经够甜了，不加糖也好吃。

ex.en: Reducing children's consumption of sweet drinks may lower their risk of tooth decay and excessive weight gain.
ex.zh: 减少儿童含糖饮料的摄入，可能降低他们蛀牙和体重过度增长的风险。

tip: 糖果英式常用sweets，美式常用candy。

senses.en: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness
strong emotional suffering caused by loss or distress
to cause someone emotional suffering

ex.en: I felt a sharp pain in my left ankle.
ex.zh: 我的左脚踝感到一阵剧痛。

ex.en: Regular exercise may reduce back pain among office workers who remain seated for long periods.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可能减轻长时间久坐的办公室职员的背痛。

tip: 泛指疼痛常不可数；具体一阵疼痛可用a pain。

senses.en: near something

ex.en: My house is close to the station.
ex.zh: 我家离车站很近。

ex.en: The children sat close to the fire to get warm.
ex.zh: 孩子们靠近火坐着取暖。

tip: close to 与 near 意思相近；far from 是它的反义表达。
scene: A small house standing right next to a train station building.

senses.en: The part of the day between midnight and noon

ex.en: I open the curtains every morning and water my plants.
ex.zh: 我每天早晨拉开窗帘，给植物浇水。

ex.en: Schools that start later in the morning may help teenagers get enough sleep and concentrate better.
ex.zh: 上午较晚上课的学校可能有助于青少年获得充足睡眠，更好地集中注意力。

col: in the morning｜在早晨；在上午
on Monday morning｜在星期一早上
tip: 泛指用in the morning；具体某天早上用on。

senses.en: a large desert animal with one or two humps

ex.en: We rode camels in the desert.
ex.zh: 我们在沙漠里骑了骆驼。

ex.en: The camel has two humps on its back.
ex.zh: 这头骆驼背上有两个驼峰。

tip: 骆驼的驼峰叫 hump；单峰驼是 dromedary。
scene: A camel standing in a sandy desert with dunes in the background.

senses.en: A unit of distance equal to approximately 1.61 kilometres.

ex.en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
ex.zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。

ex.en: Replacing short car journeys with walking even one mile could improve public health and reduce emissions.
ex.zh: 用步行替代短途驾车，哪怕只走一英里，也能改善公众健康并减少排放。

tip: 英里是距离单位；mile可数，复数加s。

senses.en: Having a lot of wind.

ex.en: It was too windy to eat lunch outside today.
ex.zh: 今天风太大，没法在外面吃午饭。

ex.en: Windy coastal regions can generate renewable electricity, although turbines must be positioned carefully to protect wildlife.
ex.zh: 多风的沿海地区可以生产可再生电力，但风力涡轮机必须谨慎选址，以保护野生动物。

col: a windy day｜刮大风的一天
tip: 天气义读/ˈwɪndi/；描述道路蜿蜒通常用winding。

senses.en: In or towards a place that is not inside.
Beyond the boundaries or limits of something.
Located on the outer part or coming from elsewhere.

ex.en: The children played outside while their parents prepared lunch.
ex.zh: 父母准备午饭时，孩子们在外面玩耍。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to learn outside the classroom through practical activities and community projects.
ex.zh: 学校应通过实践活动和社区项目，为学生提供课堂之外的学习机会。

tip: 后接地点用介词 outside；单独使用可作副词。

senses.en: in or to a place that is not specified
approximately, when used before an amount or range

ex.en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在沙发附近的某个地方了。

ex.en: Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要有负担得起的住所，才能充分参与当地的经济活动。

tip: 形容词放后面：somewhere quiet；前面通常不加to。

senses.en: ahead of; before something in position

ex.en: The school is in front of the park.
ex.zh: 学校在公园前面。

ex.en: She stood in front of the class and spoke.
ex.zh: 她站在全班面前发言。

tip: in front of 指“在…前面”；反义词是 behind（在…后面）。
scene: A school building standing in front of a green park with trees.

senses.en: a sea animal with a soft body and eight arms

ex.en: An octopus squeezed through a narrow gap between rocks.
ex.zh: 一只章鱼从岩石间狭窄的缝隙挤了过去。

ex.en: Research into octopus behaviour has revealed remarkable learning abilities, challenging traditional assumptions about intelligence in marine animals.
ex.zh: 对章鱼行为的研究揭示了其非凡的学习能力，挑战了有关海洋动物智力的传统假设。

col: a giant octopus｜一只巨型章鱼
tip: 常用复数是octopuses；腕通常称arms。

senses.en: food made from flour and water, shaped and usually boiled

ex.en: We cooked pasta with fresh tomatoes and mushrooms.
ex.zh: 我们用新鲜番茄和蘑菇做了意大利面。

ex.en: School canteens can serve wholegrain pasta with vegetables to provide affordable meals with more fibre.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以供应搭配蔬菜的全麦意大利面，提供价格实惠、膳食纤维更多的餐食。

tip: 不可数；一份意面可说a bowl of pasta。

senses.en: in or to which place

ex.en: Where do you live?
ex.zh: 你住在哪里？

ex.en: Do you know where the library is?
ex.zh: 你知道图书馆在哪里吗？

tip: where 用于询问地点。
scene: A tourist looking at a map and asking where a place is.

senses.en: having the darkest colour, like coal
the darkest colour
relating to people with ancestry from sub-Saharan Africa

ex.en: She wore a black coat and bright yellow boots.
ex.zh: 她穿着黑色外套和亮黄色靴子。

ex.en: Black roofs absorb more sunlight than pale roofs, potentially increasing the energy needed for cooling.
ex.zh: 黑色屋顶比浅色屋顶吸收更多阳光，可能增加制冷所需的能源。

tip: 指族裔时常大写为Black；避免用作单数名词称人。

senses.en: a game where teams throw a ball through raised hoops
the large round ball used in this game

ex.en: We play basketball at the park after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。

ex.en: Team sports such as basketball help young people develop cooperation skills while improving their physical fitness.
ex.zh: 篮球等团队运动有助于年轻人培养协作能力，同时增强体质。

tip: play basketball不加冠词；指一个球用a basketball。

senses.en: the natural object that moves around Earth
a natural object that moves around a planet

ex.en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
ex.zh: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。

ex.en: Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.
ex.zh: 对月球的研究可能帮助科学家了解地球和其他岩石行星的形成过程。

col: the surface of the moon｜月球表面
tip: 指地球的月亮通常用the moon；其他行星的卫星可数。

senses.en: A large wild cat with dark stripes on orange fur

ex.en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
ex.zh: 那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Protecting tiger habitats also helps conserve other species that share the same forest ecosystems.
ex.zh: 保护老虎栖息地也有助于保护同一森林生态系统中的其他物种。

tip: 可数名词；一只老虎用a tiger。

senses.en: A table used for studying, writing, or office work
A counter where people receive information or services

ex.en: I keep my pencils in the top desk drawer.
ex.zh: 我把铅笔放在书桌最上面的抽屉里。

ex.en: Providing every student with a suitable desk can improve comfort and concentration in the classroom.
ex.zh: 为每位学生提供合适的课桌可以提高课堂上的舒适度和专注度。

col: sit at a desk｜坐在书桌前
tip: 在书桌前用at a desk，不用on a desk。

senses.en: a machine that plays DVDs

ex.en: The DVD player is under the television.
ex.zh: DVD播放机在电视机下面。

ex.en: Put the film into the DVD player.
ex.zh: 把电影光盘放进DVD播放机里。

tip: DVD player 用来播放 DVD 光盘。
scene: A DVD player on a shelf under a television with a disc sliding in.

senses.en: of the kind already mentioned or being described
used to emphasise a quality or degree before a noun

ex.en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
ex.zh: 天气如此宜人，我们就在外面吃了饭。

ex.en: Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.
ex.zh: 许多城市面临严重的交通拥堵，这类问题需要统筹公共交通投资来解决。

tip: 单数可数名词前用such a/an；so后直接接形容词。

senses.en: a liquid fuel used in cars and other engines

ex.en: We stopped for petrol before driving into the mountains.
ex.zh: 开车进山前，我们停车加了汽油。

ex.en: Higher petrol prices may encourage commuters to use public transport rather than drive to work.
ex.zh: 汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者乘坐公共交通，而不是开车上班。

col: run out of petrol｜汽油用尽
tip: 不可数名词；英式用petrol，美式用gasoline或gas。

senses.en: Give someone information or describe something in words.
Instruct someone to do something.
Recognise a difference or know something from available evidence.

ex.en: Please tell me what happened at school today.
ex.zh: 请告诉我今天在学校发生了什么。

ex.en: Schools should tell parents how personal information about their children is collected and stored.
ex.zh: 学校应告知家长，孩子的个人信息是如何被收集和保存的。

col: tell someone to do something｜吩咐某人做某事
tip: tell常直接接人；say接人时通常用to。

senses.en: the time when people work

ex.en: The shop's working hours are nine to six.
ex.zh: 这家店的工作时间是九点到六点。

ex.en: Please call us during working hours.
ex.zh: 请在上班时间给我们打电话。

tip: working hours 是工作时间，即上班时段。
scene: An office clock showing working hours with a schedule on the wall.

senses.en: A series of lessons about a particular subject.
The route something follows or the way events develop.
One part of a meal served separately from other parts.

ex.en: I joined a cooking course at the community centre.
ex.zh: 我报名参加了社区中心的烹饪课程。

ex.en: Universities should design each course to combine theoretical knowledge with practical skills relevant to future employment.
ex.zh: 大学应在设计每门课程时，将理论知识与未来就业所需的实用技能相结合。

tip: course 是整门课程；lesson 是其中的一节课。

senses.en: a male ruler who usually inherits his position

ex.en: The king waved to the crowd from his carriage.
ex.zh: 国王从马车上向人群挥手。

ex.en: In some countries, the king performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
ex.zh: 在一些国家，国王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。

col: the king's reign｜国王的统治时期
tip: king指男性君主；queen可指女王或王后。

senses.en: something that belongs to us

ex.en: This garden is ours.
ex.zh: 这个花园是我们的。

ex.en: Their house is bigger than ours.
ex.zh: 他们的房子比我们的大。

tip: ours 是名词性物主代词，后面不接名词。
scene: Two children playing in their own garden with a swing.

senses.en: an area of sand or small stones beside water
to bring a boat onto a shore

ex.en: We collected smooth stones on the beach after breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐后，我们在海滩上捡了些光滑的石头。

ex.en: Local authorities should protect beaches from plastic waste while ensuring that tourism benefits nearby communities.
ex.zh: 地方政府应保护海滩免受塑料垃圾污染，同时确保旅游业惠及附近社区。

tip: 在海滩上用on the beach；shore泛指岸边。

senses.en: At a lower position, level, or amount than something.
In a lower place or later in a piece of writing.

ex.en: Our cat sleeps on the shelf below the window.
ex.zh: 我们的猫睡在窗户下方的架子上。

ex.en: Households with incomes below the national average may struggle to afford adequate heating during winter.
ex.zh: 收入低于全国平均水平的家庭可能难以负担冬季充足供暖的费用。

tip: below强调位置或数值较低，不一定在正下方。

senses.en: A way in which people or things are not alike
A disagreement between people or groups
The amount by which one quantity exceeds another

ex.en: The main difference between these jackets is their weight.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克的主要区别在于重量。

ex.en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
ex.zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。

tip: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

senses.en: a woman who is married to someone

ex.en: His wife packed sandwiches for their afternoon walk.
ex.zh: 他的妻子为他们下午的散步准备了三明治。

ex.en: A husband and wife may share childcare responsibilities more equally when both have flexible working hours.
ex.zh: 如果夫妻双方的工作时间都很灵活，他们就可能更平等地分担育儿责任。

tip: 复数为wives；spouse指配偶，不限定性别。

senses.en: In, at, or towards that place.
Used before a verb to introduce something that exists.

ex.en: Leave your muddy boots there, beside the back door.
ex.zh: 把你沾满泥的靴子放在那儿，就在后门旁边。

ex.en: There are several practical ways for cities to reduce waste without increasing household expenses.
ex.zh: 城市可以采取几种切实可行的办法，在不增加家庭开支的情况下减少垃圾。

tip: there表地点或引出存在句；别与their混淆。

senses.en: to want something to happen and believe it may happen
a feeling that something wanted may happen

ex.en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
ex.zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。

ex.en: Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生希望找到有意义的工作，使自己能够为社会作出积极贡献。

col: hope to do something｜希望做某事
hope for the best｜抱最好的希望
in the hope of｜怀着……的希望
tip: 可说hope to do，不说hope sb to do。

senses.en: someone who leads people and explains places they visit
a book or resource giving useful information or instructions
to show someone the way or help them decide

ex.en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
ex.zh: 导游带我们穿过市场里狭窄的街道。

ex.en: Teachers should guide students towards reliable sources rather than simply provide answers to every question.
ex.zh: 教师应引导学生寻找可靠的信息来源，而不是直接给出每个问题的答案。

col: guide someone through｜引导某人完成
guided tour｜有导游带领的游览
tip: 指南用a guide to；指导某人完成用guide someone through。

senses.en: a usually hard, shiny material that conducts heat and electricity

ex.en: The metal handle felt cold against my fingers.
ex.zh: 金属把手摸起来冰凉。

ex.en: Recycling metal reduces the demand for mining and can significantly lower energy consumption in manufacturing.
ex.zh: 回收金属可以减少采矿需求，并显著降低制造业的能源消耗。

tip: 泛指材料时不可数；指金属种类时可数。

senses.en: to control a vehicle and make it move
to cause something to develop or someone to act
a car journey, strong motivation, or a computer storage device

ex.en: Can you drive me to the station after breakfast?
ex.zh: 早饭后你能开车送我去车站吗？

ex.en: Consumer demand can drive innovation by encouraging companies to develop products that use fewer natural resources.
ex.zh: 消费者需求可以鼓励企业开发消耗更少自然资源的产品，从而推动创新。

col: drive economic growth｜推动经济增长
go for a drive｜开车兜风
tip: 不规则变化：drive—drove—driven；送某人用drive sb to。

senses.en: a cold drink made with lemons, sugar and water

ex.en: She made fresh lemonade for the picnic.
ex.zh: 她为野餐做了新鲜的柠檬水。

ex.en: Can I have a glass of lemonade, please?
ex.zh: 请给我一杯柠檬水好吗？

col: a glass of lemonade｜一杯柠檬水
tip: lemonade 是柠檬饮料；英式常指气泡柠檬汽水。
scene: A glass jug of lemonade with lemons on a picnic blanket.

senses.en: The front of the head, including eyes, nose, and mouth.
To encounter or deal with a difficult situation.
To look or point in a particular direction.

ex.en: He washed his face before sitting down for breakfast.
ex.zh: 他洗了脸才坐下来吃早餐。

ex.en: Many coastal cities face increasing risks from flooding as sea levels rise and extreme weather becomes more frequent.
ex.zh: 随着海平面上升和极端天气日益频繁，许多沿海城市面临越来越大的洪水风险。

tip: 面对困难可说face difficulties或be faced with difficulties。

senses.en: a round, deep container used for food or liquids
to roll a bowling ball or deliver a cricket ball

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。

ex.en: Serving meals in smaller bowls may help people control portions and reduce unnecessary food waste.
ex.zh: 用较小的碗盛饭可能有助于人们控制食量，减少不必要的食物浪费。

tip: a bowl of表示“一碗”；bowling指保龄球运动。

senses.en: relating to formal Western music, such as symphonies and operas
relating to ancient Greece or Rome and their culture
based on established theories rather than newer approaches

ex.en: My sister listens to classical music while cooking.
ex.zh: 我姐姐做饭时听古典音乐。

ex.en: Studying classical architecture helps students understand how ancient design principles continue to influence modern public buildings.
ex.zh: 研究古典建筑有助于学生理解古代设计原则如何持续影响现代公共建筑。

tip: 古典音乐用classical；经典作品常用classic。

senses.en: a person who is shopping

ex.en: The shoppers filled the supermarket on Saturday.
ex.zh: 周六超市里挤满了购物者。

ex.en: Shoppers can park free for two hours.
ex.zh: 购物者可免费停车两小时。

tip: shopper 指正在购物的人；customer 是顾客。
scene: A shopper with carrier bags walking through a busy supermarket.

senses.en: a female person or animal already mentioned

ex.en: She is my sister.
ex.zh: 她是我妹妹。

ex.en: Where is Anna? She is in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 安娜在哪？她在厨房里。

tip: she 是主格；宾格 her，物主代词 hers。
scene: A girl waving from a kitchen doorway as someone asks where she is.

senses.en: any day from Monday to Friday

ex.en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
ex.zh: 游泳池在工作日的早晨比较安静。

ex.en: Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
ex.zh: 延长图书馆工作日的开放时间，将有利于白天工作的学生。

tip: 指周一至周五，不保证当天实际上需要上班。

senses.en: someone whose job is to help people learn

ex.en: Our teacher brought a plant into class today.
ex.zh: 我们的老师今天带了一株植物来上课。

ex.en: A well-trained teacher can adapt classroom activities to support students with different learning needs and abilities.
ex.zh: 训练有素的教师能够调整课堂活动，以帮助学习需求和能力各不相同的学生。

tip: 英语中称呼老师通常用Mr、Ms等加姓，不直接喊Teacher。

senses.en: food that is made and served quickly

ex.en: We had fast food for lunch because we were in a hurry.
ex.zh: 因为赶时间，我们午饭吃了快餐。

ex.en: Eating too much fast food is not healthy.
ex.zh: 吃太多快餐不健康。

tip: 常见的 fast food 有汉堡、炸鸡、薯条等。
scene: A takeaway counter with burgers and fries in paper wrappers.

senses.en: a polite greeting used in the evening

ex.en: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen.
ex.zh: 女士们先生们，晚上好。

ex.en: We said good evening to the hotel manager.
ex.zh: 我们向酒店经理问晚上好。

tip: good evening 用于傍晚及晚上的问候；晚安说 good night。
scene: A hotel receptionist greeting a guest at the front desk in the evening.

senses.en: a hard surface built for vehicles to travel along
a way of reaching a particular result or situation

ex.en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
ex.zh: 过马路前要向两边看。

ex.en: Investment in road maintenance can improve public safety and reduce transport costs for local businesses.
ex.zh: 投资道路养护能提高公共安全水平，并降低当地企业的运输成本。

col: the road to recovery｜康复之路
tip: on the road常指在旅途中；road to可比喻通往某结果的途径。

senses.en: a public message promoting a product, service, or opportunity

ex.en: An ad for cooking classes caught my attention yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天，一则烹饪课广告吸引了我的注意。

ex.en: Online ads can influence consumer choices by presenting products that match users' browsing habits and interests.
ex.zh: 网络广告通过展示符合用户浏览习惯和兴趣的产品，可以影响消费者的选择。

tip: ad是advertisement的非正式缩写，是可数名词。

senses.en: an entrance area or passage connecting rooms in a building
a large room or building used for public gatherings
a building where university students live

ex.en: Please leave your wet shoes in the hall.
ex.zh: 请把湿鞋留在门厅里。

ex.en: The community hall provides an affordable space where residents can attend classes and organise local events.
ex.zh: 社区会堂为居民提供了一个价格实惠的场所，供他们上课和组织当地活动。

col: halls of residence｜大学学生宿舍
tip: 英式英语中，大学宿舍常称halls或halls of residence。

senses.en: the sport of riding a horse

ex.en: She goes riding every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 她每周六早上去骑马。

ex.en: Riding is a popular sport in the countryside.
ex.zh: 骑马是乡村很受欢迎的运动。

tip: riding 指骑马运动；horse-riding 也是常见说法。
scene: A girl riding a brown horse across a green field.

senses.en: Making something easier to do or understand.
Willing to help other people.

ex.en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
ex.zh: 我们游览村庄时，你的地图帮了大忙。

ex.en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
ex.zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。

col: find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

senses.en: An intelligent aquatic mammal with a long snout and curved fin.

ex.en: A dolphin leapt beside our boat early this morning.
ex.zh: 今天一大早，一只海豚在我们的船边跃出水面。

ex.en: Underwater noise from shipping can disrupt dolphin communication and make it harder for these animals to find food.
ex.zh: 船运产生的水下噪声会干扰海豚交流，使它们更难找到食物。

col: a pod of dolphins｜一群海豚
tip: 海豚是哺乳动物；一群海豚可说a pod of dolphins。

senses.en: Having a high temperature.
Having a strong taste that burns your mouth.
Attracting a lot of interest or discussion.

ex.en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
ex.zh: 小心，汤还很烫。

ex.en: As summers become increasingly hot, cities need more shaded public spaces to protect residents from heat.
ex.zh: 随着夏季越来越炎热，城市需要更多有遮阴设施的公共空间来保护居民免受高温影响。

tip: 形容食物时可指“烫”或“辣”，需结合语境。

senses.en: a place where animals are kept for people to see

ex.en: We saw lions and monkeys at the zoo.
ex.zh: 我们在动物园看到了狮子和猴子。

ex.en: The zoo is closed on Mondays.
ex.zh: 动物园周一闭园。

tip: zoo 是动物园；go to the zoo 去动物园。
scene: A zoo entrance with a lion enclosure and children looking in.

senses.en: A building or part of a building for keeping vehicles.
A business where vehicles are repaired and serviced.

ex.en: We keep our car and bicycles in the garage.
ex.zh: 我们把汽车和自行车停在车库里。

ex.en: Converting an unused garage into living space can provide additional accommodation without requiring new land.
ex.zh: 将闲置车库改成居住空间，可以在不占用新土地的情况下增加住房。

tip: 英式英语也常用 garage 指汽车修理厂。

senses.en: Someone who gathers and reports news for the media.

ex.en: The journalist interviewed our neighbour about the new park.
ex.zh: 那位记者就新公园的事采访了我们的邻居。

ex.en: A responsible journalist should verify information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion.
ex.zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众舆论的报道前，应仔细核实信息。

tip: journalist泛指新闻工作者，reporter更侧重采访报道。

senses.en: having the colour of a clear daytime sky
the colour of a clear daytime sky
feeling sad or unhappy

ex.en: He wore a blue jacket to the picnic.
ex.zh: 他穿了一件蓝色夹克去野餐。

ex.en: Urban designers often use blue surfaces to create a sense of calm in busy public spaces.
ex.zh: 城市设计师常使用蓝色的表面，在繁忙的公共空间营造宁静感。

tip: feel blue表示心情低落；颜色较浅用light blue。

senses.en: during the evening or night of today
the evening or night of today

ex.en: We are making vegetable soup for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 我们今晚要做蔬菜汤当晚餐。

ex.en: Residents will meet tonight to discuss how public transport could better serve the local community.
ex.zh: 居民们今晚将开会讨论公共交通如何更好地服务当地社区。

tip: 作时间状语时直接用tonight，前面不加介词。

senses.en: The worldwide network connecting computers and other devices.

ex.en: The internet stopped working halfway through our video call.
ex.zh: 我们视频通话进行到一半时断网了。

ex.en: Reliable internet access enables rural students to use educational resources that may be unavailable locally.
ex.zh: 可靠的互联网接入让农村学生能够使用当地可能缺乏的教育资源。

tip: 通常说 the internet；作定语时不用 the。

senses.en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.

ex.en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
ex.zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。

ex.en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。

col: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学
help a classmate｜帮助同班同学
tip: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

senses.en: to put your body in a flat position to rest

ex.en: I need to lie down for a while; I feel tired.
ex.zh: 我需要躺一会儿，我感觉很累。

ex.en: The dog likes to lie down in the shade.
ex.zh: 狗喜欢躺在阴凉处。

tip: lie down 是“躺下”休息；过去式 lay down。
scene: A tired woman lying down on a sofa with a blanket.

senses.en: A car with a driver whom you pay for a journey.
To move slowly on the ground before takeoff or after landing.

ex.en: We took a taxi home with our heavy bags.
ex.zh: 我们带着沉重的行李，打车回了家。

ex.en: Improving public transport could reduce dependence on taxis and private cars in crowded city centres.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以减少人们在拥挤的市中心对出租车和私家车的依赖。

col: hail a taxi｜招手叫出租车
tip: 乘出租车可说take a taxi或by taxi。

senses.en: The second month of the year.

ex.en: My sister starts her new job in February.
ex.zh: 我姐姐二月份开始新工作。

ex.en: The community centre will introduce additional evening classes in February to meet growing demand.
ex.zh: 社区中心将在二月份增设夜间课程，以满足不断增长的需求。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: to become unable to find something you had
to stop having something or have less of it
to fail to win a game or competition

ex.en: I always lose my keys inside this enormous bag.
ex.zh: 我总是在这个大包里找不到钥匙。

ex.en: Small businesses may lose customers when major retailers offer similar products at significantly lower prices.
ex.zh: 大型零售商以低得多的价格提供类似产品时，小企业可能会流失顾客。

tip: 过去式和过去分词都是lost；别与loose混淆。

senses.en: Belonging or relating to the person or people being addressed

ex.en: Please leave your shoes by the door before entering.
ex.zh: 进来前请把你的鞋放在门边。

ex.en: Choosing a university near your home can reduce living expenses and make higher education more affordable.
ex.zh: 选择离家近的大学可以减少生活开支，让高等教育更负担得起。

col: do your best｜尽你最大的努力
tip: your后接名词；yours独立使用；you're意为你是。

senses.en: a huge ball of hot gas shining in space
a famous or exceptionally successful performer or other person
to play a leading role or feature someone doing so

ex.en: We watched the stars from our tent beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars, reducing their connection with the natural night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民看不到星星，削弱了他们与自然夜空的联系。

col: a rising star｜冉冉升起的新星
star in a film｜主演电影
tip: star in表示“主演”；过去式starred，进行式starring。

senses.en: a book giving information about a place or practical subject

ex.en: Our guidebook recommended a quiet beach near the village.
ex.zh: 我们的旅行指南推荐了村庄附近一处安静的海滩。

ex.en: Although digital maps are convenient, a detailed guidebook can provide valuable cultural context for independent travellers.
ex.zh: 虽然电子地图很方便，但详尽的旅行指南能为自由行旅客提供宝贵的文化背景信息。

tip: 介绍某地的指南常用a guidebook to加地点。

senses.en: Someone who goes to see a person or place.

ex.en: A visitor left her umbrella beside our front door.
ex.zh: 一位访客把她的伞落在了我们前门旁。

ex.en: The museum attracts international visitors by offering exhibitions that explore local history and culture.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆通过举办探究当地历史与文化的展览吸引国际游客。

tip: visitor指人；visit可作动词或名词。

senses.en: Someone who performs characters in plays, films, or television
A person or organisation involved in a particular situation

ex.en: The actor wore a silver crown on stage.
ex.zh: 那位演员在舞台上戴着一顶银色王冠。

ex.en: Professional actors can help students develop communication skills through drama workshops that encourage teamwork and creative expression.
ex.zh: 专业演员可以通过鼓励团队合作和创意表达的戏剧工作坊，帮助学生培养沟通能力。

tip: actor可指任何性别的演员；actress专指女演员。

senses.en: popular music with catchy tunes and usually simple structures
to burst or make a short, sharp sound
to go somewhere briefly or put something somewhere quickly

ex.en: My sister listens to pop while she cooks dinner.
ex.zh: 我姐姐做晚饭时会听流行音乐。

ex.en: Pop can introduce young listeners to other cultures, especially when artists combine different musical traditions.
ex.zh: 流行音乐可以让年轻听众了解其他文化，尤其是在艺人融合不同音乐传统时。

col: pop into a shop｜顺便进店
tip: 表示短暂去或顺手放时属非正式用法。

senses.en: creative expression through activities such as painting, sculpture, or drawing
objects or images created to express ideas or beauty
a skill developed through practice and careful understanding

ex.en: We spent the afternoon making art with coloured paper.
ex.zh: 我们花了一下午用彩纸创作艺术作品。

ex.en: Public funding for art can enrich community life and make cultural experiences accessible to a wider audience.
ex.zh: 公共艺术资助能丰富社区生活，让更多人有机会体验文化活动。

col: a work of art｜一件艺术作品
the art of conversation｜交谈的艺术
tip: art指艺术通常不可数；一件作品用a work of art。

senses.en: another informal word for grandmother

ex.en: Granny knitted me a warm scarf.
ex.zh: 奶奶给我织了一条温暖的围巾。

ex.en: We are staying at granny's house for the holiday.
ex.zh: 假期我们住在奶奶家。

tip: granny 与 grandma 都是对奶奶/外婆的亲昵称呼。
scene: A grandmother knitting a scarf in a rocking chair by the window.

senses.en: A cabinet with doors and shelves for storing things

ex.en: The clean bowls are in the cupboard above the sink.
ex.zh: 干净的碗放在水槽上方的橱柜里。

ex.en: Well-designed cupboards can maximise storage space in small apartments without making living areas feel crowded.
ex.zh: 设计合理的橱柜可以充分利用小公寓的储物空间，又不会让起居区域显得拥挤。

tip: cupboard中的p不发音；通常指带门的储物柜。

senses.en: Less good or more unpleasant, harmful, or serious.
Less well or more badly.

ex.en: The weather grew worse as we climbed the hill.
ex.zh: 我们爬山时，天气变得更糟了。

ex.en: Traffic congestion may become worse unless cities invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
ex.zh: 除非城市投资建设可靠且价格合理的公共交通，否则交通拥堵可能进一步恶化。

tip: bad和badly的比较级；最高级是worst。

senses.en: a paper or digital record containing information
record information about something in writing, photographs, or other forms

ex.en: Please save the document before you close your laptop.
ex.zh: 合上笔记本电脑之前，请保存文档。

ex.en: Researchers should document changes in local wildlife to assess the environmental impact of urban development.
ex.zh: 研究人员应记录当地野生生物的变化，以评估城市开发对环境的影响。

tip: 动词末尾读/ment/，名词末尾读/mənt/。

senses.en: A team sport using a bat, ball, and wickets.
A jumping insect that makes a chirping sound.

ex.en: We played cricket in the park after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我们在公园里打板球。

ex.en: Team sports such as cricket can help young people develop cooperation skills and build lasting friendships.
ex.zh: 板球等团队运动可以帮助年轻人培养合作能力，建立持久的友谊。

col: a cricket match｜一场板球比赛
tip: 指板球运动时不可数；指蟋蟀时可数。

senses.en: A fish with a cartilage skeleton and usually sharp teeth.
Someone who cheats others, especially to get their money.

ex.en: We watched a shark swim slowly behind the aquarium glass.
ex.zh: 我们看着一条鲨鱼在水族馆的玻璃后缓缓游动。

ex.en: Protecting shark populations helps maintain balanced marine ecosystems because many species regulate the numbers of other animals.
ex.zh: 保护鲨鱼种群有助于维持海洋生态平衡，因为许多鲨鱼物种能调节其他动物的数量。

tip: loan shark指放高利贷者，不是某种鲨鱼。

senses.en: To separate into pieces or damage something so it stops working.
A short period when an activity stops.
To fail to obey a rule or keep a promise.

ex.en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
ex.zh: 小心别打碎那个玻璃碗。

ex.en: Regular breaks during study sessions may improve concentration and help students retain new information.
ex.zh: 学习期间定时休息可能有助于提高注意力，并帮助学生记住新知识。

tip: 动词变化为break—broke—broken；休息用take a break。

senses.en: a rounded object laid by female birds and some other animals
a female reproductive cell that can develop after fertilisation

ex.en: She cracked an egg into the hot frying pan.
ex.zh: 她把一个鸡蛋打进了热煎锅。

ex.en: Eggs provide an affordable source of protein and can form part of a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 鸡蛋是价格实惠的蛋白质来源，可以成为均衡饮食的一部分。

tip: scrambled eggs指炒蛋；egg white指蛋清。

senses.en: A period of twelve months
An annual period organised for education, business, or another purpose

ex.en: We moved into this flat almost a year ago.
ex.zh: 我们搬进这套公寓快一年了。

ex.en: A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
ex.zh: 间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。

tip: last year等时间短语前不加介词；年龄用years old。

senses.en: Involving two or more countries.
A match between countries, or a player representing a country.

ex.en: My sister is taking an international flight tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我姐姐明天早上要乘坐国际航班。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。

tip: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

senses.en: Costing no money.
Able to act or move without being controlled or restricted.
To release someone or something from control or confinement.

ex.en: The café offers free biscuits with every hot drink.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆每卖一杯热饮都会赠送饼干。

ex.en: Providing free public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment for disadvantaged residents.
ex.zh: 提供免费公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善弱势居民的就业可及性。

tip: be free to do表示可以自由做；for free表示免费。

senses.en: Something that happens, especially an important or planned occasion.
A particular contest within a sports competition.

ex.en: The outdoor concert was our town's biggest summer event.
ex.zh: 这场户外音乐会是我们镇上夏季最大的活动。

ex.en: Hosting a major cultural event can boost local tourism, although the financial benefits may be unevenly distributed.
ex.zh: 举办大型文化活动可以促进当地旅游业，但经济收益的分配可能不均。

col: in the event of｜万一发生
tip: in the event of后接名词，意为“万一发生”。

senses.en: Used to introduce a contrasting statement.
No matter how much or to what degree.
In any way that someone chooses.

ex.en: The jacket looked warm; however, it felt surprisingly thin.
ex.zh: 这件夹克看起来很暖和，摸起来却出奇地薄。

ex.en: Online courses offer greater flexibility; however, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers.
ex.zh: 在线课程更加灵活；不过，有些学习者从与教师的直接互动中获益更多。

col: however hard you try｜无论你多努力
tip: 表转折时不是并列连词；勿仅用逗号连接两句。

senses.en: a building displaying objects of historical, scientific, or artistic interest

ex.en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。

ex.en: Museums can help young people understand local history by connecting everyday objects with the lives of previous generations.
ex.zh: 博物馆可以将日常物品与前人的生活联系起来，帮助年轻人了解当地历史。

col: natural history museum｜自然历史博物馆
tip: museum是可数名词；参观博物馆说visit a museum。

senses.en: A place where people buy goods or services.
To visit stores or websites to look for and buy things.

ex.en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的小店卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Independent shops can strengthen local economies by creating jobs and keeping spending within the community.
ex.zh: 独立商店可以通过创造就业并让消费留在社区内，促进地方经济。

tip: 买某类商品用shop for；泛指去购物用go shopping。

senses.en: Saturday and Sunday, often a time away from work.

ex.en: We usually visit the farmers' market at the weekend.
ex.zh: 我们通常在周末逛农贸市场。

ex.en: Affordable weekend activities can encourage families to spend more time together in their local communities.
ex.zh: 价格亲民的周末活动能鼓励家人在当地社区共度更多时光。

col: a long weekend｜连休的长周末
tip: 英式常说 at the weekend，美式常用 on。

senses.en: A knitted garment worn over the upper body for warmth.

ex.en: I pulled on a warm sweater before going outside.
ex.zh: 出门前，我套上了一件暖和的毛衣。

ex.en: Choosing a durable wool sweater rather than several cheap alternatives can reduce clothing waste over time.
ex.zh: 选择一件耐穿的羊毛衫，而不是多件廉价替代品，长远来看可以减少衣物浪费。

tip: 英式英语也常用jumper；sweatshirt指运动衫。

senses.en: being in a place; existing or happening now
to show, explain or formally give something
something given to someone; the time happening now

ex.en: All the children were present for the class photo.
ex.zh: 拍班级合照时，所有孩子都在场。

ex.en: Researchers should present their findings clearly so that policymakers can make informed decisions about public health.
ex.zh: 研究人员应清楚地展示研究结果，以便政策制定者就公共卫生作出有依据的决策。

tip: 名词、形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: many different types of something

ex.en: The toy shop has all sorts of board games.
ex.zh: 这家玩具店有各种各样的桌游。

ex.en: She likes reading all sorts of books.
ex.zh: 她喜欢读各种各样的书。

tip: all sorts of 和 all kinds of 意思相近，都可以表示“各种各样的”。
scene: A colourful toy shop shelf filled with many different types of games.

senses.en: a signal with red, yellow and green lights for traffic

ex.en: Stop at the traffic light and wait for green.
ex.zh: 在红绿灯前停下，等绿灯。

ex.en: The traffic light turned red just as we arrived.
ex.zh: 我们到的时候红绿灯刚变红。

tip: traffic light 红绿灯；green light 绿灯通行，red light 红灯停。
scene: A traffic light showing green above a busy crossing.

senses.en: making you feel surprise

ex.en: It is surprising how fast the puppy grew.
ex.zh: 小狗长得这么快真令人惊讶。

ex.en: The surprising result shocked everyone.
ex.zh: 出人意料的结果震惊了所有人。

tip: surprising 形容事物；surprised 形容人的感受。
scene: A person with a surprised face seeing a birthday surprise party.

senses.en: Any person, or someone whose identity is not specified.

ex.en: Does anybody know where I left my blue umbrella?
ex.zh: 有人知道我把蓝色雨伞放在哪里了吗？

ex.en: Public libraries should be accessible to anybody who wishes to learn, regardless of their income or background.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应向所有想学习的人开放，不论其收入或背景如何。

tip: anybody作主语时，谓语用单数形式。

senses.en: A female parent.
Care for someone protectively, as a mother would.

ex.en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我妈妈教会了我骑自行车。

ex.en: Affordable childcare can help a mother return to work without placing excessive pressure on the family budget.
ex.zh: 负担得起的托育服务能帮助母亲重返职场，而不给家庭预算带来过大压力。

tip: 英式口语常用mum，美式口语常用mom。

senses.en: before anything else

ex.en: First of all, let me thank everyone for coming.
ex.zh: 首先，感谢大家的到来。

ex.en: First of all, wash your hands.
ex.zh: 首先，洗一下手。

tip: first of all 用于列举时的第一点，类似 firstly。
scene: A teacher raising one finger to say first of all to a class.

senses.en: money paid regularly to use someone else's property
to pay to use something owned by someone else
to let someone use your property in exchange for payment

ex.en: My monthly rent includes water but not electricity.
ex.zh: 我每月的租金包含水费，但不含电费。

ex.en: Rising rents in urban areas can force essential workers to live further from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 城市地区租金上涨可能迫使提供基本服务的劳动者住得离工作地点更远。

col: rent out a room｜出租房间
tip: rent可指租入或出租；rent out明确表示出租。

senses.en: needing rest or sleep because of physical or mental effort
annoyed or bored by something that continues or repeats

ex.en: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
ex.zh: 散步后我累得不想做饭。

ex.en: Employees who regularly work long hours may become too tired to perform their duties safely.
ex.zh: 经常长时间工作的员工可能会疲惫不堪，无法安全地履行职责。

col: too tired to concentrate｜累得无法集中注意力
tip: tired形容人感到累；tiring形容事情令人累。

senses.en: Enjoy an activity or take part in a game
Perform music or a role, or make a recording run
A story written for actors to perform

ex.en: The children played with wooden blocks on the floor.
ex.zh: 孩子们在地板上玩木制积木。

ex.en: Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.
ex.zh: 学校应提供安全的户外空间，让孩子们玩耍并培养重要的社交技能。

col: play a role in｜在…中发挥作用
put on a play｜上演一部戏剧
tip: 球类前通常不加冠词；乐器前通常用the。

senses.en: a polite way to show thanks

ex.en: Thank you for the lovely birthday card.
ex.zh: 谢谢你送的美好生日贺卡。

ex.en: 'Thank you very much,' she said with a smile.
ex.zh: “非常感谢。”她笑着说。

tip: thank you very much 是“非常感谢”；口语常说 thanks。
scene: A girl smiling and saying thank you as she receives a card.

senses.en: not the same as someone or something else
used to describe several separate people, things, or types

ex.en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
ex.zh: 这些手套看起来相似，但尺码不同。

ex.en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
ex.zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。

tip: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

senses.en: An artificial swimming basin or a small area of still water
A supply of money, people, or resources available for shared use
To combine resources so people can use them together

ex.en: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在室外游泳池游泳。

ex.en: Small businesses can pool their resources to purchase equipment that would otherwise be too expensive.
ex.zh: 小企业可以集中资源，购买单独承担会过于昂贵的设备。

col: a pool of talent｜人才储备
tip: pool resources指集中资源；play pool则指打美式台球。

senses.en: music with words spoken rhythmically over a strong beat
to speak words rhythmically over a musical beat
to hit a surface with short, sharp blows

ex.en: My brother listens to rap while he cooks dinner.
ex.zh: 我哥哥做晚饭时会听说唱音乐。

ex.en: Rap can give young people a creative way to express their experiences and discuss social issues.
ex.zh: 说唱能为年轻人提供一种富有创意的方式，表达经历并讨论社会问题。

col: rap on the door｜急促敲门
tip: rap重读闭音节结尾：rapped、rapping双写p。

senses.en: Earlier than a particular time or event.
Earlier than the time when something happens.
At an earlier time.

ex.en: Please put your shoes by the door before dinner.
ex.zh: 请在晚饭前把鞋放到门边。

ex.en: Before introducing new transport policies, local authorities should consult residents about their daily travel needs.
ex.zh: 地方政府在推出新的交通政策之前，应就居民的日常出行需求征求意见。

col: before making a decision｜作决定之前
tip: 时间从句表将来时，before后通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable.

ex.en: We had a wonderful picnic beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边度过了一段美好的野餐时光。

ex.en: Public libraries offer wonderful opportunities for children to discover new interests without placing financial pressure on families.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆为儿童发现新兴趣提供了极好的机会，又不会给家庭带来经济压力。

tip: 表示极好或令人愉快，不等于奇怪的。

senses.zh: 机械修理工；汽车修理工
senses.en: Someone whose job is repairing vehicles or machines.

ex.en: The mechanic found a leak under our car.
ex.zh: 修理工发现我们的汽车底部有一处泄漏。

ex.en: As electric vehicles become more common, mechanics need additional training to maintain their complex systems safely.
ex.zh: 随着电动汽车日益普及，修理工需要接受额外培训，以安全地维护其复杂系统。

col: a qualified mechanic｜合格的机械修理工
work as a mechanic｜当机械修理工
tip: mechanic指修理工；mechanics可指力学。

senses.en: A book of blank pages for writing notes.
A small portable computer with a folding screen.

ex.en: She keeps a small notebook beside her bed.
ex.zh: 她在床边放着一本小笔记本。

ex.en: Keeping a notebook during fieldwork allows researchers to record observations that photographs alone may not capture.
ex.zh: 实地研究时使用笔记本，有助于研究人员记录仅靠照片可能无法捕捉的观察结果。

col: write in a notebook｜在笔记本上写
a spiral notebook｜螺旋装订笔记本
tip: 通常指纸质笔记本；电脑义也可说notebook computer。

senses.en: having the colour of fresh snow or milk
the colour of fresh snow or milk
the clear part of an egg that turns white when cooked

ex.en: She wore a white cotton shirt to the picnic.
ex.zh: 她穿着一件白色棉衬衫去野餐。

ex.en: Painting roofs white can help buildings reflect sunlight and reduce the energy needed for cooling.
ex.zh: 把屋顶刷成白色有助于建筑物反射阳光，并减少制冷所需的能源。

tip: egg white指蛋清；蛋黄是yolk。

senses.en: the activity of riding and performing tricks on a skateboard

ex.en: We went skateboarding at the park after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我们去公园玩滑板了。

ex.en: Dedicated skateboarding facilities give young people safe spaces to exercise and develop their balance and coordination.
ex.zh: 专用滑板设施为年轻人提供了安全的锻炼空间，帮助他们提高平衡感和协调能力。

tip: 运动用skateboarding；滑板这件器材用skateboard。

senses.en: greater than usual in size, amount, or number

ex.en: A large dog was sleeping beside the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 一只大狗正睡在厨房门旁。

ex.en: Large cities often offer better employment opportunities, although high housing costs can reduce residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 大城市通常提供更好的就业机会，但高昂的住房成本可能降低居民的生活质量。

tip: large number接可数名词，large amount接不可数名词。

senses.en: a period of sixty minutes
the times when someone works or a service operates

ex.en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
ex.zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。

ex.en: Reducing working hours may improve employee wellbeing without necessarily lowering overall productivity in the workplace.
ex.zh: 缩短工作时间可能改善员工的身心健康，而不一定降低工作场所的整体生产率。

tip: h不发音，所以说an hour，而不是a hour。

senses.en: Having a husband or wife.
Relating to marriage or life as a couple.

ex.en: My sister is married and lives near the coast.
ex.zh: 我姐姐已婚，住在海岸附近。

ex.en: Affordable housing can help newly married couples establish independent households without placing excessive pressure on their finances.
ex.zh: 可负担的住房有助于新婚夫妇独立成家，而不会给他们带来过重的经济压力。

col: be married to｜与……有婚姻关系
tip: 与某人结婚用 be/get married to，不用 with。

senses.en: Containing as much as possible, with no space left.
Including everything, with nothing missing.
Having eaten enough and not wanting more food.

ex.en: The basket is full, so we need another one.
ex.zh: 篮子已经满了，我们得再拿一个。

ex.en: Governments should publish the full results of environmental studies so that citizens can make informed decisions.
ex.zh: 政府应公布环境研究的完整结果，以便公民作出知情决策。

tip: full of表示“充满”；注意full与fool发音不同。

senses.en: to take place, often without being planned
to do or be something by chance

ex.en: What happened to the plant beside your window?
ex.zh: 你窗边那盆植物怎么了？

ex.en: Traffic accidents are more likely to happen when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.
ex.zh: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，更容易发生交通事故。

col: happen to someone｜发生在某人身上
happen to do something｜碰巧做某事
tip: 不用于被动语态；happen to do表示碰巧做某事。

senses.zh: 完全；根本（用于否定句、疑问句）
senses.en: in any way; used in negatives and questions

ex.en: I don't like this film at all.
ex.zh: 我一点也不喜欢这部电影。

ex.en: Are you tired at all?
ex.zh: 你有一点累吗？

tip: at all 用于否定句表示“一点也不”，用于疑问句表示“究竟、到底”。
scene: A girl frowning and shaking her head while watching a film on TV.

senses.en: the achievement of an aim or a desired result
a person or thing that achieves a good result

ex.en: The school concert was a success despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下了雨，学校音乐会还是很成功。

ex.en: Long-term success in education depends not only on funding but also on the quality of teaching.
ex.zh: 教育的长期成功不仅取决于资金投入，也取决于教学质量。

col: the key to success｜成功的关键
tip: 泛指成功时不可数；a success指成功的人或事。

senses.en: a value used for counting, measuring, or identifying something
the total amount of people or things
to assign identifying figures or add up to a total

ex.en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
ex.zh: 我把你的电话号码存到了新手机里。

ex.en: The number of people working from home has increased as digital communication tools have improved.
ex.zh: 随着数字通信工具的改进，居家办公的人数有所增加。

tip: a number of接复数谓语；the number of接单数谓语。

senses.en: To pick up, hold, or carry something away.
To require a particular amount of time or effort.
To use a particular form of transport.

ex.en: Take an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 带把伞吧，今天下午可能会下雨。

ex.en: Developing reliable public transport networks takes considerable time and requires sustained investment from local authorities.
ex.zh: 建设可靠的公共交通网络需要相当长的时间，也需要地方政府持续投入资金。

tip: 过去式took，过去分词taken；take带走，bring带来。

senses.en: a person who works in business

ex.en: She is a business person who travels a lot.
ex.zh: 她是一位经常出差的商务人士。

ex.en: The hotel welcomes business people from all over the world.
ex.zh: 这家酒店欢迎来自世界各地的商务人士。

tip: business person 是不分性别的说法，比 businessman/businesswoman 更中性。
scene: A person in a suit with a briefcase walking into a glass office building.

senses.en: A knitted piece of clothing covering the upper body.

senses.zh: 跳跃者；跳高或跳远运动员
senses.en: A person or animal that jumps, especially in sport.
A sleeveless dress worn over a shirt or blouse.

ex.en: I packed a warm jumper for the camping trip.
ex.zh: 我为这次露营带了一件暖和的套头毛衣。

ex.en: Wearing a jumper indoors can reduce the need for heating during colder months.
ex.zh: 在寒冷的月份，室内穿毛衣可以减少供暖需求。

col: put on a jumper｜穿上套头毛衣
tip: 英式英语指套头毛衣；美式通常用sweater。

senses.en: get pleasure from an activity or experience
have something good, such as a right or advantage

ex.en: We enjoy walking beside the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们喜欢晚饭后在河边散步。

ex.en: Residents enjoy better health when their neighbourhoods provide safe walking routes and accessible green spaces.
ex.zh: 社区提供安全的步行路线和便利的绿地时，居民的健康状况会更好。

tip: 接动词时用-ing形式，不用to do。

senses.en: A large piece of cloth used to cover a bed.
A thin, flat piece of paper, metal, or another material.

ex.en: I spread a clean sheet over the mattress.
ex.zh: 我在床垫上铺了一条干净的床单。

ex.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to use both sides of each sheet.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生使用每张纸的正反两面，以减少纸张浪费。

col: a sheet of glass｜一块玻璃
tip: sheet是可数名词；一张纸说a sheet of paper。

senses.en: a child who goes to school

ex.en: Every schoolchild in the town got a free book.
ex.zh: 镇上的每个学童都得到了一本免费的书。

ex.en: The schoolchildren walked to the museum in a line.
ex.zh: 小学生们排着队走去博物馆。

tip: schoolchild 复数 schoolchildren；pupil 也指学生。
scene: Schoolchildren in uniform walking in a line with backpacks.

senses.en: the first month of the year

ex.en: Our swimming lessons begin in January this year.
ex.zh: 我们今年的游泳课从一月开始。

ex.en: Many people set health goals in January, but maintaining new habits requires consistent support.
ex.zh: 许多人在一月设定健康目标，但保持新习惯需要持续的支持。

tip: 月份首字母大写；在一月用in January。

senses.en: An activity you regularly do for pleasure in your free time

ex.en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
ex.zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。

ex.en: Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.
ex.zh: 拥有创造性的业余爱好能帮助人们调节压力，保持工作与休闲之间的健康平衡。

col: take up a hobby｜开始培养一种爱好
a creative hobby｜创造性的业余爱好
pursue a hobby｜从事业余爱好
tip: 可数名词，复数为hobbies；开始一种爱好用take up。

senses.en: a person who creates paintings, sculptures, or other art
a person who performs music or other entertainment professionally

ex.en: The artist painted the harbour in soft blue colours.
ex.zh: 这位画家用柔和的蓝色描绘了港口。

ex.en: Public funding allows an artist to create work that enriches community life without depending entirely on sales.
ex.zh: 公共资助使艺术家能够创作丰富社区生活的作品，而不必完全依赖销售收入。

tip: artist指艺术家；artistic是形容词“艺术的”。

senses.en: At any time, especially in questions and negative statements.
Continuously or always, often describing an ongoing change.
Used to emphasize surprise in a question.

ex.en: Have you ever watched the sunrise from a mountain?
ex.zh: 你曾经在山上看过日出吗？

ex.en: Public transport is more important than ever as growing cities struggle with congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 随着不断扩张的城市面临交通拥堵和空气污染，公共交通比以往任何时候都更重要。

col: more than ever｜比以往任何时候都更
tip: 问经历常用Have you ever…；肯定句不随意代替always。

senses.en: used to make a word or sentence negative

ex.en: I am not hungry right now.
ex.zh: 我现在不饿。

ex.en: This is not my umbrella.
ex.zh: 这不是我的伞。

tip: not 用于构成否定；can not 可缩为 can't，is not 缩为 isn't。
scene: A girl shaking her head at a plate of food, saying she's not hungry.

senses.en: The daughter of someone's son or daughter

ex.en: Her granddaughter brought fresh flowers when she visited on Sunday.
ex.zh: 她的孙女星期天来看她时带来了鲜花。

ex.en: Regular contact with a granddaughter or grandson can help older adults feel more connected to family life.
ex.zh: 经常与孙辈联系，可以帮助老年人更好地融入家庭生活。

col: youngest granddaughter｜最小的孙女或外孙女
granddaughter's birthday｜孙女或外孙女的生日
tip: 既指孙女也指外孙女，英语不区分父系与母系。

senses.en: Someone travelling in a vehicle without driving or operating it

ex.en: A passenger left a blue umbrella on the bus.
ex.zh: 一位乘客把一把蓝色雨伞落在了公交车上。

ex.en: Improved rail services could increase passenger numbers and reduce reliance on private cars.
ex.zh: 改善铁路服务可以增加乘客数量，减少人们对私家车的依赖。

tip: 指乘坐交通工具的人，不包括驾驶员或机组人员。

senses.en: as a result of something

ex.en: The match was cancelled because of the rain.
ex.zh: 比赛因为下雨被取消了。

ex.en: She stayed at home because of her cold.
ex.zh: 她因为感冒待在家里。

tip: because of 后接名词/代词；because 后接完整句子。
scene: A wet football pitch with raindrops falling, a match sign saying cancelled.

senses.en: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website.
A single item, especially one belonging to a particular group.
A word such as a, an, or the before a noun.

ex.en: I read an interesting article about growing tomatoes indoors.
ex.zh: 我读了一篇关于室内种植番茄的有趣文章。

ex.en: The article examines how access to green spaces influences mental health in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 这篇文章探讨了在密集人口城市中，绿地的可及性如何影响心理健康。

col: an article of clothing｜一件衣物
tip: 一件衣物可说an article of clothing。

senses.en: To be upright on your feet, or get into this position.
To accept something unpleasant without becoming too upset.
A firm opinion or action supporting or opposing something.

ex.en: Please stand near the door until the bus stops.
ex.zh: 请站在车门附近，等公交车停稳。

ex.en: Local residents took a stand against the proposed road because it would destroy valuable woodland.
ex.zh: 当地居民坚决反对这条拟建道路，因为它会破坏珍贵的林地。

col: can't stand doing something｜无法忍受做某事
take a stand｜表明坚定立场
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为stood；忍受常用can't stand。

senses.en: A person aged thirteen to nineteen.

ex.en: As a teenager, I cycled to school every day.
ex.zh: 我十几岁时每天骑自行车上学。

ex.en: Schools should provide spaces where teenagers can discuss their concerns and receive support from trained staff.
ex.zh: 学校应提供场所，让青少年能够讨论自己的困扰，并获得受过培训的工作人员的支持。

col: a young teenager｜十三四岁的青少年
as a teenager｜在青少年时期
tip: 特指13至19岁的人，不泛指所有未成年人。

senses.en: in place of someone or something else

ex.en: The café was closed, so we went home instead.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆关门了，于是我们改为回家。

ex.en: Instead of expanding roads, cities should invest in public transport to reduce congestion and pollution.
ex.zh: 城市应投资公共交通，而不是拓宽道路，以减少拥堵和污染。

tip: instead可单独作副词；instead of后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: used to express a strong obligation or requirement
used to express a confident conclusion
something considered essential

ex.en: You must wear a helmet when riding here.
ex.zh: 在这里骑车必须戴头盔。

ex.en: Governments must ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 政府必须确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不论其家庭收入如何。

col: must have done｜想必已经做过
an absolute must｜绝对必需的事物
tip: must是情态动词；mustn't表禁止，不是“不必”。

senses.en: The space above the earth where clouds and stars appear.

ex.en: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
ex.zh: 我们步行回家时，天空变成了橙色。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars clearly in the night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民无法清楚地看到夜空中的星星。

tip: 通常用the sky；skies常用于描述天气或某地天空。

senses.en: Causing great surprise or admiration.

ex.en: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
ex.zh: 从山上望去的景色真是令人惊叹。

ex.en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
ex.zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。

col: an amazing experience｜一次奇妙的经历
tip: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

senses.en: to get dressed or put something on your body

ex.en: Put on your coat, it's cold outside.
ex.zh: 穿上外套，外面很冷。

ex.en: She put on her glasses to read.
ex.zh: 她戴上眼镜看书。

tip: put on 是“穿上/戴上”；反义短语是 take off（脱下）。
scene: A child putting on a warm coat by the front door.

senses.en: concerning a particular subject
approximately, rather than exactly
in various places within or around somewhere

ex.en: We talked about our holiday plans over dinner.
ex.zh: 我们吃晚饭时聊了假期计划。

ex.en: Schools should teach children about the environmental consequences of their everyday choices and habits.
ex.zh: 学校应教导孩子了解日常选择和习惯对环境的影响。

tip: about可表示话题或约数；be about to表示即将。

senses.en: A married woman managing her home rather than doing paid work.

ex.en: As a housewife, she manages a busy household.
ex.zh: 作为家庭主妇，她操持着一个忙碌家庭的日常事务。

ex.en: The unpaid work of a housewife contributes to family welfare but is often excluded from economic statistics.
ex.zh: 家庭主妇的无偿劳动有助于家庭福祉，却往往不被纳入经济统计。

col: a full-time housewife｜全职家庭主妇
work as a housewife｜做家庭主妇
tip: 复数为housewives；homemaker不限定性别。

senses.en: Two slices of bread with a filling between them.
To place or squeeze something between two other things.

ex.en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
ex.zh: 我带了一个奶酪三明治和一个苹果当午餐。

ex.en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating by offering sandwiches made with wholegrain bread and fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以提供用全麦面包和新鲜蔬菜制作的三明治，促进更健康的饮食。

tip: 动词常用被动结构be sandwiched between。

senses.en: a sweatshirt with a hood

ex.en: He wears a grey hoodie every day.
ex.zh: 他每天都穿一件灰色连帽衫。

ex.en: My new hoodie has a pocket in the front.
ex.zh: 我的新连帽衫前面有个口袋。

tip: hoodie 是带帽子的运动衫，学生中很流行。
scene: A grey hoodie hanging on a hanger in a teenager's bedroom.

senses.en: Moving, happening, or taking place at a low speed.
To move or happen less quickly, or make something do so.
Showing a time earlier than the correct time.

ex.en: We took a slow walk along the river.
ex.zh: 我们沿着河边慢慢散步。

ex.en: Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通扩建进展缓慢，可能会削弱通勤者放弃私家车的意愿。

col: slow economic growth｜缓慢的经济增长
tip: slow多作形容词；修饰一般动作通常用slowly。

senses.en: to lift something up, or to collect someone

ex.en: Please pick up the litter and put it in the bin.
ex.zh: 请捡起垃圾放进垃圾桶。

ex.en: Mum will pick me up after school.
ex.zh: 妈妈放学后来接我。

tip: pick up 有多种意思：捡起、接人、学会（pick up a language）。
scene: A child picking up a piece of paper and putting it in a bin.

senses.en: to create or produce something
to cause a state or force an action
the brand or type of a manufactured product

ex.en: We made a small table from leftover pieces of wood.
ex.zh: 我们用剩下的木料做了一张小桌子。

ex.en: Schools can make science more accessible by allowing students to conduct simple experiments with everyday materials.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生用日常材料做简单实验，使科学更容易理解。

tip: 主动式make sb do；被动式be made to do。

senses.en: A container used for serving or cooking food.
Food prepared in a particular way as part of a meal.
Plates, bowls, and other utensils used for meals.

ex.en: Please put the strawberries in that blue dish.
ex.zh: 请把草莓放进那个蓝色盘子里。

ex.en: Traditional dishes can attract international tourists while helping local communities preserve their distinctive food culture.
ex.zh: 传统菜肴既能吸引国际游客，也能帮助当地社区保留独特的饮食文化。

tip: a dish可指一道菜；do the dishes指洗餐具。

senses.en: referring to all members of a group individually
used to show how regularly something happens
used to emphasize all possibilities or a strong degree

ex.en: Every child brought a favourite toy to the picnic.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都带了一件最喜欢的玩具去野餐。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that every student has access to reliable internet services for learning.
ex.zh: 政府应确保每个学生都能使用可靠的互联网服务进行学习。

col: every reason to believe｜充分的理由相信
tip: every后通常接单数可数名词，谓语也用单数。

senses.en: To a fairly large degree, but not extremely.
Completely or to the greatest possible degree.

ex.en: The soup is quite spicy, but I like it.
ex.zh: 这汤挺辣的，不过我喜欢。

ex.en: Although cycling is quite popular among students, inadequate infrastructure prevents many commuters from choosing this sustainable option.
ex.zh: 虽然骑行在学生中颇受欢迎，但基础设施不足使许多通勤者无法选择这种可持续的出行方式。

tip: quite good常指相当好；quite impossible指完全不可能。

senses.en: Unhappy, worried, or disappointed about something.
To make someone feel unhappy or worried.
To disturb the usual arrangement or balance of something.

ex.en: Lena felt upset when she lost her favourite scarf.
ex.zh: 莉娜丢了最喜欢的围巾，心里很难过。

ex.en: Sudden changes to school routines can upset younger children, who often rely on predictable daily activities.
ex.zh: 学校作息突然改变可能让年幼的孩子不安，因为他们往往依赖可预期的日常活动。

col: upset someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划
tip: 动词过去式、过去分词仍是upset；名词重音在前。

senses.en: making little or no noise
having little activity or excitement
a state with little or no noise

ex.en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
ex.zh: 孩子们睡着后，屋子里安静了下来。

ex.en: Quiet study spaces in public libraries are essential for students who cannot concentrate at home.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆内安静的学习空间对无法在家集中注意力的学生至关重要。

tip: quiet是“安静的”，quite是“相当”，注意拼写。

senses.en: to put something with something else or increase an amount
to combine numbers to find their total
to say something more after an earlier statement

ex.en: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
ex.zh: 如果汤太稠，就加一点牛奶。

ex.en: Adding more green spaces to urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and provide habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 为城市社区增加绿地可以改善居民的身心健康，并为野生动物提供栖息地。

tip: add A to B表示把A加入B；add to还可表示增添。

senses.en: Something known or proved to be true.

ex.en: We checked the facts before booking our train tickets.
ex.zh: 我们核实了相关情况后才订火车票。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish facts from opinions when evaluating information shared through digital media.
ex.zh: 学生在评估数字媒体传播的信息时，应学会区分事实和观点。

tip: the fact that后接完整从句，说明事实内容。

senses.en: pleasant or enjoyable
kind and friendly towards other people

ex.en: We had a nice picnic beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边愉快地野餐了一次。

ex.en: Although nice surroundings matter, affordable housing and reliable transport are more important to many urban residents.
ex.zh: 虽然宜人的环境很重要，但对许多城市居民而言，可负担的住房和可靠的交通更为重要。

col: be nice to someone｜友善地对待某人
tip: nice含义较宽，正式写作宜换成更具体的形容词。

senses.en: with a particular amount taken away
below zero
a disadvantage or negative feature

ex.en: Ten minus three leaves enough apples for everyone.
ex.zh: 十个苹果减去三个，剩下的仍够每人分一个。

ex.en: A household's disposable income is its total income minus taxes and other compulsory payments.
ex.zh: 家庭可支配收入是总收入扣除税款及其他强制性支出后剩余的部分。

tip: minus可表减去，也可置于温度前表示零下。

senses.en: lost or absent, with whereabouts unknown
not present where something should be

ex.en: We found the missing kitten asleep behind the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们发现那只找不到的小猫正在沙发后面睡觉。

ex.en: Missing data can undermine the reliability of research findings and lead policymakers to draw inaccurate conclusions.
ex.zh: 数据缺失会削弱研究结果的可靠性，并导致政策制定者得出不准确的结论。

tip: missing作形容词表不见或缺失；be missing from表缺少。

senses.en: Located on the left side.

ex.en: Keep your ticket in the left-hand pocket of your jacket.
ex.zh: 把票放在夹克左侧的口袋里。

ex.en: Separating cyclists from vehicles in the left-hand lane could make this busy road safer for everyone.
ex.zh: 将骑行者与左侧车道的车辆隔开，可以让这条繁忙道路对所有人都更安全。

tip: left-hand指左侧；left-handed指惯用左手的。

senses.en: A small bag sewn into clothing for carrying things.
To put something in your pocket, or take money dishonestly.
Small enough to fit easily inside a pocket.

ex.en: I found my missing key in my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 我在外套口袋里找到了丢失的钥匙。

ex.en: Pocket dictionaries remain useful for language learners when internet access is unavailable or unreliable.
ex.zh: 当无法上网或网络不稳定时，袖珍词典对语言学习者仍然很有用。

col: out of pocket｜自掏腰包的；亏钱的
tip: pocket money指零花钱，英式英语中常用。

senses.en: The often colourful part of a plant that produces seeds.
To produce flowers.

ex.en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
ex.zh: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市公园种植本地花卉能够帮助传粉昆虫生存，并改善当地生物多样性。

tip: flower既可作名词“花”，也可作动词“开花”。

senses.en: having many clouds in the sky
not clear or transparent

ex.en: It was cloudy, so we left our sunglasses at home.
ex.zh: 当时天阴着，所以我们把太阳镜留在了家里。

ex.en: Solar panels can still generate electricity on cloudy days, although their output is usually lower.
ex.zh: 太阳能电池板在阴天仍能发电，不过发电量通常较低。

tip: 既可形容天空多云，也可形容液体浑浊。

senses.en: including everything, or complete in degree
the amount obtained by adding everything together
to reach a particular amount or add amounts together

ex.en: The total cost includes breakfast and a bus ticket.
ex.zh: 总费用包含早餐和一张公交车票。

ex.en: Improving home insulation can reduce total energy consumption while making housing more comfortable throughout the year.
ex.zh: 改善住宅隔热性能可以减少能源总消耗，同时让住房全年都更加舒适。

tip: in total表示“总共”；totally常表示“完全地”。

senses.en: Having great value or a significant effect.
Having considerable power, influence, or status.

ex.en: Keep your important documents in this waterproof folder.
ex.zh: 把你的重要文件放在这个防水文件夹里。

ex.en: Access to reliable information plays an important role in helping citizens make informed decisions about their health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民作出明智的健康决策起着重要作用。

col: important to someone｜对某人很重要
tip: 用It is important to do；importance是名词形式。

senses.en: A room or building where artworks are displayed or sold.
A raised seating area overlooking a hall or theatre.
A collection of images available to view, especially online.

ex.en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring the local gallery.
ex.zh: 一个下雨的下午，我们逛了当地的美术馆。

ex.en: Free entry to a public gallery can make visual art accessible to people from different economic backgrounds.
ex.zh: 公共美术馆免费开放，可以让不同经济背景的人都有机会接触视觉艺术。

col: public gallery｜公共美术馆；旁听席
tip: gallery主要展示艺术品；museum涵盖的展品范围更广。

senses.en: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking
having a large amount of body fat

ex.en: Let the soup cool, then remove the fat.
ex.zh: 让汤凉下来，再撇去油脂。

ex.en: Although the body needs some fat, excessive consumption can increase the risk of certain health problems.
ex.zh: 虽然人体需要一定的脂肪，但摄入过多会增加某些健康问题的风险。

tip: 用fat形容人可能冒犯；谈健康宜用overweight。

senses.en: Walk with firm, regular steps, often in a group.
An organised walk by a group, often to protest.
Music with a strong regular rhythm suitable for marching.

ex.en: The band marched through the square in bright uniforms.
ex.zh: 乐队身穿鲜艳的制服，齐步走过广场。

ex.en: Residents organised a peaceful march to demand safer roads and better public transport in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 居民组织了一场和平游行，要求改善社区道路安全和公共交通。

col: march through the streets｜列队穿过街道
tip: 小写march指行进；大写March指三月。

senses.en: to become healthy and strong through exercise

ex.en: She runs every day to get fit.
ex.zh: 她每天跑步来健身。

ex.en: Joining a sports club can help you get fit.
ex.zh: 加入体育俱乐部可以帮助你保持健康。

tip: get fit 表示“变得健康强壮”；keep fit 表示“保持健康”。
scene: A woman jogging in a park with headphones on, looking energetic.

senses.en: the act of exchanging something for money
a period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices
the amount sold or money earned from selling goods

ex.en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
ex.zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。

ex.en: The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.
ex.zh: 销售本地生产的食品既能支持农民，也能减少长途运输带来的排放。

tip: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。

senses.en: The activity of moving over snow on skis.

ex.en: We went skiing together during our winter holiday.
ex.zh: 寒假期间，我们一起去滑雪了。

ex.en: Skiing attracts winter tourists to mountain regions, creating seasonal jobs but increasing demand for water.
ex.zh: 滑雪吸引冬季游客前往山区，创造了季节性工作，但也增加了用水需求。

tip: 滑雪用go skiing；滑水需说water skiing。

senses.en: A secret word or sequence used to gain access.

ex.en: I forgot my password and couldn't open my account.
ex.zh: 我忘了密码，无法登录账户。

ex.en: Using a different password for each account can reduce the risk of personal information being stolen.
ex.zh: 为每个账户设置不同的密码，可以降低个人信息被盗的风险。

col: a strong password｜安全性高的密码
tip: password是密码；passcode也可指数字口令。

senses.en: used to show surprise or admiration

ex.en: Wow! What a beautiful painting!
ex.zh: 哇！多漂亮的画啊！

ex.en: Wow, that's a great idea!
ex.zh: 哇，那是个好主意！

tip: wow 是表示惊叹的语气词。
scene: A child looking amazed at a colourful painting on an easel.

senses.en: A building where a person or family lives.
To provide a place for people or things to stay.

ex.en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。

ex.en: Local authorities could convert unused office buildings into apartments to house families in need of affordable accommodation.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以将闲置办公楼改造成公寓，为需要可负担住房的家庭提供住所。

tip: 名词读/haʊs/，动词读/haʊz/；home更强调家的归属感。

senses.en: An aircraft with rotating blades that can rise straight upwards.

ex.en: A helicopter landed in the field behind our house.
ex.zh: 一架直升机降落在我们屋后的田野里。

ex.en: A rescue helicopter can reach isolated communities when floods make roads unsafe for emergency vehicles.
ex.zh: 当洪水使道路无法供救援车辆安全通行时，救援直升机可以抵达被困的偏远社区。

tip: 乘直升机用by helicopter，中间不加冠词。

senses.en: A large musical instrument played by pressing black and white keys.

ex.en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。

ex.en: Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.
ex.zh: 学习弹钢琴能帮助儿童培养专注力，并创造性地表达情感。

tip: 表示弹钢琴通常说play the piano。

senses.en: A game where two teams kick a ball into goals.

ex.en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

ex.en: Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。

tip: 英式英语通常称football，美式称soccer。

senses.en: footwear that covers the foot and part of the leg
the enclosed storage space at the back of a car
to start a computer and load its operating system

ex.en: My boots kept my feet dry in the rain.
ex.zh: 我的靴子让双脚在雨中保持干爽。

ex.en: Protective boots are essential for construction workers because they reduce the risk of serious foot injuries.
ex.zh: 防护靴对建筑工人至关重要，因为它们能降低脚部严重受伤的风险。

col: a pair of boots｜一双靴子
boot up a computer｜启动电脑
tip: 汽车后备箱英式说boot，美式说trunk。

senses.en: a circular band, especially one worn on a finger
to make a bell sound or cause one to sound
to contact someone by telephone

ex.en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
ex.zh: 她把那枚银戒指戴在了手指上。

ex.en: Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.
ex.zh: 乘客应将手机调至静音，因为设备反复响铃会打扰公共交通工具上的其他人。

col: give someone a ring｜给某人打电话
tip: 响铃、打电话的过去式为rang，过去分词为rung。

senses.en: a place where people buy and sell goods
the demand for something or the business of trading particular goods
to promote and offer a product for sale

ex.en: We bought fresh peaches at the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们在集市买了新鲜桃子。

ex.en: Companies increasingly market environmentally friendly products to consumers who want to reduce their impact on the planet.
ex.zh: 企业越来越多地向希望减轻自身环境影响的消费者推销环保产品。

tip: a market for sth指对某物的市场需求。

senses.en: The system or process that keeps a building warm.
The process of making something warmer.

ex.en: We turned the heating on when the evening grew chilly.
ex.zh: 傍晚天凉起来时，我们打开了暖气。

ex.en: Improving home insulation can reduce heating costs and lower the environmental impact of household energy consumption.
ex.zh: 改善住宅保温可以降低供暖费用，并减轻家庭能源消耗对环境的影响。

tip: 指供暖时通常不可数：turn on the heating。

senses.en: a mixture of gases and particles produced when something burns
to breathe in smoke from burning tobacco
to produce smoke

ex.en: Dark smoke rose from the toast in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 厨房里的吐司冒出了黑烟。

ex.en: Smoke from forest fires can reduce air quality in cities hundreds of kilometres away.
ex.zh: 森林火灾产生的烟雾会降低数百公里外城市的空气质量。

tip: smoke作“烟雾”通常不可数；smoky意为烟雾弥漫的。

senses.en: to get out of bed, or to stand up

ex.en: I get up at seven every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上七点起床。

ex.en: He got up from his chair to greet us.
ex.zh: 他从椅子上站起来迎接我们。

tip: get up 是“起床并起身”；wake up 只是“醒来”。
scene: A boy stretching as he climbs out of bed in a sunny bedroom.

senses.en: A raised area of land, usually lower than a mountain.

ex.en: We climbed the hill and watched the sunset.
ex.zh: 我们爬上小山，看了日落。

ex.en: Building houses on steep hills can increase construction costs and expose residents to the risk of landslides.
ex.zh: 在陡峭的山坡上建房会增加建设成本，并使居民面临滑坡风险。

tip: hill通常比mountain低矮，但没有统一高度界限。

senses.en: a series of events or stages that repeats
to travel by bicycle
a vehicle with two wheels powered by pedalling

ex.en: I usually cycle to the park on sunny mornings.
ex.zh: 晴朗的早晨，我通常骑自行车去公园。

ex.en: Climate change can disrupt the natural water cycle, increasing the frequency of droughts and floods in some regions.
ex.zh: 气候变化会扰乱自然水循环，使一些地区的干旱和洪水更频繁。

col: cycle to work｜骑自行车上班
tip: cycle作动词表示骑车；骑车上班用cycle to work。

senses.en: after the expected time or near the end of a period
