senses.en: Used informally to greet someone or attract their attention.

ex.en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
ex.zh: 喂，你把伞落在门边了！

ex.en: Informal greetings such as hey may be inappropriate when students first contact university staff by email.
ex.zh: 学生初次通过电子邮件联系大学教职员工时，使用hey这类非正式问候语可能不太合适。

tip: 适合熟人间打招呼；正式邮件避免使用。

senses.en: One of four equal parts of something.
A period of three months within a year.
An area of a town with a particular character.

ex.en: She cut the sandwich into quarters for the children.
ex.zh: 她把三明治切成四等份给孩子们吃。

ex.en: Almost a quarter of the city's residents depend on public transport for their daily commute.
ex.zh: 这座城市近四分之一的居民依靠公共交通日常通勤。

col: a quarter of an hour｜一刻钟
tip: a quarter of an hour是一刻钟；季度也是quarter。

senses.en: A sweet, dark, fizzy drink, usually containing caffeine.

ex.en: He poured cold cola into a glass with ice.
ex.zh: 他把冰可乐倒进一个放了冰块的玻璃杯。

ex.en: Reducing the consumption of sugary drinks such as cola may help prevent tooth decay in children.
ex.zh: 减少可乐等含糖饮料的摄入，可能有助于预防儿童龋齿。

col: a can of cola｜一罐可乐
tip: 泛指饮料时不可数；a cola可指一杯或一份可乐。

senses.en: Washing under falling water, or the equipment used for this
A short period of rain
Wash your body under water falling from a shower

ex.en: I always take a warm shower after cycling home.
ex.zh: 我骑车回家后总会洗个温水澡。

ex.en: Taking shorter showers is a simple way for households to reduce both water consumption and energy use.
ex.zh: 缩短淋浴时间是家庭减少用水和能源消耗的一种简单方法。

tip: 洗淋浴可用take或have a shower；阵雨也叫shower。

senses.en: suggestions about what someone should do in a particular situation

ex.en: Your advice helped me choose a comfortable bicycle.
ex.zh: 你的建议帮我选到了一辆骑着舒服的自行车。

ex.en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
ex.zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。

col: a piece of advice｜一条建议
tip: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

senses.en: A land reptile with a hard shell and short legs.

ex.en: The tortoise slowly stretched its neck towards a lettuce leaf.
ex.zh: 陆龟慢慢伸长脖子，探向一片生菜叶。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for tortoise populations threatened by illegal trade and agricultural expansion.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对受到非法贸易和农业扩张威胁的陆龟种群至关重要。

tip: 通常指陆龟；英式英语中turtle多指海龟。

senses.en: something that belongs to me

ex.en: This bicycle is mine, not yours.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车是我的，不是你的。

ex.en: My phone is black and hers is white. Wait, mine is blue.
ex.zh: 我的手机是黑色的，她的是白色的。等等，我的是蓝色的。

tip: mine 是名词性物主代词，后面不接名词。
scene: A blue bicycle standing in front of a school bike rack.

senses.en: A tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches.

ex.en: A small bird built its nest in our tree.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟在我们家的树上筑了巢。

ex.en: Planting trees in urban areas provides shade, improves air quality, and creates valuable habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 在城市地区植树能提供树荫、改善空气质量，并为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。

tip: tree是树；wood可指木材，woods通常指树林。

senses.en: Extremely good or of very high quality.

ex.en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
ex.zh: 这汤好喝极了，所以我又点了一碗。

ex.en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
ex.zh: 优质的公共交通可以减少人们对汽车的依赖，让所有居民出行更便利。

tip: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。

senses.en: to make structures or develop something over time
the size and shape of a person's body

ex.en: We built a small wooden shelter in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里搭了一个小木棚。

ex.en: Local authorities should build more affordable homes near public transport to support families on low incomes.
ex.zh: 地方政府应在公共交通设施附近建造更多经济适用住房，以帮助低收入家庭。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为built；体格可用build。

senses.en: to reach, or heat liquid until it reaches, bubbling temperature
to cook food in water that is bubbling from heat
a painful swollen lump in the skin containing pus

ex.en: Boil the potatoes until you can pierce them easily.
ex.zh: 把土豆煮到能轻松戳穿为止。

ex.en: Residents should boil drinking water when flooding has damaged local supplies and increased the risk of infection.
ex.zh: 当洪水破坏当地供水并增加感染风险时，居民应将饮用水煮沸。

tip: boil指沸腾或煮沸；simmer指小火慢煮。

senses.en: having a thin, often attractive shape
very small in amount or likelihood
to lose weight or reduce something in size

ex.en: This slim lamp fits neatly on my small desk.
ex.zh: 这盏细长的灯放在我的小书桌上正合适。

ex.en: Without reliable public transport, there is only a slim chance that commuters will stop driving.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，通勤者放弃开车的可能性就很小。

tip: 形容身材多含褒义；slim chance指机会渺茫。

senses.en: A liquid or thick mixture added to food for flavour.

ex.en: This tomato sauce tastes lovely with fresh pasta.
ex.zh: 这种番茄酱汁配新鲜意面很好吃。

ex.en: Preparing sauce at home allows families to control the amount of salt and sugar in their meals.
ex.zh: 在家制作酱汁，能让家庭控制饭菜中的盐和糖含量。

tip: sauce泛指酱汁；酱油应说soy sauce。

senses.en: Special clothing worn by members of a particular group.
Remaining the same in form, quality, or amount.

ex.en: My school uniform is still drying by the window.
ex.zh: 我的校服还在窗边晾着。

ex.en: Uniform safety standards across all factories can help protect workers and improve overall working conditions.
ex.zh: 所有工厂实行统一的安全标准，有助于保护工人并改善整体工作条件。

tip: 开头是辅音/j/，所以说a uniform，不用an。

senses.en: to copy data from the internet onto your device
the act of downloading, or a file obtained this way

ex.en: Download the map before you leave the hotel tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天离开酒店前，先把地图下载好。

ex.en: Students can download course materials at home, allowing them to study even when internet access is unavailable.
ex.zh: 学生可以在家下载课程资料，这样即使无法联网也能学习。

tip: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；反义词是upload。

senses.en: An adult male human
Human beings considered collectively
To provide people to operate or guard something

ex.en: A man in a blue coat held the door open.
ex.zh: 一位穿蓝色外套的男子扶着门，让别人通过。

ex.en: Additional volunteers are needed to man information desks during the city's annual cultural festival.
ex.zh: 该市举办一年一度的文化节期间，需要更多志愿者在咨询台值守。

col: man a desk｜在服务台值守
man a checkpoint｜在检查站执勤
tip: 复数为men；泛指人类时现代写作更常用humankind。

senses.en: Feeling afraid because of danger or something unexpected.

ex.en: The frightened kitten hid behind the sofa during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中，受惊的小猫躲到了沙发后面。

ex.en: Children who feel frightened in unfamiliar environments may benefit from patient support and predictable routines.
ex.zh: 在陌生环境中感到害怕的儿童，可能会从耐心的支持和规律的日常安排中受益。

tip: frightened形容感到害怕；frightening形容令人害怕。

senses.en: used when an animal or thing does something to itself

ex.en: The cat cleaned itself in the sun.
ex.zh: 猫在阳光下给自己梳理毛发。

ex.en: The door closes by itself.
ex.zh: 门自己会关上。

tip: by itself 表示“自动地/独自地”，如门自动关上。
scene: A cat licking its paw while sitting in a sunny window.

senses.en: the name shared by members of a family

ex.en: My surname is often difficult for strangers to pronounce.
ex.zh: 陌生人常常觉得我的姓很难念。

ex.en: Naming traditions vary across cultures, and a person's surname may reflect family history or regional origins.
ex.zh: 不同文化的命名传统各不相同，一个人的姓氏可能反映其家族历史或地域来源。

tip: surname指姓，given name指名；姓不一定在最后。

senses.en: Near the beginning of a period or before the usual time
Before the expected time or near the beginning

ex.en: We caught an early train and arrived before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们赶上了一班早车，在早餐前就到了。

ex.en: Early investment in childhood education can reduce inequality and improve employment prospects later in life.
ex.zh: 及早投资幼儿教育可以减少不平等，并改善孩子成年后的就业前景。

tip: early兼作形容词和副词，不加-ly。

senses.en: Used before plural nouns for nearby people or things.
Nearby people or things, or ones just mentioned.

ex.en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
ex.zh: 这些草莓闻起来很香，我们买一篮吧。

ex.en: These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.
ex.zh: 这些研究结果表明，经常参加户外活动可以改善儿童的注意力和情绪健康。

col: in these circumstances｜在这些情况下
tip: these是this的复数，后接复数名词。

senses.en: the ability to store and recall information or experiences
something from the past that you remember
the part of a computer that stores information

ex.en: My grandmother has an excellent memory for faces.
ex.zh: 我奶奶特别善于记住别人的长相。

ex.en: Regular physical exercise may improve memory and help older adults maintain their independence for longer.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可能改善记忆力，帮助老年人更长久地保持独立生活的能力。

tip: 记忆力通常不可数；一段段回忆用memories。

senses.en: A soft support for your head when resting or sleeping.

ex.en: She placed a fresh pillow on the guest bed.
ex.zh: 她在客床上放了一个干净的枕头。

ex.en: Choosing a supportive pillow may improve sleep quality by helping maintain a comfortable neck position.
ex.zh: 选择支撑性好的枕头，有助于保持舒适的颈部姿势，从而可能改善睡眠质量。

tip: pillow主要用于睡觉；cushion多指靠垫或坐垫。

senses.en: A set of instructions that tells a computer what to do.
Write computer instructions or set a machine to operate automatically.
An organised plan, course of activities, or broadcast show.

ex.en: This program helps me organise all my holiday photos.
ex.zh: 这个程序帮我整理所有度假照片。

ex.en: Schools should teach students how to program computers rather than simply how to use existing software.
ex.zh: 学校应教学生如何给计算机编程，而不只是如何使用现有软件。

col: program a computer｜给计算机编程
tip: 英式计算机程序用program；计划、节目用programme。

senses.en: Something indicating that a condition exists or may develop
An object, mark, or gesture that communicates information
Write your name to identify yourself or show agreement

ex.en: Those dark clouds are a sign of approaching rain.
ex.zh: 那些乌云预示着雨就要来了。

ex.en: A decline in local wildlife may be a sign of wider environmental damage caused by urban expansion.
ex.zh: 当地野生动物数量下降可能意味着城市扩张造成了更广泛的环境破坏。

col: a sign of improvement｜好转的迹象
tip: sign中的g不发音；a sign of后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: For each unit of something.

ex.en: The swimming pool costs five pounds per visit.
ex.zh: 这个游泳池每次收费五英镑。

ex.en: Reducing energy consumption per household is an important step towards lowering a country's carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 减少每户家庭的能源消耗是降低一个国家碳排放的重要一步。

tip: per后通常接单数名词，不加冠词，如per day。

senses.en: the science of substances and how they react
the chemical properties and processes of a substance
a natural connection or attraction between people

ex.en: We mixed two clear liquids in chemistry class today.
ex.zh: 今天化学课上，我们把两种透明液体混合在一起。

ex.en: Understanding the chemistry of seawater helps scientists explain how rising carbon emissions affect marine life.
ex.zh: 了解海水的化学特性有助于科学家解释碳排放增加如何影响海洋生物。

tip: 学科名通常不可数：study chemistry，不加a。

senses.en: liked more than any other of the same kind
a person or thing someone likes best
the competitor considered most likely to win

ex.en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店卖我最喜欢的那种面包。

ex.en: Public libraries allow readers to discover new authors as well as revisit their favourite books without additional cost.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆让读者无需额外花费，既能发现新作家，也能重读自己最喜爱的书。

col: a firm favourite｜一直备受喜爱的人或物
the favourite to win｜夺冠热门
tip: 英式拼写favourite，美式favorite；一般不用most修饰。

senses.en: more than usual, or more than other people or things

ex.en: I enjoy cooking, especially when friends come for dinner.
ex.zh: 我喜欢做饭，尤其是在朋友来吃晚饭的时候。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is especially important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
ex.zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通尤其重要。

tip: especially强调“尤其”；specially常指“专门地”。

senses.en: A person or animal that has finished growing.
Fully grown, or relating to grown people.

ex.en: Children must visit the swimming pool with an adult.
ex.zh: 儿童必须由成年人陪同前往游泳池。

ex.en: Adult education programmes help people gain new qualifications and adapt to changes in the labour market.
ex.zh: 成人教育项目帮助人们获得新的资格，并适应劳动力市场的变化。

tip: 既可作可数名词，也可作形容词，如adult education。

senses.en: land outside towns and cities, including fields, woods, and farms

ex.en: We spent the weekend cycling through the quiet countryside.
ex.zh: 我们周末在宁静的乡间骑车游玩。

ex.en: Reliable public transport in the countryside can improve access to employment and reduce rural residents' dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 乡村地区可靠的公共交通可以改善就业机会的可及性，并减少农村居民对汽车的依赖。

col: protect the countryside｜保护乡村环境
tip: 通常不可数，常说the countryside，不说a countryside。

senses.en: The condition of someone's body and mind.
How well an organisation, economy, or system is functioning.

ex.en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
ex.zh: 步行上班确实改善了我的健康状况。

ex.en: Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过提供安全饮用水和可负担的医疗服务来改善公众健康。

tip: 通常不可数；表示身体健康用in good health。

senses.en: a device that shows the time
to measure or record the time or speed of something

ex.en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
ex.zh: 我们做午饭时，厨房的时钟停了。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to work when they are most productive, rather than watching the clock.
ex.zh: 弹性工作安排让员工在效率最高时工作，而不是盯着时钟等下班。

col: watch the clock｜盯着时间等下班
tip: clock通常指钟；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。

senses.en: On or towards a lower floor of a building
Located on a lower floor of a building

ex.en: I went downstairs when I smelled fresh bread.
ex.zh: 闻到新鲜面包的香味后，我下了楼。

ex.en: Providing a downstairs bedroom can help older residents remain independent in their own homes.
ex.zh: 在楼下设置卧室可以帮助老年住户在自己家中保持独立生活。

tip: 作副词时直接说go downstairs，不加to。

senses.en: Facts or details about someone or something

ex.en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
ex.zh: 接待员向我们提供了有关当地公交车的实用信息。

ex.en: Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息能帮助患者就治疗和长期健康作出更好的决定。

col: access to information｜信息获取渠道
a piece of information｜一条信息
tip: 不可数：说some information，不说an information。

senses.en: to take something back to where it was

ex.en: Please bring back my book tomorrow.
ex.zh: 请明天把我的书带回来。

ex.en: She brought back some gifts from her trip.
ex.zh: 她旅行带回来一些礼物。

tip: bring back 和 take back 都表示“带回”，bring 强调带回来，take 强调带走。
scene: A girl handing a book back to her friend at school.

senses.en: A dark classroom board used for writing or drawing with chalk.

ex.en: Our teacher drew a huge circle on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 老师在黑板上画了一个大圆圈。

ex.en: Although digital screens offer interactive features, a traditional blackboard remains an affordable teaching tool for many schools.
ex.zh: 尽管电子屏幕具有互动功能，传统黑板仍是许多学校负担得起的教学工具。

col: write on the blackboard｜在黑板上书写
tip: 在黑板上用on the blackboard；配合粉笔使用。

senses.en: small British money; 100 pence in a pound

ex.en: The sweets cost fifty pence.
ex.zh: 这些糖果五十便士。

ex.en: I have one pound and twenty pence.
ex.zh: 我有一英镑二十便士。

tip: pence 是 penny 的复数（金额时用），如 20 pence。
scene: A handful of British coins on a shop counter.

senses.en: a place where you buy petrol for cars

ex.en: We stopped at a petrol station to fill the car.
ex.zh: 我们在加油站停车加油。

ex.en: The petrol station is open all night.
ex.zh: 这家加油站通宵营业。

tip: petrol station 是英式说法；美式说 gas station。
scene: A car being filled with fuel at a petrol station with a price sign.

senses.en: A social gathering where people celebrate or enjoy themselves.
An organised group seeking political power through shared policies.
A person or group involved in an agreement or dispute.

ex.en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在花园里办了一场小聚会。

ex.en: Each political party should explain how its education policies will benefit students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
ex.zh: 每个政党都应说明其教育政策将如何惠及弱势背景的学生。

tip: 合同中的party指当事方，不是聚会或政党。

senses.en: An occasion when you eat, or the food eaten then.

ex.en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
ex.zh: 我们长途步行回来后，爸爸做了一顿热乎乎的饭。

ex.en: Providing healthy school meals can improve children's concentration and support their physical development.
ex.zh: 提供健康的学校餐食能提高儿童的专注力，并促进他们的身体发育。

tip: meal指一顿饭；food泛指食物，通常不可数。

senses.en: to direct your eyes towards something

ex.en: Look at the picture and answer the questions.
ex.zh: 看这幅图并回答问题。

ex.en: He looked at the clock and hurried out.
ex.zh: 他看了看钟，匆匆出去了。

tip: look at 是“看着某物”；watch 是“注视动态画面”，如看电视。
scene: A student looking closely at a picture book at a desk.

senses.en: a seat for one person, usually with a back
the person responsible for leading a meeting or committee
to lead a meeting and manage its discussion

ex.en: She pulled a chair closer to the window.
ex.zh: 她把一把椅子拉到离窗户更近的地方。

ex.en: An independent expert should chair the meeting to ensure that all participants can contribute fairly.
ex.zh: 应由一位独立专家主持会议，确保所有参与者都能公平地发表意见。

tip: chair作动词直接接meeting，表示主持会议。

senses.en: Not at any time.
Certainly not, used to express strong refusal or intention.

ex.en: I never leave home without my water bottle.
ex.zh: 我出门从来都带着水瓶。

ex.en: Public transport can never fully replace walking and cycling as accessible forms of daily exercise.
ex.zh: 作为方便易行的日常运动方式，步行和骑行永远无法被公共交通完全取代。

tip: 通常放在实义动词前，be动词或助动词后。

senses.en: The time around the middle of the day when people eat.

ex.en: At lunchtime, we sat outside and shared some sandwiches.
ex.zh: 午餐时，我们坐在外面分着吃了一些三明治。

ex.en: Providing quiet spaces at lunchtime may help employees relax and return to work with greater focus.
ex.zh: 在午餐时间提供安静的空间，可能有助于员工放松，并在重返工作时更加专注。

col: a lunchtime walk｜午餐时段的散步
tip: 表示“在午餐时间”通常用at lunchtime。

senses.en: The central part, point, or position of something
Located between other things or between the beginning and end

ex.en: Someone left a suitcase in the middle of the hallway.
ex.zh: 有人把一个行李箱放在了走廊正中央。

ex.en: Housing costs often force essential workers to live far from the middle of the cities they serve.
ex.zh: 住房成本常常迫使提供必要服务的工作者住在远离其服务城市中心的地方。

tip: 名词常用the middle of；形容词直接修饰名词。

senses.en: slightly cold, often in a pleasant way
calm and able to think clearly under pressure
to become or make something less hot

ex.en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从敞开的厨房窗户吹了进来。

ex.en: Planting more trees can help cool urban areas and reduce energy demand during summer.
ex.zh: 种植更多树木有助于为城市地区降温，并减少夏季的能源需求。

tip: cool 比 cold 温和；口语中还可表示“很酷的”。

senses.en: The month after August and before October.

ex.en: Our evening photography course starts in September this year.
ex.zh: 我们今年的摄影夜课九月开课。

ex.en: In many countries, the academic year begins in September, creating seasonal demand for student accommodation near universities.
ex.zh: 许多国家的学年在九月开始，使大学附近的学生住宿出现季节性需求。

tip: 月份首字母大写；用 in September，但 next September 前不加 in。

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition

senses.zh: 成功的人或事物；受益者
senses.en: someone or something successful or benefiting from a situation

ex.en: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
ex.zh: 获胜者举起奖杯，人群欢呼起来。

ex.en: Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.
ex.zh: 当更激烈的竞争促使企业降价并改善服务时，消费者可能成为主要受益者。

tip: winner 指获胜者；winning 可作形容词修饰队伍。

senses.en: Not difficult and requiring little effort.
Relaxed and free from worry or pressure.

ex.en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 用新鲜蔬菜做这道汤很容易。

ex.en: Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 让人们方便地获取可靠的健康信息，有助于他们作出更好的生活方式选择。

col: easy access to｜便于获取或到达……
tip: 常用easy to do；修饰动作通常用easily。

senses.en: an object whose name is unknown or not specified
an action, event, fact, or situation
possessions or equipment, usually referred to in the plural

ex.en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
ex.zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？

ex.en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。

col: the right thing to do｜正确的做法
first thing in the morning｜早晨第一件事
one thing at a time｜一次一件事
tip: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

senses.zh: 无线网络；无线联网技术
senses.en: Technology connecting devices to a network without cables.

ex.en: The café offers free wifi near the window seats.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆靠窗的座位附近有免费无线网络。

ex.en: Providing reliable public wifi can help residents access essential services and participate in online learning.
ex.zh: 提供可靠的公共无线网络，有助于居民使用基本服务并参与在线学习。

tip: 常规范写作Wi-Fi；通常不可数，不加a。

senses.en: extra and available to use when needed
to give time or resources that you can make available
to prevent someone from experiencing harm or difficulty

ex.en: I keep a spare umbrella in my car.
ex.zh: 我在车里放了一把备用伞。

ex.en: People who can spare a few hours each week could support local charities through regular volunteering.
ex.zh: 每周能抽出几个小时的人，可以通过定期做志愿者来支持当地慈善机构。

col: spare a moment｜抽出一点时间
tip: spare time是空闲时间；spare作动词可指抽出。

senses.en: the opening in your face used for eating and speaking
the opening of a cave or where a river meets the sea
to form words with your lips without making a sound

ex.en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
ex.zh: 牙医让我把嘴张大一点。

ex.en: Wetlands near the mouth of a river provide valuable habitats and help protect coastal communities from flooding.
ex.zh: 河口附近的湿地提供了宝贵的栖息地，也有助于保护沿海社区免遭洪灾。

col: the mouth of a river｜河口
tip: 名词末音为/θ/；动词末音为/ð/。

senses.en: A cupboard or small enclosed space for storing clothes or belongings
Keeping a particular identity, belief, or interest secret

ex.en: I hung my winter coat in the hallway closet.
ex.zh: 我把冬季外套挂进了走廊的壁橱里。

ex.en: Small apartments can feel more spacious when residents organise belongings efficiently and make better use of closet space.
ex.zh: 如果住户高效整理物品，更充分地利用壁橱空间，小公寓也会显得更宽敞。

tip: 衣物收纳义多见于美式英语；英式常用wardrobe。

senses.en: a document that proves who you are

ex.en: You need your ID to open a bank account.
ex.zh: 开银行账户需要身份证件。

ex.en: Please show your ID at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在门口出示证件。

tip: ID 是 identification 的缩写，ID card 是身份证。
scene: A hand holding an ID card in front of a security desk.

senses.en: Spend time learning about or carefully examining a subject.
The activity of learning, or an investigation of a subject.
A room used for reading, writing, or working.

ex.en: I study English on the bus every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上在公交车上学英语。

ex.en: A recent study suggests that regular exercise can improve students' concentration during classroom activities.
ex.zh: 最近一项研究表明，经常锻炼能提高学生在课堂活动中的专注力。

col: a recent study｜最近的一项研究
study for an exam｜为考试学习
tip: study强调学习过程，learn常强调学会或获得知识。

senses.en: the money needed to buy or do something
to require a particular amount of money
something valuable lost to achieve or obtain something

ex.en: The cost of our weekly groceries keeps rising.
ex.zh: 我们每周购买食品杂货的费用不断上涨。

ex.en: Improving public transport can reduce the cost of commuting and make cities more accessible.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以降低通勤成本，并让城市出行更加便利。

col: the cost of living｜生活成本
at all costs｜不惜一切代价
tip: 表示花费时，过去式和过去分词均为cost。

senses.en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice
Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements

ex.en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
ex.zh: 你可以从这篮玩具里随便挑一件。

ex.en: Before introducing new policies, governments should check whether anything similar has worked successfully elsewhere.
ex.zh: 在推行新政策之前，政府应查明其他地方是否有类似的成功做法。

tip: 疑问句中常指“什么”；陈述句中可指“任何事物”。

senses.en: someone who takes part in a sport or game
someone who plays a musical instrument
a device or program that plays recorded sound or video

ex.en: Each player shook hands before the football match began.
ex.zh: 足球比赛开始前，每位球员都握了手。

ex.en: Young players benefit from coaches who value teamwork and personal development rather than winning alone.
ex.zh: 教练若重视团队合作和个人成长，而非一味追求胜利，年轻运动员就能从中受益。

col: team player｜善于团队合作的人
tip: 乐器演奏者可用“乐器名＋player”，如piano player。

senses.en: informal word for grandmother

ex.en: Grandma bakes the best apple pie.
ex.zh: 奶奶烤的苹果派最好吃。

ex.en: We visited my grandma in the countryside.
ex.zh: 我们去乡下看望了外婆。

tip: grandma 是 grandmother 的口语说法；granny 也常用。
scene: A grandmother with grey hair baking an apple pie in a kitchen.

senses.en: A sweet food made from cocoa, often with milk and sugar.
An individual sweet made of chocolate, sometimes with a filling.

ex.en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
ex.zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越期望巧克力生产商确保整个供应链中的公平工资和安全工作条件。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一块巧克力
a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力糖
tip: 食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。

senses.en: How big or small someone or something is.
A standard measurement used for clothes and other products.
To sort by measurements or make something a particular size.

ex.en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱的大小正适合周末出行。

ex.en: Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 缩小班级规模或许能让教师为有学习困难的学生提供更多个别辅导。

tip: 问尺码用What size，不用How much size。

senses.en: a machine that plays CDs

ex.en: My old CD player still works well.
ex.zh: 我的旧光盘播放机还能用。

ex.en: She listened to music on her CD player.
ex.zh: 她用光盘播放机听音乐。

tip: 现在大家多用手机听歌，CD player 是较旧的设备。
scene: A small CD player on a shelf with headphones next to it.

senses.en: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes

ex.en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
ex.zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。

ex.en: Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。

col: put up a tent｜搭起帐篷
tip: “搭帐篷”用pitch或put up a tent。

senses.en: used before a noun to ask or show who owns something
used to ask who something belongs to

ex.en: Whose umbrella is dripping water all over the floor?
ex.zh: 谁的雨伞把水滴得满地都是？

ex.en: Children whose parents read regularly at home may develop a stronger interest in books.
ex.zh: 父母经常在家阅读的孩子可能会对书籍产生更浓厚的兴趣。

tip: whose表示所属；who’s是who is或who has的缩写。

senses.en: to exercise, or to find the answer

ex.en: She works out at the gym three times a week.
ex.zh: 她每周去健身房锻炼三次。

ex.en: Can you work out the answer to this problem?
ex.zh: 你能算出这道题的答案吗？

tip: work out 有“锻炼、算出、解决”等多个意思。
scene: A person exercising on a treadmill at a gym.

senses.en: Limited in size, amount, or degree.
Young and not yet fully grown.
Not very important or serious.

ex.en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
ex.zh: 我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。

ex.en: Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
ex.zh: 即使对住宅保温做出小幅改善，也能减少能源消耗并降低家庭开支。

tip: 数量少可说a small number of，不能说small people。

senses.zh: 穿着衣服的；穿戴整齐的
senses.en: wearing clothes

ex.en: Get dressed quickly, we are late!
ex.zh: 快点穿好衣服，我们要迟到了！

ex.en: She was dressed in a blue coat.
ex.zh: 她穿着一件蓝色外套。

tip: get dressed 表示“穿好衣服”这个动作；be dressed in 表示“穿着”。
scene: A child pulling on a jumper in a bright bedroom in the morning.

senses.en: Physical activities involving skill, effort, and often competition
To wear or display something in a noticeable way

ex.en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
ex.zh: 游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜欢的运动。

ex.en: Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.
ex.zh: 经常参加体育运动能改善身体健康，并帮助年轻人培养团队合作能力。

col: take part in sport｜参加体育运动
tip: 泛指体育时英式常用sport，美式常用sports。

senses.en: to a greater degree or a more distant place
additional or more advanced
to help something develop or succeed

ex.en: We walked further along the beach before stopping.
ex.zh: 我们沿着海滩又走了一段才停下。

ex.en: Further research is needed to understand how urban green spaces affect residents' mental health.
ex.zh: 还需要进一步研究，才能了解城市绿地如何影响居民的心理健康。

col: further your career｜促进职业发展
tip: further可指程度或距离；farther主要指距离。

senses.en: the person or people spoken to

ex.en: You are my best friend.
ex.zh: 你是我最好的朋友。

ex.en: Are you coming to the party?
ex.zh: 你来参加聚会吗？

tip: you 单复数同形；you 的形容词性物主代词是 your。
scene: Two friends talking face to face on a sunny path.

senses.en: the hand on the right side of your body

ex.en: She writes with her right hand.
ex.zh: 她用右手写字。

ex.en: Hold the cup in your right hand.
ex.zh: 用右手拿着杯子。

tip: right hand 是右手；反义 left hand 左手。
scene: A child raising their right hand in class.

senses.en: The organ inside your head controlling thought and bodily activity.
The ability to think clearly and understand things.

ex.en: A helmet helps protect your brain if you fall.
ex.zh: 跌倒时，头盔有助于保护你的大脑。

ex.en: Adequate sleep supports healthy brain function and helps learners remember information more effectively.
ex.zh: 充足的睡眠有助于大脑正常运作，并帮助学习者更有效地记忆信息。

tip: 表示智力时常用复数brains；器官用brain。

senses.en: an adult female bovine, often kept for milk
to frighten someone into obeying or giving up resistance

ex.en: A brown cow stood quietly beside the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一头棕色母牛静静地站在农场门旁。

ex.en: Improving the diet of dairy cows can increase milk production while supporting animal health.
ex.zh: 改善奶牛的饮食可以在促进动物健康的同时提高产奶量。

col: be cowed into silence｜被吓得不敢出声
tip: cow指成年母牛；cattle统称牛，不能说a cattle。

senses.en: Containing so many people or things that little space remains

ex.en: The bus was so crowded that we stood all the way.
ex.zh: 公交车太拥挤了，我们一路都站着。

ex.en: Crowded urban neighbourhoods need accessible parks where residents can exercise and enjoy some personal space.
ex.zh: 拥挤的城市社区需要方便到达的公园，让居民能够锻炼并享有一些个人空间。

tip: be crowded with 表示“挤满……”。

senses.en: A round object used in games or shaped like one.
A formal social event where people dance.

ex.en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
ex.zh: 那只狗追着球跑过草地。

ex.en: Simple ball games can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 简单的球类游戏能帮助儿童发展协调能力，同时促进合作和日常体育锻炼。

col: a ball of wool｜一团毛线
tip: 球类运动前通常不用冠词，如play football。

senses.en: Feeling sad or lacking happiness
Not satisfied with someone or something

ex.en: He looked unhappy when the picnic was cancelled.
ex.zh: 野餐取消后，他显得很不开心。

ex.en: Residents are unhappy with the proposed road expansion because it would remove valuable green space.
ex.zh: 居民对拟议中的道路扩建不满意，因为它会占用宝贵的绿地。

col: unhappy with the service｜对服务不满意
an unhappy childhood｜不快乐的童年
tip: unhappy with常表示“对……不满意”。

senses.en: a subject, situation or problem needing thought or attention
to be important or make a difference
physical substance that occupies space and has mass

ex.en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们可以今天午饭后讨论这件事。

ex.en: The quality of teaching matters more than expensive equipment when schools aim to improve student achievement.
ex.zh: 学校若想提高学生成绩，教学质量比昂贵的设备更重要。

col: a matter of time｜时间问题
tip: 指事情时通常可数；指物质时不可数；作动词表示要紧。

senses.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home
to eat a meal outdoors for pleasure

ex.en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
ex.zh: 我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。

ex.en: Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供了花费不高的空间，让家庭享受野餐并共度美好时光。

tip: 动词过去式为picnicked，进行形式为picnicking。

senses.en: to start happening or start doing something

ex.en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
ex.zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好后，我们开始吃晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should begin teaching digital safety early so that children develop responsible habits when using the internet.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授网络安全知识，让孩子养成负责任地使用互联网的习惯。

tip: 过去式began，过去分词begun；后接不定式或动名词。

senses.en: as much or as many as needed
to the degree that is needed
an amount that meets a need

ex.en: We have enough rice to feed everyone tonight.
ex.zh: 我们的米够今晚所有人吃。

ex.en: Many rural schools lack enough resources to provide students with a broad range of subjects.
ex.zh: 许多农村学校缺乏足够的资源，无法为学生开设广泛的课程。

col: enough to eat｜足够吃的东西
tip: 修饰名词放前面，修饰形容词或副词放后面。

senses.en: Someone who designs or builds machines, structures, or technical systems.
To design something technical or skilfully arrange an outcome.

ex.en: An engineer checked the bridge before it opened.
ex.zh: 一位工程师在桥梁通车前进行了检查。

ex.en: Engineers can reduce urban energy consumption by designing buildings that require less heating and cooling.
ex.zh: 工程师可以通过设计供暖和制冷需求更低的建筑来减少城市能源消耗。

col: engineer a solution｜精心设计解决方案
tip: engineer也可作动词，表示设计或策划促成。

senses.en: A group learning together, or a lesson they attend.
A social group or category sharing particular characteristics.
To place someone or something in a particular category.

ex.en: Our class is learning how to grow vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们班正在学习如何种蔬菜。

ex.en: Smaller class sizes may allow teachers to give more individual attention to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 较小的班级规模可能让教师给予学习有困难的学生更多个别关注。

tip: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

senses.en: the middle of the day, around twelve o'clock

ex.en: We stopped for a picnic beside the lake at midday.
ex.zh: 中午，我们停下来在湖边野餐。

ex.en: Outdoor workers should avoid direct sunlight around midday to reduce the risk of heat exhaustion.
ex.zh: 户外工作者应避免在中午前后受到阳光直射，以降低热衰竭的风险。

tip: 时间前用at；也可置于名词前，如midday sun。

senses.en: Not many; a small number of countable things.
A small number of people or things.

ex.en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午店里的顾客很少。

ex.en: Few rural communities have access to the specialist medical services available in major cities.
ex.zh: 很少有农村社区能获得大城市所提供的专科医疗服务。

col: few and far between｜少之又少
tip: few表几乎没有，a few表有几个；均接可数名词复数。

senses.en: a shelf used for storing books

ex.en: She placed her favourite novel on the wooden bookshelf.
ex.zh: 她把最喜欢的小说放到了木书架上。

ex.en: A well-stocked bookshelf in every classroom can encourage children to explore subjects beyond the school curriculum.
ex.zh: 每间教室都配备藏书丰富的书架，可以鼓励孩子探索学校课程以外的主题。

col: a well-stocked bookshelf｜藏书丰富的书架
tip: 复数为bookshelves，注意把f变为ves。

senses.en: a reptile with a long tail, usually with four legs

ex.en: A tiny lizard rested on the warm garden wall.
ex.zh: 一只小蜥蜴趴在花园里温暖的墙上。

ex.en: Protecting rocky habitats helps preserve lizard populations, which play an important role in controlling insects.
ex.zh: 保护岩石栖息地有助于维持蜥蜴种群，它们在控制昆虫数量方面发挥着重要作用。

tip: lizard是可数名词，复数为lizards。

senses.en: An area of land governed as an independent political unit.
Land outside towns and cities, often with farms and villages.
A popular music style rooted in rural American traditions.

ex.en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
ex.zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。

ex.en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
ex.zh: 各国都应根据本国自然资源和长期环境目标制定能源政策。

col: live in the country｜住在乡下
tip: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。

senses.en: to know what something means or how it works
to recognise why someone feels or behaves a certain way
to believe something is true based on available information

ex.en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
ex.zh: 我终于懂得怎么用这台洗衣机了。

ex.en: Schools should help students understand how their daily choices affect the natural environment.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生理解自己的日常选择如何影响自然环境。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为understood。

senses.en: title used before a man's surname

ex.en: Mr Brown is our new English teacher.
ex.zh: 布朗先生是我们新的英语老师。

ex.en: Good morning, Mr Smith.
ex.zh: 早上好，史密斯先生。

tip: Mr 用于男性姓氏前；Mrs 用于已婚女性，Ms 用于女性（不限婚否）。
scene: A friendly male teacher standing at a classroom door with books.

senses.en: Pleasant to look at
Having qualities that make people interested in choosing something

ex.en: The garden looks especially attractive when the roses bloom.
ex.zh: 玫瑰盛开时，这座花园显得格外美丽。

ex.en: Flexible working hours make teaching a more attractive career option for some university graduates.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作时间让教师职业对一些大学毕业生更具吸引力。

col: an attractive option｜有吸引力的选择
tip: 既可形容外表好看，也可形容方案、薪资诱人。

senses.en: An opinion or belief about something.
What you can see from a particular place.
To consider something in a particular way, or look at it.

ex.en: My view is that we should leave earlier.
ex.zh: 我的看法是我们应该早点出发。

ex.en: Many residents view investment in public transport as an effective way to reduce urban pollution.
ex.zh: 许多居民认为，投资公共交通是减少城市污染的有效方式。

tip: 观点用view on；把某事视为用view…as…。

senses.en: After a long wait, delay, or effort.
Used to introduce the last point or action.

ex.en: After searching all morning, I finally found my keys.
ex.zh: 找了一上午后，我终于找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Finally, governments should invest in reliable public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 最后，政府应投资建设可靠的公共交通，以缓解交通拥堵和城市空气污染。

tip: 表示终于常置于实义动词前；引出最后一点常置句首。

senses.en: Stop living.
Stop working or gradually become weaker and disappear.
A small cube with marked faces, thrown in games.

ex.en: These plants will die if we forget to water them.
ex.zh: 如果忘了浇水，这些植物就会枯死。

ex.en: Many marine animals die after swallowing plastic waste, highlighting the urgent need to reduce ocean pollution.
ex.zh: 许多海洋动物吞食塑料垃圾后死亡，这凸显了减少海洋污染的迫切需要。

tip: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

senses.en: A toy shaped like a person.

ex.en: My little cousin tucked her doll into a tiny bed.
ex.zh: 我的小表妹把她的洋娃娃安顿在一张小床上。

ex.en: Playing with dolls can help young children develop communication skills and explore different social roles.
ex.zh: 玩玩偶可以帮助幼儿培养沟通能力，并探索不同的社会角色。

tip: 通常指人形玩具；用来称呼女性可能显得轻慢。

senses.en: The fourth month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
ex.zh: 我们将在四月搬进新公寓。

ex.en: The community garden will open in April, giving local residents more opportunities to grow their own vegetables.
ex.zh: 社区菜园将于四月开放，让当地居民有更多机会自己种菜。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: a reason given to explain or defend a fault
forgive someone for a mistake or impolite behaviour
allow someone to avoid a duty or leave

ex.en: He made an excuse for arriving late to dinner.
ex.zh: 他为晚餐迟到找了个借口。

ex.en: Limited funding should not become an excuse for neglecting essential maintenance in schools and public hospitals.
ex.zh: 资金有限不应成为忽视学校和公立医院必要维护工作的借口。

col: excuse someone from｜准许某人免于
tip: 名词末尾读/s/，动词读/z/；excuse me常用于礼貌打断。

senses.en: Accompanied by another person or thing.
Having or including a particular feature or thing.
Using a particular tool, material, or means.

ex.en: I cooked dinner with my sister last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我和姐姐一起做了晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should work with local communities to provide children with safe spaces for outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 学校应与当地社区合作，为儿童提供安全的户外活动空间。

col: agree with someone｜同意某人的看法
with the help of｜在……的帮助下
tip: with后接名词或代词宾格，如with me。

senses.en: a two-player board game involving pieces with different permitted moves

ex.en: My grandfather taught me chess during the winter holidays.
ex.zh: 寒假期间，爷爷教我下国际象棋。

ex.en: Playing chess regularly may help children develop concentration and practise planning several steps ahead.
ex.zh: 经常下国际象棋可能有助于儿童提高专注力，并练习提前规划多个步骤。

tip: 说play chess，不加冠词the。

senses.en: A flat, usually round dish used for serving food.
A flat piece of metal or another hard material.
To cover an object with a thin layer of metal.

ex.en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
ex.zh: 她在我的盘子里放了一张热乎乎的薄煎饼。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.
ex.zh: 餐馆可以提供较小的餐盘，并允许顾客要求加量，从而减少食物浪费。

col: a plate of rice｜一盘米饭
tip: plate通常指浅盘，bowl指较深的碗。

senses.en: Pain felt in the head.
A problem that causes worry or is difficult to manage.

ex.en: I have a headache, so I need some quiet.
ex.zh: 我头痛，需要安静一会儿。

ex.en: Ageing transport infrastructure has become a major headache for local authorities facing increasingly limited budgets.
ex.zh: 对于预算日益紧张的地方政府而言，老化的交通基础设施已成为一大难题。

tip: 表示一次头痛用a headache，通常说have a headache。

senses.en: with another person or other people
joined or combined with something else

ex.en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
ex.zh: 我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。

ex.en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
ex.zh: 学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。

tip: together通常作副词：一起做某事用动词加together。

senses.en: a small animal with a shell that moves very slowly

ex.en: The snail crawled slowly across the path.
ex.zh: 蜗牛慢慢地爬过小路。

ex.en: We found a snail in the garden after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后我们在花园里发现了一只蜗牛。

tip: snail 蜗牛以“慢”著称；slippery as a snail 之类的习语少见，记住词义即可。
scene: A snail with its shell crawling across a green leaf.

senses.en: A restaurant where customers collect food and carry it to tables.

ex.en: We carried our lunch trays to the cafeteria window.
ex.zh: 我们端着午餐托盘走到食堂窗边。

ex.en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating habits by offering affordable meals with fresh vegetables and fruit.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以提供价格实惠、含新鲜蔬菜水果的餐食，促进更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 强调自行取餐，不一定是不限量的自助餐。

senses.en: the day after Friday and before Sunday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们通常星期六去市场买新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆在星期六开放，让更多上班的家长能与孩子一起参加教育活动。

tip: 首字母大写；on Saturday，但this Saturday前不用on。

senses.en: Having the colour of chocolate or dark wood.
The colour of chocolate or dark wood.
To become brown, or make food brown through cooking.

ex.en: A small brown dog was sleeping beside the door.
ex.zh: 一只棕色的小狗正在门边睡觉。

ex.en: During dry periods, grass often turns brown as plants conserve water and reduce their growth.
ex.zh: 在干旱时期，植物为了保存水分会减缓生长，草也常因此变成褐色。

tip: brown作动词常用于烹饪，指把食物煎或烤至褐色。

senses.en: A fungus often shaped like an umbrella; some are edible.
Grow or increase very quickly.

ex.en: I added sliced mushrooms to the soup for lunch.
ex.zh: 我在午餐的汤里加了切片蘑菇。

ex.en: Online learning platforms have mushroomed as demand for flexible and affordable education has increased worldwide.
ex.zh: 随着全球对灵活且价格可负担的教育需求上升，在线学习平台迅速涌现。

col: mushroom into a large business｜迅速发展成大企业
tip: 作动词表示迅速增长，不接直接宾语。

senses.en: a flying insect that collects pollen; some kinds make honey

ex.en: A bee landed gently on the yellow flower.
ex.zh: 一只蜜蜂轻轻落在那朵黄花上。

ex.en: Protecting bees is essential for agriculture because these insects pollinate many crops that humans depend on.
ex.zh: 保护蜜蜂对农业至关重要，因为它们为许多人类赖以生存的作物授粉。

col: a swarm of bees｜一群蜜蜂
tip: bee与be同音；蜂群可用a swarm of bees。

senses.en: relating to the Olympic Games

ex.en: She watched the Olympic Games on TV.
ex.zh: 她在电视上观看奥运会。

ex.en: The Olympic torch arrived in the city.
ex.zh: 奥运圣火到达了这座城市。

tip: the Olympic Games 是“奥运会”，也常说 the Olympics。
scene: An Olympic torch with five colourful rings symbol on a stadium.

senses.en: to use money to pay for something
to use time doing something or being somewhere

ex.en: We spent all our money on fresh fruit.
ex.zh: 我们把钱全花在了新鲜水果上。

ex.en: Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 政府应增加预防保健方面的支出，以减少未来治疗慢性病的费用。

tip: 用spend时间doing或spend钱on；过去式spent。

senses.en: a large building with many shops

ex.en: We spent the afternoon at the shopping centre.
ex.zh: 我们在购物中心待了一下午。

ex.en: The new shopping centre has a cinema inside.
ex.zh: 新购物中心里面有一家电影院。

tip: shopping centre 是英式说法；美式常说 shopping mall。
scene: A modern shopping centre with glass walls and people carrying bags.

senses.en: The season between summer and winter

ex.en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们每年秋天都在公园里收集落叶。

ex.en: Warmer autumn temperatures may delay leaf fall and affect the seasonal behaviour of local wildlife.
ex.zh: 秋季气温升高可能推迟落叶，并影响当地野生动物的季节性行为。

tip: 字母n不发音；美式英语常用fall表示秋天。

senses.en: Make something easier or better for someone.
Support that makes a difficulty or task easier.

ex.en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？

ex.en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会，并减少他们对汽车的依赖。

col: help someone with something｜帮助某人做某事
tip: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。

senses.en: something that belongs to you

ex.en: This seat is yours.
ex.zh: 这个座位是你的。

ex.en: My umbrella is red; yours is black.
ex.zh: 我的伞是红色的，你的是黑色的。

tip: yours 是名词性物主代词；yours sincerely 是信件结尾敬语。
scene: A red umbrella and a black umbrella standing side by side by a door.

senses.en: extending far upwards or positioned far above the ground
greater than usual in amount, degree, or quality
at or to a position far above the ground

ex.en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
ex.zh: 架子太高了，我够不着。

ex.en: High housing costs can prevent young adults from living independently, particularly in major urban centres.
ex.zh: 高昂的住房成本可能使年轻人无法独立居住，在大城市中心尤其如此。

tip: high常指位置或程度；人的身高用tall。

senses.en: a request for someone to attend or join something

ex.en: We received an invitation to our neighbour's garden party.
ex.zh: 我们收到了邻居花园聚会的邀请。

ex.en: An invitation to participate in local planning can encourage residents to take greater responsibility for their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 邀请居民参与地方规划，可以鼓励他们为社区承担更多责任。

col: an invitation to dinner｜晚餐邀请
tip: 参加活动用invitation to；邀请做事用to do。

senses.en: Someone who arranges meetings and handles office communication.

senses.zh: 协会或组织的书记；干事
senses.en: An official managing an organisation's records and routine business.
A senior government official responsible for a particular department.

ex.en: The secretary arranged a meeting for tomorrow afternoon.
ex.zh: 秘书安排了明天下午的会议。

ex.en: A school secretary often provides essential support by coordinating appointments and communicating with parents throughout the day.
ex.zh: 学校秘书常常通过安排会面及全天与家长沟通，提供不可或缺的支持。

tip: 既可指办公室秘书，也可指某些政府部长。

senses.en: having no living members left
describing a volcano not expected to erupt again

ex.en: My little cousin asked why dinosaurs became extinct.
ex.zh: 我的小表弟问恐龙为什么灭绝了。

ex.en: Without stronger habitat protection, many endangered species could become extinct within the next few decades.
ex.zh: 如果不加强栖息地保护，许多濒危物种可能在未来几十年内灭绝。

tip: extinct指已灭绝；endangered指濒危，尚未灭绝。

senses.en: something given for winning a competition or achieving something
to value something very highly

ex.en: Lina won a prize for her colourful garden.
ex.zh: 莉娜因她色彩缤纷的花园获了奖。

ex.en: Offering a prize for innovative designs can encourage students to develop practical solutions to environmental problems.
ex.zh: 为创新设计设奖，可以鼓励学生提出解决环境问题的实用方案。

tip: prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。

senses.en: A tropical fruit with sweet orange flesh and a large stone

ex.en: This mango is sweet enough to eat without sugar.
ex.zh: 这个芒果已经很甜了，不用加糖就能吃。

ex.en: Improved storage facilities can help mango farmers reduce food waste and earn more reliable incomes.
ex.zh: 改善储存设施可以帮助芒果种植户减少食物浪费，获得更稳定的收入。

tip: 复数mangoes和mangos均正确。

senses.en: A person who is widely known by the public.
The state of being famous.

ex.en: A celebrity stopped outside the theatre to greet fans.
ex.zh: 一位明星在剧院外停下脚步，与粉丝打招呼。

ex.en: Celebrity endorsements can influence young consumers, so advertisements should clearly distinguish personal opinions from paid promotion.
ex.zh: 名人代言可能影响年轻消费者，因此广告应明确区分个人观点与付费推广。

tip: 指名人时可数；指名气时通常不可数。

senses.en: relating to the area where someone lives or something happens
a person who lives in a particular area
affecting only a limited part of something

ex.en: We buy fresh bread from our local bakery every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早晨都在附近的面包店买新鲜面包。

ex.en: Supporting local businesses can strengthen community ties and keep more money circulating within the regional economy.
ex.zh: 支持本地企业可以加强社区联系，并让更多资金在区域经济内部流通。

tip: 名词复数locals指当地人；locally是副词。

senses.en: A liquid food made by cooking ingredients in water or stock.

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。

ex.en: Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.
ex.zh: 社区厨房可以提供价格实惠的蔬菜汤，帮助居民在经济困难时期获得有营养的餐食。

tip: 通常不可数；点餐时two soups可指两份汤。

senses.en: a living being, especially an animal
an imaginary being with unusual physical features

ex.en: A tiny creature crawled out from under the leaf.
ex.zh: 一只小生物从叶子底下爬了出来。

ex.en: Even the smallest marine creature can play an important role in maintaining a healthy ocean ecosystem.
ex.zh: 即使是最小的海洋生物，也能在维持健康的海洋生态系统方面发挥重要作用。

tip: creature常指动物，也可指想象中的生物。

senses.en: a sound, especially one that is loud or unwanted

ex.en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
ex.zh: 外面的噪音在闹钟响之前就把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can affect sleep quality and reduce the wellbeing of urban residents.
ex.zh: 长期接触交通噪音会影响睡眠质量，降低城市居民的身心健康水平。

tip: 泛指噪音时不可数；指某个具体声响可用a noise。

senses.en: to decide which person or thing you want
to decide to do something rather than something else

ex.en: You can choose a seat beside the window.
ex.zh: 你可以选一个靠窗的座位。

ex.en: Many students choose to study abroad because they want to experience different cultures and teaching methods.
ex.zh: 许多学生选择出国留学，因为他们想体验不同的文化和教学方法。

col: choose to do something｜选择做某事
tip: 过去式chose，过去分词chosen；后接to do。

senses.en: something new that someone has designed or created
the act of creating something that did not exist before
a story or explanation created rather than based on facts

ex.en: Her latest invention waters the plants while she is away.
ex.zh: 她最新的发明能在她外出时给植物浇水。

ex.en: The invention of affordable water filters has improved public health in communities with limited access to clean water.
ex.zh: 价格低廉的滤水器的发明改善了难以获得清洁用水的社区的公共卫生状况。

tip: invention创造原本没有的东西；discovery发现已有事物。

senses.en: To accept that something is true or someone is truthful.
To think that something is likely or correct.
To have confidence or faith in someone or something.

ex.en: I believe you, but your story sounds quite unusual.
ex.zh: 我相信你，但你讲的事情听起来很不寻常。

ex.en: Some educators believe that practical experience is just as valuable as academic knowledge in preparing students for employment.
ex.zh: 一些教育工作者认为，在帮助学生为就业做准备方面，实践经验与学术知识同样重要。

tip: believe someone指相信其话；believe in someone指信任其能力。

senses.en: Connected railway vehicles that carry passengers or goods.
Teach or practise skills needed for an activity or job.

ex.en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们赶上了回家的末班火车。

ex.en: Governments should train more healthcare workers to meet the needs of an ageing population.
ex.zh: 政府应培训更多医护人员，以满足老龄化人口的需求。

col: train for a marathon｜为马拉松训练
tip: 交通方式用by train；在某列火车上用on the train。

senses.en: Thin material used for writing, printing, or wrapping.
A publication containing news, usually printed on large sheets.
An academic article or a written examination.

ex.en: She wrapped the small gift in bright yellow paper.
ex.zh: 她用鲜黄色的纸把小礼物包了起来。

ex.en: The university encourages students to submit assignments electronically to reduce paper consumption across its departments.
ex.zh: 这所大学鼓励学生以电子形式提交作业，以减少各院系的纸张消耗。

tip: 纸不可数，用a piece of paper；论文、报纸可数。

senses.en: a place on the internet where people chat

ex.en: They met in an online chatroom.
ex.zh: 他们在一个在线聊天室里认识。

ex.en: Be careful what you share in a chatroom.
ex.zh: 在聊天室里注意不要随意分享信息。

tip: 在 chatroom 里要注意安全，不透露个人信息。
scene: A laptop screen showing a friendly chat window with speech bubbles.

senses.en: introduces a condition for something to happen
introduces an indirect question about whether something is true

ex.en: If it rains, we can play indoors instead.
ex.zh: 如果下雨，我们可以改在室内玩。

ex.en: If cities invest in safe cycling routes, more residents may choose bicycles for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 如果城市投资建设安全的自行车道，更多居民可能会选择骑车进行日常出行。

tip: 谈未来条件时，if从句通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: completely different, or on the other side
facing someone or something from the other side
someone or something completely different from another

ex.en: We left the station and walked in opposite directions.
ex.zh: 我们离开车站，朝相反的方向走去。

ex.en: Although the policy aimed to reduce traffic, it had the opposite effect in several residential areas.
ex.zh: 尽管该政策旨在减少交通流量，却在几个住宅区产生了相反的效果。

col: the exact opposite｜截然相反的事物
tip: 介词opposite后直接接地点；名词常用the opposite of。

senses.en: Large in size, amount, or degree.
Important or likely to have a strong effect.

ex.en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
ex.zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。

ex.en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通能显著改善快速发展城市的空气质量。

tip: big较口语；正式写作可按语境用large或major。

senses.en: The body part at the arm's end, with fingers and thumb.
Help with doing a task.
To give something to someone by holding it out.

ex.en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
ex.zh: 她用左手握着温热的杯子。

ex.en: Practical workshops allow students to develop skills by making objects with their own hands.
ex.zh: 实践工作坊让学生通过亲手制作物品来培养技能。

col: give someone a hand｜帮某人一把
hand in an assignment｜提交作业
tip: give someone a hand表示帮忙；by hand表示手工。

senses.en: used when two people do the same thing to one another

ex.en: The twins help each other with homework.
ex.zh: 这对双胞胎互相帮助做作业。

ex.en: They looked at each other and smiled.
ex.zh: 他们相视而笑。

tip: each other 表示两者或多者“互相”；常用于 help/look at 等动词后。
scene: Two twins sitting at a desk helping each other with homework.

senses.en: having the colour of lemons or ripe bananas
the colour of lemons or ripe bananas
to become yellow or make something yellow

ex.en: She picked a yellow umbrella for the rainy walk.
ex.zh: 她挑了一把黄色雨伞，准备在雨中散步。

ex.en: Yellow leaves may indicate that urban trees are suffering from water shortages or poor soil conditions.
ex.zh: 黄叶可能表明城市树木正受到缺水或土壤条件不佳的影响。

tip: 可作动词表示变黄；不要用它描述人的种族。

senses.en: Stored information on a computer, or an organized collection of papers.
To store documents systematically or submit them to an authority.
A rough metal tool used to smooth or shape surfaces.

ex.en: I saved the file before switching off my laptop.
ex.zh: 我关掉笔记本电脑之前保存了文件。

ex.en: Public institutions should store confidential files securely to prevent unauthorized access and protect citizens' personal information.
ex.zh: 公共机构应安全存储机密文件，以防止未经授权的访问并保护公民的个人信息。

col: file a complaint｜正式提出投诉
tip: file a complaint 指正式投诉，不是把投诉归档。

senses.en: Having a lot of money or valuable possessions.
Containing a large amount or variety of something valuable.
Containing plenty of fat, cream, sugar, or strong flavour.

ex.en: Their rich uncle owns a large house by the sea.
ex.zh: 他们富有的叔叔在海边拥有一栋大房子。

ex.en: Rich countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
ex.zh: 富裕国家可以通过投资贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。

col: rich in nutrients｜富含营养成分
rich cultural heritage｜丰富的文化遗产
tip: “富含……”用 rich in，不用 rich of。

senses.en: To have information or understanding about something
To be familiar with a person, place, or thing

ex.en: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
ex.zh: 你知道怎么修这辆自行车吗？

ex.en: Consumers need to know how their personal information is collected before they can make informed choices online.
ex.zh: 消费者需要了解个人信息的收集方式，才能在网上作出知情选择。

tip: 过去式knew，过去分词known；通常不用进行时。

senses.zh: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
senses.en: A child of your aunt or uncle

ex.en: My cousin taught me to ride a bicycle yesterday.
ex.zh: 我的表姐昨天教我骑自行车。

ex.en: Children who regularly spend time with their cousins may develop strong family bonds beyond their immediate household.
ex.zh: 经常与堂表兄弟姐妹相处的孩子，可能与小家庭之外的亲人建立深厚感情。

col: a distant cousin｜远房堂亲或表亲
a younger cousin｜年幼的堂表亲
tip: 不区分堂表、性别或长幼；需要时另加说明。

senses.en: used when we are both doing and receiving an action
used to emphasize that we do something, not others

ex.en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
ex.zh: 我们看到了自己映在清澈湖水中的倒影。

ex.en: By involving ourselves in community projects, we can develop practical skills and strengthen local relationships.
ex.zh: 通过参与社区项目，我们可以培养实用技能并增进邻里关系。

tip: by ourselves可指独自，也可指不靠别人。

senses.en: The eleventh month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in November.
ex.zh: 我们将在十一月搬进新公寓。

ex.en: The university plans to launch its new scholarship programme in November, allowing more international students to apply.
ex.zh: 该大学计划在十一月推出新的奖学金项目，让更多国际学生能够申请。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: cooked in hot oil or fat

ex.en: We had fried eggs and toast for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们早餐吃了煎蛋和烤面包。

ex.en: Eating fried foods too frequently can increase calorie intake and make maintaining a healthy weight more difficult.
ex.zh: 过于频繁地吃油炸食品会增加热量摄入，使维持健康体重更加困难。

tip: fried是fry的过去式和过去分词，也作形容词；不限于油炸。

senses.en: Say you are willing to give something or do something.
A proposal of help, an opportunity, or a place.
Say how much you are willing to pay.

ex.en: Our neighbour offered to carry the heavy bags upstairs.
ex.zh: 邻居主动提出帮我们把沉重的袋子搬上楼。

ex.en: Universities should offer practical training that helps students develop skills relevant to the workplace.
ex.zh: 大学应提供实践培训，帮助学生培养与职场相关的技能。

col: offer someone a job｜给某人提供工作
make an offer｜出价；提出提议
tip: 主动做某事用offer to do，不用offer doing。

senses.en: a person who works in a shop helping customers

ex.en: The shop assistant helped me find the right size.
ex.zh: 店员帮我找到了合适的尺码。

ex.en: Ask the shop assistant how much this costs.
ex.zh: 问问店员这个多少钱。

tip: shop assistant 是英式说法，指商店里的服务员。
scene: A shop assistant in a uniform helping a customer at a counter.

senses.en: to exist; used with names, ages, feelings

ex.en: I am twelve years old.
ex.zh: 我十二岁。

ex.en: They are my best friends.
ex.zh: 他们是我最好的朋友。

tip: be 的现在时形式是 am/is/are，过去时是 was/were。
scene: A classroom blackboard showing the words am, is, are with happy faces.

senses.en: the people or things already mentioned, as objects

ex.en: I called them yesterday evening.
ex.zh: 我昨晚给他们打了电话。

ex.en: Please give the books to them.
ex.zh: 请把书给他们。

tip: them 是 they 的宾格，作宾语用。
scene: A person handing a stack of books to two children.

senses.en: to have your home somewhere, lead a life, or remain alive
broadcast or performed as it happens, rather than recorded
alive rather than dead

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。

ex.en: People who live near public transport often depend less on private cars for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 住在公共交通设施附近的人日常出行往往较少依赖私家车。

col: live a healthy life｜过健康的生活
tip: 动词读/lɪv/；形容词及表示现场直播的副词读/laɪv/。

senses.en: a group of things sharing similar characteristics
to arrange things in groups or a particular order
to deal successfully with a problem or practical matter

ex.en: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
ex.zh: 你在家听哪种音乐？

ex.en: Households should sort their waste carefully so that recyclable materials can be processed more efficiently.
ex.zh: 家庭应仔细将垃圾分类，以便更高效地处理可回收材料。

col: sort out a problem｜解决问题
tip: a sort of表示“一种”；sort of也可口语表示“有点”。

senses.en: A planned piece of work with a particular purpose.
To estimate a future amount or situation using current information.
To send light or images onto a surface.

ex.en: Our garden project started with three pots of herbs.
ex.zh: 我们的园艺项目是从三盆香草开始的。

ex.en: Researchers project that demand for electricity will increase as more households switch to electric vehicles.
ex.zh: 研究人员预计，随着更多家庭改用电动汽车，电力需求将会增加。

col: carry out a project｜开展项目
be projected to rise｜预计会上升
tip: 名词重音在前，动词重音在后；音标按此顺序列出。

senses.en: the female person or animal receiving an action
belonging to or connected with a female person or animal

ex.en: I called her after lunch to arrange a walk.
ex.zh: 午饭后我给她打了电话，约好一起散步。

ex.en: When a student requests additional support, teachers should help her access appropriate learning resources.
ex.zh: 当一名女学生请求额外支持时，教师应帮助她获取合适的学习资源。

tip: her可作宾语或接名词表所属；hers独立使用。

senses.en: Liked or enjoyed by many people.
Intended for ordinary people rather than specialists.

ex.en: This small café is popular with local students.
ex.zh: 这家小咖啡馆很受当地学生欢迎。

ex.en: Popular science books can encourage public interest in research by explaining discoveries in accessible language.
ex.zh: 通俗科普书籍通过用易懂的语言解释科学发现，可以激发公众对研究的兴趣。

tip: 表示受某群体欢迎，常用popular with或among。

senses.en: Make something work properly or solve a problem.
Attach something firmly in a particular place.
Decide an exact time, price, or arrangement.

ex.en: My neighbour helped me fix the broken kitchen tap.
ex.zh: 邻居帮我修好了厨房里坏掉的水龙头。

ex.en: Governments should fix weaknesses in existing transport networks before investing in expensive new infrastructure.
ex.zh: 政府应先解决现有交通网络的薄弱环节，再投资昂贵的新基础设施。

col: fix something to a wall｜把某物固定在墙上
tip: fix既可修理物品，也可解决问题或确定日期。

senses.zh: 迪斯科舞会；迪斯科音乐
senses.en: a place or party where people dance to pop music

ex.en: There is a school disco on Friday night.
ex.zh: 周五晚上有一场学校舞会。

ex.en: They danced at the disco until ten o'clock.
ex.zh: 他们在舞会上跳到十点。

tip: disco 指跳流行音乐的舞会/舞厅；go to a disco 去跳舞。
scene: A colourful school hall with flashing lights and teenagers dancing.

senses.en: moving or acting fast, without much delay
taking only a short time

ex.en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
ex.zh: 她反应敏捷，及时接住了差点掉落的玻璃杯。

ex.en: A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.
ex.zh: 对水污染报告作出迅速回应，可以防止附近生态系统遭受严重破坏。

tip: 正式表达中用副词quickly修饰动作。

senses.en: A container used for rubbish or for storing things.
To throw something away, especially into a rubbish container.

ex.en: Please put the banana skin in the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 请把香蕉皮放进厨房的垃圾桶。

ex.en: Providing a separate bin for food waste can help households recycle more effectively and reduce landfill use.
ex.zh: 提供单独的厨余垃圾桶有助于家庭更有效地回收废物，并减少垃圾填埋量。

tip: “垃圾桶”英式常说bin，美式常说trash can。

senses.en: Cooked using strong direct heat, often on a metal rack.

ex.en: We shared grilled vegetables and warm bread for lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐我们一起吃了烤蔬菜和热面包。

ex.en: Offering grilled fish alongside plant-based dishes can help school cafeterias provide a wider range of nutritious meals.
ex.zh: 学校食堂同时供应烤鱼和植物性菜肴，有助于提供更多种类的营养餐。

tip: grilled强调直接高温烤制；不表示“有格子的”。

senses.en: From one side of something to the other.
On the opposite side of, or throughout, an area.

senses.zh: 从一边到另一边；在对面
senses.en: From one side to another, or on the opposite side.

ex.en: We walked across the bridge before the rain started.
ex.zh: 下雨前，我们走过了那座桥。

ex.en: Improved internet access allows students across rural regions to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 互联网接入条件的改善，让广大农村地区的学生能够利用更丰富的教育资源。

tip: across强调横跨表面；through强调从内部穿过。

senses.en: The activity or skill of taking photographs.

ex.en: My sister enjoys photography and carries her camera everywhere.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢摄影，走到哪儿都带着相机。

ex.en: Digital photography allows researchers to document environmental changes and share visual evidence with a wider audience.
ex.zh: 数码摄影让研究人员能够记录环境变化，并向更广泛的受众分享影像证据。

col: take up photography｜开始学习摄影
tip: photography不可数；一张照片用a photograph。

senses.en: the eighth month of the year

ex.en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
ex.zh: 我们通常八月去看望住在海边的祖父母。

ex.en: Tourist destinations often experience increased demand in August, putting pressure on local transport and accommodation.
ex.zh: 旅游目的地的需求往往在八月增加，给当地交通和住宿带来压力。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: a game played on a screen or computer

ex.en: He plays video games for an hour after school.
ex.zh: 他放学后玩一小时电子游戏。

ex.en: This video game is popular with children.
ex.zh: 这款电子游戏很受孩子们欢迎。

tip: video game 是电子/视频游戏；play a video game 玩游戏。
scene: A child playing a video game with a controller in a living room.

senses.en: Letters and parcels, or the system used to deliver them.
To send something by mail or share it publicly.
A job or position in an organisation.

ex.en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上寄来了一个包裹。

ex.en: Local authorities should post regular updates online to keep residents informed about changes to public services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应定期在网上发布最新消息，让居民了解公共服务的变化。

col: apply for a post｜申请职位
tip: 邮寄义中，英式常用post，美式常用mail。

senses.en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things.
To put something into a bag.

ex.en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
ex.zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。

ex.en: Charging customers for plastic bags can encourage shoppers to adopt more environmentally responsible habits.
ex.zh: 向顾客收取塑料袋费用，可以鼓励购物者养成更环保的习惯。

col: a reusable bag｜可重复使用的袋子
tip: a bag of后接所装物品，如a bag of rice。

senses.en: A flying mammal usually active at night.
An object used to hit the ball in certain sports.
To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.

ex.en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
ex.zh: 黄昏时，一只蝙蝠从我们花园上方飞过。

ex.en: Protecting bat habitats can benefit agriculture because many species feed on insects that damage crops.
ex.zh: 保护蝙蝠栖息地能使农业受益，因为许多蝙蝠以危害农作物的昆虫为食。

tip: 网球拍用racket，棒球棒和板球拍用bat。

senses.en: To be the right size, shape, or type for something.
Physically healthy and strong, especially through exercise.
Suitable or good enough for a particular purpose.

ex.en: These boots fit perfectly, even with my thick socks.
ex.zh: 即使穿着厚袜子，这双靴子也非常合脚。

ex.en: Public exercise facilities can help older adults stay fit while strengthening social connections within their communities.
ex.zh: 公共健身设施可以帮助老年人保持健康，同时加强他们与社区内其他人的联系。

tip: 衣物fit指尺寸合适；suit多指款式或颜色适合。

senses.en: usual, expected, or typical in a particular situation
the usual state or level of something

ex.en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview.
ex.zh: 面试前感到紧张是正常的。

ex.en: Flexible working hours are becoming a normal feature of employment in many sectors of the economy.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间正成为许多经济领域中常见的用工安排。

col: normal working hours｜正常工作时间
tip: normal强调符合常态；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

senses.en: A game of hitting a ball over a high net.

ex.en: We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
ex.zh: 我们在沙滩上打排球，一直打到日落。

ex.en: Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 排球等团队运动既能帮助学生培养沟通能力，也能鼓励他们定期锻炼。

tip: 指运动时不可数，play volleyball中不加冠词。

senses.en: a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets

ex.en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们每逢周日都在公园打网球。

ex.en: Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.
ex.zh: 提供价格实惠的网球课程，可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼并提高身体协调能力。

tip: 说 play tennis，不加冠词；球拍用 racket。

senses.en: emotions such as happiness or sadness

ex.en: Don't hurt her feelings with those words.
ex.zh: 别说那些话伤她的感情。

ex.en: He has strong feelings about the environment.
ex.zh: 他对环境有很强烈的感受。

col: hurt someone's feelings｜伤某人的感情
tip: feelings 常用复数表示“情感”；hurt one's feelings 是伤感情。
scene: Two friends talking, one looking hurt while the other listens.

senses.en: a person who takes photos as a job or hobby

ex.en: The photographer took our class photo.
ex.zh: 摄影师给我们拍了班级合影。

ex.en: She wants to be a nature photographer.
ex.zh: 她想成为一名自然摄影师。

tip: photographer 是“摄影师”；photography 是“摄影（艺术）”。
scene: A photographer with a camera taking photos of flowers in a park.

senses.en: A photograph you take of yourself, usually with a phone.

ex.en: We took a selfie beside the lake after our walk.
ex.zh: 散步后，我们在湖边拍了一张自拍照。

ex.en: Sharing a selfie online can express personal identity, but users should consider their privacy settings first.
ex.zh: 在网上分享自拍照可以展现个人身份，但用户应先考虑隐私设置。

tip: 拍自拍照用take a selfie，不用make a selfie。

senses.en: To move past something or through a place.
To give something to another person.
To achieve the required standard in an examination or test.

ex.en: We pass a small bakery on our way home.
ex.zh: 我们回家的路上会经过一家小面包店。

ex.en: Students must pass a practical assessment before they can begin working independently in the laboratory.
ex.zh: 学生必须通过实践考核，才能开始在实验室独立工作。

tip: pass是动词；past可作介词：walk past。

senses.en: a sweet, sticky food made by bees

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
ex.zh: 她往茶里加了一勺蜂蜜，搅拌均匀。

ex.en: Local honey production can provide rural income while encouraging farmers to protect habitats for bees.
ex.zh: 本地蜂蜜生产能为农村带来收入，同时鼓励农民保护蜜蜂的栖息地。

col: a spoonful of honey｜一勺蜂蜜
a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜
tip: 表示蜂蜜时不可数；一罐蜂蜜说a jar of honey。

senses.en: a board you stand on to slide down snow

ex.en: He rides his snowboard down the mountain.
ex.zh: 他踩着滑雪板从山上滑下来。

ex.en: My new snowboard is blue and white.
ex.zh: 我的新滑雪板是蓝白色的。

tip: snowboard 是滑雪板；运动本身叫 snowboarding。
scene: A snowboard standing upright in the snow on a ski slope.

senses.en: A small furry animal often kept as a pet.
An animal belonging to the same family as lions.

ex.en: Our cat sleeps in a sunny spot by the window.
ex.zh: 我们家的猫睡在窗边阳光照得到的地方。

ex.en: Keeping pet cats indoors can help protect native birds, particularly in areas with vulnerable wildlife populations.
ex.zh: 将宠物猫养在室内有助于保护本地鸟类，尤其是在野生动物种群脆弱的地区。

tip: big cats指狮、虎等大型猫科动物。

senses.en: A particular area, position, or location.
To put something in a particular position.
A space available for someone to sit, study, or participate.

ex.en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
ex.zh: 这处阴凉的地方很适合野餐。

ex.en: Urban planners should place public facilities near residential areas to make essential services accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 城市规划者应将公共设施设在住宅区附近，让所有人都能方便地获得基本服务。

col: a university place｜大学录取名额
tip: take place表示发生或举行，不用被动语态。

senses.en: a one-piece garment with a top and a skirt
to put clothes on yourself or someone else
clothing of a particular type or worn for a particular occasion

ex.en: She wore a blue dress to her sister's party.
ex.zh: 她穿了一条蓝色连衣裙去参加姐姐的聚会。

ex.en: Some employers require formal dress, while others allow staff to wear casual clothing at work.
ex.zh: 有些雇主要求穿正装，而另一些则允许员工上班时穿便装。

tip: a dress指连衣裙；get dressed指穿好衣服。

senses.en: Travel around a place to discover what it is like
Examine an idea or issue carefully to learn more

ex.en: We spent the afternoon exploring narrow streets near the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们花了一下午探访港口附近的狭窄街巷。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to explore different career options before choosing subjects for further study.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生在选择深造科目前探索不同的职业方向。

tip: 作及物动词时直接接地点或问题，不加about。

senses.en: A small rodent with a pointed nose and long thin tail.
A handheld device for moving a pointer on a computer screen.

ex.en: A tiny mouse slipped behind the cupboard before breakfast.
ex.zh: 早饭前，一只小老鼠溜到了橱柜后面。

ex.en: Using a mouse for long periods may cause wrist discomfort, so office workers should take regular breaks.
ex.zh: 长时间使用鼠标可能引起手腕不适，因此办公室职员应定时休息。

tip: 老鼠的复数是mice；鼠标的复数可用mice或mouses。

senses.en: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose
a show broadcast on television or radio
to arrange activities or set a machine to operate automatically

ex.en: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
ex.zh: 我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。

ex.en: A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.
ex.zh: 设计合理的培训项目能帮助失业成年人掌握新职业所需的技能。

col: launch a programme｜启动一项计划
tip: 英式通常用programme，计算机程序用program；美式均用program。

senses.en: a road vehicle with wheels, usually carrying a few people
one of the separate sections of a train

ex.en: Our car is parked under the tree outside.
ex.zh: 我们的汽车停在外面的树下。

ex.en: Reducing private car use could improve urban air quality and make streets safer for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 减少私家车使用可以改善城市空气质量，让街道对行人更安全。

tip: by car不加冠词；in a car需要冠词。

senses.en: trousers with legs ending above or near the knees

ex.en: I packed shorts and sandals for our beach holiday.
ex.zh: 我为这次海滨度假打包了短裤和凉鞋。

ex.en: In hot weather, lightweight shorts can help people stay comfortable while taking part in outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，轻薄的短裤能帮助人们在户外锻炼时保持舒适。

col: a pair of shorts｜一条短裤
tip: shorts用复数；一条短裤说a pair of shorts。

senses.en: A piece of jewellery worn around the wrist.

ex.en: She wears a silver bracelet that her grandmother gave her.
ex.zh: 她戴着祖母送给她的一条银手链。

ex.en: A handmade bracelet can reflect local artistic traditions while providing income for craftspeople in rural communities.
ex.zh: 手工手链既能体现当地艺术传统，又能为农村社区的手艺人带来收入。

tip: bracelet戴在手腕；anklet戴在脚踝。

senses.en: the meal you eat at the start of the day

ex.en: I usually have breakfast before taking the bus.
ex.zh: 我通常吃完早餐再去坐公交车。

ex.en: Schools that provide a healthy breakfast may help students concentrate better during morning lessons.
ex.zh: 提供健康早餐的学校可能有助于学生在上午的课堂上更加专注。

col: a balanced breakfast｜营养均衡的早餐
tip: 泛指吃早餐用have breakfast，不加冠词。

senses.en: To write or say the letters of a word in order.
A period during which a particular condition or activity continues.
Words or magic believed to have special powers.

ex.en: Could you spell your surname slowly for me, please?
ex.zh: 请你把姓氏慢慢拼给我听，好吗？

ex.en: A prolonged spell of dry weather can reduce crop yields and increase pressure on local water supplies.
ex.zh: 持续的干旱天气会降低农作物产量，并加大当地供水压力。

col: a spell of illness｜一段患病期
tip: 过去式及过去分词英式可用spelt或spelled。

senses.en: A flat piece of wood or other firm material.
A group responsible for managing an organisation or making decisions.
Get onto a ship, aircraft, train, or bus.

ex.en: She placed a wooden board across the muddy path.
ex.zh: 她在泥泞的小路上横放了一块木板。

ex.en: The board approved a plan to reduce factory emissions without cutting jobs or lowering wages.
ex.zh: 董事会批准了一项在不裁员、不降薪的前提下减少工厂排放的计划。

tip: board作动词可直接接交通工具：board a train。

senses.en: to stop and hold something moving, or capture someone
to reach a bus, train, or plane in time
to become ill with an infectious disease

ex.en: Can you catch the ball with just one hand?
ex.zh: 你能只用一只手接住球吗？

ex.en: More frequent bus services would help commuters catch connecting trains without relying on private cars.
ex.zh: 增加公交班次将帮助通勤者赶上接续列车，而不必依赖私家车。

col: catch someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为caught；感冒用catch a cold。

senses.en: a person who gives a talk or addresses others
a person who speaks a particular language
a device that produces sound from electrical signals

ex.en: The speaker made everyone laugh with her opening story.
ex.zh: 演讲者开场讲的故事把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: Inviting a guest speaker from the scientific community can help students understand how classroom knowledge applies to real problems.
ex.zh: 邀请科学界的嘉宾来演讲，可以帮助学生理解课堂知识如何应用于实际问题。

tip: a native speaker of English指英语母语者。

senses.en: glasses with dark lenses that protect eyes from bright sunlight

ex.en: I put on my sunglasses before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 出门前，我戴上了太阳镜。

ex.en: Wearing sunglasses with adequate ultraviolet protection can reduce the risk of eye damage during outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 在户外活动时，佩戴具有充分紫外线防护功能的太阳镜可以降低眼睛受损的风险。

col: a pair of sunglasses｜一副太阳镜
tip: 通常用复数；一副说a pair of sunglasses。

senses.en: feel deep affection for someone or enjoy something very much
a strong feeling of affection or great enjoyment

ex.en: I love walking by the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我很喜欢晚饭后沿着河边散步。

ex.en: Schools can develop children's love of reading by providing diverse books and regular library visits.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供多样化的图书和安排定期参观图书馆，培养孩子对阅读的热爱。

col: love of learning｜对学习的热爱
tip: love doing和love to do均可表示喜欢做某事。

senses.en: To let someone see something or demonstrate how something works.
To provide information or evidence that something is true.
A performance, programme, or public display intended for an audience.

ex.en: Please show me how to fold this paper bird.
ex.zh: 请教我怎么折这只纸鸟。

ex.en: Recent studies show that access to green spaces can improve mental wellbeing in urban populations.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，能够使用绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: show someone how to｜教某人如何
tip: 过去式showed，过去分词通常用shown。

senses.en: In a higher position than something else.
Greater than a particular amount, level, or standard.
In a higher place or earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 厨房水槽上方挂着一个小木架。

ex.en: Temperatures above the seasonal average can increase water demand and put pressure on urban supplies.
ex.zh: 高于当季平均水平的气温会增加用水需求，给城市供水带来压力。

tip: above 表示位置更高，不一定正上方，也不表示接触。

senses.en: someone who has just started learning or doing something

ex.en: This swimming class is perfect for a complete beginner.
ex.zh: 这堂游泳课非常适合完全没有基础的初学者。

ex.en: Courses designed for beginners should provide clear guidance and regular opportunities to practise new skills.
ex.zh: 为初学者设计的课程应提供清晰的指导，以及定期练习新技能的机会。

col: a complete beginner｜零基础初学者
tip: beginner是可数名词，单数前通常要有限定词。

senses.en: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.
To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.

ex.en: You were brave to speak in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 你敢在大家面前发言，真勇敢。

ex.en: It takes brave leadership to introduce necessary environmental reforms when powerful groups strongly oppose them.
ex.zh: 当强势群体激烈反对时，推行必要的环境改革需要勇敢的领导力。

col: brave enough to｜有足够勇气做
tip: brave并非毫不害怕，而是害怕仍敢面对。

senses.en: Products applied to the face to change or enhance appearance.
The parts or qualities that together form something.

ex.en: She keeps her make-up in a small blue bag.
ex.zh: 她把化妆品放在一个蓝色小包里。

ex.en: The social make-up of a neighbourhood can change significantly as new housing attracts different residents.
ex.zh: 随着新建住房吸引不同的居民，一个社区的社会构成可能显著改变。

tip: 名词也写作makeup；动词短语make up不加连字符。

senses.en: a live musical performance given before an audience

ex.en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。

ex.en: Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.
ex.zh: 免费公共音乐会能让更多人参与文化活动，并鼓励居民使用城市公共空间。

tip: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

senses.en: to ride ocean waves while standing or lying on a board
to browse websites, often without a specific purpose
waves and white foam breaking near the shore

ex.en: My cousin learned to surf during our beach holiday.
ex.zh: 我们在海滨度假时，我的表亲学会了冲浪。

ex.en: Students who surf the internet for research need skills to distinguish reliable sources from misleading information.
ex.zh: 上网查找研究资料的学生需要具备辨别可靠来源与误导性信息的能力。

tip: surf the internet指上网浏览，不一定有明确搜索目标。

senses.en: Produce tears because of sadness, pain, or strong emotion.
Call out loudly because of strong emotion or urgent need.
A loud sound expressing emotion or attracting attention.

ex.en: The baby began to cry when her toy fell.
ex.zh: 玩具掉了，宝宝就哭了起来。

ex.en: Young children may cry when separated from their parents, so schools should provide a welcoming environment.
ex.zh: 幼儿与父母分开时可能会哭，因此学校应营造亲切友好的环境。

col: have a good cry｜痛哭一场
tip: 过去式cried；现在分词crying；表示喊叫常用cry out。

senses.en: to obtain something by paying money for it
to believe an explanation or accept an idea

senses.zh: 买到的东西；合算的购买
senses.en: something bought, especially something offering good value

ex.en: I need to buy some bread before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我需要在吃早饭前买些面包。

ex.en: Consumers can reduce packaging waste when they buy fresh produce from local markets.
ex.zh: 消费者在当地市场购买新鲜农产品时，可以减少包装废弃物。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bought；不要写成buyed。

senses.en: Having little length, height, or duration.
Not having as much of something as is needed.
Before reaching a target, or with a sudden stop.

ex.en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚饭前，我们散了一小会儿步。

ex.en: Short training courses can help unemployed adults acquire practical skills without committing to several years of study.
ex.zh: 短期培训课程能帮助失业成年人获得实用技能，而不必投入数年时间学习。

tip: short of表示缺少；shortly通常意为“不久”。

senses.en: costing half the usual price
at half the usual price

ex.en: We bought half-price tickets for the afternoon boat trip.
ex.zh: 我们买了下午游船的半价票。

ex.en: Offering half-price public transport to students could improve access to education and reduce car use.
ex.zh: 向学生提供半价公共交通服务可以改善受教育机会，并减少汽车使用。

col: buy something half-price｜以半价购买某物
tip: 名词前常写half-price；at half price不加连字符。

senses.en: used in questions about things

ex.en: What is your name?
ex.zh: 你叫什么名字？

ex.en: What do you want for breakfast?
ex.zh: 早餐你想吃什么？

tip: what 用于提问事物；What's this? 这是什么？
scene: A child asking what with a hand raised in class.

senses.en: a group of words expressing a complete statement, question, or command
a punishment officially given by a court
to officially give someone a punishment in court

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to write one sentence about autumn.
ex.zh: 老师让我们写一个关于秋天的句子。

ex.en: Learning to vary sentence length can help students express complex ideas more clearly in academic essays.
ex.zh: 学会变化句子长度，可以帮助学生在学术文章中更清晰地表达复杂观点。

col: sentence someone to｜判处某人……刑罚
tip: 判某人某种刑罚用sentence sb to sth。

senses.en: to have clothes, jewellery, or accessories on your body
to damage or become damaged through repeated use
damage caused by regular use over time

ex.en: I always wear thick socks when the floor feels cold.
ex.zh: 地板凉的时候，我总会穿上厚袜子。

ex.en: Encouraging employees to wear protective equipment can significantly reduce the risk of injuries in industrial workplaces.
ex.zh: 鼓励员工穿戴防护装备，可以显著降低工业场所的工伤风险。

tip: wear强调穿戴状态，put on强调动作；过去式wore。

senses.en: pleasant to look at; attractive

ex.en: He is a good-looking young man.
ex.zh: 他是个好看的年轻人。

ex.en: The good-looking actress smiled at the camera.
ex.zh: 漂亮的女演员对着镜头微笑。

tip: good-looking 用于形容人长相好看；比较级 more good-looking。
scene: A smiling young man in a blue shirt looking at himself in a mirror.

senses.en: a period of twenty-four hours
the part of each day when there is natural light
a particular period in the past or present

ex.en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
ex.zh: 我们一整天都在海滩上堆沙堡。
