ex.en: Shorter working days may improve employee wellbeing while allowing parents to spend more time with their children.
ex.zh: 缩短每日工作时间可能改善员工的身心状态，同时让家长有更多时间陪伴孩子。

tip: every day意为每天；everyday是形容词，意为日常的。

senses.en: Schoolwork that students are asked to complete outside lessons.
Research or preparation done before making a decision.

ex.en: I finished my homework before dinner and went outside.
ex.zh: 我在晚饭前做完了作业，然后出门了。

ex.en: Schools should limit homework so that children have enough time for exercise and family activities.
ex.zh: 学校应限制家庭作业量，让孩子有足够的时间锻炼和参加家庭活动。

col: do your homework｜做好事前准备
tip: 不可数名词；一项作业用a piece of homework。

senses.en: A designated place where people or vehicles cross.
A journey across water or another geographical barrier.

ex.en: We waited at the crossing until the cars stopped.
ex.zh: 我们在人行横道前等到车辆停下才过马路。

ex.en: Installing a pedestrian crossing near every school can help protect children and encourage more families to walk.
ex.zh: 在每所学校附近设置人行横道，有助于保护儿童并鼓励更多家庭步行。

tip: 作名词可指过街地点，也可指乘船横渡的行程。

senses.en: To put something over a surface or object.
To include something, deal with it, or pay its cost.
An outer layer that protects or encloses something.

ex.en: Cover the bread with a cloth while it cools.
ex.zh: 面包冷却时，用一块布盖住它。

ex.en: University scholarships should cover living expenses as well as tuition fees for students from low-income families.
ex.zh: 大学奖学金应为低收入家庭的学生支付生活费和学费。

col: cover a topic｜涉及某个话题
tip: cover A with B表示用B盖住A；cover费用指足以支付。

senses.en: A team sport involving hitting a ball and running between bases
The small, hard ball used in this sport

ex.en: We played baseball in the park after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我们在公园打棒球。

ex.en: Team sports such as baseball can help young people develop cooperation skills and maintain physical fitness.
ex.zh: 棒球等团队运动能帮助年轻人培养合作能力并保持身体健康。

tip: 运动名称不可数；表示一个棒球时用a baseball。

senses.en: must; it is necessary to do something

ex.en: I have got to finish my homework before dinner.
ex.zh: 我必须在晚饭前完成作业。

ex.en: You have got to be careful on the road.
ex.zh: 你过马路必须小心。

tip: have got to 与 have to 意思相同，都表示“必须”，口语常用。
scene: A student looking at the clock while doing homework at a desk.

senses.en: Quick to learn, understand, or find solutions.
Showing skill or an original way of solving a problem.

ex.en: That clever child fixed the puzzle before lunch.
ex.zh: 那个聪明的孩子午饭前就解开了这道谜题。

ex.en: Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 巧妙的设计可以让城市小公寓显得宽敞，同时不增加其环境影响。

tip: 比较级cleverer，最高级cleverest。

senses.en: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else.
In a more effective or satisfactory way.
Less ill than before.

ex.en: This backpack is better than my old one.
ex.zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。

ex.en: Better public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
ex.zh: 更好的公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，并改善发展中城市的就业可达性。

tip: 是good和well的比较级，不说more better。

senses.en: in, at, or to all places

ex.en: We looked everywhere, but the kitten was under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们到处找，结果小猫就在沙发底下。

ex.en: Although digital services are expanding rapidly, reliable internet access is not yet available everywhere.
ex.zh: 尽管数字服务正在迅速扩展，可靠的互联网接入仍未覆盖所有地方。

tip: everywhere是副词，前面通常不加in或at。

senses.en: an official document identifying you when travelling between countries
something that makes success or an opportunity possible

ex.en: I checked my bag twice to find my passport.
ex.zh: 我翻了两遍包才找到护照。

ex.en: A university degree is often viewed as a passport to better employment, although practical experience also matters.
ex.zh: 大学学位常被视为获得更好工作的通行证，不过实践经验也很重要。

col: a passport to success｜成功的通行证
tip: 比喻用法a passport to中，to后接名词。

senses.en: Money in the form of coins and banknotes
Exchange a cheque for money

ex.en: I keep some cash in my wallet for emergencies.
ex.zh: 我在钱包里放了一些现金，以备急用。

ex.en: Although digital payments are increasingly common, many small businesses still prefer customers to pay in cash.
ex.zh: 尽管电子支付日益普及，许多小商家仍然更希望顾客用现金付款。

tip: cash作现金讲不可数；用现金付款是pay in cash。

senses.en: towards and then inside something
used to show the result of a change
interested in or enthusiastic about something

ex.en: The kitten jumped into the basket beside my chair.
ex.zh: 小猫跳进了我椅子旁的篮子里。

ex.en: Converting unused offices into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
ex.zh: 将闲置办公室改造成经济适用住房，可帮助城市缓解住房短缺，而不必向周边乡村扩张。

col: walk into a room｜走进房间
look into a problem｜调查问题
tip: into强调进入的过程；in通常表示在里面。

senses.en: Cloth worn around the neck or head.

ex.en: She wrapped a wool scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她在脖子上围了一条羊毛围巾。

ex.en: In colder regions, a locally woven scarf can reflect traditional craftsmanship while providing essential warmth.
ex.zh: 在较寒冷的地区，当地织造的围巾既能体现传统手艺，又能提供必要的保暖。

col: wrap a scarf around your neck｜在脖子上围围巾
tip: 复数可用scarves或scarfs，前者更常见。

senses.en: a two-wheeled vehicle moved by pushing pedals
to travel by bicycle

ex.en: I locked my bicycle outside the small bakery.
ex.zh: 我把自行车锁在那家小面包店外面。

ex.en: Travelling by bicycle can reduce urban air pollution while providing residents with regular physical exercise.
ex.zh: 骑自行车出行既能减少城市空气污染，也能让居民经常锻炼身体。

tip: by bicycle不加冠词；ride a bicycle要加冠词。

senses.en: To go to see a person or place.
An occasion when someone goes to see someone or somewhere.

ex.en: We visited our neighbours and shared some homemade soup.
ex.zh: 我们去拜访邻居，和他们分享了一些自制的汤。

ex.en: Students who visit science museums can connect classroom theories with practical examples from everyday life.
ex.zh: 参观科学博物馆的学生能够把课堂理论与日常生活中的实际例子联系起来。

col: pay a visit to｜拜访；参观
a guided visit｜有导游陪同的参观
tip: 动词visit后直接接宾语；名词用a visit to。

senses.en: an appliance that keeps food and drinks cold

ex.en: Put the milk in the refrigerator before it spoils.
ex.zh: 把牛奶放进冰箱，免得变质。

ex.en: Replacing an old refrigerator with an efficient model can reduce household electricity consumption significantly.
ex.zh: 用节能型号替换旧冰箱，可以显著减少家庭用电量。

col: store food in the refrigerator｜把食物存放在冰箱里
tip: 日常口语常用fridge；freezer专指冷冻柜或冷冻室。

senses.en: Every person in a group, or all people.

ex.en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
ex.zh: 每个人都带了一道菜，在野餐时一起分享。

ex.en: Public libraries should ensure that everyone can access reliable information, regardless of income or educational background.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应确保每个人都能获取可靠信息，不论收入或教育背景如何。

tip: everyone接单数谓语；every one强调逐个。

senses.en: Not correct, accurate, or suitable.
Not morally acceptable or fair.
In an incorrect way, or with an unsuccessful result.

ex.en: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
ex.zh: 我坐错了公交车，结果到了机场附近。

ex.en: It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.
ex.zh: 仅仅因为家庭付不起学费就剥夺儿童受教育的机会，是不正当的。

col: something is wrong with｜……出了问题
tip: go wrong表示出问题；wrong的词首w不发音。

senses.en: The activity of travelling in a boat powered by wind.
A scheduled journey or departure by a ship or ferry.

ex.en: We went sailing on the lake last weekend.
ex.zh: 上周末我们去湖上玩帆船了。

ex.en: Sailing clubs can encourage outdoor exercise while teaching young people teamwork and respect for marine environments.
ex.zh: 帆船俱乐部能鼓励户外锻炼，同时培养年轻人的团队合作精神和对海洋环境的尊重。

tip: 运动义不可数；航班义可数，如daily sailings。

senses.en: the act of learning, or work at school or university

ex.en: Her studies are going well this term.
ex.zh: 这学期她的学业进展顺利。

ex.en: He gave up his studies to work abroad.
ex.zh: 他放弃学业去国外工作。

tip: studies 常用复数表示“学业/学习”；单数 study 是学习行为。
scene: A desk with open books and a laptop, a student studying hard.

senses.en: The physical world, including plants, animals, and landscapes.
The basic qualities that make something what it is.
The qualities that shape how a person usually behaves.

ex.en: Camping helps us enjoy nature away from busy streets.
ex.zh: 露营让我们远离繁忙的街道，享受大自然。

ex.en: Understanding the nature of urban poverty is essential for developing policies that address its underlying causes.
ex.zh: 了解城市贫困的本质，对制定解决其根本原因的政策至关重要。

tip: 指大自然时通常不加the；某事的性质用the nature of。

senses.en: a polite greeting used in the afternoon

ex.en: Good afternoon, everyone. Welcome to our school.
ex.zh: 大家下午好，欢迎来到我们学校。

ex.en: 'Good afternoon,' said the shop assistant.
ex.zh: “下午好，”店员说。

tip: good afternoon 用于下午的正式问候（12点后至傍晚）。
scene: A shop assistant greeting a customer with a smile in the afternoon.

senses.en: a situation that causes difficulty and needs a solution
a question requiring thought or calculation to answer

ex.en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
ex.zh: 厨房的水龙头有问题：它一直滴水。

ex.en: Traffic congestion is a growing problem that requires investment in reliable public transport rather than additional roads.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵是日益严重的问题，需要投资建设可靠的公共交通，而不是增建道路。

tip: ……有问题用a problem with；问题的解决办法用to。

senses.en: a parent's brother or an aunt's husband

ex.en: My uncle taught me how to mend a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我叔叔教过我怎样修自行车。

ex.en: An uncle or aunt can provide valuable emotional support when parents are busy with work commitments.
ex.zh: 父母忙于工作时，叔伯姑姨等亲属可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: uncle and aunt｜叔伯姑姨等亲属
tip: uncle不区分父母哪一方，也不区分长幼。

senses.en: A thick underground liquid used to produce fuel and chemicals.
A slippery liquid used for cooking, lubrication or other purposes.
To apply oil so that something moves smoothly.

ex.en: The truck carried oil from the well to the refinery.
ex.zh: 卡车把原油从油井运往炼油厂。

ex.en: Reducing dependence on oil requires sustained investment in renewable energy and more efficient public transport.
ex.zh: 减少对石油的依赖，需要持续投资于可再生能源和更高效的公共交通。

col: oil a hinge｜给铰链加润滑油
tip: 通常不可数；表示不同种类的油时可用oils。

senses.en: An edible seed, or the plant that produces it.

ex.en: I added some beans to the vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 我在蔬菜汤里加了些豆子。

ex.en: Beans provide an affordable source of protein and can support a balanced plant-based diet.
ex.zh: 豆类是价格实惠的蛋白质来源，有助于形成均衡的植物性饮食。

tip: 可数名词；泛指食用豆类时通常用beans。

senses.en: to be unsuccessful or not do something required
to not pass a test, or give an unsuccessful grade
to stop working properly or become weaker

ex.en: The cake failed to rise despite an extra egg.
ex.zh: 尽管多加了一个鸡蛋，蛋糕还是没发起来。

ex.en: Recycling programmes often fail when local authorities do not provide clear guidance or convenient collection services.
ex.zh: 地方政府若不提供清晰指导或便捷的收集服务，回收计划往往会失败。

col: fail to do something｜未能做某事
fail to meet expectations｜未达到预期
tip: fail to do表示未能做；fail an exam表示考试不及格。

senses.en: a disc that stores films or data

ex.en: We watched a DVD at home last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我们在家看了一张DVD。

ex.en: This DVD has a special bonus film on it.
ex.zh: 这张DVD里有一部特别附加电影。

tip: DVD 是 digital versatile disc 的缩写，比 CD 容量更大。
scene: A DVD disc and its case lying on a coffee table in a living room.

senses.en: Use your voice to say words or communicate with someone.
Be able to communicate in a particular language.
Address an audience about a subject.

ex.en: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
ex.zh: 下课后我能和你谈谈吗？

ex.en: Students who speak more than one language may find it easier to communicate across cultural boundaries.
ex.zh: 会说多种语言的学生可能更容易进行跨文化交流。

tip: 过去式spoke，过去分词spoken；语言前不用介词。

senses.en: someone who dances, especially as a job

ex.en: The dancer spun gracefully across the small stage.
ex.zh: 那位舞者在小舞台上优雅地旋转。

ex.en: Professional dancers require regular physical training and adequate rest to maintain performance quality and prevent injuries.
ex.zh: 专业舞蹈演员需要定期体能训练和充分休息，以保持表演水平并预防受伤。

tip: dancer不限定性别，也不一定指职业舞者。

senses.en: unable to happen, exist, or be done
extremely difficult to deal with or satisfy

ex.en: It is impossible to fit this sofa through the doorway.
ex.zh: 这张沙发根本无法从门口搬进去。

ex.en: Without reliable public transport, it is almost impossible for some rural residents to access essential services.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，一些农村居民几乎无法获得基本服务。

col: impossible task｜不可能完成的任务
make it impossible to｜使……无法做到
tip: 常用it is impossible to do，表示不可能做某事。

senses.en: bags and cases that hold your belongings when travelling

ex.en: Our luggage barely fitted into the small taxi.
ex.zh: 我们的行李勉强塞进了那辆小出租车。

ex.en: Providing secure luggage storage at railway stations can encourage tourists to explore nearby attractions on foot.
ex.zh: 在火车站提供安全的行李寄存服务，可以鼓励游客步行游览附近景点。

col: a piece of luggage｜一件行李
tip: 不可数；一件行李用a piece of luggage。

senses.en: A thick slice of meat, especially beef, or fish.

ex.en: She served the steak with potatoes and green beans.
ex.zh: 她端上牛排，配了土豆和四季豆。

ex.en: Replacing beef steak with plant proteins occasionally can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.
ex.zh: 偶尔用植物蛋白代替牛排，可以减少个人饮食对环境的影响。

tip: steak与stake同音；单说steak通常指牛排。

senses.en: Neatly arranged, with everything in its proper place.
To put things in order and make a place neat.

ex.en: Her desk stays tidy, even during the busiest weeks.
ex.zh: 即使在最忙的几周里，她的书桌也保持整洁。

ex.en: Keeping shared workplaces tidy can help employees find equipment quickly and create a more pleasant environment.
ex.zh: 保持共用工作场所整洁，有助于员工迅速找到设备，并营造更舒适的环境。

tip: tidy强调摆放整齐；clean强调没有污垢。

senses.en: Sheep's soft hair, or yarn and cloth made from it.

ex.en: This wool scarf keeps my neck warm on windy mornings.
ex.zh: 这条羊毛围巾让我的脖子在刮风的早晨保持温暖。

ex.en: Wool provides natural insulation, making it a useful material for clothing designed for cold climates.
ex.zh: 羊毛具有天然保温性能，因此适合用来制作寒冷气候下穿着的衣物。

col: a ball of wool｜一团毛线
tip: 通常不可数；一团毛线说a ball of wool。

senses.en: to look at written words and understand their meaning
to say written words aloud
to understand information shown by something

ex.en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上睡前都会读几页书。

ex.en: Children who read regularly often develop stronger language skills and a broader understanding of the world.
ex.zh: 经常阅读的儿童通常能培养更强的语言能力，对世界也有更广泛的了解。

tip: 原形读/riːd/；过去式及过去分词读/red/。

senses.en: a small money holder; in American English, a handbag
money available to a person, organisation, or government
to press your lips together into a small rounded shape

ex.en: She opened her purse and took out a coin.
ex.zh: 她打开零钱包，取出一枚硬币。

ex.en: Investment in preventive healthcare could reduce the long-term burden on the public purse.
ex.zh: 投资预防性医疗可以减轻公共财政的长期负担。

tip: 英式purse多指零钱包，美式常指女式手提包。

senses.en: to become aware of something through your senses
a written statement giving information or instructions
information given before something happens or ends

ex.en: Did you notice the tiny bird outside our window?
ex.zh: 你注意到窗外那只小鸟了吗？

ex.en: Residents often notice improvements in air quality when cities restrict traffic in central areas.
ex.zh: 城市限制中心区域的交通时，居民常会察觉空气质量有所改善。

col: at short notice｜在通知很仓促的情况下
tip: notice sb do强调全过程；notice sb doing强调正在发生。

senses.en: Used when something is likely but not certain.

ex.en: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
ex.zh: 我们到那儿之前，面包店很可能就关门了。

ex.en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport will probably experience less traffic congestion over time.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市，交通拥堵很可能会逐渐减轻。

tip: 通常置于实义动词前、be动词后或第一个助动词后。

senses.zh: 电子邮件；电子邮件通信
senses.en: An electronic message, or the system used to send it
Send someone a message using email

ex.en: Please email me the photos from our camping trip.
ex.zh: 请把我们露营旅行的照片通过电子邮件发给我。

ex.en: Although email enables rapid communication, excessive messages can distract employees and reduce productivity at work.
ex.zh: 虽然电子邮件可以实现快速沟通，但过多的邮件会分散员工注意力，降低工作效率。

col: send an email｜发送电子邮件
check your email｜查看电子邮件
an email address｜电子邮箱地址
tip: 指一封邮件时可数；指通信方式时不可数，如by email。

senses.en: a car used by the police

ex.en: A police car drove past with its lights flashing.
ex.zh: 一辆警车闪着灯开了过去。

ex.en: The police car stopped outside the bank.
ex.zh: 警车停在银行外面。

tip: police car 是警车，配有警灯和警报器。
scene: A white and blue police car with flashing lights on a street.

senses.en: Vehicles or systems used to move people and goods.
To move people or goods from one place to another.

ex.en: We rely on public transport to get around town.
ex.zh: 我们在城里出行靠公共交通。

ex.en: Better transport links between rural areas and cities can expand employment opportunities for local residents.
ex.zh: 改善乡村与城市之间的交通联系可以为当地居民增加就业机会。

tip: 上列为名词音标；动词重音后移，英/t/前为/n/。

senses.en: a procedure that checks knowledge, ability, condition, or performance
to check what someone knows or how something performs

ex.en: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天在学校有拼写测验。

ex.en: Researchers must test new materials under different conditions before recommending their use in public buildings.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须在不同条件下测试新材料，才能建议将其用于公共建筑。

tip: 参加测验用take a test；通过测验用pass a test。

senses.zh: 夫人；太太（已婚女性称谓）
senses.en: title used before a married woman's surname

ex.en: Mrs Jones lives next door to us.
ex.zh: 琼斯太太住在我们隔壁。

ex.en: Hello, Mrs Green. How are you today?
ex.zh: 你好，格林太太，你今天好吗？

tip: Mrs 用于已婚女性姓氏前；不确定婚否用 Ms。
scene: A friendly woman in a garden waving to neighbours over a fence.

senses.en: The seventh month of the year, following June

ex.en: We usually visit our cousins for a week in July.
ex.zh: 我们通常在七月去表亲家住一周。

ex.en: In many northern countries, tourism peaks in July, creating seasonal jobs but increasing pressure on local services.
ex.zh: 在许多北方国家，旅游业在七月达到高峰，创造了季节性岗位，却也增加了当地公共服务的压力。

col: by the end of July｜到七月底之前
tip: 月份首字母大写；表示在七月用in July。

senses.en: to fall, let something fall, or become lower
a very small, rounded amount of liquid
to stop doing or considering something

ex.en: I dropped my keys while reaching for my phone.
ex.zh: 我伸手拿手机时，钥匙掉了。

ex.en: If public transport becomes more reliable, the number of people driving to work may drop significantly.
ex.zh: 如果公共交通变得更可靠，开车上班的人数可能会显著下降。

col: a drop in prices｜价格下降
tip: drop by表示下降了多少；drop to表示降至多少。

senses.en: feeling tired and unhappy because nothing is interesting

ex.en: I was bored during the long train journey.
ex.zh: 漫长的火车旅途中我感到很无聊。

ex.en: The children are bored because it's raining.
ex.zh: 因为下雨，孩子们觉得很无聊。

tip: bored 形容人的感受（感到无聊）；boring 形容事物（令人无聊的）。
scene: A yawning boy staring out of a train window on a rainy day.

senses.en: The number representing no quantity.
The point marked as nothing on a measuring scale.

ex.en: The temperature fell below zero while we were sleeping.
ex.zh: 我们睡觉时，气温降到了零度以下。

ex.en: Achieving zero carbon emissions will require substantial investment in renewable energy, public transport, and more efficient buildings.
ex.zh: 实现零碳排放需要对可再生能源、公共交通和能效更高的建筑进行大量投资。

tip: 读电话号码时零也常读作oh；温度用zero。

senses.en: One more time, or on another occasion.

ex.en: Could you say that again a little more slowly?
ex.zh: 你能再说一遍，稍微慢一点吗？

ex.en: If cities fail to address the causes of congestion, the same transport problems will occur again.
ex.zh: 如果城市不解决交通拥堵的成因，同样的交通问题就会再次出现。

tip: again表示重复；again and again强调反复多次。

senses.en: To use, enjoy or take responsibility for something with others.
One part of something divided among people or groups.
One of the equal units of ownership in a company.

ex.en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
ex.zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。

ex.en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
ex.zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。

col: share something with someone｜与某人分享某物
tip: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

senses.en: An electric passenger vehicle running on tracks along city streets.

ex.en: We caught the tram outside the library this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们在图书馆外乘上了有轨电车。

ex.en: Investing in tram networks can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to busy city centres.
ex.zh: 投资建设有轨电车网络可以缓解交通拥堵，让人们更方便地前往繁忙的市中心。

col: catch a tram｜赶上有轨电车
tip: 指车辆，不是轨道；美式英语常用streetcar。

senses.en: used to greet someone or begin a phone conversation
a greeting spoken when meeting someone

ex.en: Hello, would you like to sit next to me?
ex.zh: 你好，你愿意坐在我旁边吗？

ex.en: A simple hello between neighbours can encourage social contact and help newcomers feel welcome in a community.
ex.zh: 邻里之间一句简单的问候就能促进交往，让新来者感受到社区的欢迎。

tip: 电话开头的hello可译为“喂”；say hello to表示向某人问好。

senses.en: A flat paper container used for sending a letter.

ex.en: She slipped the birthday card into a blue envelope.
ex.zh: 她把生日贺卡放进了一个蓝色信封。

ex.en: Although digital communication is widespread, official documents are still sometimes delivered in a sealed envelope for privacy.
ex.zh: 尽管数字通信十分普及，官方文件有时仍会装在密封信封里送达，以保护隐私。

col: a padded envelope｜有衬垫的信封
tip: envelope是“信封”；envelop是“包围”的动词。

senses.en: Long narrow bands differing in colour from the surrounding surface

ex.en: My favourite shirt has blue stripes across the front.
ex.zh: 我最喜欢的衬衫正面有蓝色条纹。

ex.en: Researchers investigate how zebra stripes may discourage biting insects, potentially revealing useful strategies for protecting livestock.
ex.zh: 研究人员探究斑马条纹如何阻止叮咬昆虫，这可能为保护牲畜提供有用策略。

col: black and white stripes｜黑白条纹
tip: stripes是stripe的复数；“条纹的”用striped。

senses.en: Human beings considered together or referred to in general.
A group sharing a culture, history, or national identity.

ex.en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。

ex.en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that people of all ages can travel independently.
ex.zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让各年龄段的人都能独立出行。

col: people from all walks of life｜各行各业的人
tip: 表示人们时用people；peoples指多个民族。

senses.en: To make something happen later than expected or planned.
A period of waiting before something happens or continues.

ex.en: Heavy snow delayed our flight until the next morning.
ex.zh: 大雪使我们的航班延误到第二天早上。

ex.en: Delays in public transport can reduce productivity and discourage people from leaving their cars at home.
ex.zh: 公共交通的延误会降低生产效率，并使人们不愿放弃开车出行。

tip: 动词后接动名词：delay doing，不用to do。

senses.en: A primate that usually has a tail and climbs trees.

ex.en: A little monkey swung between branches above our heads.
ex.zh: 一只小猴子在我们头顶的树枝间荡来荡去。

ex.en: Protecting tropical forests helps preserve monkey populations and the complex ecosystems on which they depend.
ex.zh: 保护热带森林有助于保护猴类种群及其赖以生存的复杂生态系统。

col: a troop of monkeys｜一群猴子
tip: monkey通常有尾巴；ape指猿类，通常无尾。

senses.en: a tropical bird with a curved beak, sometimes copying speech
to repeat someone's words without understanding or considering them

ex.en: The green parrot cracked a seed with its beak.
ex.zh: 那只绿色鹦鹉用喙啄开了一粒种子。

ex.en: Students who merely parrot their teachers' explanations may struggle to apply knowledge to unfamiliar situations.
ex.zh: 只会机械重复教师讲解的学生，可能难以将知识应用于陌生情境。

col: parrot someone's words｜机械重复某人的话
tip: 作动词常带贬义，强调不加理解或思考地重复。

senses.en: to rest with your weight supported by your bottom
to be in a particular place or position
to take an examination

ex.en: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
ex.zh: 过来坐在花园长椅上，坐我旁边。

ex.en: Students who sit for long periods should take regular breaks to support their physical health.
ex.zh: 长时间坐着的学生应定期休息，以维护身体健康。

col: sit beside someone｜坐在某人旁边
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sat；现在分词为sitting。

senses.en: A water sport using a board with an attached sail.

ex.en: My sister tried windsurfing during our holiday by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边度假时，我姐姐尝试了帆板运动。

ex.en: Windsurfing schools can attract visitors to coastal towns, provided that local authorities establish clear water safety guidelines.
ex.zh: 只要地方政府制定明确的水上安全准则，帆板学校就能吸引游客前往沿海城镇。

tip: windsurfing借帆利用风力；surfing主要借海浪滑行。

senses.en: to go from one side to another, or intersect
a shape made by two intersecting lines, or a religious symbol
annoyed or slightly angry

ex.en: We waited for the traffic to stop before crossing.
ex.zh: 我们等车辆停下后才过马路。

ex.en: Safer pedestrian routes encourage residents to cross busy roads on foot rather than drive short distances.
ex.zh: 更安全的步行路线鼓励居民步行穿过繁忙道路，而不是短途开车。

tip: cross是动词；across是介词或副词。

senses.en: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part
a cover fitted over the end or opening of something
to set a maximum amount or level for something

ex.en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
ex.zh: 他戴上帽子后出门去训练。

ex.en: Governments could cap annual rent increases to protect households from sudden rises in housing costs.
ex.zh: 政府可以限制年度租金涨幅，以保护家庭免受住房成本骤增的影响。

col: a cap on fees｜费用上限
tip: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。

senses.en: A particular period or step in a process.
A raised area where performers appear before an audience.
To organise and present a performance or public event.

ex.en: The cake is cooling at this stage of preparation.
ex.zh: 制作进行到这个阶段，蛋糕正在冷却。

ex.en: Early intervention at a critical stage of childhood can significantly improve educational outcomes later in life.
ex.zh: 在童年的关键阶段及早干预，能显著改善日后的教育成果。

col: at an early stage｜在早期阶段
a stage of development｜发展阶段
tip: 表示阶段常用at a stage；表示在舞台上用on stage。

senses.en: A place or object for someone to sit on.
To provide a sitting place or have room for seated people.
A position as a member of an elected body.

ex.en: She saved me a seat near the front.
ex.zh: 她在靠前的位置给我留了一个座位。

ex.en: Providing more seats on public transport would make daily travel easier for older passengers and families.
ex.zh: 在公共交通工具上增加座位，会让老年乘客和家庭的日常出行更方便。

tip: sit是不及物动词；seat常接人，be seated表就座。

senses.en: Someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

ex.en: My colleague brought homemade soup to the office today.
ex.zh: 我的同事今天把自制的汤带到了办公室。

ex.en: Sharing knowledge with colleagues can improve workplace efficiency and help new employees develop essential skills.
ex.zh: 与同事分享知识可以提高工作效率，并帮助新员工培养必要技能。

col: a close colleague｜关系密切的同事
tip: colleague指同事，不一定是朋友或同级员工。

senses.en: A small drinking container, or the amount it holds.
A decorative container awarded for winning a competition.
To curve your hands into a hollow shape to hold something.

ex.en: I warmed my hands around a cup of tea.
ex.zh: 我双手捧着一杯茶取暖。

ex.en: Encouraging customers to bring a reusable cup can help cafés reduce waste from disposable packaging.
ex.zh: 鼓励顾客自带可重复使用的杯子，可以帮助咖啡馆减少一次性包装垃圾。

col: a reusable cup｜可重复使用的杯子
cup your hands｜将双手拢成杯状
tip: a cup of后接饮品；cup作动词可表示用手捧住。

senses.en: a story or events recorded as moving pictures
to record moving pictures using a camera
a thin layer, or material used to record photographs

ex.en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

ex.en: Documentary films can raise public awareness of environmental problems by showing their effects on local communities.
ex.zh: 纪录片可以通过展示环境问题对当地社区的影响，提高公众的环保意识。

col: a thin film of oil｜一层薄薄的油膜
tip: 表示电影时，film偏英式，movie偏美式。

senses.en: A particular standard, amount, or height of something.
Flat and even, or at the same height.
To make a surface flat or things equal.

ex.en: The water level rose after last night's heavy rain.
ex.zh: 昨晚的大雨过后，水位上升了。

ex.en: Improving the level of public transport can encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 提高公共交通服务水平可以鼓励更多居民不开私家车出行。

col: a high level of｜高水平的；大量的
level the playing field｜创造公平竞争环境
tip: at表示所处水平；on the same level可指同一楼层。

senses.en: At a later time, following an event.

ex.en: We watched a film and had dinner afterwards.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部电影，之后吃了晚饭。

ex.en: Students who discuss a lecture afterwards may remember its key ideas more clearly than those who do not.
ex.zh: 课后讨论讲座内容的学生，可能比不讨论的学生更清楚地记住其中的要点。

tip: 是副词，后面不直接接宾语；after可接宾语。

senses.en: the day after Sunday and before Tuesday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh fruit at the market on Monday.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期一去市场买新鲜水果。

ex.en: Many employees find Monday mornings stressful because they must deal with tasks accumulated over the weekend.
ex.zh: 许多员工觉得星期一早上压力很大，因为他们必须处理周末积压的任务。

col: from Monday to Friday｜从星期一到星期五
tip: 星期首字母大写；用on Monday，但next Monday前不加on。

senses.en: Containing nothing or having no people inside.
To remove everything from a container or place.
Lacking real meaning, value, or sincere intention.

ex.en: The biscuit tin was empty when I opened it.
ex.zh: 我打开饼干盒时，里面已经空了。

ex.en: Converting empty office buildings into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
ex.zh: 将空置办公楼改造成可负担住房，可以帮助城市缓解住房短缺，而不必向周边乡村扩张。

tip: empty强调里面没有东西；vacant常指房屋或职位空缺。

senses.en: A shop or hospital department that prepares and supplies medicines.
The study and practice of preparing and supplying medicines.

ex.en: I collected my medicine from the pharmacy after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我去药店取了药。

ex.en: A community pharmacy can improve access to healthcare by offering professional advice close to people's homes.
ex.zh: 社区药店能在居民家附近提供专业建议，使医疗保健服务更易获得。

tip: 药店可数，药剂学不可数；药剂师是pharmacist。

senses.en: In addition to or different from someone or something mentioned
Used after or to introduce an alternative or consequence

ex.en: Would you like anything else with your soup?
ex.zh: 除了汤，你还想要点别的吗？

ex.en: Governments must improve public transport, or else growing traffic congestion may undermine the economic benefits of urban development.
ex.zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则日益严重的交通拥堵可能削弱城市发展带来的经济效益。

tip: 放在不定代词或疑问词后，如someone else。

senses.en: used to add something new to a conversation

ex.en: By the way, do you know the homework for today?
ex.zh: 顺便问一下，你知道今天的作业吗？

ex.en: Oh, by the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
ex.zh: 哦对了，我昨天看到你哥哥了。

tip: by the way 常用于口语，在交谈中引出新话题，可缩写为 BTW。
scene: Two students chatting at school, one suddenly remembering something.

senses.en: To receive money in return for work.
To gain something deserved through your actions or qualities.

ex.en: She earns extra money by walking dogs after school.
ex.zh: 她放学后帮人遛狗，赚些零花钱。

ex.en: Companies can earn public trust by reporting their environmental impact honestly and taking responsibility for their mistakes.
ex.zh: 企业可以通过如实报告环境影响并为自身错误负责来赢得公众信任。

tip: earn强调劳动或表现所得；win多指比赛获胜。

senses.en: An exciting experience involving uncertainty or possible danger
Willingness to explore unfamiliar or exciting situations

ex.en: Our camping trip turned into an adventure after dark.
ex.zh: 天黑后，我们的露营之旅变成了一次冒险。

ex.en: Outdoor adventure activities can help young people develop confidence and learn to cooperate with others.
ex.zh: 户外探险活动能帮助年轻人建立自信，并学会与他人合作。

col: a sense of adventure｜冒险精神
tip: adventure指具体经历时可数，指冒险精神时不可数。

senses.en: a strip worn around the waist to hold clothes
a long area with a particular feature
a continuous strip that moves machinery or carries objects

ex.en: This belt keeps my trousers from slipping down.
ex.zh: 这条腰带能防止我的裤子往下滑。

ex.en: A green belt around a city can limit urban expansion and protect nearby farmland from development.
ex.zh: 城市周边的绿化带可以限制城市扩张，保护附近农田免遭开发。

tip: belt除腰带外也指带状区域，如green belt。

senses.en: to write information in a form

ex.en: Please fill in this form with your name.
ex.zh: 请在这张表格上填上你的名字。

ex.en: She filled in the answers in pen.
ex.zh: 她用钢笔填写了答案。

tip: fill in 用于“填表”；fill out 也是美式常见说法。
scene: A hand writing on an application form at a desk.

senses.en: Inside a place, container, or larger area.
During a period or after a stated amount of time.
Inside a place, moving inside, or at home.

ex.en: Your keys are in the bowl beside the door.
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在门边的碗里。

ex.en: Investment in public libraries can help reduce educational inequality and strengthen connections within local communities.
ex.zh: 对公共图书馆的投资有助于减少教育不平等，并加强当地社区内部的联系。

col: in public｜公开地；在公共场合
tip: in two days常指两天后；月份、年份前也用in。

senses.en: the highest part or surface of something
highest in position, rank, or quality
to rank highest or be greater than something

ex.en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
ex.zh: 她把那颗星星放在树顶上。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable housing should be a top priority for governments facing rapid urban population growth.
ex.zh: 对于面临城市人口快速增长的政府来说，改善居民获得可负担住房的机会应是首要任务。

tip: on top of指在上面；at the top of指在顶端。

senses.en: a small box or bag for pens and pencils

ex.en: My pencil case has two pens and three pencils.
ex.zh: 我的文具盒里有两支钢笔和三支铅笔。

ex.en: Don't forget your pencil case for the exam.
ex.zh: 考试别忘了带文具盒。

tip: pencil case 是装笔的文具盒/袋。
scene: An open pencil case with pens, pencils and an eraser on a desk.

senses.en: Almost the same, but not exactly alike.

ex.en: Your jacket looks similar to mine, but slightly darker.
ex.zh: 你的夹克看起来和我的相似，不过颜色稍深一点。

ex.en: Cities with similar population sizes may require different transport policies because of their geographical features.
ex.zh: 人口规模相近的城市可能因地理特征不同而需要不同的交通政策。

tip: 用similar to，不用similar with；相似不等于相同。

senses.en: Complete, with no part missing or left out.
A complete thing made up of connected parts.

ex.en: We spent the whole afternoon baking bread together.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在一起烤面包。

ex.en: Transport policies should consider the needs of the whole community rather than focusing only on car owners.
ex.zh: 交通政策应考虑整个社区的需求，而不应只关注汽车拥有者。

col: a whole range of｜各种各样的
tip: 注意语序：the whole day＝all the day。

senses.en: Having a colour made by mixing red and blue
A colour between red and blue

ex.en: He wore a purple scarf with his grey coat.
ex.zh: 他穿着灰色外套，围了一条紫色围巾。

ex.en: Garden designers often combine purple flowers with yellow varieties to create a striking visual contrast.
ex.zh: 花园设计师常将紫色花卉与黄色品种搭配，形成鲜明的视觉反差。

tip: purple可作形容词或名词；purplish表示“略带紫色的”。

senses.en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds.
To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.

ex.en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。

ex.en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
ex.zh: 选择可重复使用的瓶子而非一次性塑料容器，有助于减少城市垃圾。

col: reusable bottle｜可重复使用的瓶子
tip: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。

senses.en: a small pepper with a strong, hot taste
a spicy dish usually made with meat, beans, and tomatoes

ex.en: Add one chopped chilli if you like spicy food.
ex.zh: 如果你喜欢吃辣，就加一根切碎的辣椒。

ex.en: Farmers growing chilli peppers may need reliable irrigation systems as rising temperatures increase water demand.
ex.zh: 随着气温上升导致需水量增加，辣椒种植户可能需要可靠的灌溉系统。

tip: 英式拼写chilli，美式通常写chili。

senses.en: A folded cover used to hold loose papers.
A place on a computer where files are grouped together.

ex.en: Keep your receipts in this folder beside the desk.
ex.zh: 把收据放在桌子旁的这个文件夹里。

ex.en: Organising digital resources into clearly named folders can help students locate information efficiently during research projects.
ex.zh: 将数字资源整理到命名清晰的文件夹中，可以帮助学生在研究项目中高效查找信息。

col: save files in a folder｜将文件存入文件夹
tip: file是文件；folder是存放文件的文件夹。

senses.en: The sixth month of the year, between May and July.

ex.en: My sister is getting married in June this year.
ex.zh: 我姐姐今年六月要结婚了。

ex.en: The community centre will open in June, providing local residents with affordable exercise classes.
ex.zh: 社区中心将于六月开放，为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身课程。

col: by the end of June｜到六月底为止
tip: 月份首字母大写；在六月用in June。

senses.en: to take something without permission and keep or use it
to move quietly without attracting attention
something bought for much less than its usual price

ex.en: Someone stole my bicycle while I was buying bread.
ex.zh: 我买面包的时候，有人偷走了我的自行车。

ex.en: Companies must protect customer information because criminals may steal personal data from insecure websites.
ex.zh: 企业必须保护客户信息，因为犯罪分子可能从不安全的网站窃取个人数据。

col: steal from someone｜偷某人的东西
tip: 过去式stole，过去分词stolen；宾语通常是物。

senses.en: a page of information on the internet

ex.en: This web page has pictures of animals.
ex.zh: 这个网页有动物的图片。

ex.en: She found the information on a school web page.
ex.zh: 她在一个学校网页上找到了信息。

tip: web page 是网页；website 是网站（由多个网页组成）。
scene: A laptop screen showing a colourful web page about animals.

senses.en: Relating to the present or relatively recent times.
Using the latest ideas, methods, or styles.

ex.en: Our flat has a modern kitchen with large windows.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓有一间新式厨房，窗户很大。

ex.en: Modern technology allows students in remote areas to access educational resources previously available only in cities.
ex.zh: 现代技术让偏远地区的学生能够获取过去只有城市才有的教育资源。

tip: modern强调现代或新式；不一定表示刚刚制造。

senses.en: Move around a centre or change direction.
Change to a different state, colour, or condition.
An opportunity to do something in an agreed order.

ex.en: Turn the handle gently and pull the door towards you.
ex.zh: 轻轻转动把手，然后朝自己这边拉门。

ex.en: As populations age, governments must turn their attention to accessible housing and community healthcare.
ex.zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府必须将注意力转向无障碍住房和社区医疗。

tip: 表示变得时，turn后接形容词；turn into后接名词。

senses.en: a part of something or a single item
a work of writing, music, or art
to join separate parts to make something complete

ex.en: She saved the last piece of cake for her brother.
ex.zh: 她把最后一块蛋糕留给了弟弟。

ex.en: Each piece of evidence should be carefully assessed before researchers draw conclusions about environmental change.
ex.zh: 研究人员在对环境变化作出结论前，应仔细评估每一项证据。

col: a piece of advice｜一条建议
a piece of equipment｜一件设备
a piece of music｜一首乐曲
tip: a piece of可量化advice等不可数名词。

senses.en: a belief or judgement about someone or something

ex.en: What is your opinion of our new kitchen?
ex.zh: 你觉得我们的新厨房怎么样？

ex.en: In my opinion, public transport should be affordable enough to encourage people to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 在我看来，公共交通的价格应足够实惠，从而鼓励人们不开私家车出门。

col: a difference of opinion｜意见分歧
tip: 表达“在我看来”用in my opinion，不用according to me。

senses.en: having a pale red colour
a colour made by mixing red with white

ex.en: The tree outside our window has pink flowers.
ex.zh: 我们窗外的树开着粉红色的花。

ex.en: Designers often use soft colours such as pink to create a welcoming atmosphere in children's healthcare facilities.
ex.zh: 设计师常用粉红色等柔和色彩，为儿童医疗机构营造温馨的氛围。

tip: pink既可作形容词，也可作名词表示粉红色。

senses.en: A period of teaching or learning a particular subject.
Something useful learned from an experience, especially a mistake.

ex.en: Our swimming lesson starts after school on Thursday.
ex.zh: 我们的游泳课在周四放学后开始。

ex.en: A key lesson from previous environmental policies is that effective regulation requires consistent monitoring and public support.
ex.zh: 以往环境政策带来的一条重要经验是，有效监管需要持续监测和公众支持。

tip: learn a lesson常指吸取教训，不只是学习课程。

senses.en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity
A set of parts used to build something

ex.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
ex.zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。

ex.en: Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
ex.zh: 学校应提供基础科学实验套件，让所有学生都能参与动手实验。

col: kit someone out｜给某人配齐装备
tip: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

senses.en: belonging to a male person

ex.en: This is his bicycle.
ex.zh: 这是他的自行车。

ex.en: He left his jacket at school.
ex.zh: 他把夹克落在学校了。

tip: his 既是形容词性物主代词（his bike），也是名词性物主代词（it's his）。
scene: A boy getting on his bicycle parked against a wall.

senses.en: an area of land where flowers or vegetables are grown
to grow and care for plants in a garden

ex.en: We picked fresh beans from the garden before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前，我们从菜园里摘了新鲜的豆角。

ex.en: Community gardens can strengthen neighbourhood relationships while giving urban residents access to fresh vegetables and green space.
ex.zh: 社区花园既能加强邻里关系，又能让城市居民获得新鲜蔬菜和绿色空间。

tip: 英式garden可指住宅庭院；美式常用yard。

senses.en: the person speaking, when someone does something to them

ex.en: Can you help me with my bag?
ex.zh: 你能帮我拿一下包吗？

ex.en: The teacher gave me a book.
ex.zh: 老师给了我一本书。

tip: me 是 I 的宾格，作动词/介词的宾语。
scene: A friend helping another carry a heavy school bag.

senses.en: the study of Earth's places, environments, and human activity
the physical features and arrangement of a particular area

ex.en: In geography today, we learned how rivers shape valleys.
ex.zh: 今天的地理课上，我们学习了河流如何塑造河谷。

ex.en: The geography of coastal regions influences settlement patterns and determines how communities respond to rising sea levels.
ex.zh: 沿海地区的地理特征影响聚居格局，并决定当地社区如何应对海平面上升。

tip: geography是地理学；geology是地质学。

senses.en: feeling happy or satisfied about something

ex.en: I'm really pleased with how the cake turned out.
ex.zh: 我对这个蛋糕做出来的效果非常满意。

ex.en: Residents were pleased that the council had created more green spaces for children to play safely.
ex.zh: 居民们很高兴，市政部门增设了更多绿地，让孩子们可以安全地玩耍。

col: pleased to meet you｜很高兴认识你
tip: 对结果满意用pleased with；听到喜讯用pleased to hear。

senses.en: a white substance used to flavour or preserve food
to add salt to food or preserve it with salt

ex.en: Please pass the salt before the soup gets cold.
ex.zh: 趁汤还没凉，请把盐递过来。

ex.en: Reducing salt intake is an effective way to lower the risk of high blood pressure.
ex.zh: 减少盐的摄入量是降低高血压风险的有效方法。

col: a pinch of salt｜一小撮盐
tip: 食盐通常不可数；“一小撮盐”用a pinch of salt。

senses.en: More than two but not many
A few people or things already mentioned or understood

ex.en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
ex.zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。

ex.en: Several studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
ex.zh: 几项研究表明，能够接触绿地可能改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: several of them｜他们中的几个
for several reasons｜出于几个原因
tip: 后接可数名词复数；several of后接限定词或代词。

senses.en: Up to a particular time or event.
Up to the time when something happens.

ex.en: We waited outside until the rain finally stopped.
ex.zh: 我们在外面一直等到雨终于停了。

ex.en: Governments should continue supporting renewable energy until cleaner technologies become affordable for the majority of households.
ex.zh: 政府应持续支持可再生能源，直到大多数家庭都能负担得起更清洁的技术。

col: until further notice｜直至另行通知
tip: until强调持续到某时；by强调不迟于某时。

senses.en: Every individual member of a group, considered separately.
Every person or thing in a group, taken separately.
For every individual person or thing.

ex.en: Each child carried a small basket into the garden.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都提着一个小篮子走进花园。

ex.en: Each household can reduce its environmental impact by conserving water and choosing products with less packaging.
ex.zh: 每个家庭都可以通过节约用水和选择包装较少的产品来减少对环境的影响。

tip: each后接单数名词；each of后接复数名词或代词。

senses.en: A person or organisation that buys goods or services.

ex.en: The customer asked for a larger pair of shoes.
ex.zh: 这位顾客想要一双大一点的鞋。

ex.en: Businesses can build customer loyalty by providing reliable products and responding quickly to complaints.
ex.zh: 企业可以通过提供可靠的产品并迅速回应投诉来培养客户忠诚度。

tip: customer泛指顾客；client常指专业服务的客户。

senses.en: To gather things together or keep objects as a hobby
To go somewhere and bring someone or something away
To receive or gather money from people

ex.en: I collect smooth stones whenever we visit the beach.
ex.zh: 每次去海边，我都会收集光滑的石头。

ex.en: Researchers collect data from local households to assess how transport policies affect daily travel habits.
ex.zh: 研究人员收集当地家庭的数据，以评估交通政策如何影响日常出行习惯。

tip: 英式英语collect someone可指去接某人。

senses.en: a clock that makes a noise to wake you up

ex.en: My alarm clock rings at seven every morning.
ex.zh: 我的闹钟每天早上七点响。

ex.en: He set the alarm clock for six o'clock.
ex.zh: 他把闹钟定在六点。

tip: set the alarm clock 表示“定闹钟”，wake up 表示“醒来”。
scene: A ringing alarm clock on a bedside table in a bright bedroom at dawn.

senses.en: A small amphibian with long back legs for jumping.

ex.en: A green frog jumped from the stone into our pond.
ex.zh: 一只绿色的青蛙从石头上跳进了我们的池塘。

ex.en: Declining frog populations can indicate environmental damage because these animals are sensitive to changes in water quality.
ex.zh: 青蛙数量下降可能表明环境遭到破坏，因为它们对水质变化十分敏感。

tip: 可数名词，复数为frogs；toad指蟾蜍。

senses.en: a subject that people discuss, write about, or study

ex.en: Food is always a popular topic in our house.
ex.zh: 食物在我们家一直是个热门话题。

ex.en: Climate change has become a central topic in school discussions about the future of our planet.
ex.zh: 气候变化已成为学校讨论地球未来时的核心话题。

col: a topic of discussion｜讨论的话题
a controversial topic｜有争议的话题
tip: topic指讨论或写作的主题；title指文章等的标题。

senses.en: very unpleasant or bad
causing strong fear or shock

ex.en: A horrible smell came from the forgotten lunch box.
ex.zh: 那个被遗忘的午餐盒散发出难闻的气味。

ex.en: Residents described the horrible conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter enforcement of safety standards.
ex.zh: 居民描述了拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁更严格地执行安全标准。

tip: horrible常指很糟糕；horrific多指骇人、惨烈。

senses.en: added to the usual or necessary amount
more than usual, or in addition to the normal amount
an additional item, or a background actor in a film

ex.en: I packed an extra sweater because the evenings get cold.
ex.zh: 我多带了一件毛衣，因为晚上会冷。

ex.en: Schools should provide extra support for students who struggle to access learning materials at home.
ex.zh: 学校应为在家难以获取学习资料的学生提供额外支持。

tip: 形容词指额外的；pay extra中作副词。

senses.en: Washing your body while sitting or lying in water.
A large container that you fill with water for washing yourself.

ex.en: A warm bath helped me relax after the hike.
ex.zh: 徒步之后，泡个温水澡让我放松了下来。

ex.en: Taking shorter showers instead of a daily bath can reduce household water consumption significantly.
ex.zh: 用较短时间的淋浴代替每天泡澡，可以显著减少家庭用水量。

tip: 英式常说have a bath；美式常说take a bath。

senses.en: feeling unhappy

ex.en: She felt sad when her friend moved away.
ex.zh: 朋友搬走时她很难过。

ex.en: The sad film made everyone cry.
ex.zh: 这部悲伤的电影让大家都哭了。

tip: sad 形容悲伤；名词 sadness 悲伤，副词 sadly 悲伤地。
scene: A girl sitting alone on a bench looking down with a sad face.

senses.en: Opposing someone or something, or competing with them.
Touching or supported by a surface.
For protection from something harmful or unwanted.

ex.en: Our team is playing against the neighbours this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午我们队要和邻居们比赛。

ex.en: Some residents are against airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to nearby habitats.
ex.zh: 一些居民反对机场扩建，因为他们担心噪声增加以及附近栖息地遭到破坏。

tip: against是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。

senses.en: A very short period of time.
A particular point in time, sometimes especially important.

ex.en: Wait a moment while I put my shoes on.
ex.zh: 等一会儿，我穿上鞋就好。

ex.en: The opening of the new railway marked a significant moment in the region's economic development.
ex.zh: 新铁路的开通标志着该地区经济发展中的一个重要时刻。

col: in a moment｜马上；一会儿后
a turning point moment｜转折时刻
tip: at the moment指现在；in a moment指马上。

senses.en: The activity or habit of breathing in smoke from tobacco.

ex.en: My uncle gave up smoking and now enjoys long walks.
ex.zh: 我叔叔戒了烟，现在很喜欢长距离散步。

ex.en: Banning smoking in public buildings can protect workers and visitors from the harmful effects of tobacco smoke.
ex.zh: 禁止在公共建筑内吸烟可以保护工作人员和访客免受烟草烟雾的危害。

tip: 表示吸烟活动时不可数；戒烟可用give up smoking。

senses.en: An informal word for a man.

ex.en: The guy next door helped carry my groceries.
ex.zh: 隔壁那位小伙子帮我提了买回来的东西。

ex.en: Calling a colleague a guy may sound friendly, but informal vocabulary is usually inappropriate in academic writing.
ex.zh: 称同事为guy可能显得亲切，但非正式词汇通常不适合学术写作。

tip: guy属口语；正式写作通常用man或person。

senses.en: To desire something or wish for something to happen.
A lack of something needed, especially basic necessities.

ex.en: I want to grow tomatoes on our balcony.
ex.zh: 我想在我们的阳台上种番茄。

ex.en: Many young adults want governments to invest more in affordable housing rather than expensive urban redevelopment projects.
ex.zh: 许多年轻人希望政府更多投资于可负担住房，而不是昂贵的城市重建项目。

col: want to do something｜想做某事
want someone to do something｜想让某人做某事
tip: 用want to do或want sb to do，不用want doing表想做。

senses.en: A case with a handle for carrying clothes when travelling.

ex.en: Her suitcase was too heavy to lift onto the train.
ex.zh: 她的行李箱太重，搬不上火车。

ex.en: Travellers can reduce transport emissions by packing a lighter suitcase and choosing public transport whenever possible.
ex.zh: 旅客可以通过减轻行李箱的重量，并尽量选择公共交通来减少交通排放。

col: unpack a suitcase｜打开行李箱取出物品
tip: suitcase可数；统称行李的luggage不可数。

senses.en: A large printed picture or announcement displayed on a surface

ex.en: She hung a colourful poster above her desk.
ex.zh: 她在书桌上方挂了一张色彩鲜艳的海报。

ex.en: A well-designed poster can encourage people to recycle by presenting environmental messages clearly and attractively.
ex.zh: 设计精良的海报可以清晰而有吸引力地传达环保信息，鼓励人们回收利用。

col: put up a poster｜张贴海报
tip: poster 是海报；postcard 是明信片，注意区分。

senses.en: used in questions about people

ex.en: Who is that girl over there?
ex.zh: 那边那个女孩是谁？

ex.en: Who helped you with the homework?
ex.zh: 谁帮你做作业了？

tip: who 用于询问人；Whose 是询问“谁的”。
scene: A child pointing at a girl across the playground and asking who she is.

senses.en: Something given freely to another person
A natural ability to do something well
To give something to someone as a present

ex.en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
ex.zh: 姐姐用鲜黄色的纸把礼物包了起来。

ex.en: Schools should nurture each child's gift rather than judge everyone by the same narrow standards.
ex.zh: 学校应培养每个孩子的天赋，而不是用同一套狭隘的标准评判所有人。

col: a gift for languages｜语言天赋
tip: 表示天赋时常用 a gift for，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: To have an opinion or belief about something.
To use your mind to consider ideas or solve problems.

ex.en: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
ex.zh: 我觉得这汤需要再加一点盐。

ex.en: Some people think that schools should devote more time to practical skills rather than examination preparation.
ex.zh: 一些人认为，学校应将更多时间用于实用技能，而不是备考。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为thought；认为时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: one more, or a different one
one more person or thing, or a different one

ex.en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
ex.zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。

ex.en: Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通的另一个理由是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

tip: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。

senses.en: A shirt traditionally worn by women, often made from light fabric

ex.en: She wore a blue blouse with her favourite grey trousers.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件蓝色女式衬衫，搭配最喜欢的灰色长裤。

ex.en: Choosing a durable blouse rather than a cheaply made alternative may reduce clothing waste over time.
ex.zh: 选择耐穿的女式衬衫而非制作廉价的替代品，长期来看可能减少衣物浪费。

tip: 通常指女式衬衫；shirt的适用范围更广。

senses.en: a member of the police force

ex.en: The police officer helped the lost child.
ex.zh: 警察帮助了迷路的孩子。

ex.en: Ask a police officer if you need directions.
ex.zh: 需要问路可以找警察。

tip: police officer 是不分性别的说法；policeman 是男警。
scene: A police officer in uniform helping a lost child on a street.

senses.en: a structure with walls and a roof
the activity of constructing houses or other structures

ex.en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
ex.zh: 我们住的公寓楼屋顶上有一个花园。

ex.en: Improving insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and lower heating costs for residents.
ex.zh: 改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，降低居民的取暖费用。

tip: 指建筑物时可数，指建造活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: Used when something is possible but not certain.
Used to make a suggestion or request sound less direct.

ex.en: Perhaps we should take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 也许我们该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Perhaps governments could encourage healthier diets by making fresh produce more affordable for low-income households.
ex.zh: 政府或许可以让低收入家庭更买得起新鲜农产品，以鼓励更健康的饮食。

col: perhaps the best｜或许是最好的
perhaps we could｜或许我们可以
tip: perhaps比maybe略正式，可放句首使建议更委婉。

senses.en: very close to something, beside it

ex.en: The bank is next to the supermarket.
ex.zh: 银行紧挨着超市。

ex.en: She sat next to me in the cinema.
ex.zh: 她在电影院里坐在我旁边。

tip: next to 表示“紧挨着”；near 是“附近”，距离更远。
scene: A bank building standing right beside a supermarket.

senses.en: To give food or drink, or assist customers.
To work for people, an organisation, or your country.
To be used for a particular purpose.

ex.en: This little café serves fresh soup with warm bread.
ex.zh: 这家小咖啡馆供应新鲜的汤和温热的面包。

ex.en: Public libraries serve as community spaces where residents can access information, attend workshops, and meet other learners.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆是社区活动空间，居民可以在那里获取信息、参加工作坊并结识其他学习者。

tip: serve as后接角色或用途；serve for不这样用。

senses.en: having plenty of bright sunlight
cheerful and positive in character or mood

ex.en: We ate breakfast on the sunny balcony this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我们在阳光充足的阳台上吃了早餐。

ex.en: Regions with sunny climates can generate substantial amounts of electricity through well-planned solar energy projects.
ex.zh: 阳光充足的地区可以通过规划合理的太阳能项目产生大量电力。

tip: sunny强调阳光足，不一定表示气温高。

senses.en: To move through water using your body.
An occasion when you move through water for exercise or pleasure.

ex.en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。

ex.en: Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子游泳，因为这项基本技能既能增强体能，又能提高水上安全性。

tip: 不规则变化：swim—swam—swum。

senses.en: someone living nearby, or something located next to another

ex.en: Our neighbour watered the plants while we were away.
ex.zh: 我们不在家时，邻居帮忙给植物浇了水。

ex.en: Shared gardens can strengthen relationships between neighbours and create a greater sense of belonging in urban communities.
ex.zh: 共享花园可以增进邻里关系，增强城市社区居民的归属感。

tip: 英式拼写neighbour，美式拼写neighbor。

senses.en: Study of the natural world through observation and experiments
A particular field of study using scientific methods

ex.en: We grew tiny crystals in our science class today.
ex.zh: 今天的科学课上，我们培育了微小的晶体。

ex.en: Investment in science can help countries develop cleaner energy sources and improve public health.
ex.zh: 科学投入能帮助各国开发更清洁的能源，并改善公共健康。

tip: 泛指科学通常不可数；指具体学科可用a science。

senses.en: to press a mouse button or select something on screen
a short sharp sound, or an action selecting something onscreen
to suddenly become clear or understood

ex.en: Click on the picture to see a larger version.
ex.zh: 点击图片即可查看大图。

ex.en: Students should check whether a website is trustworthy before they click on links or share personal information.
ex.zh: 学生在点击链接或分享个人信息前，应检查网站是否可信。

col: click on a link｜点击链接
a mouse click｜一次鼠标点击
a sharp click｜清脆的咔嗒声
tip: 点击链接常用click on；it clicked可指突然想通了。

senses.en: Soft white frozen flakes falling from clouds or covering the ground.
For snow to fall from the sky.

ex.en: Fresh snow covered the garden when we woke up.
ex.zh: 我们醒来时，新下的雪覆盖了花园。

ex.en: Heavy snow can disrupt public transport and prevent rural communities from accessing essential services.
ex.zh: 大雪可能扰乱公共交通，使农村社区无法获得基本服务。

tip: snow作名词通常不可数；下雪用it snows。

senses.en: to fail to remember a fact, person, or experience
to fail to do or bring something through not remembering

ex.en: I always forget where I put my reading glasses.
ex.zh: 我总是忘记把老花镜放在哪里了。

ex.en: Students may quickly forget new vocabulary unless they review it regularly and use it in meaningful contexts.
ex.zh: 如果学生不定期复习新词，并在有意义的语境中运用，就可能很快忘记。

col: forget to do something｜忘记做某事
tip: forget to do忘记去做；forget doing忘记做过。

senses.en: At a low speed or over a long time.

ex.en: She slowly poured the hot soup into bowls.
ex.zh: 她慢慢地把热汤倒进碗里。

ex.en: Although public attitudes are changing slowly, more consumers are choosing products with less plastic packaging.
ex.zh: 尽管公众观念改变得较慢，但越来越多的消费者正在选择塑料包装更少的产品。

col: slowly but surely｜缓慢而稳步地
tip: slowly是副词，修饰动作；slow通常作形容词。

senses.en: to learn or discover something

ex.en: I called the cinema to find out the film times.
ex.zh: 我打电话给电影院查放映时间。

ex.en: She found out the answer in the book.
ex.zh: 她在书里找到了答案。

tip: find out 强调“经过打听/查询后得知”；find 更强调“找到”。
scene: A girl on the phone checking film times with a notepad.

senses.en: a set of rooms forming a home within a building
level and smooth, without raised or curved parts
having too little air inside, especially a tyre

ex.en: We rent a small flat above a busy bakery.
ex.zh: 我们在一家生意兴隆的面包店楼上租了一套小公寓。

ex.en: Building affordable flats near public transport could reduce commuting costs for many urban workers.
ex.zh: 在公共交通设施附近建造价格合理的公寓，可以降低许多城市工作者的通勤成本。

tip: “公寓”英式常用 flat，美式常用 apartment。

senses.en: the smallest amount of something
to the smallest degree or extent
the smallest amount or degree

ex.en: This soup needs the least salt of all.
ex.zh: 这些汤里，这道汤需要的盐最少。

ex.en: Public transport often causes the least pollution per passenger when compared with private car travel.
ex.zh: 与私家车出行相比，公共交通的人均污染通常最少。

tip: least是little的最高级；修饰可数名词用fewest。

senses.en: relating to a whole country or its people
a person who is a citizen of a particular country

ex.en: My sister hopes to join the national swimming team.
ex.zh: 我姐姐希望加入国家游泳队。

ex.en: National policies can help reduce regional differences in access to healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 国家政策有助于缩小医疗和教育机会方面的地区差异。

tip: national侧重一国整体；international指国际的。

senses.en: Two lenses in a frame worn to improve sight.
Containers made of glass, usually used for drinking.

ex.en: I left my glasses beside the bed last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚把眼镜落在床边了。

ex.en: Regular eye examinations help students obtain suitable glasses, allowing them to read comfortably and participate fully in lessons.
ex.zh: 定期眼部检查有助于学生配到合适的眼镜，让他们舒适阅读并充分参与课堂。

col: a pair of glasses｜一副眼镜
tip: 指眼镜时用复数；一副眼镜用a pair of glasses。

senses.en: Different from usual, often in an important or valued way.
Intended for a particular purpose or person.
A specially priced product or a featured restaurant dish.

ex.en: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
ex.zh: 我们把这个特别的蛋糕留到了你生日时享用。

ex.en: Schools should provide special equipment so that students with disabilities can participate fully in classroom activities.
ex.zh: 学校应提供专用设备，让残障学生能够充分参与课堂活动。

tip: specially强调专门；especially常表示尤其。

senses.en: to stop working (about a machine or car)

ex.en: Our car broke down on the way to the beach.
ex.zh: 我们的车在去海滩的路上抛锚了。

ex.en: The washing machine has broken down again.
ex.zh: 洗衣机又坏了。

tip: break down 指机器、汽车等“出故障”；人崩溃也说 break down。
scene: A car stopped on a country road with steam coming from the engine.

senses.en: a printed piece of paper you sign to pay money

ex.en: He paid the rent by cheque.
ex.zh: 他用支票付房租。

ex.en: Can I write you a cheque for the ticket?
ex.zh: 我能给你开张支票付票钱吗？

tip: cheque 是英式拼写，美式拼写是 check。
scene: A person writing on a cheque at a desk with a pen.

senses.en: An insect with broad, often colourful wings and a thin body.
A swimming stroke with both arms moving forward together above water.

ex.en: A yellow butterfly landed gently on my sleeve.
ex.zh: 一只黄色蝴蝶轻轻落在我的袖子上。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban gardens can support butterfly populations and contribute to greater local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市花园中种植本地花卉可以帮助维持蝴蝶种群，并提升当地的生物多样性。

tip: 复数为butterflies；蝶泳义通常不可数。

senses.en: the inside surface at the top of a room
the highest amount or level that is allowed

ex.en: A small spider was crawling across the ceiling.
ex.zh: 一只小蜘蛛正爬过天花板。

ex.en: A ceiling on annual rent increases could protect tenants, although it might discourage investment in housing.
ex.zh: 限制年度租金涨幅可以保护租户，但也可能抑制住房投资。

col: set a ceiling on｜为……设定上限
tip: ceiling是室内天花板；roof是建筑外部的屋顶。

senses.en: a living thing that usually grows in soil and has leaves
to put seeds or young plants into soil to grow
a factory or facility where industrial processes take place

ex.en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
ex.zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。

ex.en: Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。

tip: plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。

senses.en: The flesh of animals eaten as food.

ex.en: We keep raw meat separate from vegetables in the fridge.
ex.zh: 我们把生肉和蔬菜分开放在冰箱里。

ex.en: Reducing meat consumption may lower the environmental impact of food production in many countries.
ex.zh: 在许多国家，减少肉类消费可能降低食品生产对环境的影响。

tip: 泛指食用肉时不可数；meats指不同种类的肉。

senses.en: the body part connecting the head to the shoulders
a narrow part of an object, such as a bottle

ex.en: He wrapped a warm scarf around his neck.
ex.zh: 他在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。

ex.en: Office workers may experience neck pain if their computer screens are positioned at an unsuitable height.
ex.zh: 如果电脑屏幕的高度不合适，办公室职员可能会感到颈部疼痛。

col: the neck of a bottle｜瓶颈
tip: neck指脖子；throat指喉咙，勿混用。

senses.en: The activity of moving through water using your body.

ex.en: We go swimming at the indoor pool every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们每周六都去室内泳池游泳。

ex.en: Regular swimming can improve physical fitness while placing relatively little stress on the joints.
ex.zh: 经常游泳可以增强体质，同时对关节造成的压力相对较小。

tip: 表示运动时不可数；去游泳用go swimming。

senses.en: a game played with pieces on a board

ex.en: We played a board game together last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我们一起玩了一个桌游。

ex.en: This board game is easy to learn.
ex.zh: 这个桌游很容易学会。

tip: 常见的 board game 有 chess（国际象棋）和 Monopoly 这类游戏。
scene: A family playing a colourful board game around a living room table.

senses.en: to transfer files from a device to an online system
the transfer of a file online, or the file itself

ex.en: I uploaded our picnic photos to a shared folder.
ex.zh: 我把我们野餐的照片上传到了共享文件夹。

ex.en: Students can upload their assignments to a secure platform, allowing teachers to provide timely feedback.
ex.zh: 学生可以将作业上传至安全平台，方便教师及时提供反馈。

col: upload to a server｜上传至服务器
tip: 上传用upload，下载用download；上传至某处用to。

senses.en: A low plant with narrow green leaves covering the ground.

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边的草地上铺了一条毯子。

ex.en: Replacing natural grass with artificial surfaces can reduce habitats for insects and increase local temperatures.
ex.zh: 用人造地面取代天然草地可能减少昆虫的栖息地，并使当地气温升高。

col: a blade of grass｜一片草叶
tip: 通常不可数；一片草叶用a blade of grass。

senses.en: used before a noun when it is clear which one

ex.en: The sun is shining today.
ex.zh: 今天阳光明媚。

ex.en: Close the door, please.
ex.zh: 请关上门。

tip: the 用在特指的名词前；元音音素前读 /ðiː/。
scene: A bright sun shining over a house with an open door.

senses.en: Help someone learn knowledge, skills, or ways of behaving

ex.en: My aunt taught me how to mend a shirt.
ex.zh: 姑姑教会了我如何缝补衬衫。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to evaluate online information rather than simply memorise facts.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子如何评估网上的信息，而非只是死记事实。

col: teach a subject｜教授一门学科
teach someone to swim｜教某人游泳
teach a lesson｜授课；给以教训
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为taught；教某人做用teach sb to do。

senses.en: Hold or support something while moving it somewhere
Have something with you wherever you go
Contain and potentially pass on a disease or infection

ex.en: Could you carry this heavy bag upstairs for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这个沉重的袋子拿上楼吗？

ex.en: Reusable bottles allow commuters to carry drinking water without purchasing disposable plastic containers every day.
ex.zh: 可重复使用的水瓶让通勤者能随身带水，无须每天购买一次性塑料容器。

tip: carry强调携带或搬运；bring和take还体现方向。

senses.en: A device that produces light, often on a table.

ex.en: She switched on the lamp beside her bed.
ex.zh: 她打开了床边的灯。

ex.en: Using an adjustable desk lamp can improve comfort for students who study in poorly lit rooms.
ex.zh: 对于在光线不足的房间里学习的学生，使用可调节台灯可以提高舒适度。

tip: lamp指灯具；light也可指光或光线。

senses.en: Thin strands growing on the skin of people and animals.
A single strand growing from skin.

ex.en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
ex.zh: 她做午饭前把头发扎了起来。

ex.en: Some workplaces are relaxing rules about hair and clothing to create a more inclusive environment.
ex.zh: 一些工作场所正在放宽对发型和服装的规定，以营造更包容的环境。

col: a strand of hair｜一缕头发
tip: 整体头发不可数；一根头发用a hair。

senses.en: Having the colour of grass and most leaves.
Causing little harm to the environment.
The colour of grass and most leaves.

ex.en: She wore a green jacket to match her shoes.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件绿色夹克来搭配鞋子。

ex.en: Governments can encourage green transport by improving public services and building safer routes for cyclists.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过改善公共服务和修建更安全的自行车道来鼓励绿色出行。

col: go green｜采取环保生活方式
tip: 除颜色外，green常表示环保；形容人还可指缺乏经验。

senses.en: A small round fruit growing in bunches on vines.

ex.en: She packed some grapes in my lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在我的午餐盒里装了一些葡萄。

ex.en: Farmers growing grapes may need more efficient irrigation systems as summers become hotter and drier.
ex.zh: 随着夏季变得更炎热、更干燥，葡萄种植者可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。

col: a bunch of grapes｜一串葡萄
tip: 单颗葡萄用a grape，一串用a bunch of grapes。

senses.en: To telephone someone or shout to get their attention.
To give someone or something a particular name.
A telephone conversation or a public request for action.

ex.en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚到家后我会给你打电话。

ex.en: Environmental groups call for stricter regulations to reduce plastic waste entering rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 环保团体呼吁制定更严格的法规，减少流入河流和海洋的塑料垃圾。

col: call for action｜呼吁采取行动
call someone back｜给某人回电话
tip: call sb表示给某人打电话，不加to。

senses.en: A food made by pressing or ripening the solids of milk.

ex.en: I added some cheese to my warm vegetable sandwich.
ex.zh: 我在热乎乎的蔬菜三明治里加了些奶酪。

ex.en: Although cheese provides protein and calcium, some varieties contain high levels of salt and saturated fat.
ex.zh: 虽然奶酪能提供蛋白质和钙，但有些品种的盐和饱和脂肪含量较高。

col: a slice of cheese｜一片奶酪
tip: 通常不可数；一块奶酪用a piece of cheese。

senses.en: Extending a great distance or lasting a great time.
For a great amount of time.
To want something very strongly, especially something unavailable.

ex.en: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
ex.zh: 她的长围巾差点碰到湿漉漉的人行道。

ex.en: Long commuting times can reduce workers' leisure opportunities and negatively affect their overall quality of life.
ex.zh: 长时间通勤会减少劳动者的休闲机会，并对其整体生活质量产生负面影响。

col: long to do something｜渴望做某事
tip: 动词long后接for加名词，或to加动词原形。

senses.en: A body part or aircraft structure that enables flight.
A section extending from the main part of a building.
A group within an organisation sharing particular views or aims.

ex.en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
ex.zh: 那只鸟飞离树枝前展开了翅膀。

ex.en: The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
ex.zh: 医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。

col: spread your wings｜展开翅膀；拓展自我
tip: 鸟的翅膀和飞机机翼都用wing，通常成对用复数。

senses.en: an occasion when people gather to discuss something
an occasion when people come together, by arrangement or chance

ex.en: Our team meeting starts right after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们团队今天午饭后马上开会。

ex.en: Regular meetings between teachers and parents can help identify learning difficulties at an early stage.
ex.zh: 教师与家长定期会面有助于及早发现学习困难。

tip: 参加会议用attend a meeting；meeting也可指会面。

senses.en: in a good way; also used to start a sentence

ex.en: She sings very well.
ex.zh: 她唱歌唱得很好。

ex.en: Well, let's start the lesson.
ex.zh: 好了，我们开始上课吧。

tip: well 作副词“很好地”；作感叹词引出话题。
scene: A teacher clapping and saying well done to a student.

senses.en: A person, traditionally male, who serves food in a restaurant

ex.en: The waiter brought our soup and two warm rolls.
ex.zh: 服务员端来了我们的汤和两个热乎乎的小面包。

ex.en: A well-trained waiter can improve the dining experience by responding patiently to customers with different needs.
ex.zh: 训练有素的服务员可以耐心回应不同顾客的需求，提升用餐体验。

col: work as a waiter｜当餐厅服务员
tip: waiter传统上指男服务员；server更不强调性别。

senses.en: filled with fog, making things difficult to see
unclear or difficult to remember or understand

ex.en: The road was so foggy that we drove slowly.
ex.zh: 路上雾很大，我们只好慢慢开车。

ex.en: Foggy conditions can disrupt air travel, causing delays that affect both passengers and airport operations.
ex.zh: 大雾天气可能扰乱航空出行，造成延误，影响乘客和机场运营。

col: a foggy morning｜雾蒙蒙的早晨
tip: foggy既可形容天气，也可形容记忆模糊。

senses.en: twice the usual amount, size, or quantity
become twice as much, or make something twice as much
an amount that is twice as large as another

ex.en: I ordered a double portion of rice for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午饭点了双份米饭。

ex.en: The city plans to double its investment in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 该市计划将自行车基础设施投资增加一倍，以缓解交通拥堵。

col: double in size｜规模扩大一倍
tip: double表示变为原来的两倍，即增加一倍。

senses.en: an organisation that holds money and provides financial services
land along the edge of a river or lake
put money into an account at a bank

ex.en: I went to the bank to open an account.
ex.zh: 我去银行开了一个账户。

ex.en: Banks can support local economic development by offering affordable loans to small businesses and new entrepreneurs.
ex.zh: 银行可以向小企业和初创创业者提供低成本贷款，以支持当地经济发展。

tip: 岸边用on the bank；银行里用at或in the bank。

senses.en: Animals and other living things in their natural surroundings.

ex.en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
ex.zh: 我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。

ex.en: Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。

col: a wildlife reserve｜野生生物保护区
tip: 不可数名词；wildlife park中作名词定语。

senses.en: A thick woven covering for a floor.

ex.en: We sat on the carpet and played cards.
ex.zh: 我们坐在地毯上打牌。

ex.en: Installing carpet in classrooms can reduce noise, although regular cleaning is necessary to maintain good hygiene.
ex.zh: 在教室里铺地毯可以降低噪声，但需要定期清洁以保持良好卫生。

tip: carpet常指大面积地毯；rug多指可移动的小块地毯。

senses.en: a room where students are taught

ex.en: Sunlight filled the classroom as we opened our books.
ex.zh: 我们打开书本时，阳光洒满了教室。

ex.en: A well-designed classroom should provide adequate lighting, comfortable furniture, and enough space for students to work together.
ex.zh: 设计良好的教室应有充足的照明、舒适的家具，以及供学生合作学习的足够空间。

tip: in the classroom强调教室内；in class强调上课中。

senses.en: From one side or end to the other, within something.
By using a particular method, person, or process.
From beginning to end, or from one side to another.

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
ex.zh: 阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。

ex.en: Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.
ex.zh: 学生可以通过需要合作和创造性解决问题的项目来培养实践技能。

tip: through强调从内部穿过；across强调横越表面。

senses.en: An arrangement or idea for what to do in future.
To decide what to do and how to do it.
A drawing showing the layout of a building or area.

ex.en: Our plan is to leave early and avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我们的计划是早点出发，避开拥堵。

ex.en: Cities need a clear plan for expanding public transport before introducing restrictions on private vehicles.
ex.zh: 城市在实施私家车限制措施之前，需要制定明确的公共交通扩展计划。

col: plan to do something｜计划做某事
tip: plan to do表示打算做；过去式planned双写n。

senses.en: the tools and other items needed for a particular activity

ex.en: Please put the camping equipment back in the garage.
ex.zh: 请把露营装备放回车库。

ex.en: Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.
ex.zh: 学校需要合适的实验室设备，让学生获得实践经验并培养科学兴趣。

col: a piece of equipment｜一件设备
tip: 不可数；一件设备说a piece of equipment。

senses.en: problems or difficulties that cause worry or inconvenience
to cause someone worry or ask them for help

ex.en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
ex.zh: 厨房的窗户很紧，我们费了好大劲才打开。

ex.en: Many older adults have trouble accessing public services that are available only through digital platforms.
ex.zh: 许多老年人难以使用那些仅通过数字平台提供的公共服务。

col: have trouble doing something｜做某事有困难
take the trouble to do something｜费心做某事
tip: 表示做某事有困难，用have trouble doing。

senses.en: said when you say goodbye at night or go to bed

ex.en: Good night, sleep well.
ex.zh: 晚安，睡个好觉。

ex.en: Mum kissed me and said good night.
ex.zh: 妈妈亲了我一下，说了晚安。

tip: good night 用于道别或睡前；即使天黑见面也用 good evening。
scene: A mother tucking her child into bed and switching off the light.

senses.en: A public display of art, objects, or products.

ex.en: We visited a photography exhibition at the local museum.
ex.zh: 我们参观了当地博物馆的一场摄影展。

ex.en: An interactive exhibition can make scientific discoveries more accessible to children and encourage their interest in research.
ex.zh: 互动展览能让儿童更容易理解科学发现，并激发他们对研究的兴趣。

tip: exhibition指整场展览；exhibit可指一件展品。

senses.en: Protected from danger or unlikely to cause harm.
Unlikely to fail or lead to loss.
A strong locked container for money and valuable objects.

ex.en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
ex.zh: 你的自行车放在我们锁好的车库里很安全。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all communities have access to safe drinking water and reliable sanitation.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有社区都能获得安全饮用水和可靠的卫生设施。

col: keep someone safe｜保护某人安全
tip: safe是形容词，safety是名词；注意词性区别。

senses.en: having a pleasant flavour

ex.en: This tasty soup is perfect for a cold evening.
ex.zh: 这道美味的汤很适合寒冷的夜晚。

ex.en: School canteens can encourage healthier eating by offering tasty meals made with fresh vegetables and whole grains.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以提供用新鲜蔬菜和全谷物制作的美味餐食，鼓励更健康的饮食。

tip: tasty指食物美味；tasteful指有品位。

senses.en: a soft sea animal with hanging tentacles that can sting

ex.en: A translucent jellyfish drifted past our boat this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，一只半透明的水母从我们船边漂过。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures may encourage jellyfish populations to grow, potentially disrupting marine ecosystems and coastal tourism.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升可能促使水母数量增加，进而扰乱海洋生态系统并影响沿海旅游业。

col: a swarm of jellyfish｜一大群水母
tip: 复数通常仍用 jellyfish；它不是鱼类。

senses.en: making you laugh or smile
unusual or difficult to explain

ex.en: That funny story made everyone at the table laugh.
ex.zh: 那个好笑的故事逗得桌边的人都笑了。

ex.en: Teachers sometimes use funny examples to make difficult concepts more memorable and encourage students to participate.
ex.zh: 教师有时会用有趣的例子，让复杂概念更容易记住，并鼓励学生参与。

col: find something funny｜觉得某事好笑
tip: funny侧重好笑或奇怪；fun侧重令人愉快、有趣。

senses.en: a strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust
a type of fiction intended to frighten its audience

ex.en: She watched in horror as her laptop fell downstairs.
ex.zh: 她惊恐地看着自己的笔记本电脑掉下楼梯。

ex.en: Horror films often use music and lighting to create tension rather than relying entirely on frightening images.
ex.zh: 恐怖电影常用音乐和灯光制造紧张气氛，而非完全依赖吓人的画面。

tip: 情绪义通常不可数；in horror表示惊恐地。

senses.en: A small official sticker showing that postage has been paid.
A tool that presses a mark, or the mark it leaves.
Press a mark onto something, or bring a foot down hard.

ex.en: She put a stamp on the envelope before leaving.
ex.zh: 她出门前在信封上贴了一张邮票。

ex.en: Although digital communication has reduced letter writing, collecting stamps remains a way to explore history and culture.
ex.zh: 尽管数字通信减少了书信往来，集邮仍是一种探索历史与文化的方式。

col: stamp a passport｜在护照上盖章
tip: 邮票用a stamp；“在信封上贴邮票”用put a stamp on。

senses.en: used to say that something is disappointing or unlucky

ex.en: Unfortunately, the bakery had sold out of fresh bread.
ex.zh: 遗憾的是，面包店的新鲜面包已经卖完了。

ex.en: Unfortunately, many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with reliable internet access.
ex.zh: 遗憾的是，许多乡村学校缺乏为学生提供可靠网络连接所需的资源。

col: unfortunately for someone｜对某人来说不幸的是
unfortunately not｜遗憾的是并非如此
tip: 常置于句首并加逗号，对整件事表示遗憾。

senses.en: happening or done most often in a particular situation

ex.en: Our usual table by the window was already taken.
ex.zh: 我们平时坐的窗边那张桌子已经有人了。

ex.en: Working from home has become the usual arrangement for some employees in the technology sector.
ex.zh: 对科技行业的一些员工来说，居家办公已成为常规安排。

col: the usual routine｜惯常的生活规律
tip: as usual意为“照常”；than usual意为“比平时”。

senses.en: To give money for something or for someone's work
Money received regularly for doing a job
To bring a benefit or be worth doing

ex.en: Can I pay for these apples by card?
ex.zh: 这些苹果可以刷卡付款吗？

ex.en: Employers should pay workers fairly to improve staff morale and reduce the number of people leaving.
ex.zh: 雇主应公平支付员工薪酬，以提高士气并减少人员流失。

tip: pay for接所购物品；pay接账单或款额；过去式paid。

senses.en: a shape with four equal sides and four right angles
an open public area surrounded by buildings
shaped like a square, or expressing area in squared units

ex.en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
ex.zh: 先把纸折成正方形，再剪。

ex.en: Creating a public square can encourage social interaction and provide space for cultural events in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市中，建设公共广场可以促进社交互动，并为文化活动提供空间。

tip: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。

senses.en: Having lived or existed for a long time.
Having a particular age.
Belonging to an earlier period of someone's life.

ex.en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
ex.zh: 我们家的老狗睡在温暖的厨房炉子旁。

ex.en: Preserving old buildings can protect cultural heritage while attracting visitors and supporting the local economy.
ex.zh: 保护古老建筑既能保护文化遗产，也能吸引游客并支持当地经济。

tip: an old friend通常指相识已久，不一定年纪大。

senses.en: The lowest part of something.
The part of your body that you sit on.
In the lowest position.

ex.en: My keys were at the bottom of my bag.
ex.zh: 我的钥匙在包的最底下。

ex.en: Waste often collects at the bottom of rivers, damaging habitats and threatening aquatic life.
ex.zh: 废弃物经常堆积在河底，破坏栖息地并威胁水生生物。

col: from top to bottom｜从上到下
tip: 在某物底部用at the bottom of。

senses.en: to put on clothes to see if they fit

ex.en: Can I try on this jacket, please?
ex.zh: 请问我可以试穿这件夹克吗？

ex.en: She tried on three dresses before choosing one.
ex.zh: 她试了三件裙子才选了一件。

tip: try on 是“试穿”；try it on 中代词放中间。
scene: A girl trying on a jacket in front of a shop mirror.

senses.en: Something incorrect that you do, say, or believe.
To wrongly identify someone or understand something incorrectly.

ex.en: I took your umbrella by mistake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我误拿了你的伞。

ex.en: Teachers should encourage students to learn from mistakes rather than feel ashamed of making them.
ex.zh: 教师应鼓励学生从错误中学习，而不是因为犯错而感到羞愧。

col: learn from mistakes｜从错误中学习
mistake A for B｜把A误认成B
tip: 说make a mistake，不说do；动词过去式为mistook。

senses.en: A place where something is built, happens, or once existed.
A collection of connected web pages.
Place or build something in a particular location.

ex.en: Workers put a fence around the building site.
ex.zh: 工人们在建筑工地周围围起了围栏。

ex.en: The proposed hospital site is close to public transport, making healthcare more accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 拟建医院的选址靠近公共交通，方便居民获得医疗服务。

tip: site指地点或网站；sight指视力或景象，二者同音。

senses.en: To say or do something again.
Something that happens or is shown again.

ex.en: Could you repeat the address a little more slowly?
ex.zh: 你能把地址再慢一点说一遍吗？

ex.en: Students who repeat new vocabulary aloud regularly may develop greater confidence when speaking a foreign language.
ex.zh: 经常大声重复新词汇的学生，在说外语时可能会更有信心。

col: repeat after someone｜跟着某人复述
tip: repeat已含“再次”之意，通常不必再加again。

senses.en: to greet someone warmly or accept something with pleasure
wanted, appreciated, or gladly accepted
the way someone is greeted when they arrive

ex.en: Our neighbours came outside to welcome us home.
ex.zh: 邻居们走到外面，欢迎我们回家。

ex.en: Many communities welcome new cultural festivals because they encourage social interaction and support local businesses.
ex.zh: 许多社区欢迎新的文化节庆活动，因为这些活动能促进社交互动并支持当地商家。

col: a welcome change｜令人欣喜的变化
tip: be welcome to do表示可随意做；You're welcome用于回应感谢。

senses.en: a soft red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface

ex.en: I picked a ripe strawberry and put it in my basket.
ex.zh: 我摘了一颗熟透的草莓，放进篮子里。

ex.en: Growing strawberries locally can reduce transport distances, although heated greenhouses may increase overall energy consumption.
ex.zh: 在本地种植草莓可以缩短运输距离，但加温温室可能增加总体能源消耗。

tip: 可数名词，复数为strawberries。

senses.en: a period of seven days
the days or hours normally spent working each week

ex.en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
ex.zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。

ex.en: A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.
ex.zh: 缩短工作周可能改善员工的身心状况，前提是减少工作量，而非把工作集中完成。

tip: last/next/this week前不加介词。

senses.en: a large reptile with tough skin, long jaws and tail

ex.en: We watched a crocodile slide into the river.
ex.zh: 我们看着一条鳄鱼滑入河中。

ex.en: Wetland conservation protects crocodile habitats while also supporting the fish and birds that depend on these ecosystems.
ex.zh: 湿地保护既能保护鳄鱼的栖息地，也有利于依赖这些生态系统的鱼类和鸟类。

col: crocodile tears｜假慈悲；虚假的眼泪
tip: alligator指短吻鳄，与crocodile并非同一种动物。

senses.en: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday

ex.en: We meet for lunch every Wednesday near the library.
ex.zh: 我们每周三在图书馆附近一起吃午饭。

ex.en: The community centre offers free language classes every Wednesday to help newcomers participate in local life.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周三提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者融入当地生活。

tip: 首字母大写；on Wednesday，但every Wednesday前不加on。

senses.en: Having little colour, or less colour than usual.
Giving only a weak light.
To lose colour or seem less impressive in comparison.

ex.en: You look pale; sit down and have some water.
ex.zh: 你脸色苍白，坐下来喝点水吧。

ex.en: The financial benefits of tourism may pale in comparison with its long-term environmental costs.
ex.zh: 与旅游业带来的长期环境代价相比，其经济收益可能显得微不足道。

col: pale in comparison｜相比之下相形见绌
tip: pale可指脸色苍白或颜色浅，不等于白色。

senses.en: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.

ex.en: Let's meet outside the library at noon tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我们明天中午在图书馆外见吧。

ex.en: Outdoor workers should avoid intense physical activity around noon, when temperatures and sunlight can be particularly strong.
ex.zh: 户外工作者应避免在正午前后进行高强度体力活动，此时气温可能很高，阳光也可能特别强烈。

tip: 说at noon，不说in noon；正午是12 p.m.。

senses.en: in the morning, before midday

ex.en: The shop opens at nine a.m.
ex.zh: 商店上午九点开门。

ex.en: She gets up at six a.m. every day.
ex.zh: 她每天早上六点起床。

tip: a.m. 表示上午（午夜后至正午前）；p.m. 表示下午。
scene: A wall clock showing nine in the morning with a shop opening.

senses.en: an informal greeting

ex.en: Hi, how are you today?
ex.zh: 嗨，你今天好吗？

ex.en: She said hi to everyone in the class.
ex.zh: 她向班里的每个人打招呼。

tip: hi 比 hello 更随意，朋友间常用。
