senses.en: a yellow citrus fruit with sour juice
having a pale yellow colour

ex.en: I squeezed half a lemon over the grilled fish.
ex.zh: 我把半个柠檬的汁挤在烤鱼上。

ex.en: Adding lemon juice to meals can improve flavour without increasing the amount of salt consumed.
ex.zh: 在餐食中加入柠檬汁可以增添风味，而不增加盐的摄入量。

col: a slice of lemon｜一片柠檬
tip: 整个柠檬可数；lemon juice中的juice不可数。

senses.en: a thick cloud near the ground that limits visibility
to become or make a surface covered with fine droplets

ex.en: Thick fog hid the hills behind our house.
ex.zh: 浓雾遮住了我们屋后的山丘。

ex.en: Dense fog can disrupt transport networks, causing flight cancellations and increasing the risk of road accidents.
ex.zh: 浓雾可能扰乱交通网络，导致航班取消，并增加道路事故的风险。

tip: fog比mist更浓；fog up常指玻璃蒙上雾气。

senses.en: direct your eyes towards someone or something
appear to have a particular quality or condition
an act of looking, or someone's expression or appearance

ex.en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
ex.zh: 看窗边那只小鸟。

ex.en: Public parks often look more attractive when local residents help maintain their gardens and pathways.
ex.zh: 当当地居民协助维护花园和步道时，公共公园往往显得更有吸引力。

tip: look at后接看的对象；look作系动词后接形容词。

senses.en: coming before all others in order or time
before anything or anyone else

ex.en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
ex.zh: 这是我第一次到海边来。

ex.en: Governments should first improve public transport before encouraging residents to give up private cars.
ex.zh: 政府应先改善公共交通，再鼓励居民放弃私家车。

tip: at first指起初；first可用于列举第一点。

senses.en: costing a large amount of money

ex.en: These boots are too expensive for my budget.
ex.zh: 这双靴子太贵，超出了我的预算。

ex.en: Housing in major cities is becoming increasingly expensive, forcing many young workers to live farther from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 大城市的住房越来越贵，迫使许多年轻职工住到离工作地点更远的地方。

col: an expensive mistake｜代价高昂的错误
tip: 物品贵用expensive，价格高用high。

senses.en: a professional who examines and treats teeth and gums

ex.en: The dentist checked my teeth and recommended a softer toothbrush.
ex.zh: 牙医检查了我的牙齿，并建议我用更软的牙刷。

ex.en: Regular visits to a dentist can prevent minor dental problems from developing into serious health conditions.
ex.zh: 定期看牙医可以防止小的牙齿问题发展成严重的健康问题。

col: a qualified dentist｜有执业资格的牙医
tip: dentist指牙医；the dentist's可指牙医诊所。

senses.en: a system of words or gestures used for communication
the words and style used in a particular context

ex.en: My neighbour teaches me a little of her language.
ex.zh: 邻居教我一点她的语言。

ex.en: Learning a foreign language can broaden students' cultural understanding and improve their future employment prospects.
ex.zh: 学习外语可以拓宽学生的文化视野，并改善他们未来的就业前景。

tip: 指某种语言时可数；泛指语言能力时常不可数。

senses.en: worried or uneasy about what might happen
relating to the nerves in the body

ex.en: I felt nervous before my first swimming lesson yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天第一次上游泳课前，我感到很紧张。

ex.en: Students who feel nervous about examinations may benefit from regular practice and supportive feedback from teachers.
ex.zh: 对考试感到紧张的学生可以从定期练习和教师的鼓励性反馈中获益。

tip: nervous about后接名词或动名词，表示对某事紧张。

senses.en: the top covering of a building or vehicle
to cover a building with a roof

ex.en: Rain drummed on the roof throughout the night.
ex.zh: 雨点整夜敲打着屋顶。

ex.en: Installing solar panels on the roof can help households lower electricity bills and reduce their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 在屋顶安装太阳能板，可以帮助家庭降低电费并减少对环境的影响。

col: under one roof｜在同一屋檐下
tip: 复数是roofs；roof指外部屋顶，ceiling指室内天花板。

senses.en: Having many things to do or being actively occupied.
Full of people, traffic, or activity.
Already being used, especially a telephone line.

ex.en: I am busy making soup for dinner right now.
ex.zh: 我现在正忙着做晚餐要喝的汤。

ex.en: Busy urban roads can discourage cycling unless local authorities provide safe routes separated from motor traffic.
ex.zh: 繁忙的城市道路可能让人不愿骑车，除非地方政府提供与机动车流隔离的安全路线。

tip: 用busy doing或busy with，不用busy to do。

senses.en: Any longer, usually in negative statements.

ex.en: I don't take the bus to school anymore.
ex.zh: 我不再坐公交车上学了。

ex.en: Many employees do not commute every day anymore because their employers now offer flexible working arrangements.
ex.zh: 许多员工不再每天通勤，因为雇主如今提供灵活的工作安排。

col: not live here anymore｜不再住在这里
not need it anymore｜不再需要它
tip: 表示“不再”；英式常写any more，数量“更多”须分写。

senses.en: To form words on paper or a screen.
To create a story, article, or piece of music.
To send someone a letter or written message.

ex.en: Please write your address on this small card.
ex.zh: 请把你的地址写在这张小卡片上。

ex.en: Students who write regularly often develop stronger reasoning skills and express complex ideas more clearly.
ex.zh: 经常写作的学生往往能培养更强的推理能力，并更清晰地表达复杂观点。

tip: 不规则变化：write—wrote—written。

senses.en: Suffering from a disease or feeling unwell.
In a bad or unkind way.

ex.en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
ex.zh: 长途乘车后，我感到身体不适。

ex.en: Employees who are ill should be encouraged to rest rather than return to work immediately.
ex.zh: 应鼓励生病的员工休息，而不是立即返岗。

tip: 表示生病时通常作表语：be ill。

senses.en: to do a job, or to function

ex.en: My father works in a hospital.
ex.zh: 我爸爸在医院工作。

ex.en: The lift is not working today.
ex.zh: 电梯今天不能用。

tip: work 作动词“工作/运转”，作名词“工作”；job 是可数名词“工作”。
scene: A nurse working at a hospital desk with a computer.

senses.en: a small plastic card used to pay for things later

ex.en: I paid for the jacket with my credit card.
ex.zh: 我用信用卡买了这件夹克。

ex.en: You can pay by credit card in most shops.
ex.zh: 大多数商店都可以用信用卡付款。

tip: credit card 是信用卡（先消费后还款）；debit card 是借记卡。
scene: A hand holding a credit card near a card machine in a shop.

senses.en: instructions explaining how to prepare and cook a dish

senses.zh: 促成某结果的方法或因素
senses.en: a method or situation likely to produce a particular result

ex.en: This soup recipe needs only a few simple ingredients.
ex.zh: 这个汤的食谱只需要几种简单的食材。

ex.en: Investment in teacher training and accessible learning materials provides a recipe for educational success.
ex.zh: 投资教师培训并提供易于获取的学习材料，是推动教育成功的有效方法。

col: follow a recipe｜按照食谱做菜
a recipe for success｜成功之道
a recipe for disaster｜招致灾难的做法
tip: recipe指做菜方法；menu是菜单，prescription是处方。

senses.en: past form of can; used to ask politely

ex.en: Could you help me with this bag?
ex.zh: 你能帮我拿一下这个包吗？

ex.en: When I was five, I could ride a bike.
ex.zh: 我五岁的时候就会骑自行车了。

tip: could 用于请求时比 can 更礼貌，也表示 can 的过去式。
scene: A polite student asking a teacher to help carry a heavy bag.

senses.en: The event or process of a baby being born.
The beginning of something new.

ex.en: The whole family celebrated the birth of our daughter.
ex.zh: 全家人都庆祝了我们女儿的出生。

ex.en: Access to skilled medical care during birth significantly improves health outcomes for both mothers and newborn babies.
ex.zh: 分娩时获得专业医疗护理能显著改善母亲和新生儿的健康状况。

col: the birth of a movement｜一场运动的诞生
tip: give birth to表示生下；be born表示出生。

senses.en: An animal often kept as a pet or trained for work.
To cause persistent problems for someone or something.

ex.en: Our dog waits by the door every afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们的狗每天下午都守在门边。

ex.en: Training a guide dog requires considerable time, but it can greatly improve someone's independence.
ex.zh: 训练一只导盲犬需要大量时间，但它能显著增强使用者的独立生活能力。

col: be dogged by problems｜长期受问题困扰
tip: 动词常见被动式be dogged by，表示长期受困扰。

senses.en: A chart of dates or a schedule of events.
A system for dividing time into years, months, and days.

ex.en: I marked our camping weekend on the kitchen calendar.
ex.zh: 我在厨房的日历上标出了周末露营的日子。

ex.en: Schools should publish an annual calendar so families can plan holidays around important educational events.
ex.zh: 学校应公布年度日程表，方便家庭避开重要教学活动来安排假期。

tip: calendar year指一月至十二月，不等于学年。

senses.en: Having a pattern of long, narrow bands.

ex.en: She wore a striped shirt and dark blue jeans.
ex.zh: 她穿着一件条纹衬衫和深蓝色牛仔裤。

ex.en: The striped coats of certain animals may help them avoid detection in their natural habitats.
ex.zh: 某些动物带条纹的皮毛可能有助于它们在自然栖息地中避免被发现。

tip: striped意为有条纹的；strip的过去式是stripped。

senses.en: A toothed tool used to arrange or tidy hair.
To tidy hair with a comb, or search an area thoroughly.

ex.en: She pulled a comb from her bag and tidied her hair.
ex.zh: 她从包里拿出梳子，梳理了一下头发。

ex.en: Volunteers combed the beach for plastic waste before the start of the summer tourist season.
ex.zh: 暑期旅游季开始前，志愿者仔细搜寻海滩上的塑料垃圾。

tip: 词尾b不发音；comb through表示仔细搜查。

senses.en: A sport hitting a small ball into holes with clubs

ex.en: My grandfather plays golf with his friends every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我祖父每周日都和朋友打高尔夫球。

ex.en: Golf courses can attract tourists, but maintaining their grass may require considerable amounts of water.
ex.zh: 高尔夫球场可以吸引游客，但养护草坪可能需要大量用水。

col: a golf club｜高尔夫球杆；高尔夫俱乐部
a round of golf｜一轮高尔夫球
tip: 球类运动前通常不加冠词：play golf。

senses.en: to speak to someone or discuss something
a conversation or discussion between people
a speech given to an audience about a subject

ex.en: We talked about our weekend plans over breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们吃早饭时聊了聊周末的计划。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生坦诚谈论压力，并在需要时寻求帮助。

tip: talk about接话题；talk to或with接人。

senses.en: making a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds

ex.en: Our noisy washing machine woke everyone up this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，吵闹的洗衣机把大家都吵醒了。

ex.en: Living near noisy roads can affect sleep quality and increase stress among urban residents.
ex.zh: 住在嘈杂的道路附近可能影响城市居民的睡眠质量并加重压力。

tip: noisy是形容词，noise是名词；注意不是nosy。

senses.en: using highly developed technology or methods
requiring knowledge or skills beyond a basic level
having reached a late stage of development or progress

ex.en: This advanced camera takes clear pictures even at night.
ex.zh: 这台先进的相机即使在夜间也能拍出清晰的照片。

ex.en: Advanced medical technology can improve patient outcomes, but its high cost may increase inequalities in healthcare access.
ex.zh: 先进的医疗技术可以改善治疗效果，但其高昂成本可能加剧医疗服务获取方面的不平等。

col: at an advanced stage｜处于后期阶段
tip: advanced表示先进或高级；预先通知用advance notice。

senses.en: a room or building where people do administrative work
a place providing a particular service or handling official business
an official position of responsibility, especially in government

ex.en: I left my umbrella under the desk at the office.
ex.zh: 我把伞落在办公室的桌子下面了。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to divide their time between the office and home.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排让员工能够把工作时间分配在办公室和家中。

tip: 在办公室用in the office；任公职用in office。

senses.en: someone you know well, like, and enjoy spending time with

ex.en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天在市场遇到了一位老朋友。

ex.en: Maintaining close friendships can improve mental wellbeing, as friends often provide emotional support during difficult periods.
ex.zh: 维持亲密友谊可以改善心理健康，因为朋友常在困难时期提供情感支持。

col: keep in touch with friends｜与朋友保持联系
tip: “与某人交朋友”用make friends with，friends用复数。

senses.en: Air moving naturally outdoors.
To wrap something around an object or itself.
To follow a route with many bends and turns.

ex.en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
ex.zh: 突然一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。

ex.en: Investing in wind power can help countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 投资风能可以帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低碳排放。

tip: 风读/wɪnd/；缠绕读/waɪnd/，过去式wound。

senses.en: Feeling no doubt that something is true or correct.
Certain to happen or do something.
Used informally to agree or strongly confirm something.

ex.en: Are you sure you left your keys here?
ex.zh: 你确定把钥匙落在这里了吗？

ex.en: Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.
ex.zh: 政府必须确保农村社区能够稳定地获得基本医疗服务。

tip: be sure of表确信；be sure to可表必然或叮嘱。

senses.en: Used to make an adjective or adverb stronger.
Used to emphasize an exact person, thing, place, or time.

ex.en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
ex.zh: 汤很烫，先让它凉一凉。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is very important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
ex.zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通非常重要。

tip: very通常修饰形容词或副词；修饰动词常用very much。

senses.en: To think something is probably true without being certain.
To imagine a situation in order to consider its consequences.

ex.en: I suppose we can eat outside if it stays warm.
ex.zh: 我想，如果天气一直这么暖和，我们可以在外面吃饭。

ex.en: Suppose every household used less electricity; the combined reduction in demand could significantly benefit the environment.
ex.zh: 假设每户家庭都减少用电，需求的总体下降就可能为环境带来显著益处。

col: be supposed to do｜应该做；按安排做
tip: be supposed to表示应该或按安排做某事。

senses.en: the activity of moving your body rhythmically, usually to music

ex.en: We go dancing together at the community centre every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们每周六都一起去社区中心跳舞。

ex.en: Regular dancing can improve physical fitness while providing opportunities for social interaction across different age groups.
ex.zh: 经常跳舞可以改善体能，同时为不同年龄群体提供社交机会。

tip: 作活动名词通常不可数；去跳舞用go dancing。

senses.en: A greater or additional amount or number of something.
To a greater degree or extent.
A greater or additional amount or number.

ex.en: Could you add more rice to my bowl, please?
ex.zh: 请再给我的碗里添点米饭，好吗？

ex.en: Governments should invest more resources in preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
ex.zh: 政府应加大对预防保健的资源投入，以长期减轻医院的压力。

tip: 可修饰可数或不可数名词；是 many、much 的比较级。

senses.en: A set of pages joined together for reading
To arrange in advance to use a service or attend something

ex.en: I left my book on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我把书落在厨房的桌子上了。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free access to books, helping people continue learning regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费借阅书籍的机会，让不同收入的人都能持续学习。

tip: book 作动词表示预订，可直接接房间、机票等。

senses.en: the hard material forming tree trunks and branches
an area of land covered with trees

ex.en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
ex.zh: 这把小椅子完全由实木制成。

ex.en: Using wood from responsibly managed forests can reduce the environmental impact of constructing new homes.
ex.zh: 使用来自负责任管理的森林的木材，可以减少建造新住宅对环境的影响。

col: a piece of wood｜一块木头
walk in the woods｜在树林中散步
tip: 木材义不可数；树林可说a wood或the woods。

senses.en: The place where someone lives or feels they belong.
At or towards the place where you live.
Relating to your house or your own country.

ex.en: We walked home together after dinner at the café.
ex.zh: 在咖啡馆吃过晚饭后，我们一起走回家。

ex.en: Working from home can reduce commuting costs, but it may also limit social interaction among colleagues.
ex.zh: 居家办公可以降低通勤成本，但也可能限制同事之间的社交互动。

tip: home作副词时前面不加to：go home。

senses.en: the number equal to a thousand thousands

ex.en: The city now has more than a million residents.
ex.zh: 这座城市如今有一百多万居民。

ex.en: The government plans to invest several million pounds in renewable energy projects over the next decade.
ex.zh: 政府计划在未来十年向可再生能源项目投入数百万英镑。

tip: 具体数词后million不加s；millions of表示数百万。

senses.en: To make something damaged or broken work properly again
Work done to restore something damaged or broken
To improve a damaged relationship or put a situation right

ex.en: Can you repair the broken zip on my jacket?
ex.zh: 你能修好我夹克上坏掉的拉链吗？

ex.en: Encouraging consumers to repair household appliances rather than replace them could significantly reduce electronic waste.
ex.zh: 鼓励消费者维修而非更换家用电器，可以显著减少电子垃圾。

tip: 具体维修常用复数repairs；beyond repair表示无法修复。

senses.en: A particular day of a month or year.
An arranged meeting, especially with someone you find romantically attractive.
To establish something's age, or originate in a particular period.

ex.en: Have you chosen a date for the picnic?
ex.zh: 你选好野餐的日期了吗？

ex.en: Researchers used wooden tools found nearby to date the remains of this ancient village.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用附近发现的木制工具确定这座古村落遗迹的年代。

tip: date back to表示始于某时期，不用被动语态。

senses.en: to close something or stop being open for business
closed or not open for business

ex.en: Please shut the window before the rain gets in.
ex.zh: 请在雨飘进来之前把窗户关上。

ex.en: When local libraries shut, residents lose valuable access to free learning resources and shared community spaces.
ex.zh: 当本地图书馆关闭时，居民便失去了宝贵的免费学习资源和共享社区空间。

col: shut down a factory｜关闭工厂
keep something shut｜让某物保持关闭
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为shut；现在分词为shutting。

senses.en: small facts or pieces of information

ex.en: Please send me the details of the trip.
ex.zh: 请把行程的详细信息发给我。

ex.en: She knows all the details about the project.
ex.zh: 她了解这个项目的所有细节。

tip: details 常用复数，指具体信息；personal details 是个人信息。
scene: A form on a desk with personal details filled in by hand.

senses.en: an organisation whose members share an interest or activity
a place where people dance and socialise at night
a stick used to hit a golf ball or strike something

ex.en: I joined a chess club to meet new people.
ex.zh: 我加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部，想认识些新朋友。

ex.en: A school sports club can help students develop teamwork skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 学校体育社团可以帮助学生培养团队合作能力，同时鼓励他们经常锻炼。

tip: join a club表示加入社团，不用join in a club。

senses.en: Used when I am both the person acting and receiving.
Used to emphasize that I personally do something.

ex.en: I made myself a sandwich before the walk.
ex.zh: 散步前，我给自己做了个三明治。

ex.en: By volunteering at a community garden, I taught myself practical skills that formal education rarely provides.
ex.zh: 通过在社区花园做志愿者，我自学了正规教育很少传授的实用技能。

col: not feel myself｜感觉不在状态
tip: by myself表示独自或独立；不能用myself代替主语I。

senses.en: before now or earlier than expected

ex.en: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我已经收拾好明天要用的包了。

ex.en: Many cities have already introduced cycling schemes to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 许多城市已经推出骑行计划，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。

col: already in place｜已经就位；已落实
tip: 常置于助动词后、实义动词前；表示已经或比预期早。

senses.en: a bowl-shaped fixture used for getting rid of bodily waste
a room containing a toilet

ex.en: The toilet upstairs keeps making a strange dripping sound.
ex.zh: 楼上的马桶一直发出奇怪的滴水声。

ex.en: Access to clean public toilets is essential for protecting health and making urban spaces welcoming to everyone.
ex.zh: 提供干净的公共厕所，对保障健康和打造人人友好的城市空间至关重要。

tip: 美式toilet通常指马桶；问公共洗手间常用restroom。

senses.en: The mother of your father or mother.

ex.en: My grandmother grows fresh herbs on her kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 我的祖母在厨房窗台上种新鲜的香草。

ex.en: For many working parents, a grandmother provides essential childcare and helps maintain strong family connections.
ex.zh: 对许多在职父母来说，祖母或外祖母提供了不可或缺的育儿帮助，也有助于维系紧密的家庭关系。

tip: 可指祖母或外祖母；口语常用grandma。

senses.en: A substance used to treat or prevent illness.
The study and practice of treating and preventing illness.

ex.en: The pharmacist explained how often to take the medicine.
ex.zh: 药剂师解释了这种药应该多久服用一次。

ex.en: Advances in medicine have increased life expectancy, but access to effective treatment remains unequal across regions.
ex.zh: 医学进步延长了预期寿命，但各地区获得有效治疗的机会仍不平等。

tip: 服药用take medicine；表示医学时不可数。

senses.en: not open
not available for business or public use
unwilling to consider different ideas

ex.en: Keep the window closed while the heating is on.
ex.zh: 开着暖气时，请把窗户关好。

ex.en: When local libraries remain closed at weekends, working families have fewer opportunities to access educational resources.
ex.zh: 如果当地图书馆周末不开放，上班族家庭获取教育资源的机会就会减少。

col: keep something closed｜使某物保持关闭
tip: 形容词意为“关着的”；也是close的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: the activity of catching fish for pleasure or food

ex.en: We went fishing by the lake before breakfast.
ex.zh: 早饭前，我们去湖边钓鱼了。

ex.en: Strict limits on commercial fishing can help marine ecosystems recover and support coastal communities in the long term.
ex.zh: 严格限制商业捕鱼能帮助海洋生态系统恢复，并长期支持沿海社区的生计。

tip: 说“去钓鱼”用go fishing，不用go to fishing。

senses.en: to hit something with your foot
an act of hitting something with your foot

ex.en: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
ex.zh: 她轻轻地把球踢向弟弟。

ex.en: Children learn to kick and throw balls through activities that improve coordination and encourage teamwork.
ex.zh: 孩子们通过能够改善协调能力、培养团队精神的活动学习踢球和投球。

tip: kick用脚踢；hit泛指击打，不限定用什么。

senses.en: a piece of music with words

ex.en: This song is my favourite at the moment.
ex.zh: 这首歌是我现在最喜欢的。

ex.en: They sang a happy song at the party.
ex.zh: 他们在聚会上唱了一首欢快的歌。

tip: song 是“歌曲”；sing a song 是“唱歌”。
scene: A music note floating over a guitar on a stage.

senses.en: to perform an action or activity

ex.en: What do you do at the weekend?
ex.zh: 你周末做什么？

ex.en: I have a lot of homework to do.
ex.zh: 我有很多作业要做。

tip: do 也用作助动词构成疑问句和否定句：Do you like tea?
scene: A student doing homework at a desk with books and a pencil.

senses.en: A large wild cat, whose males usually have thick neck hair.

ex.en: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
ex.zh: 那头狮子在树荫下休息。

ex.en: Protecting lions requires large habitats where they can hunt naturally without coming into conflict with farmers.
ex.zh: 保护狮子需要大片栖息地，让它们能够自然捕猎而不与农民发生冲突。

col: a pride of lions｜一群狮子
tip: 狮群用a pride of lions；母狮称lioness。

senses.en: a division of an organisation responsible for a particular subject
an area of a shop selling a particular type of product

ex.en: Please ask our sales department about the delivery date.
ex.zh: 请向我们的销售部门询问送货日期。

ex.en: Each university department should review its courses regularly to ensure they reflect developments in the relevant field.
ex.zh: 大学各系应定期审查课程，确保课程反映相关领域的发展。

tip: 大学的系可用department；学院通常用faculty或school。

senses.en: a piece of jewellery worn around the neck

ex.en: She wore a silver necklace with a tiny bird.
ex.zh: 她戴着一条带有小鸟吊坠的银项链。

ex.en: A handmade necklace can reflect local traditions while providing income for craftspeople in rural communities.
ex.zh: 一条手工项链既能体现当地传统，也能为农村社区的手工艺人带来收入。

tip: 结尾-lace读/ləs/，不是单词lace的读音。

senses.en: A place where two sides, walls, or streets meet.
To trap someone so they cannot escape or avoid answering.

ex.en: We put a small lamp in the corner.
ex.zh: 我们在角落里放了一盏小灯。

ex.en: Shops on street corners can encourage walking by making everyday services more accessible to local residents.
ex.zh: 街角商店让当地居民更方便地获得日常服务，从而鼓励人们步行。

col: around the corner｜在拐角处；即将到来
tip: 室内角落用in the corner；街道拐角常用on或at。

senses.en: Physical activity for health, or a task for practising skills.
To do physical activity to stay healthy or become stronger.
To use a right, power, ability, or quality.

ex.en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
ex.zh: 我步行去商店，顺便锻炼一下。

ex.en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 经常运动能够改善心理健康，并降低几种常见慢性病的患病风险。

tip: 泛指运动时不可数；一项练习或一套动作中的动作可数。

senses.en: easy to press, bend, or change in shape
gentle and not loud, bright, or harsh
not strict or severe enough

ex.en: This soft blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
ex.zh: 这条柔软的毯子让我在寒冷的夜晚保持温暖。

ex.en: Soft lighting and comfortable furniture can make hospital waiting areas feel less stressful for patients.
ex.zh: 柔和的灯光和舒适的家具可以减轻患者在医院候诊区的紧张感。

tip: soft是形容词；修饰说话等动作通常用softly。

senses.en: An upright structure enclosing, dividing, or supporting a space.
To surround or separate an area with a wall.

ex.en: We hung a colourful painting on the kitchen wall.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房墙上挂了一幅色彩鲜艳的画。

ex.en: Green walls covered with plants can improve air quality and reduce heat in crowded urban areas.
ex.zh: 覆盖植物的绿墙可以改善空气质量，并减少拥挤城区的热量。

tip: 图片挂在墙上用on；嵌在墙内用in。

senses.en: An unspecified amount or number of something.
An unspecified number or amount of people or things.
Approximately, used before an amount or number.

ex.en: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
ex.zh: 我在回家的路上买了些新鲜面包。

ex.en: Some residents support the proposed cycle lanes, while others worry about losing parking spaces.
ex.zh: 一些居民支持拟建的自行车道，另一些人则担心停车位会减少。

tip: 可修饰复数名词或不可数名词；弱读常为/səm/。

senses.en: Wanting to learn about or take part in something.
Likely to be affected by a situation or decision.

ex.en: My sister is interested in learning to grow vegetables.
ex.zh: 我姐姐对学习种菜很感兴趣。

ex.en: Students who are interested in science should have regular opportunities to conduct practical experiments.
ex.zh: 对科学感兴趣的学生应该经常有机会开展实际实验。

tip: 人感到有兴趣用interested；后接in加名词或动名词。

senses.en: Having the warm yellow colour of gold.
Especially valuable, favourable, or successful.

ex.en: The bread turned golden after twenty minutes in the oven.
ex.zh: 面包在烤箱里烤了二十分钟后变成了金黄色。

ex.en: International exchange programmes offer students a golden opportunity to develop language skills and understand different cultures.
ex.zh: 国际交流项目为学生提供了提高语言能力、了解不同文化的绝佳机会。

tip: golden多形容颜色；表示金制的通常用gold。

senses.en: one of the long movable parts of a hand
to touch or handle something with your fingers

ex.en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
ex.zh: 她的中指上戴着一枚银戒指。

ex.en: Tasks requiring precise finger movements can help young children develop coordination before they learn to write.
ex.zh: 需要手指精细动作的任务可以帮助幼儿在学习写字前发展协调能力。

col: point a finger at｜用手指指向；指责
tip: 通常不包括拇指；拇指专称thumb。

senses.en: To feel anxious, or make someone feel anxious.
An anxious feeling or something that causes it.

ex.en: I worry about my cat when she stays outside.
ex.zh: 猫待在外面时，我会担心她。

ex.en: Many parents worry that excessive screen time may affect their children's sleep and concentration.
ex.zh: 许多家长担心，过长的屏幕使用时间可能影响孩子的睡眠和注意力。

tip: worry about表示担心某事；worried描述人的状态。

senses.en: to stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping

ex.en: I wake up at six thirty on school days.
ex.zh: 上学日我六点半醒来。

ex.en: Please wake me up at seven tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天七点请叫醒我。

tip: wake up 是“醒来”；叫醒某人说 wake sb up。
scene: Sunlight coming through curtains as a child wakes up in bed.

senses.en: Used before a noun to ask about a limited choice.
Used to ask about a choice without repeating the noun.
Introduces information about a thing or a previous statement.

ex.en: Which jacket should I wear to dinner tonight?
ex.zh: 今晚去吃饭我该穿哪件夹克？

ex.en: Governments must decide which policies will improve air quality without placing excessive financial pressure on households.
ex.zh: 政府必须决定哪些政策能改善空气质量，又不会给家庭造成过大的经济压力。

col: in which case｜如果是那样的话
tip: which常用于限定范围内的选择；what范围更开放。

senses.en: A method of doing something.
A route or direction leading somewhere.
By a large amount or distance.

ex.en: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
ex.zh: 教我一个更简单的叠床单方法吧。

ex.en: Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通是减少交通拥堵和城市空气污染的有效方法。

col: an effective way｜一种有效的方法
tip: “做某事的方法”可用way to do或way of doing。

senses.en: A style of clothing or behaviour popular at a particular time
A particular way of doing something
Make or shape something, often using simple materials

ex.en: My sister follows fashion but rarely buys expensive clothes.
ex.zh: 我姐姐关注时尚，但很少买昂贵的衣服。

ex.en: The fashion industry can reduce its environmental impact by producing durable clothing and using recycled materials.
ex.zh: 时装行业可以通过生产耐穿的衣服和使用回收材料来减少对环境的影响。

col: in a similar fashion｜以类似的方式
tip: 表方式时常用in a ... fashion，语气较正式。

senses.en: A large boat carrying people or goods, especially at sea.
To send goods somewhere by sea, air, or land.

ex.en: We watched a huge ship glide into the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘巨轮缓缓驶入港口。

ex.en: Many countries ship agricultural products overseas, making reliable transport networks essential for economic growth.
ex.zh: 许多国家向海外运送农产品，因此可靠的运输网络对经济增长至关重要。

tip: ship作动词不只指海运，也可指陆运或空运。

senses.en: The body part connecting your shoulder to your hand.
A projecting part of an object, especially a chair.
To provide weapons or useful tools for a task.

ex.en: She carried the sleeping baby gently in her arms.
ex.zh: 她轻轻地把熟睡的宝宝抱在怀里。

ex.en: Schools should arm students with practical skills that help them adapt to a rapidly changing workplace.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生掌握实用技能，帮助他们适应快速变化的职场。

col: arm someone with knowledge｜用知识充实某人
tip: 表“武器”用复数arms；arm还可作动词。

senses.en: An adult female person.

ex.en: The woman next door grows beautiful flowers on her balcony.
ex.zh: 隔壁那位女士在阳台上种了漂亮的花。

ex.en: Ensuring that every woman has access to education can improve health and economic opportunities across generations.
ex.zh: 确保每位女性都能接受教育，可以改善几代人的健康状况和经济机会。

tip: 复数women读/ˈwɪmɪn/，注意首音节变化。

senses.en: coming immediately after the present one
immediately after this; on the following occasion

ex.en: Our next bus leaves in about ten minutes.
ex.zh: 我们要坐的下一班公交车大约十分钟后发车。

ex.en: Over the next decade, governments will need to invest more heavily in affordable public transport.
ex.zh: 未来十年，各国政府需要加大对价格可负担的公共交通的投入。

tip: “下周”用next week，不加the；the next week指随后一周。

senses.en: a machine that washes clothes

ex.en: The washing machine is making a strange noise.
ex.zh: 洗衣机发出奇怪的声音。

ex.en: She put the dirty clothes into the washing machine.
ex.zh: 她把脏衣服放进洗衣机。

tip: washing machine 是洗衣机；do the washing 是洗衣服。
scene: A white washing machine in a laundry room with clothes going in.

senses.en: The official organisation responsible for preventing crime and maintaining order.
To maintain order somewhere or ensure rules are obeyed.

ex.en: The police helped us find our missing bicycle.
ex.zh: 警方帮我们找到了丢失的自行车。

ex.en: Effective cooperation between police and local residents can improve public safety and build trust within communities.
ex.zh: 警方与当地居民的有效合作可以改善公共安全，并建立社区内部的信任。

col: police an event｜维持活动秩序
tip: the police作主语用复数；一名警察用a police officer。

senses.en: In a way that is poor, unsuccessful, or unacceptable
To a serious or harmful degree
Very much, especially when wanting or needing something

ex.en: I slept badly because the room was too hot.
ex.zh: 房间太热，我睡得很不好。

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads can badly affect rural communities by limiting access to schools, hospitals, and markets.
ex.zh: 维护不善的道路会限制人们前往学校、医院和市场，严重影响农村社区。

tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；不是bad的形容词用法。

senses.en: Having lived or existed for only a short time
The babies of an animal

ex.en: A young kitten fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
ex.zh: 一只小猫在我空着的鞋子里睡着了。

ex.en: Young people need affordable housing and stable employment to build independent lives in large cities.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要负担得起的住房和稳定的工作，才能在大城市独立生活。

tip: the young指年轻人群体；动物的幼崽也可用young。

senses.en: Every person in a group, or all people generally.

ex.en: Everybody is waiting outside for the doors to open.
ex.zh: 所有人都在外面等着开门。

ex.en: Public libraries should offer accessible services so that everybody can benefit from opportunities for lifelong learning.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应提供无障碍服务，让每个人都能受益于终身学习的机会。

tip: 作主语时谓语用单数：Everybody is ready。

senses.en: a person who flies an aircraft
done on a small scale to test whether something works
to fly an aircraft or test a new plan

ex.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly despite strong winds.
ex.zh: 尽管风很大，飞行员还是平稳地让飞机着陆了。

ex.en: The council launched a pilot scheme to assess whether free bus travel would reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 地方议会推出了一项试点计划，以评估免费乘坐公交车能否缓解交通拥堵。

col: pilot a programme｜试行一个项目
tip: pilot作定语常表示试点，如pilot project。

senses.en: a person who plays tennis

ex.en: She is a promising young tennis player.
ex.zh: 她是一名有前途的年轻网球运动员。

ex.en: The tennis player served the ball very fast.
ex.zh: 这名网球运动员发球很快。

tip: tennis player 是网球选手；play tennis 是打网球。
scene: A tennis player in white hitting a ball on a court.

senses.en: To keep doing something or keep happening.
To start again after a pause or interruption.

ex.en: We continued walking along the beach despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是继续沿着海滩走。

ex.en: If housing costs continue to rise, more young adults may struggle to live independently in major cities.
ex.zh: 如果住房成本持续上涨，更多年轻人可能难以在大城市独立生活。

tip: 可接to do或doing，通常都表示继续做某事。

senses.en: A round citrus fruit with orange skin and juicy flesh.
Having a colour between red and yellow.
The colour between red and yellow.

ex.en: I peeled an orange and shared it with my sister.
ex.zh: 我剥了一个橙子，和妹妹分着吃。

ex.en: An orange provides vitamin C, but a balanced diet requires a variety of foods.
ex.zh: 橙子能提供维生素C，但均衡饮食需要多种食物。

tip: 橙子可数；表示橙色时通常不可数。

senses.en: A place where people pay to watch films.
Films considered as an art form or industry.

ex.en: We met outside the cinema and bought some popcorn.
ex.zh: 我们在电影院外碰面，买了些爆米花。

ex.en: International cinema allows audiences to explore unfamiliar cultures and consider social issues from different perspectives.
ex.zh: 国际电影让观众能够了解陌生的文化，并从不同角度思考社会问题。

col: go to the cinema｜去看电影
tip: 英式常说go to the cinema，美式常说go to the movies。

senses.en: a sports contest between two people or teams
to go well together, correspond, or equal something
a small stick that produces fire when rubbed

ex.en: We watched a football match at the local park.
ex.zh: 我们在附近的公园看了一场足球比赛。

ex.en: Training programmes should match the skills taught in colleges with the needs of local employers.
ex.zh: 培训项目应使院校教授的技能与当地雇主的需求相匹配。

col: match A with B｜将A与B匹配
tip: match强调搭配协调；fit常指尺寸合适。

senses.en: The organ that pumps blood around the body.
The part of someone associated with feelings and love.
The central or most important part of something.

ex.en: My heart beats faster when I run uphill.
ex.zh: 我跑上坡时，心跳会加快。

ex.en: Regular physical activity strengthens the heart and can reduce the risk of serious illness.
ex.zh: 经常运动能增强心脏功能，并降低患严重疾病的风险。

col: at the heart of｜处于……的核心
tip: by heart表示熟记；lose heart表示灰心。

senses.en: a room in a house where people eat meals

ex.en: We have dinner in the dining room every evening.
ex.zh: 我们每天晚上在饭厅吃晚饭。

ex.en: The dining room table can seat six people.
ex.zh: 饭厅的桌子可以坐六个人。

tip: dining room 是家里吃饭的房间；restaurant 是外面的餐馆。
scene: A warm dining room with a wooden table set for dinner and chairs around it.

senses.en: not wet or containing very little moisture
to remove moisture or become free from moisture
not interesting or entertaining

ex.en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 毛巾在阳光下晾过后已经干了。

ex.en: Long periods of dry weather can damage crops and threaten food security in agricultural communities.
ex.zh: 长期干旱天气会损害农作物，并威胁农业社区的粮食安全。

tip: 形容词比较级drier；名词dryer指烘干设备。

senses.en: to enter a bus, train, plane or bike

ex.en: We got on the train just before it left.
ex.zh: 我们正好在火车开走前上了车。

ex.en: She got on her bike and rode away.
ex.zh: 她骑上自行车走了。

col: get on with someone｜和某人相处
tip: get on 表示“上车”；get on with sb 是“与某人相处融洽”。
scene: A child stepping up onto a school bus, holding the handrail.

senses.en: To require something because it is necessary or important
Something necessary or the condition of requiring it
A situation in which essential things are lacking

ex.en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，这些植物需要更多的水。

ex.en: Cities need to improve public transport if they want to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市若想减少人们对私家车的依赖，就需要改善公共交通。

col: need to do something｜需要做某事
meet basic needs｜满足基本需求
tip: need to do表需要做；need doing表需要被做。

senses.en: Feeling the need or desire to eat.
Having a strong desire for something.

ex.en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
ex.zh: 在河边走了很久之后，我觉得饿了。

ex.en: School meal programmes help hungry children concentrate in class and participate more actively in learning.
ex.zh: 学校供餐计划帮助饥饿的孩子集中课堂注意力，更积极地参与学习。

tip: hungry for后接名词，表示渴望某物。

senses.en: Before the present time, following an expression of time

ex.en: I left my umbrella on the bus an hour ago.
ex.zh: 一小时前，我把雨伞落在了公交车上。

ex.en: Many jobs that seemed secure a decade ago now require workers to develop new digital skills.
ex.zh: 许多十年前看似稳定的工作，如今要求员工掌握新的数字技能。

col: a long time ago｜很久以前
as recently as a year ago｜就在一年前
tip: ago放在时间段后，通常搭配一般过去时。

senses.en: Plant products containing seeds, often sweet and eaten as food.
The useful results of work or effort.
To produce fruit.

ex.en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在我的午餐盒里放了新鲜水果。

ex.en: Making fresh fruit affordable could encourage healthier eating habits among families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 让新鲜水果价格更亲民，可以鼓励低收入家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: the fruits of your labour｜劳动成果
tip: 泛指水果通常不可数；fruits可指种类或成果。

senses.en: shaped like a circle or ball
one stage in a repeated series of activities
around something or on all sides of it

ex.en: We placed a round table beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房窗边放了一张圆桌。

ex.en: A further round of negotiations may help governments reach an agreement on reducing industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 新一轮谈判可能有助于各国政府就减少工业排放达成协议。

col: a round of talks｜一轮会谈
walk round the lake｜绕湖散步
tip: round作介词常见于英式英语，美式多用around。

senses.en: A male child in relation to his parents.

ex.en: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
ex.zh: 他们的儿子帮他们在花园里种花。

ex.en: Parents should give their sons and daughters equal opportunities to pursue education and develop practical skills.
ex.zh: 父母应给予儿子和女儿平等的机会，让他们接受教育并培养实用技能。

tip: son与sun同音；成年男性也仍是父母的son。

senses.en: the qualities that make someone or something distinctive
a person represented in a story, play, or film
a written or printed symbol, such as a letter

ex.en: Her cheerful character makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
ex.zh: 她开朗的性格让阴雨的早晨也显得明朗起来。

ex.en: Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市在适应现代经济需求的同时，保留自身的独特风貌。

tip: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

senses.en: above something or from one side to the other
more than a particular amount, age, or level
finished or no longer happening

ex.en: A small bird flew over the garden wall.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟飞过了花园的围墙。

ex.en: Over half of the residents surveyed supported plans to create more green spaces in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 受访居民中有超过一半支持在社区内增设绿地的计划。

col: all over the world｜世界各地
tip: over可指越过或超过；be over表示结束。

senses.en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event
An organised series of performances or other cultural events

ex.en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。

ex.en: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.
ex.zh: 一年一度的艺术节既能吸引游客，也能为当地表演者提供接触更多观众的宝贵机会。

col: hold a festival｜举办节庆活动
tip: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。

senses.en: a plant or plant part eaten as food

ex.en: We bought fresh vegetables at the market this morning.
ex.zh: 我们今天早上在市场买了新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving a wider variety of vegetables at lunchtime.
ex.zh: 学校可以在午餐时供应更多种类的蔬菜，鼓励更健康的饮食。

tip: 通常为可数名词；泛指多种蔬菜用vegetables。

senses.en: To get something that someone sends, gives, or provides.
To welcome someone arriving at a place.

ex.en: Did you receive the photos I sent yesterday?
ex.zh: 你收到我昨天发的照片了吗？

ex.en: All residents should receive clear information about changes to public transport before new routes are introduced.
ex.zh: 在新线路开通之前，所有居民都应获得有关公共交通调整的明确信息。

col: receive an email｜收到电子邮件
receive a warm welcome｜受到热烈欢迎
tip: receive侧重收到；accept侧重愿意接受。

senses.en: a resource listing words with their meanings, pronunciations, or translations

ex.en: I checked the pronunciation of this word in a dictionary.
ex.zh: 我查了词典，确认这个词的发音。

ex.en: Using a bilingual dictionary can help language learners understand unfamiliar vocabulary without relying entirely on their teachers.
ex.zh: 使用双语词典能帮助语言学习者理解陌生词汇，而不必完全依赖教师。

tip: 查词用look up a word in a dictionary。

senses.en: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.

ex.en: Maybe we can have a picnic if the weather improves.
ex.zh: 如果天气好转，也许我们可以去野餐。

ex.en: Maybe cities could reduce traffic congestion by offering cheaper public transport rather than building more roads.
ex.zh: 也许城市可以通过提供更便宜的公共交通，而非修建更多道路，来缓解交通拥堵。

tip: maybe是副词；may be是情态动词加be。

senses.en: a visible spot, line, or symbol on a surface
a score showing the quality of a student's work
to indicate something visibly or assess a student's work

ex.en: Your wet glass left a mark on the table.
ex.zh: 你的湿杯子在桌上留下了一道印子。

ex.en: Teachers should mark assignments consistently so that students receive fair and useful feedback.
ex.zh: 教师批改作业时应采用一致的标准，让学生获得公平且有用的反馈。

tip: 表示考试分数常用复数marks，尤其在英式英语中。

senses.en: Used for people or things already mentioned or understood.

senses.zh: 指性别未知或非二元者
senses.en: Used for someone of unknown or nonbinary gender.

ex.en: The children waved as they boarded the bus.
ex.zh: 孩子们一边上公交车一边挥手。

ex.en: When a student receives constructive feedback, they are more likely to identify weaknesses and improve their performance.
ex.zh: 学生收到建设性反馈后，更有可能发现不足并改善表现。

tip: 单数they也搭配are、have，不用is、has。

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: A huge dog was sleeping beside the tiny kitten.
ex.zh: 一只大狗正睡在那只小猫旁边。

ex.en: Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 对于饱受交通拥堵和空气污染困扰的城市，投资公共交通可以带来巨大益处。

tip: 本身表示极大，常用absolutely huge加强语气。

senses.en: a large number of, used with plural countable nouns
a large number of people or things

ex.en: How many apples do we need for the pie?
ex.zh: 做这个派需要多少个苹果？

ex.en: Many cities are investing in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 许多城市正在投资自行车基础设施，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。

tip: many 接可数名词复数；much 接不可数名词。

senses.en: A public message promoting a product, service, event, or opportunity.

ex.en: I saw an advertisement for bicycles at the station.
ex.zh: 我在车站看到了一则自行车广告。

ex.en: Advertisements aimed at young consumers should present accurate information rather than encourage unnecessary spending.
ex.zh: 面向年轻消费者的广告应提供准确信息，而不是鼓励不必要的消费。

tip: 广告内容用 for 引出；advertising 泛指广告活动。

senses.en: A team sport using sticks to hit a ball or puck

ex.en: We practised hockey on the school field yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在学校运动场练习了曲棍球。

ex.en: Making hockey facilities more accessible could encourage greater participation in team sports among young people.
ex.zh: 让曲棍球设施更便于使用，可以鼓励更多年轻人参加团队运动。

tip: 英国通常指草地曲棍球；美国通常指冰球。

senses.en: An unexpected event that causes injury or damage.
Something that happens without being planned or intended.

ex.en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
ex.zh: 幸好，我们家外面发生的事故没有造成人员受伤。

ex.en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。

col: a road accident｜道路交通事故
tip: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

senses.en: a place filled with water for swimming

ex.en: We go to the swimming pool every Friday.
ex.zh: 我们每周五去游泳池。

ex.en: The hotel has a big outdoor swimming pool.
ex.zh: 这家酒店有一个很大的室外游泳池。

tip: swimming pool 是游泳池；go swimming 是去游泳。
scene: A blue swimming pool with lanes and people swimming.

senses.en: Very surprised by something unexpected.

ex.en: I was amazed to find flowers growing through concrete.
ex.zh: 发现花从混凝土缝里长出来，我十分惊讶。

ex.en: Researchers were amazed by how quickly children learned new vocabulary through interactive games.
ex.zh: 研究人员惊讶地发现，孩子们通过互动游戏学习新词汇的速度如此之快。

col: be amazed to discover｜惊讶地发现
tip: amazed描述人的感受；amazing描述令人惊讶的事物。

senses.en: in place of something

ex.en: Let's walk instead of taking the bus.
ex.zh: 我们走路吧，别坐公交车了。

ex.en: She had tea instead of coffee.
ex.zh: 她喝了茶而不是咖啡。

tip: instead of 后接名词/动名词；instead 单独用放在句尾。
scene: Two friends choosing to walk on a path while a bus passes.

senses.en: A storm with thunder, lightning, and usually heavy rain.

ex.en: We stayed indoors while the thunderstorm shook the windows.
ex.zh: 雷雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。

ex.en: Severe thunderstorms can disrupt transport networks and cause sudden flooding, particularly in cities with inadequate drainage.
ex.zh: 强雷暴会扰乱交通网络并引发突发洪水，排水设施不足的城市尤其如此。

tip: thunder是雷声，lightning是闪电；雷暴用thunderstorm。

senses.en: to prepare food by heating it, or become ready through heating
someone who prepares and cooks food

ex.en: I usually cook vegetable soup when the weather turns cold.
ex.zh: 天气变冷时，我通常会煮蔬菜汤。

ex.en: Teaching children to cook simple meals can encourage healthier eating habits and greater independence later in life.
ex.zh: 教孩子做简单饭菜，可以培养更健康的饮食习惯，让他们日后更加独立。

col: cook from scratch｜从原材料开始做饭
a good cook｜做饭好吃的人
cook over low heat｜用小火烹调
tip: cook可指厨师；cooker在英式英语中指炉灶。

senses.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

ex.en: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
ex.zh: 我们租了一条小船，划到了湖对岸。

ex.en: Agricultural pollution can damage lake ecosystems and threaten the communities that rely on them for drinking water.
ex.zh: 农业污染会破坏湖泊生态系统，并威胁依靠湖水获取饮用水的社区。

col: the shore of a lake｜湖岸
tip: on the lake 指在湖面上；in the lake 指在湖水中。

senses.en: A section of writing dealing with one main idea.

ex.en: This paragraph is too long for a quick email.
ex.zh: 对于一封简短的邮件来说，这一段太长了。

ex.en: Each paragraph in an academic essay should develop a clear argument supported by relevant evidence.
ex.zh: 学术文章的每一段都应展开一个清晰的论点，并以相关证据加以支持。

tip: 可数名词；写作中通常一段围绕一个中心意思。

senses.en: Moving or staying at a distance from someone or something.
Not at home or at the usual place.

ex.en: The little bird flew away when I opened the window.
ex.zh: 我打开窗户时，小鸟飞走了。

ex.en: Moving away from crowded cities can improve wellbeing, but may reduce access to employment.
ex.zh: 搬离拥挤的城市可能改善身心健康，但也可能减少就业机会。

tip: away是副词；表示“远离某处”用away from。

senses.en: a cold dish of vegetables or other mixed ingredients

ex.en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
ex.zh: 我往沙拉里加了黄瓜和番茄。

ex.en: Offering fresh salad in school cafeterias can encourage children to eat a wider variety of vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂供应新鲜沙拉，有助于鼓励儿童摄入更多种类的蔬菜。

tip: 可指一份沙拉，也可不可数地指沙拉这种食物。

senses.en: used to ask permission or say something is possible

ex.en: May I use your pen, please?
ex.zh: 请问我可以用你的钢笔吗？

ex.en: It may rain later, so take an umbrella.
ex.zh: 待会儿可能下雨，带把伞吧。

tip: may 用于请求更正式礼貌；表示可能性时比 might 更可能。
scene: A student politely asking a classmate to borrow a pen.

senses.en: a test designed to discover something or check an idea
test ideas or methods to see what happens

ex.en: Our science experiment showed how roots grow towards water.
ex.zh: 我们的科学实验展示了植物根部如何朝水源生长。

ex.en: Schools should allow students to experiment with different materials before explaining the scientific principles involved.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生先尝试使用不同材料，再讲解其中的科学原理。

col: experiment with materials｜尝试使用各种材料
tip: 动词接with表示尝试；名词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: Away from the inside of a place, or from home.
No longer burning, shining, or working.
Available to the public or no longer secret.

ex.en: We went out for a walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后我们出去散步了。

ex.en: When a new research report comes out, journalists should examine its evidence before reporting its conclusions.
ex.zh: 新的研究报告发布时，记者应先审查其证据，再报道其结论。

tip: out 常作副词；在某物外面可用 outside。

senses.en: the activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist

ex.en: We spent the morning sightseeing around the old harbour.
ex.zh: 我们花了一上午在老港口一带观光。

ex.en: Sightseeing tours can support local economies, especially when visitors choose guides and businesses from the community.
ex.zh: 观光游览能促进当地经济，尤其是在游客选择当地社区的导游和商家时。

tip: 不可数名词；说go sightseeing，不加a。

senses.en: A picture made with a pencil, pen, or similar tool.
The activity or skill of making pictures with lines.

ex.en: He showed me a drawing of his cat.
ex.zh: 他给我看了一幅他画的猫。

ex.en: Drawing can help children express emotions that they may find difficult to communicate through spoken language.
ex.zh: 绘画可以帮助儿童表达那些难以用口头语言传达的情感。

tip: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: Sweet food eaten at the end of a meal.

ex.en: We shared a bowl of ice cream for dessert.
ex.zh: 我们分吃了一碗冰淇淋作为餐后甜点。

ex.en: Offering fresh fruit for dessert can help school cafeterias encourage healthier eating habits among children.
ex.zh: 学校食堂提供新鲜水果作为餐后甜点，有助于培养儿童更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: dessert有两个s，重音在后；desert作沙漠时重音在前。

senses.en: Feeling very happy and enthusiastic about something.

ex.en: The children were excited about their first camping trip.
ex.zh: 孩子们对第一次露营旅行感到兴奋。

ex.en: Students are often more excited about learning when lessons involve practical experiments and opportunities for discovery.
ex.zh: 当课程包含实践实验和探索机会时，学生往往对学习更有热情。

tip: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

senses.en: to ask someone to attend something or do something
to request a response or make a reaction likely

ex.en: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们邀请新邻居过来吃晚饭吧。

ex.en: Local councils should invite residents to discuss proposed changes before making decisions about public spaces.
ex.zh: 地方议会在就公共空间作出决定前，应邀请居民讨论拟议的改动。

col: invite someone to dinner｜邀请某人吃晚饭
invite someone to do something｜邀请某人做某事
tip: invite sb to＋活动；invite sb to do＋动作。

senses.en: A utensil with a small bowl for eating or serving.
To move or serve food using a spoon.

ex.en: She stirred her soup with a wooden spoon.
ex.zh: 她用木勺搅了搅汤。

ex.en: Teaching children to use a spoon independently can help develop their coordination and confidence.
ex.zh: 教孩子独立使用勺子有助于培养他们的协调能力和自信心。

col: spoon into a bowl｜用勺舀入碗中
tip: 一勺的量通常用 a spoonful of 表达。

senses.en: a place where buses stop for passengers

ex.en: Wait for me at the bus stop near the school.
ex.zh: 在学校附近的公交车站等我。

ex.en: The bus stop is just across the road.
ex.zh: 公交车站就在马路对面。

tip: bus stop 是沿途停车点；bus station 是始发/终点总站。
scene: A red bus pulling up at a bus stop with a shelter and a timetable.

senses.en: someone who travels through unfamiliar places to discover more about them

ex.en: The explorer carried a compass through the dense forest.
ex.zh: 探险者带着指南针穿过茂密的森林。

ex.en: An explorer can contribute valuable observations, but expeditions should avoid disturbing local wildlife and communities.
ex.zh: 探险者可以提供宝贵的观察资料，但探险活动应避免干扰当地野生动物和社区。

tip: explorer指探险的人，exploration指探索活动。

senses.en: a device used to speak to people at a distance
to contact someone using a telephone

ex.en: My phone rang while I was washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 我洗碗时，电话响了。

ex.en: Limiting phone use in classrooms may help students concentrate more effectively on lessons and group activities.
ex.zh: 限制课堂上的手机使用，可能有助于学生更专注于课程和小组活动。

col: phone someone back｜给某人回电话
tip: 动词直接接人：phone someone，不加to。

senses.en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects.
A continuing television or radio drama about everyday relationships.
To rub or wash something with soap.

ex.en: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前请用肥皂洗手。

ex.en: Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.
ex.zh: 在学校提供清洁用水和肥皂有助于预防感染，改善儿童的整体健康状况。

col: a bar of soap｜一块肥皂
tip: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

senses.en: to fail to catch, attend, or experience something
to feel sad because someone or something is absent
to fail to hit a target or notice something

ex.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the last bus.
ex.zh: 快点，否则我们会错过末班公交车。

ex.en: Students who miss several lessons may need additional support to keep up with their classmates.
ex.zh: 缺了几节课的学生可能需要额外帮助，才能跟上同学的进度。

col: miss the bus｜没赶上公交车
tip: miss后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: To send something through the air using your hand
To organise and host a party
An act of throwing, or the distance something is thrown

ex.en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
ex.zh: 趁狗还没抢到球，快把球扔给我。

ex.en: Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过培养协调能力和团队精神的游戏，教孩子安全地投接球。

tip: 不规则变化：throw–threw–thrown；聚会也可用throw。

senses.en: To go from one place to another.
The activity of going to other places.
To move or spread from one place to another.

ex.en: We usually travel by train to visit our grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们通常坐火车去看望祖父母。

ex.en: Affordable public transport enables residents to travel more sustainably and reduces dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 价格合理的公共交通让居民能够以更可持续的方式出行，并减少对私家车的依赖。

tip: 泛指旅行时travel不可数；一次旅行用a trip。

senses.en: To move behind someone or along a route.
To act according to instructions, rules, or advice.
To understand what someone says or explains.

ex.en: Follow this path until you reach the wooden bridge.
ex.zh: 沿着这条小路走，直到到达木桥。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to follow safety guidelines when using digital devices and online services.
ex.zh: 学校应教导儿童在使用数字设备和网络服务时如何遵守安全准则。

col: follow an argument｜理解论证思路
tip: follow直接接宾语：follow me，不加with。

senses.en: to make something clear or easy to understand
to give or be the reason why something happens

ex.en: Could you explain how this coffee machine works?
ex.zh: 你能说明一下这台咖啡机怎么用吗？

ex.en: Differences in access to healthcare may partly explain why life expectancy varies considerably between regions.
ex.zh: 医疗服务可及性的差异，可能在一定程度上解释不同地区预期寿命差距较大的原因。

col: explain something to someone｜向某人解释某事
tip: 说explain something to someone，不说explain someone。

senses.en: belonging to an animal or thing

ex.en: The dog wagged its tail happily.
ex.zh: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。

ex.en: The phone is in its case.
ex.zh: 手机在它的保护壳里。

tip: its 是“它的”；注意 it's 是 it is 的缩写，二者易混。
scene: A happy dog wagging its tail in a sunny yard.

senses.en: Used when something may happen or may be true.
Used with can or could to emphasise possibility or difficulty.

ex.en: We could possibly have a picnic if the rain stops.
ex.zh: 如果雨停了，我们也许可以去野餐。

ex.en: Expanding urban green spaces could possibly reduce summer temperatures while improving residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 扩大城市绿地可能降低夏季气温，同时改善居民的身心健康。

tip: can't possibly表示“绝不可能”，语气很强。

senses.en: A shiny greyish-white precious metal used for jewellery and coins.
Having a shiny greyish-white colour, or made of silver.
A medal awarded for second place in a competition.

ex.en: This little spoon is made of pure silver.
ex.zh: 这把小勺子是纯银做的。

ex.en: Silver is widely used in electronic devices because it conducts electricity exceptionally well.
ex.zh: 银的导电性能极佳，因此被广泛用于电子设备。

tip: 表示金属银时不可数；a silver可指一枚银牌。

senses.en: A reproduction, or one example of a book or document
To reproduce something or imitate someone's actions
Written material prepared for publication or advertising

ex.en: Please keep a copy of the receipt at home.
ex.zh: 请在家里留一份收据副本。

ex.en: Students should learn to evaluate sources rather than simply copy information from websites into their assignments.
ex.zh: 学生应学会评估资料来源，而不是直接把网站信息抄进作业。

tip: 复数为copies；广告文案义的copy通常不可数。

senses.en: to join in an activity or event

ex.en: All the students took part in the sports day.
ex.zh: 所有学生都参加了运动会。

ex.en: Would you like to take part in the competition?
ex.zh: 你想参加比赛吗？

tip: take part in 是“参加活动”；join 是“加入组织”。
scene: Students running in a race on a school sports day.

senses.en: no more than; alone in a group

ex.en: I have only one ticket left.
ex.zh: 我只剩一张票了。

ex.en: She is the only girl in the team.
ex.zh: 她是队里唯一的女孩。

tip: only 作副词表示“仅仅”，作形容词表示“唯一的”。
scene: A single ticket lying on an empty table.

senses.en: a large black and white bear native to China

ex.en: The panda sat quietly, chewing a fresh bamboo shoot.
ex.zh: 那只大熊猫静静地坐着，嚼着一根新鲜竹笋。

ex.en: Protecting panda habitats also benefits other species that depend on the same mountain forests for survival.
ex.zh: 保护大熊猫栖息地也有益于其他依赖同一片山林生存的物种。

tip: panda通常指大熊猫；red panda指小熊猫。

senses.en: knowledge or skill gained by doing things
something that happens to you or that you do
to have something happen to you or feel something

ex.en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姐姐有多年修理旧自行车的经验。

ex.en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
ex.zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。

col: a rewarding experience｜有收获的经历
tip: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

senses.en: Conditions outside, such as rain, sunshine, wind, and temperature.
To survive a difficult situation without serious damage.
To change or become damaged through exposure to outdoor conditions.

ex.en: The weather turned sunny just before our picnic.
ex.zh: 就在我们野餐前，天气转晴了。

ex.en: Extreme weather can disrupt food production and increase the cost of basic goods for vulnerable communities.
ex.zh: 极端天气会扰乱粮食生产，并推高弱势社区基本商品的价格。

col: weather a storm｜经受风暴；渡过危机
tip: 表示天气时不可数；climate指长期气候特征。

senses.en: On two occasions.
To double the amount, degree, or size.

ex.en: I checked my bag twice but couldn't find my keys.
ex.zh: 我检查了两次包，却没找到钥匙。

ex.en: Residents who exercise at least twice a week may experience improvements in their physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 每周至少锻炼两次的居民，身心健康可能得到改善。

tip: 两倍常用twice as…as或twice the＋名词。

senses.en: To make musical sounds with your voice.
For a bird to make pleasant musical sounds.

ex.en: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。

ex.en: Children who sing together regularly may develop greater confidence and stronger relationships with their classmates.
ex.zh: 经常一起唱歌的孩子可能会变得更加自信，与同学的关系也更加紧密。

col: sing in a choir｜在合唱团唱歌
tip: 不规则变化：sing—sang—sung。

senses.en: To be owned by someone
To have a proper place or category
To feel accepted as part of a group

ex.en: This blue umbrella belongs to my younger sister.
ex.zh: 这把蓝色雨伞是我妹妹的。

ex.en: Community centres provide welcoming spaces where newcomers can feel they belong and build lasting friendships.
ex.zh: 社区中心提供友好的空间，让新来者获得归属感并建立持久的友谊。

col: belong in a museum｜应放在博物馆
feel you belong｜感到有归属感
tip: belong to表示属于，不用被动语态或进行时。

senses.en: Nearly, but not completely or not quite.

ex.en: I almost missed the bus while tying my shoes.
ex.zh: 我系鞋带时差点错过了公交车。

ex.en: Almost all participants agreed that affordable public transport would improve their access to employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 几乎所有参与者都认为，价格实惠的公共交通能让他们获得更多就业机会。

tip: almost可接all、every和no；不能直接接most。

senses.en: an institution offering degree courses and conducting advanced research

ex.en: My sister studies engineering at a university near home.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在离家不远的一所大学读工程学。

ex.en: Governments should improve access to university so that talented students are not excluded by financial barriers.
ex.zh: 政府应扩大接受大学教育的机会，避免有才华的学生因经济障碍被拒之门外。

tip: 用a university而非an，因开头发辅音/j/。

senses.en: Precisely, with no difference or error.
Used to confirm that something is completely correct.

ex.en: This jacket is exactly the colour I wanted.
ex.zh: 这件夹克正是我想要的颜色。

ex.en: Researchers must record exactly how much energy each household uses to ensure reliable comparisons between regions.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须准确记录每户家庭的能耗，以确保地区之间的比较可靠。

tip: not exactly常表示并非完全，也可委婉否定。

senses.en: to hand something to someone or let them have it
to provide something or cause someone to experience something
to hold an event or perform an action for others

ex.en: Please give your sister a clean towel after swimming.
ex.zh: 游泳后请给你妹妹一条干净的毛巾。

ex.en: Schools should give students opportunities to develop practical skills through projects that address real community needs.
ex.zh: 学校应通过解决社区实际需求的项目，让学生有机会培养实践技能。

col: give someone a chance｜给某人机会
tip: give sb sth＝give sth to sb；过去式gave。

senses.en: an upper-body garment, usually with sleeves, a collar, and front buttons

ex.en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
ex.zh: 他在面试前熨好了自己的蓝衬衫。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear a formal shirt, while others allow more casual clothing.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式衬衫，另一些则允许更休闲的着装。

col: button up a shirt｜扣好衬衫扣子
tip: shirt通常指衬衫；T-shirt才是T恤。

senses.en: A place where people stay temporarily, often in tents.
Stay outdoors temporarily in a tent or similar shelter.
A group sharing the same opinions or aims.

ex.en: We returned to camp before the rain started.
ex.zh: 我们在下雨前回到了营地。

ex.en: Schools can organise outdoor camps to help students develop independence and learn practical skills beyond the classroom.
ex.zh: 学校可以组织户外营地活动，帮助学生培养独立性并学习课堂之外的实用技能。

tip: go camping表示去露营；camp也可指观点相同的阵营。

senses.en: Quickly and unexpectedly, with little or no warning.

ex.en: The lights suddenly went out while we were cooking.
ex.zh: 我们做饭时，灯突然灭了。

ex.en: When demand suddenly increases, public transport systems may struggle to provide enough services for passengers.
ex.zh: 当需求突然增加时，公共交通系统可能难以为乘客提供足够的班次。

tip: 可置于句首或动词前；强调变化突然、事先无预兆。

senses.en: A tall African animal with a long neck and spotted coat

ex.en: The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the highest leaves.
ex.zh: 那只长颈鹿伸长脖子去够最高处的叶子。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining healthy giraffe populations and preserving biodiversity in African grasslands.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持健康的长颈鹿种群和保护非洲草原的生物多样性至关重要。

col: a herd of giraffes｜一群长颈鹿
tip: 重音在第二音节，复数通常加-s。

senses.en: used to agree or say something is true

ex.en: 'Are you ready?' 'Yes, I am.'
ex.zh: “你准备好了吗？”“是的。”

ex.en: Yes, I would love to come to your party.
ex.zh: 好的，我很乐意来参加你的聚会。

tip: yes 用于肯定回答；口语 yes please 表示同意并接受。
scene: A child nodding and saying yes with a big smile.

senses.en: to fall to the ground

ex.en: He fell over on the ice and hurt his knee.
ex.zh: 他在冰上滑倒，摔伤了膝盖。

ex.en: The little boy fell over but he didn't cry.
ex.zh: 小男孩摔倒了，但他没有哭。

tip: fall over 指人或物“倒下”；fall down 也常用，意思相近。
scene: A boy slipping on an icy path and about to fall, arms out.

senses.en: at or towards the back of someone or something
at the back or making less progress than expected
responsible for causing or supporting something

ex.en: Your umbrella is behind the door in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 你的伞在厨房的门后面。

ex.en: Students who fall behind at school may benefit from additional support rather than stricter discipline.
ex.zh: 在学校学习落后的学生可能更需要额外的支持，而非更严格的纪律。

tip: behind可作介词或副词；fall behind表示落后。

senses.en: costing little money or less than usual
of poor quality and little value

ex.en: We found a cheap café near the train station.
ex.zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了一家价格实惠的咖啡馆。

ex.en: Cheap public transport can improve access to employment and reduce dependence on private cars in large cities.
ex.zh: 价格低廉的公共交通能改善大城市居民的就业可达性，并减少对私家车的依赖。

col: a cheap alternative｜便宜的替代选择
tip: cheap有时暗示质量差；中性表达可用inexpensive。

senses.en: A tool with two blades for cutting things.

ex.en: Please use these scissors to cut the wrapping paper.
ex.zh: 请用这把剪刀裁剪包装纸。

ex.en: Teachers should supervise young children when they use scissors during classroom craft activities.
ex.zh: 幼儿在课堂手工活动中使用剪刀时，教师应在旁监督。

col: a pair of scissors｜一把剪刀
tip: 通常用复数；一把剪刀说a pair of scissors。

senses.en: Very good or enjoyable.
Very large in amount, size, or degree.
Highly important, admired, or successful.

ex.en: We had a great afternoon swimming in the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖里游泳，度过了一个愉快的下午。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet is of great importance for students living in remote areas.
ex.zh: 对于居住在偏远地区的学生来说，能够使用可靠的互联网至关重要。

tip: a great deal of后接不可数名词，表示大量。

senses.en: used when a male does something to himself

ex.en: He built the bookshelf himself.
ex.zh: 书架是他自己做的。

ex.en: Tom hurt himself playing football.
ex.zh: 汤姆踢足球时弄伤了自己。

tip: by himself 表示“独自”；反身代词 himself 指代男性主语。
scene: A boy proudly standing next to a bookshelf he built himself.

senses.en: A television service or route for communicating and distributing things
A passage of water connecting areas or allowing boats through
Direct energy, money, or resources towards a particular purpose

ex.en: Could you change the channel before the film starts?
ex.zh: 电影开始前，你能换个频道吗？

ex.en: Governments should channel more funding into public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 政府应将更多资金投入公共交通，以缓解拥堵并便利人们上班求职。

tip: 动词常用channel sth into sth，表示将资源投入某处。

senses.en: Water that falls from clouds in drops
For water drops to fall from clouds

ex.en: Heavy rain kept us inside for the whole afternoon.
ex.zh: 大雨让我们整个下午都待在屋里。

ex.en: Farmers increasingly depend on stored water because seasonal rain has become less predictable in many regions.
ex.zh: 由于许多地区的季节性降雨越来越难以预测，农民日益依赖储存的水。

col: a chance of rain｜降雨的可能性
tip: rain作名词通常不可数；说下雨用It rains。

senses.en: the rear part of an animal or an aircraft
to follow someone closely and watch where they go

ex.en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
ex.zh: 我回家时，那只狗摇起了尾巴。

ex.en: Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.
ex.zh: 一些动物用尾巴保持平衡，这有助于它们在复杂的森林栖息地中安全移动。

tip: tail指尾巴；tale指故事，两词同音。

senses.en: Belonging to a particular person, rather than someone else.
To have something that legally belongs to you.

ex.en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
ex.zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。

ex.en: People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.
ex.zh: 拥有住房的人可能在经济上更有安全感，不过房屋维护费用也可能相当高。

col: my own room｜我自己的房间
of your own｜属于你自己的
tip: own表“自己的”前通常有物主词，如my own。

senses.en: To mark a special occasion by doing something enjoyable.
To praise someone or something publicly.

ex.en: We cooked a special dinner to celebrate her graduation.
ex.zh: 我们做了一顿特别的晚餐来庆祝她毕业。

ex.en: Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.
ex.zh: 社区节庆活动在弘扬当地传统的同时，也让居民有机会增进邻里关系。

col: celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就
tip: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

senses.en: Of a high or satisfactory standard.
Having a helpful or healthy effect.
Something that benefits people or is morally right.

ex.en: This bakery makes good bread with a crisp crust.
ex.zh: 这家面包店做的面包很好，外皮酥脆。

ex.en: Good public transport allows residents to reach essential services without relying on private cars.
ex.zh: 优质的公共交通让居民无需依赖私家车也能获得基本服务。

tip: good是形容词；修饰动作通常用well。

senses.en: referring to two people or things together
the two people or things already mentioned

ex.en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
ex.zh: 两扇窗户都开着，凉风吹了进来。

ex.en: Both governments and individuals have a responsibility to reduce waste and protect natural resources.
ex.zh: 政府和个人都有责任减少浪费并保护自然资源。

tip: both指两者；both A and B作主语用复数谓语。

senses.en: made of wood
showing little natural feeling or movement

ex.en: She stirred the soup slowly with a wooden spoon.
ex.zh: 她用木勺慢慢搅拌汤。

ex.en: Wooden buildings can offer environmental benefits when their materials come from responsibly managed forests.
ex.zh: 如果木材来自负责任管理的森林，木制建筑就能带来环境效益。

tip: wooden指木制；woody多指木质或像木头的。

senses.en: in or into the inner part of something
in or into an enclosed place or container
the inner part or surface of something

ex.en: Your keys are inside the small pocket of your bag.
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在包的小口袋里。

ex.en: Air quality inside buildings deserves greater attention because many people spend most of their day indoors.
ex.zh: 建筑物内部的空气质量值得更多关注，因为许多人一天中的大部分时间都在室内度过。

tip: inside后接名词时是介词；单独用可作副词。

senses.en: not any; used to say no

ex.en: There is no milk in the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。

ex.en: 'Are you coming?' 'No, I'm busy.'
ex.zh: “你来吗？”“不，我很忙。”

tip: no + 名词表示“没有…”；回答疑问句用 yes/no。
scene: An open fridge with an empty milk carton inside.

senses.en: Not long ago, or during the period just before now.

ex.en: We recently moved into a flat near the river.
ex.zh: 我们最近搬进了河边的一套公寓。

ex.en: Researchers have recently explored how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 研究人员最近探讨了绿地的可及性如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

tip: 可用于一般过去时或现在完成时，不只限于完成时。

senses.en: a journey to a place and usually back again
to stumble or make someone stumble by catching a foot

ex.en: Our weekend trip to the coast was wonderfully relaxing.
ex.zh: 我们周末的海滨之旅让人十分放松。

ex.en: School trips to museums can enrich classroom learning by giving students direct access to historical objects.
ex.zh: 学校组织的博物馆参观能让学生直接接触历史实物，从而丰富课堂学习。

tip: trip 是可数名词；travel 表示旅行活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: A person who controls a car or another road vehicle.
Something that strongly influences or causes a development.
Software that lets a computer communicate with a device.

ex.en: The bus driver waited while I found my ticket.
ex.zh: 公交车司机等着我找到车票。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can be a major driver of economic growth in expanding cities.
ex.zh: 在不断扩张的城市，公共交通投资可以成为经济增长的重要驱动力。

col: a key driver of growth｜增长的关键驱动因素
install a driver｜安装驱动程序
tip: a driver of change指推动变化的因素。

senses.en: the smallest positive whole number
used instead of a countable noun already mentioned
people in general, including the speaker, in formal language

ex.en: There is only one apple left in the bowl.
ex.zh: 碗里只剩一个苹果了。

ex.en: One major benefit of public transport is that it reduces the demand for parking spaces in cities.
ex.zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能减少城市对停车位的需求。

col: one at a time｜一次一个
tip: one可替代单数可数名词；复数用ones。

senses.en: Relating to music, or showing skill and interest in it.
A play or film whose story includes songs and dancing.
Having a pleasant sound resembling music.

ex.en: He keeps his musical instruments beside the sofa.
ex.zh: 他把乐器放在沙发旁边。

ex.en: Schools that offer musical training give children valuable opportunities to develop creativity and practise teamwork.
ex.zh: 提供音乐训练的学校为孩子们培养创造力和练习团队合作提供了宝贵机会。

tip: 作形容词指“音乐的”；作可数名词指音乐剧等。

senses.en: someone who writes books, articles, or other texts

ex.en: The writer filled her notebook while waiting for the train.
ex.zh: 那位作家等火车时，把笔记本写得满满的。

ex.en: A skilled writer can make complex environmental issues accessible to readers without oversimplifying the scientific evidence.
ex.zh: 优秀的作者能让读者理解复杂的环境问题，同时不过度简化科学证据。

tip: writer范围较广；author常指某部作品的作者。

senses.en: a tall building with many flats

ex.en: They live on the fifth floor of an apartment building.
ex.zh: 他们住在一栋公寓楼的五楼。

ex.en: The apartment building has a small garden outside.
ex.zh: 这栋公寓楼外面有一个小花园。

tip: apartment 是美式说法，英式常说 flat。
scene: A tall modern apartment building with balconies and lit windows at dusk.

senses.en: A piece of furniture used for sleeping
The ground at the bottom of a river, sea, or lake
An area of soil prepared for growing plants

ex.en: The cat curled up on my bed after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，猫蜷缩在我的床上。

ex.en: Maintaining a regular time to go to bed can improve sleep quality and support mental health.
ex.zh: 保持固定的就寝时间可以改善睡眠质量，并有益于心理健康。

tip: go to bed指就寝，不加the；make the bed指铺床。

senses.en: Exactly alike, or referring to one particular thing rather than another.
The very thing already mentioned, or something exactly like it.

ex.en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车上学。

ex.en: Students from different backgrounds should have the same opportunities to access high-quality education and develop their talents.
ex.zh: 不同背景的学生应享有同样的机会，接受优质教育并发展自己的才能。

tip: 通常用the same；比较时用the same as。

senses.en: to own, eat, drink, or do something

ex.en: I have two brothers and one sister.
ex.zh: 我有两个哥哥和一个妹妹。

ex.en: We usually have lunch at twelve.
ex.zh: 我们通常十二点吃午饭。

tip: have 用法很多：拥有、吃、喝、开展活动（have a shower）。
scene: A family having lunch together around a round table.

senses.en: a room in a house for relaxing and entertaining

ex.en: We sat in the sitting room and chatted.
ex.zh: 我们坐在客厅里聊天。

ex.en: The sitting room is at the front of the house.
ex.zh: 客厅在房子的前面。

tip: sitting room 与 living room 同义，是客厅。
scene: A bright sitting room with armchairs, a lamp and a rug.

senses.en: A recording of moving images, usually with sound.
Record moving images of someone or something.

ex.en: We watched a video of penguins sliding across ice.
ex.zh: 我们看了一段企鹅在冰上滑行的视频。

ex.en: Educational video can make complex processes easier to understand, especially for students with limited background knowledge.
ex.zh: 教学视频可以让复杂的过程更容易理解，对背景知识有限的学生尤其如此。

tip: 一段视频用a video；泛指视频媒介时可不可数。

senses.en: at some point within, or throughout, a particular period

ex.en: Please keep your phone silent during the concert.
ex.zh: 音乐会期间请将手机调为静音。

ex.en: During periods of extreme heat, local authorities should provide cool indoor spaces for vulnerable residents.
ex.zh: 在极端高温期间，地方政府应为脆弱群体提供凉爽的室内场所。

col: during working hours｜在工作时间内
tip: during后接名词；while后常接句子；for表示持续时长。

senses.en: A smooth surface, usually glass, that shows a reflected image.
Show the same qualities, changes, or features as something else.

ex.en: He checked his hair in the mirror before leaving.
ex.zh: 他离开前照镜子检查了一下头发。

ex.en: Changes in consumer spending often mirror broader economic trends, particularly during periods of financial uncertainty.
ex.zh: 消费者支出的变化往往反映更广泛的经济趋势，在金融形势不明朗时期尤其如此。

tip: 照镜子用look in the mirror，不用look the mirror。

senses.en: A small, simple building, often made of wood or grass.

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain in a wooden hut.
ex.zh: 我们躲进一间木屋避雨。

ex.en: Mountain huts provide essential shelter for hikers, but their construction should minimise damage to fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 山间小屋为徒步者提供必要的庇护，但建造时应尽量减少对脆弱生态系统的破坏。

tip: hut强调简小朴素，通常不是设施齐全的住宅。

senses.en: Having a sharp taste like a lemon.
Having an unpleasant taste or smell after becoming spoiled.
To become less pleasant or make a relationship worse.

ex.en: These grapes are too sour for my taste.
ex.zh: 这些葡萄对我来说太酸了。

ex.en: Disagreements over shared resources can sour relations between neighbouring countries and delay important environmental projects.
ex.zh: 共享资源方面的分歧可能使邻国关系恶化，并延误重要的环境项目。

tip: go sour可指食物变质，也可指关系变坏。

senses.en: The money used in a particular country.
The state of being widely accepted or used.

ex.en: We exchanged our money for local currency at the airport.
ex.zh: 我们在机场把钱兑换成了当地货币。

ex.en: A weaker currency can attract international tourists by making accommodation and other services more affordable.
ex.zh: 货币贬值可以降低住宿和其他服务的价格，从而吸引国际游客。

tip: 货币种类可数；泛指货币通常不可数。

senses.en: calm and not worried

ex.en: She felt relaxed after the long holiday.
ex.zh: 长假后她感到放松。

ex.en: The relaxed atmosphere made everyone comfortable.
ex.zh: 轻松的氛围让每个人都很自在。

tip: relaxed 形容人的感受；relaxing 形容事物令人放松。
scene: A person relaxing in a bath with candles and calm music.

senses.en: to phone someone back

ex.en: I'll ring you back after the meeting.
ex.zh: 会议后我给你回电话。

ex.en: She rang back ten minutes later.
ex.zh: 十分钟后她回了电话。

tip: ring back 是英式“回电话”；美式说 call back。
scene: A person returning a phone call at an office desk.

senses.en: An official award showing successful completion of education or training.
A skill or quality making someone suitable for a role.
A condition that limits the meaning or acceptance of something.

ex.en: This qualification helped me find work at a nursery.
ex.zh: 这个资格证书帮助我在一家幼儿园找到了工作。

ex.en: Employers increasingly value practical experience alongside formal qualifications when recruiting graduates for demanding professional roles.
ex.zh: 招聘毕业生担任要求较高的专业岗位时，雇主越来越重视实际经验与正式学历。

tip: 谈学历或资历常用复数qualifications。

senses.en: Living rather than dead
Full of energy, activity, or excitement

ex.en: The tiny plant is still alive after our holiday.
ex.zh: 我们度假回来后，那株小植物还活着。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats helps keep endangered species alive and preserves the ecological balance of entire regions.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地有助于让濒危物种存活，并维持整个地区的生态平衡。

tip: 通常放在系动词后；“活鱼”说a live fish。

senses.en: An important subject or problem that needs discussion.
To officially announce or give something to people.
One edition of a regularly published newspaper or magazine.

ex.en: We discussed the parking issue at our neighbourhood meeting.
ex.zh: 我们在邻里会议上讨论了停车问题。

ex.en: Governments must address the issue of housing affordability to ensure that young adults can live independently.
ex.zh: 政府必须解决住房负担能力问题，确保年轻人能够独立生活。

col: a controversial issue｜有争议的议题
tip: issue 作问题常指需讨论的议题，不一定是困难。

senses.en: to cook food in hot oil

ex.en: She fried the eggs for breakfast.
ex.zh: 她煎了鸡蛋当早餐。

ex.en: Fry the onions until they are soft.
ex.zh: 把洋葱煎软。

tip: fry 是“煎/炸”；boil 煮，roast 烤。
scene: Eggs frying in a pan with oil in a kitchen.

senses.en: a way to solve a problem or answer a question
a liquid containing a substance dissolved in it

ex.en: Adding another shelf was a simple solution to the clutter.
ex.zh: 再加一个架子是解决杂乱问题的简单办法。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy offers a long-term solution to the environmental problems caused by fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源为化石燃料造成的环境问题提供了长期解决方案。

col: a solution to a problem｜问题的解决办法
find a solution｜找到解决办法
a practical solution｜切实可行的办法
tip: 表示“……的解决办法”用solution to，不用solution of。

senses.en: a machine that blows hot air to dry hair

ex.en: She dried her hair with a hairdryer.
ex.zh: 她用吹风机吹干了头发。

ex.en: The hairdryer is in the bathroom drawer.
ex.zh: 吹风机在浴室的抽屉里。

tip: hairdryer 是吹风机（美式也拼 hair dryer）。
scene: A hairdryer on a bathroom shelf next to a mirror.

senses.en: used to encourage or hurry someone

ex.en: Come on, we're going to be late!
ex.zh: 快点，我们要迟到了！

ex.en: Come on, you can do it!
ex.zh: 加油，你能做到的！

tip: come on 是鼓励/催促用语“快、加油”。
scene: A coach clapping and encouraging runners on a track.

senses.en: as a result of what has just been stated

ex.en: The shop was closed; therefore, we went home empty-handed.
ex.zh: 商店关门了，因此我们空手回了家。

ex.en: Public parks encourage physical activity and social interaction; therefore, cities should invest in maintaining accessible green spaces.
ex.zh: 公共公园有助于促进体育活动和社交互动，因此城市应投入资金维护方便使用的绿地。

tip: 是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个完整句子。

senses.en: A regular way of doing things in a particular order.
Done regularly as part of the usual process.
A planned sequence of movements in a performance.

ex.en: A short walk is part of my morning routine.
ex.zh: 短距离散步是我每天早晨的固定安排之一。

ex.en: Maintaining a regular sleep routine can improve concentration and help students cope with academic pressure.
ex.zh: 保持规律的睡眠作息能提高注意力，帮助学生应对学业压力。

col: establish a routine｜建立固定规律
tip: 名词指固定安排；形容词指按惯例进行的。

senses.en: To achieve what you are trying to do.
To take someone's position after they leave it.

ex.en: After several attempts, I succeeded in fixing the lamp.
ex.zh: 尝试了几次后，我终于把灯修好了。

ex.en: Students are more likely to succeed when schools provide consistent feedback and practical support.
ex.zh: 学校持续提供反馈和实际支持时，学生更有可能取得成功。

col: succeed in doing something｜成功做成某事
succeed as a manager｜作为经理取得成功
succeed someone as chair｜接替某人担任主席
tip: 表示成功做成某事，用succeed in doing，不用to do。

senses.en: not less than; anyway

ex.en: You should sleep at least eight hours a night.
ex.zh: 你每晚至少应该睡八小时。

ex.en: At least we tried our best.
ex.zh: 至少我们尽力了。

tip: at least 表示“至少”；反义 at most（至多）。
scene: A clock showing eight on a bedside table with a child asleep.

senses.en: below the surface of the water

ex.en: The diver took photos of underwater plants.
ex.zh: 潜水员拍了水下植物的照片。

ex.en: The fish swim underwater near the rocks.
ex.zh: 鱼在岩石附近的水下游动。

tip: underwater 是“水下的/在水下”。
scene: A diver taking photos of colourful fish underwater.

senses.en: someone who freely offers to help, usually without payment
to freely offer to do something or give information

ex.en: A volunteer helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
ex.zh: 一位志愿者帮我们把箱子搬上了楼。

ex.en: Universities can encourage students to volunteer in their communities by offering flexible schedules and practical support.
ex.zh: 大学可以通过提供灵活的时间安排和实际支持，鼓励学生参与社区志愿服务。

col: volunteer to help｜主动提出帮忙
volunteer for a charity｜为慈善机构做义工
tip: 自愿做某事用volunteer to do；voluntary是常用形容词。

senses.en: to continue, or to happen

ex.en: Please go on with your story.
ex.zh: 请继续讲你的故事。

ex.en: What's going on here?
ex.zh: 这里发生了什么？

tip: go on 表示“继续”；What's going on? 是“发生了什么？”。
scene: A child continuing to read a storybook aloud.

senses.en: A statement about what is likely to happen in the future.
To say what will probably happen, using available information.

ex.en: The weather forecast says we should expect snow tonight.
ex.zh: 天气预报说今晚可能会下雪。

ex.en: Economists forecast slower growth next year as rising energy costs place greater pressure on businesses.
ex.zh: 经济学家预测，随着能源成本上涨给企业带来更大压力，明年的经济增长将放缓。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常用forecast，也可用forecasted。

senses.en: A device used to turn equipment on or off.
To change from one thing to another.
A change from one thing to another.

ex.en: The light switch is just behind the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 电灯开关就在厨房门后。

ex.en: Governments can encourage households to switch to renewable energy by offering financial support.
ex.zh: 政府可以提供经济支持，鼓励家庭改用可再生能源。

tip: switch on/off表示开关设备；switch to表示改用。

senses.en: Not severe or strong in effect
Pleasantly warm rather than cold
Not strong or spicy in flavour

ex.en: I have a mild headache, so I'll rest briefly.
ex.zh: 我有点头痛，所以要稍微休息一下。

ex.en: Even mild air pollution can affect vulnerable groups, making regular monitoring essential in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 即使轻度空气污染也会影响易受伤害的群体，因此人口密集的城市必须定期监测空气质量。

tip: mild 可形容症状、天气和味道，不等于“无害”。

senses.en: An inexpensive place to stay, often with shared rooms.
A place providing temporary accommodation for people needing support.

ex.en: We shared a room with other travellers at the hostel.
ex.zh: 我们在旅舍和其他旅行者合住一个房间。

ex.en: Youth hostels make international travel more affordable for students while encouraging interaction between people from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 青年旅舍让学生更能负担国际旅行，同时促进不同背景的人之间的交流。

tip: hostel常有多人间，hotel通常提供独立客房。

senses.en: a unit of length equal to 2.54 centimetres
to move very slowly over a short distance

ex.en: The shelf is an inch wider than the cupboard.
ex.zh: 这个架子比橱柜宽一英寸。

ex.en: During rush hour, buses inch through crowded streets, making public transport less attractive to commuters.
ex.zh: 高峰时段，公交车在拥挤的街道上缓慢行驶，降低了公共交通对通勤者的吸引力。

tip: 英寸符号为″；作动词表示一点点移动。
