A connection between things or the way they affect each other.

ex.en: She has a warm relationship with her younger sister.
ex.zh: 她和妹妹的关系很亲密。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在调查城市社区中绿地的可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

col: the relationship between A and B｜甲与乙之间的关系
tip: 与某人的关系用with；两者关系用between。

senses.en: to cause physical harm to a person or animal

ex.en: You could injure your back lifting that heavy box.
ex.zh: 搬那个重箱子可能会让你的背部受伤。

ex.en: Employers should provide safety training to reduce the risk of workers injuring themselves while operating machinery.
ex.zh: 雇主应提供安全培训，以降低工人操作机器时受伤的风险。

tip: injure通常指身体受伤；损坏物品常用damage。

senses.en: To say that something is wrong or unsatisfactory

ex.en: Our neighbours often complain about noise from the traffic.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居经常抱怨交通噪声。

ex.en: Residents may complain to local authorities when construction work repeatedly disrupts their sleep and daily activities.
ex.zh: 当施工反复影响睡眠和日常活动时，居民可能会向地方当局投诉。

col: complain to the manager｜向经理投诉
tip: 向某人投诉某事：complain to sb about sth。

senses.en: A job requiring specialist knowledge and usually advanced training.
All the people working in a particular specialist occupation.
An open statement of a belief, feeling, or intention.

ex.en: Nursing is a demanding profession, but my sister loves it.
ex.zh: 护理是个要求很高的职业，但我姐姐很喜欢。

ex.en: The teaching profession needs greater public support to attract talented graduates and retain experienced staff.
ex.zh: 教师行业需要更多公众支持，以吸引优秀毕业生并留住经验丰富的教师。

col: enter a profession｜进入某职业领域
a profession of faith｜信仰的公开表白
tip: profession通常指需专门训练的职业，比job范围窄。

senses.en: A practice combining body positions, controlled breathing, and mental focus.

ex.en: She does yoga on a mat beside the window.
ex.zh: 她在窗边的垫子上练瑜伽。

ex.en: Offering yoga classes in community centres may help residents manage stress and maintain flexibility.
ex.zh: 在社区中心开设瑜伽课可能有助于居民缓解压力并保持身体柔韧。

tip: 练瑜伽用do或practise yoga，不用play。

senses.en: An area of sea partly enclosed by land.
A designated space within a building or parking area.

ex.en: Small fishing boats floated in the sheltered bay.
ex.zh: 小渔船漂浮在避风的海湾里。

ex.en: Coastal development around the bay must be carefully managed to protect marine habitats and local livelihoods.
ex.zh: 必须谨慎管理海湾周边的沿海开发，以保护海洋栖息地和当地居民的生计。

tip: bay主要指海湾；停车或装卸语境中指专用区域。

senses.en: An area around people's homes within a town or city.
The people living in a particular local area.

ex.en: A small bakery has just opened in our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 我们街区刚开了一家小面包店。

ex.en: Investing in neighbourhood parks can improve residents' health while creating opportunities for people to meet and socialise.
ex.zh: 投资建设社区公园可以改善居民健康，同时创造见面和社交的机会。

tip: 英式拼写为neighbourhood，美式为neighborhood。

senses.en: Behave or feel in response to something that happens.
Change chemically when combined with another substance.

ex.en: How did your sister react to the surprise party?
ex.zh: 你姐姐对这场惊喜派对有什么反应？

ex.en: Governments must react quickly to public health emergencies while providing clear information to citizens.
ex.zh: 政府必须迅速应对公共卫生紧急事件，同时向公众提供清晰的信息。

col: react to news｜对消息作出反应
tip: 对某事反应用react to；与物质反应用react with。

senses.en: Having an uneven surface that is not smooth.
Not exact, detailed, or completely finished.
Difficult to experience, or involving strong, uncontrolled movement or force.

ex.en: The rough wooden bench scratched my bare legs.
ex.zh: 粗糙的木长凳刮到了我裸露的小腿。

ex.en: A rough estimate of construction costs can help local authorities decide whether a housing project is affordable.
ex.zh: 粗略估算建筑成本有助于地方政府判断是否负担得起某个住房项目。

tip: rough estimate是粗略估计；rough中的gh发/f/。

senses.en: Not accurate, true, or right.

ex.en: The delivery failed because our address details were incorrect.
ex.zh: 由于我们的地址信息有误，配送未能成功。

ex.en: Incorrect information shared online can undermine public understanding of health issues and influence important personal decisions.
ex.zh: 网上传播的错误信息会妨碍公众理解健康问题，并影响重要的个人决定。

tip: incorrect比wrong正式，常用于答案、信息或数据。

senses.en: During the same time or while something else is happening.

ex.en: The soup is simmering; meanwhile, I will prepare dessert.
ex.zh: 汤正在慢炖；趁这会儿，我来准备甜点。

ex.en: New railway lines may take years to complete; meanwhile, cities should improve existing bus services.
ex.zh: 新铁路线可能需要多年才能建成；在此期间，城市应改善现有的公交服务。

tip: 连接两个完整句子时，前面用句号或分号。

senses.en: completely or entirely
when everything or everyone is counted
when considering everything

ex.en: We stopped going to that crowded café altogether.
ex.zh: 我们彻底不再去那家拥挤的咖啡馆了。

ex.en: Although online courses improve access, they cannot altogether replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
ex.zh: 虽然在线课程扩大了学习机会，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。

tip: altogether是完全或总共；all together是全在一起。

senses.en: pain in your ear

ex.en: The child cried because of an earache.
ex.zh: 孩子因为耳朵疼哭了起来。

ex.en: She has an earache after swimming.
ex.zh: 游泳后她耳朵疼。

tip: earache 耳朵疼；toothache 牙疼；stomach ache 肚子疼。
scene: A child holding their ear and looking uncomfortable in bed.

senses.en: to keep something inside, or to stop someone going out

ex.en: We had to keep in the cat during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间我们只能把猫关在家里。

ex.en: Keep your hands in your pockets to stay warm.
ex.zh: 把手放在口袋里保暖。

tip: keep in 表示“关在屋内/放在里面”。
scene: A cat looking out of a window while kept inside a house.

senses.en: because of

ex.en: The match was cancelled due to heavy rain.
ex.zh: 比赛因大雨被取消。

ex.en: The delay was due to a technical problem.
ex.zh: 延误是由于技术问题。

tip: due to 是正式说法，等于 because of，后接名词。
scene: A rainy football pitch with an umbrella and a cancelled sign.

senses.en: something you want or plan to achieve
to intend or try to achieve something
to point something towards a particular target

ex.en: My main aim today is to tidy the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我今天的主要目标是把厨房收拾整齐。

ex.en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
ex.zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。

col: aim to do something｜力求做某事
with the aim of｜以……为目的
aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable.
Very great in amount, degree, or intensity.

ex.en: You did a terrific job fixing that old bicycle.
ex.zh: 你把那辆旧自行车修得真棒。

ex.en: Community gardens offer a terrific opportunity for residents to exercise outdoors while developing stronger social connections.
ex.zh: 社区花园为居民提供了极好的机会，让他们在户外锻炼的同时建立更紧密的社会联系。

tip: 常用于口语赞扬；别与terrible“糟糕的”混淆。

senses.en: mostly, or more than anything else

ex.en: This little shop mainly sells fresh bread and cakes.
ex.zh: 这家小店主要卖新鲜面包和蛋糕。

ex.en: Many rural communities depend mainly on agriculture, making them particularly vulnerable to changes in weather patterns.
ex.zh: 许多农村社区主要依赖农业，因此尤其容易受到天气模式变化的影响。

tip: 表示“主要而非全部”；常放在实义动词前。

senses.en: to become aware of a fact or understand a situation
to make a hope, ambition, or possibility become real

ex.en: I suddenly realised my keys were still inside the house.
ex.zh: 我突然意识到钥匙还在屋里。

ex.en: Many students realise the importance of time management when they begin balancing academic work with paid employment.
ex.zh: 许多学生开始兼顾学业与有偿工作时，才意识到时间管理的重要性。

col: realise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
realise your potential｜发挥你的潜能
tip: 英式常写realise，美式写realize；可接that从句。

senses.en: next; coming after something

ex.en: The following day, we visited the museum.
ex.zh: 第二天我们参观了博物馆。

ex.en: Please answer the following questions.
ex.zh: 请回答以下问题。

tip: the following day 是“第二天”；following 也作“以下的”。
scene: A calendar with the next day circled after today.

senses.en: agreement allowing someone to do something

ex.en: You need permission to borrow your sister's bicycle.
ex.zh: 你得先征得姐姐同意，才能借她的自行车。

ex.en: Researchers must obtain permission from participants before collecting personal information for a scientific study.
ex.zh: 研究人员为科学研究收集个人信息前，必须征得参与者同意。

col: permission to do something｜做某事的许可
tip: 通常不可数；说give permission，不加a。

senses.en: a small shallow dish placed underneath a cup

ex.en: She placed a biscuit on the saucer beside her cup.
ex.zh: 她把一块饼干放在茶托上，紧挨着杯子。

ex.en: Traditional tea sets, including matching cups and saucers, can reflect local craftsmanship and cultural preferences.
ex.zh: 传统茶具，包括配套的茶杯和茶碟，可以体现当地的手工艺和文化偏好。

tip: saucer是杯子下的小碟；flying saucer指飞碟。

senses.en: A raised outdoor platform attached to a building, with a railing.
An upper level of seats in a theatre.

ex.en: She grows herbs in small pots on her balcony.
ex.zh: 她在阳台上的小盆里种香草。

ex.en: Apartments with a balcony offer residents valuable outdoor space, particularly in cities where public gardens are scarce.
ex.zh: 带阳台的公寓为住户提供了宝贵的户外空间，在公共花园稀少的城市尤其如此。

tip: 在阳台上用on the balcony，不用in。

senses.en: feeling tired and ready to sleep
quiet and having very little activity

ex.en: I felt sleepy after lunch and took a short nap.
ex.zh: 午饭后我觉得困，就小睡了一会儿。

ex.en: Students who feel sleepy during lessons may struggle to concentrate and retain new information effectively.
ex.zh: 上课时感到困倦的学生可能难以集中注意力，也难以有效记住新知识。

tip: sleepy是想睡的；asleep是已经睡着的。

senses.en: A film or programme presenting facts about real subjects.
Consisting of or supported by written documents.

ex.en: We watched a documentary about penguins after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们看了一部关于企鹅的纪录片。

ex.en: A well-researched documentary can raise public awareness of environmental problems without oversimplifying their causes.
ex.zh: 一部经过充分调研的纪录片能够提高公众对环境问题的认识，同时避免过度简化其成因。

col: documentary about wildlife｜关于野生动物的纪录片
tip: 作名词指纪录片；documentary evidence指书面证据。

senses.en: To experience physical pain or mental distress.
To experience something harmful or become worse.

ex.en: I suffer from headaches when I skip lunch.
ex.zh: 我不吃午饭时就会头痛。

ex.en: Small businesses often suffer financial losses when major roadworks prevent customers from reaching their premises.
ex.zh: 大型道路施工导致顾客无法到店时，小企业往往会遭受经济损失。

tip: 疾病常用suffer from；损失、损坏常直接接在suffer后。

senses.en: A small stand or space where goods are sold.
To stop progress or deliberately delay action.
For an engine to stop unexpectedly, or cause this.

ex.en: We bought fresh peaches from a small roadside stall.
ex.zh: 我们在路边的一个小摊买了新鲜桃子。

ex.en: Negotiations may stall if governments cannot agree on how to share the costs of reducing emissions.
ex.zh: 如果各国政府无法就如何分担减排成本达成一致，谈判可能会陷入停滞。

col: stall an engine｜使发动机熄火
tip: 作动词可指发动机熄火，也可指谈判等陷入停滞。

senses.en: A light, gentle wind
Something that is very easy to do
Move or complete something easily and confidently

ex.en: A cool breeze lifted the curtains beside my bed.
ex.zh: 一阵凉风吹起了我床边的窗帘。

ex.en: Coastal parks offer residents pleasant places to exercise while enjoying the fresh sea breeze.
ex.zh: 沿海公园为居民提供了宜人的锻炼场所，让他们同时享受清新的海风。

col: breeze through an exam｜轻松通过考试
tip: be a breeze是口语，表示“轻而易举”。

senses.en: An improvement or development in a particular field
Move forward or help something develop
Done or provided before a particular time or event

ex.en: This new treatment is a major advance in medicine.
ex.zh: 这种新疗法是医学上的一大进步。

ex.en: Advances in renewable energy technology could reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve long-term energy security.
ex.zh: 可再生能源技术的进步可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并改善长期能源安全。

tip: in advance表示提前；advanced表示先进的或高级的。

senses.en: Work done to keep a home clean and tidy.

ex.en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
ex.zh: 我们分担家务，这样就没人需要独自在周日打扫了。

ex.en: Sharing housework fairly allows family members to balance paid employment with responsibilities at home more effectively.
ex.zh: 公平分担家务可以让家庭成员更有效地平衡有偿工作与家庭责任。

tip: 不可数，不能说a housework；做家务用do。

senses.en: the activity of buying and selling goods or services
to buy, sell, or exchange goods or services
a skilled job, especially one involving practical work

ex.en: At lunch, I traded my apple for a pear.
ex.zh: 午饭时，我用自己的苹果换了一个梨。

ex.en: International trade can create employment, but governments must ensure that workers receive fair wages and adequate protection.
ex.zh: 国际贸易可以创造就业，但政府必须确保工人获得公平的工资和充分的保障。

tip: trade A for B指用A换B；by trade指职业上。

senses.en: A place where people are kept as punishment for crimes.
The state of being kept in a prison.

ex.en: The old prison has become a popular local museum.
ex.zh: 这座旧监狱已成为当地一处受欢迎的博物馆。

ex.en: Education programmes in prison can help individuals develop skills that support their successful return to society.
ex.zh: 监狱内的教育项目能帮助服刑人员培养技能，支持他们顺利回归社会。

tip: in prison指服刑；in the prison强调在监狱内。

senses.en: A person or group that opposes or wants to harm another.
Something that seriously harms or threatens something else.

ex.en: In the story, the prince becomes friends with his enemy.
ex.zh: 故事里，王子和他的敌人成了朋友。

ex.en: Public distrust can become an enemy of effective environmental policy, particularly when governments fail to explain their decisions.
ex.zh: 公众的不信任可能成为有效环境政策的大敌，尤其是在政府未能解释其决策时。

tip: enemy指敌人；比赛对手通常用opponent。

senses.en: to find information, or to raise your eyes

ex.en: Look up the word in the dictionary.
ex.zh: 在词典里查这个词。

ex.en: Things are looking up for our team.
ex.zh: 我们队的情况正在好转。

tip: look up 表示“查阅（资料）”；look up to 是“尊敬”。
scene: A student looking up a word in a dictionary at a desk.

senses.en: A person or organisation that pays people to work.

ex.en: My employer lets me work from home on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我的雇主允许我每周五在家办公。

ex.en: Employers can improve staff retention by offering fair wages, flexible schedules, and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 雇主可以通过提供公平的薪资、灵活的工作安排和职业发展机会来提高员工留任率。

col: a major employer｜大型用人单位
tip: employer是雇主；employee是雇员。

senses.en: To an extremely high degree.
In a way that is surprising or hard to believe.

ex.en: The soup was incredibly hot, so I waited.
ex.zh: 汤特别烫，所以我等了一会儿。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can be incredibly valuable to older residents who no longer drive.
ex.zh: 对于不再开车的老年居民来说，可靠的公共交通可能极其重要。

tip: 常修饰形容词或副词；句首可表示“难以置信的是”。

senses.en: used in speech to check understanding

ex.en: You know, the new café near the station.
ex.zh: 你知道的，车站附近那家新咖啡馆。

ex.en: It's a really nice place, you know.
ex.zh: 那是个很棒的地方，你懂的。

tip: you know 是口语填充语，用于引出对方已知的信息。
scene: Two friends chatting at a table, one gesturing with a hand.

senses.en: the bright flash of light in a storm

ex.en: Lightning lit up the sky during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中闪电照亮了天空。

ex.en: We saw lightning in the distance.
ex.zh: 我们看到了远处的闪电。

tip: lightning 是闪电；thunder 是雷声。
scene: A bright lightning bolt striking across a dark stormy sky.

senses.en: to hit someone to the ground, or to destroy a building

ex.en: The strong wind knocked down the old fence.
ex.zh: 大风把旧篱笆刮倒了。

ex.en: They plan to knock down the old building.
ex.zh: 他们计划拆除旧楼。

tip: knock down 表示“撞倒/拆除”。
scene: A digger knocking down an old brick wall.

senses.en: not any of the people or things being considered
not at all, used before certain comparative expressions

ex.en: I checked the biscuit tin, but there were none left.
ex.zh: 我看了看饼干罐，但一块也没剩下。

ex.en: Although several solutions were proposed, none addressed the underlying causes of inequality in access to education.
ex.zh: 虽然提出了多种解决办法，但没有一种触及教育机会不平等的根本原因。

col: none other than｜正是；不是别人而是
tip: none可独立用；修饰名词用no，如no books。

senses.en: using science to design and build machines, structures, or systems

ex.en: My cousin studies engineering and builds small robots at home.
ex.zh: 我的表哥学工程，平时在家制作小型机器人。

ex.en: Advances in engineering have enabled cities to build bridges that withstand extreme weather and carry heavier traffic.
ex.zh: 工程技术的进步使城市能够建造抵御极端天气、承载更大交通量的桥梁。

tip: 表示学科或技术领域时不可数；engineer可指工程师。

senses.en: likely to damage physical or mental health
not in good physical condition
harmful or excessive in a way that causes problems

ex.en: Eating only biscuits for dinner is an unhealthy habit.
ex.zh: 晚餐只吃饼干是个不健康的习惯。

ex.en: Advertising unhealthy foods to children may contribute to poor dietary habits and higher rates of obesity.
ex.zh: 向儿童投放不健康食品广告，可能导致不良饮食习惯和更高的肥胖率。

col: an unhealthy diet｜不健康的饮食
an unhealthy lifestyle｜不健康的生活方式
tip: unhealthy可指事物伤身，也可指身体状况差。

senses.en: correct and free from mistakes
able to hit or reach the intended target

ex.en: This kitchen scale is accurate enough for baking bread.
ex.zh: 这台厨房秤的精度足以用来做面包。

ex.en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。

tip: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

senses.zh: 科学的；符合科学方法的
senses.en: relating to science or using methods based on evidence

ex.en: Our class used scientific methods to test the water.
ex.zh: 我们班用科学方法检测了水质。

ex.en: Governments should rely on scientific evidence when developing policies to protect public health.
ex.zh: 政府在制定保护公众健康的政策时，应依据科学证据。

tip: scientific强调科学依据，不等于仅仅有条理。

senses.en: immediately, right now

ex.en: Come here at once! It's important.
ex.zh: 马上过来！有重要的事。

ex.en: She answered the phone at once.
ex.zh: 她立刻接了电话。

tip: at once 是“立刻、马上”的意思。
scene: A parent calling a child to come at once from the doorway.

senses.en: The work done to get ready for something.

ex.en: Dinner preparation takes longer when the children help.
ex.zh: 孩子们帮忙时，准备晚饭反而要花更长时间。

ex.en: Thorough preparation for job interviews can help graduates communicate their skills and experience more confidently.
ex.zh: 充分准备求职面试能帮助毕业生更自信地介绍自己的技能和经验。

tip: 泛指准备时不可数；具体筹备工作常用复数preparations。

senses.en: A warning signal or device, or something that wakes you.
A sudden feeling of fear or worry.
To make someone frightened or worried.

ex.en: My alarm rang before sunrise, waking the whole family.
ex.zh: 我的闹钟在日出前响了，把全家人都吵醒了。

ex.en: Every school should test its fire alarm regularly to ensure that pupils receive an immediate warning.
ex.zh: 每所学校都应定期测试火灾警报器，确保学生能立即收到警报。

tip: 警报响起用go off，不是go on。

senses.en: An official document proving a fact or qualification.

ex.en: Lena proudly showed her swimming certificate to her grandparents.
ex.zh: 莉娜自豪地向祖父母展示了她的游泳证书。

ex.en: A professional certificate can improve employment prospects, but employers also value practical experience.
ex.zh: 专业资格证书可以改善就业前景，但雇主也重视实践经验。

col: a professional certificate｜专业资格证书
tip: certificate泛指证明或资格证书，不一定是学位。

senses.en: Not interesting or exciting.
Not bright or sunny.
Having an edge that does not cut easily.

ex.en: The film was so dull that I nearly fell asleep.
ex.zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我差点睡着。

ex.en: Lessons can seem dull when students have few opportunities to ask questions or explore ideas independently.
ex.zh: 如果学生很少有机会提问或独立探索想法，课堂就可能显得枯燥。

tip: 形容刀刃时指“钝”，形容活动时指“无聊”。

senses.en: Related to electricity or equipment that uses it.

ex.en: An electrical fault left our kitchen in darkness.
ex.zh: 一处电路故障让我们的厨房一片漆黑。

ex.en: Regular inspections of electrical equipment can reduce fire risks in crowded residential buildings and workplaces.
ex.zh: 定期检查电气设备可以降低人口密集的住宅楼和工作场所的火灾风险。

tip: electrical常指电气领域；electric常指电驱动的。

senses.en: Things people wear to cover or protect their bodies.

ex.en: Pack some warm clothing for our weekend camping trip.
ex.zh: 为我们周末的露营之旅带些保暖衣物。

ex.en: The clothing industry can reduce its environmental impact by using recycled materials and designing products that last longer.
ex.zh: 服装行业可以通过使用再生材料和设计更耐穿的产品来减少对环境的影响。

col: an item of clothing｜一件衣物
tip: clothing不可数；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

senses.en: information that makes something easier to understand
a reason given for why something happened

ex.en: Her simple explanation helped me understand the new game.
ex.zh: 她简单的讲解让我明白了这个新游戏。

ex.en: One possible explanation for declining car ownership is the growing availability of reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 汽车拥有率下降的一个可能原因，是可靠的公共交通越来越普及。

tip: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。

senses.en: Before a planned event or a particular time.

ex.en: We booked our train tickets two weeks in advance.
ex.zh: 我们提前两周订好了火车票。

ex.en: Publishing consultation dates well in advance allows more residents to participate in local planning decisions.
ex.zh: 早早公布咨询会日期，可以让更多居民参与地方规划决策。

tip: in advance可独立用；接事件用in advance of。

senses.en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is
the distance of something above the ground or sea
the time when something is strongest or most successful

ex.en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
ex.zh: 她调节了椅子的高度，让双脚能够踩到地面。

ex.en: Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 限制新建筑的高度可以保护历史景观，并保留老街区的特色。

col: average height｜平均身高；平均高度
at a height of｜在……的高度
at the height of｜在……的鼎盛时期
tip: height 是名词；形容人高用 tall，物体高可用 high。

senses.en: Unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped.

ex.en: I was disappointed when rain cancelled our beach picnic.
ex.zh: 下雨导致我们的海滩野餐取消，我很失望。

ex.en: Graduates may feel disappointed if their first jobs offer few opportunities to apply the skills they have learned.
ex.zh: 如果第一份工作很少提供运用所学技能的机会，毕业生可能会感到失望。

col: disappointed to hear｜听到……感到失望
tip: disappointed形容人的感受；disappointing形容令人失望的事物。

senses.en: A strong protective covering worn on the head

ex.en: Fasten your helmet before you get on the bicycle.
ex.zh: 骑上自行车前，先扣好头盔。

ex.en: Wearing a helmet can reduce the risk of serious head injuries among cyclists involved in accidents.
ex.zh: 骑车时佩戴头盔，可以降低事故中头部严重受伤的风险。

tip: 可数名词：戴头盔用wear a helmet。

senses.en: shining with many small flashes of light
containing bubbles of gas

senses.zh: 生动有趣的；才华横溢的
senses.en: lively, clever, and entertaining

ex.en: She held the sparkling bracelet up to the sunlight.
ex.zh: 她把闪闪发亮的手链举到阳光下。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce packaging waste by serving locally filtered sparkling water rather than imported bottled alternatives.
ex.zh: 餐厅可以供应本地过滤的气泡水，代替进口瓶装水，从而减少包装废弃物。

tip: 饮用水中sparkling指含气泡，still指无气泡。

senses.en: a loose top and trousers worn for sleeping

ex.en: I put on my pyjamas and climbed into bed.
ex.zh: 我穿上睡衣裤，爬上了床。

ex.en: Choosing comfortable pyjamas and maintaining a regular bedtime may help children establish healthier sleep routines.
ex.zh: 选择舒适的睡衣裤并保持固定的就寝时间，可能有助于儿童养成更健康的睡眠习惯。

col: a pair of pyjamas｜一套睡衣裤
tip: 用复数；一套用a pair of；美式拼pajamas。

senses.en: on the farther side of something
outside a particular limit, range, or ability
at or towards a place farther away

ex.en: A narrow path leads to the beach beyond the dunes.
ex.zh: 一条狭窄的小路通向沙丘另一边的海滩。

ex.en: The benefits of university education extend beyond employment prospects to include personal growth and greater social awareness.
ex.zh: 大学教育的益处不仅限于就业前景，还包括个人成长和更强的社会意识。

tip: beyond不仅表位置，也可表示超出能力或限度。

senses.en: Try to win or succeed against others.
Take part in a sporting event or other contest.

ex.en: Several bakeries compete for customers on our street.
ex.zh: 我们街上的几家面包店都在争取顾客。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。

col: compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

senses.en: money given by an organisation for a particular purpose
to officially give someone something they request
to accept that something is true, often reluctantly

ex.en: A small grant helped us repair the village playground.
ex.zh: 一笔小额补助金帮助我们修好了村里的游乐场。

ex.en: Governments should provide research grants to universities developing affordable technologies for reducing household energy consumption.
ex.zh: 政府应向研发低成本家庭节能技术的大学提供研究拨款。

col: apply for a grant｜申请补助金
take something for granted｜认为某事理所当然
tip: grant sb sth可改为grant sth to sb。

senses.en: Fair and sensible, showing good judgement.
Not too expensive.
Acceptable in quality or amount, though not excellent.

ex.en: Your suggestion sounds reasonable, so let's try it tomorrow.
ex.zh: 你的建议听起来很合理，我们明天试试吧。

ex.en: Employers should set reasonable targets that encourage productivity without placing excessive pressure on their staff.
ex.zh: 雇主应设定合理目标，在提高生产效率的同时避免给员工施加过大压力。

tip: 形容价格时指公道、不贵，不一定是非常便宜。

senses.en: a country in the south-west Pacific Ocean

ex.en: My aunt lives in Australia.
ex.zh: 我姑姑住在澳大利亚。

ex.en: Australia is famous for its beaches and wildlife.
ex.zh: 澳大利亚以海滩和野生动物闻名。

tip: Australia 是专有名词，注意首字母大写；澳大利亚人叫 Australian。
scene: A beach with kangaroos and the Sydney Opera House in the background.

senses.en: to use something as the starting point

ex.en: The film is based on a true story.
ex.zh: 这部电影根据真实故事改编。

ex.en: You should base your answer on the facts.
ex.zh: 你的回答应该以事实为依据。

tip: be based on 是“基于、以…为依据”，被动形式很常用。
scene: A film poster next to a book, showing the film is based on the book.

senses.en: a small camera used with a computer

ex.en: She turns off her webcam during online classes.
ex.zh: 上网课时她会关闭摄像头。

ex.en: The webcam has a built-in microphone.
ex.zh: 这个摄像头内置麦克风。

tip: webcam 是电脑摄像头，用于视频通话。
scene: A small webcam sitting on top of a laptop screen.

senses.en: able to live or act without relying on others
not controlled by another person, organisation, or country
not connected with or affected by something else

ex.en: Living alone has made me much more independent.
ex.zh: 独居让我变得更加独立。

ex.en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
ex.zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。

tip: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

senses.en: to end a relationship, or to break into pieces

ex.en: They broke up after three years together.
ex.zh: 他们在一起三年后分手了。

ex.en: The ice on the lake broke up in spring.
ex.zh: 春天湖面的冰裂开了。

tip: break up 常见义为“分手”；也指“解散、破碎”。
scene: Two people walking away in different directions on a street.

senses.en: on something, especially in formal or literary language
immediately after or at the time of an event

ex.en: The cat rested upon a cushion beside the window.
ex.zh: 猫趴在窗边的垫子上休息。

ex.en: Upon completing their training, new teachers should receive ongoing support from experienced colleagues at school.
ex.zh: 新教师完成培训后，应持续获得校内资深同事的支持。

tip: 比on正式；upon doing表示“一……就”。

senses.en: to continue to be in the same state
to stay in a place rather than leave
to still exist after other things have gone

ex.en: Please remain seated until the bus has stopped completely.
ex.zh: 请留在座位上，直到公交车完全停稳。

ex.en: Despite improvements in public transport, private cars remain the main means of travel in many rural areas.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，私家车仍是许多农村地区的主要出行工具。

col: remain a challenge｜仍是一项挑战
remain to be seen｜尚待分晓
tip: 表示保持某状态时，后接形容词或名词，不用副词。

senses.en: the value of one currency in another

ex.en: The exchange rate between the two currencies changed today.
ex.zh: 今天这两种货币的汇率变了。

ex.en: You can check the exchange rate online.
ex.zh: 你可以在网上查汇率。

tip: exchange rate 是汇率；currency exchange 是货币兑换。
scene: A currency exchange board showing different exchange rates.

senses.en: A book or other product that sells in very large quantities.

ex.en: Her first novel became a bestseller within weeks.
ex.zh: 她的第一部小说几周内就成了畅销书。

ex.en: A bestseller can introduce complex scientific ideas to readers who rarely engage with academic publications.
ex.zh: 畅销书能向很少接触学术出版物的读者介绍复杂的科学概念。

tip: 指畅销书或商品，不指畅销书作者。

senses.en: to build, hang or raise something

ex.en: They put up a tent in the garden.
ex.zh: 他们在花园里搭了一顶帐篷。

ex.en: Please put up your hand if you know the answer.
ex.zh: 知道答案请举手。

tip: put up 有“搭起、张贴、举起”等义。
scene: Two people putting up a tent in a garden.

senses.en: A king's or queen's daughter, or a prince's wife.

ex.en: The princess waved to the crowd from her carriage.
ex.zh: 公主从马车里向人群挥手。

ex.en: Traditional stories often portray a princess as dependent, whereas modern adaptations increasingly emphasise her independence and leadership.
ex.zh: 传统故事常将公主塑造成依赖他人的形象，而现代改编作品越来越强调她的独立性和领导力。

tip: 可指君主的女儿，也可指王子的妻子。

senses.en: to stop trying or stop doing something

ex.en: Don't give up; you are doing well!
ex.zh: 别放弃，你做得很好！

ex.en: He gave up smoking last year.
ex.zh: 他去年戒烟了。

tip: give up 表示“放弃”或“戒除（习惯）”。
scene: A coach encouraging a tired runner not to give up.

senses.en: To speak to a god to ask, thank, or worship.
To hope very strongly that something will happen.

ex.en: They gather quietly each morning to pray for peace.
ex.zh: 他们每天早晨静静地聚在一起，为和平祈祷。

ex.en: Providing quiet spaces allows people of different faiths to pray while studying or working on campus.
ex.zh: 提供安静的空间能让不同信仰的人在校园学习或工作期间祈祷。

tip: pray to 接祈祷对象，pray for 接所求之事。

senses.en: A woody plant with several branches growing near the ground.
Wild, uncultivated land, especially in Australia or Africa.

ex.en: A small bird was hiding in the rose bush.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟躲在玫瑰丛里。

ex.en: Planting native bushes in urban gardens can provide shelter and food for local wildlife.
ex.zh: 在城市花园中种植本地灌木，可以为当地野生动物提供庇护和食物。

tip: 灌木是可数名词；the bush可指澳洲等地的荒野。

senses.en: Happening quickly and unexpectedly

ex.en: A sudden gust blew my hat into the pond.
ex.zh: 一阵突如其来的风把我的帽子吹进了池塘。

ex.en: A sudden rise in food prices can place considerable pressure on families with low incomes.
ex.zh: 食品价格突然上涨会给低收入家庭带来相当大的压力。

tip: sudden是形容词；修饰动作通常用suddenly。

senses.en: to remove something unwanted

ex.en: We need to get rid of this old sofa.
ex.zh: 我们需要扔掉这张旧沙发。

ex.en: He got rid of his bad habit of staying up late.
ex.zh: 他改掉了熬夜的坏习惯。

tip: get rid of 是“摆脱/处理掉”。
scene: Two people carrying an old sofa out of a house.

senses.en: very pleasant or attractive in a way that delights people

ex.en: We found a charming little café beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边发现了一家迷人的小咖啡馆。

ex.en: Preserving charming historic neighbourhoods can attract visitors while strengthening residents' sense of belonging to their city.
ex.zh: 保护迷人的历史街区可以吸引游客，同时增强居民对城市的归属感。

tip: 既可形容人讨喜，也可形容地方迷人。

senses.en: to relax completely

ex.en: We chilled out by the pool all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在泳池边放松。

ex.en: Chill out! Everything will be fine.
ex.zh: 冷静点！一切都会好的。

tip: chill out 是口语“放松、冷静”。
scene: A person relaxing in a pool chair with sunglasses and a drink.

senses.en: a person who protects a building or people

ex.en: The security guard checked our bags at the entrance.
ex.zh: 保安在入口检查了我们的包。

ex.en: A security guard watches the building at night.
ex.zh: 保安夜里看守大楼。

tip: security guard 是保安/警卫人员。
scene: A security guard in uniform checking bags at a building entrance.

senses.en: The act of reaching a place.
A person or thing that has recently reached a place.

ex.en: Our arrival at the campsite was delayed by heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨耽误了我们抵达营地的时间。

ex.en: The arrival of faster rail services has made smaller towns more attractive to commuters seeking affordable housing.
ex.zh: 更快捷的铁路服务使小城镇对寻求可负担住房的通勤者更有吸引力。

col: arrival at the airport｜抵达机场
tip: on arrival意为一到达，相当于upon arrival。

senses.en: making you feel sad because it is not as good as hoped

ex.en: The film was disappointing; the ending was weak.
ex.zh: 这部电影令人失望，结尾很弱。

ex.en: It was disappointing that it rained on our picnic.
ex.zh: 野餐时下雨真让人失望。

tip: disappointing 形容事物；disappointed 形容人的感受。
scene: A person walking out of a cinema shaking their head.

senses.en: in person, looking at each other

ex.en: We talked face to face instead of texting.
ex.zh: 我们面对面交谈而不是发短信。

ex.en: She wanted to meet the singer face to face.
ex.zh: 她想和歌手面对面见面。

tip: face to face 是“面对面地”。
scene: Two people sitting across a table talking face to face.

senses.en: Happening often or at short intervals
Visit a particular place regularly

ex.en: Frequent buses make getting to the market easy.
ex.zh: 公交车班次密集，去市场很方便。

ex.en: Frequent changes in education policy can make it difficult for teachers to plan effective lessons.
ex.zh: 教育政策频繁变化，可能使教师难以规划有效的课堂教学。

tip: 形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: mathematics (American English)

ex.en: Math is my favourite subject at school.
ex.zh: 数学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

ex.en: She is good at math and science.
ex.zh: 她擅长数学和科学。

tip: math 是美式说法；英式说 maths。
scene: A blackboard with maths equations written on it.

senses.en: having happened or started a short time ago

ex.en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
ex.zh: 你看过我们家小狗最近的照片吗？

ex.en: Recent advances in medical technology have improved treatment options for patients living in remote communities.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的近期进步改善了偏远社区患者的治疗选择。

tip: recent是形容词；修饰动作要用recently。

senses.en: a piece of wax with a central string that burns

ex.en: He lit a candle when the electricity went off.
ex.zh: 停电时，他点了一支蜡烛。

ex.en: Although candles create a pleasant atmosphere, they should never be left burning unattended in homes or public spaces.
ex.zh: 虽然蜡烛能营造宜人的氛围，但在住宅或公共场所，绝不能让其在无人看管时燃烧。

col: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛
tip: 点蜡烛用light；吹灭用blow out。

senses.en: Unable to see.
Unwilling or unable to recognize facts or problems.
A window covering that can be raised or adjusted.

ex.en: My blind uncle reads stories using his fingertips.
ex.zh: 我失明的叔叔用指尖触读故事。

ex.en: Public transport systems should provide clear audio announcements to help blind passengers travel safely and independently.
ex.zh: 公共交通系统应提供清晰的语音播报，帮助失明乘客安全、独立地出行。

col: blind to the risks｜无视风险
tip: blind to表示未察觉或无视；窗帘义是可数名词。

senses.en: relaxed and not formal
done occasionally rather than regularly or permanently
done without much attention or serious thought

ex.en: You can wear casual clothes to dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚吃饭你可以穿休闲服。

ex.en: Casual employment offers flexibility, but workers may lack the financial security associated with permanent jobs.
ex.zh: 临时工作提供了灵活性，但从业者可能缺乏固定工作带来的经济保障。

tip: casual可指穿着随意，也可指工作非长期固定。

senses.en: on or towards the right side

ex.en: The shops are on the right-hand side of the street.
ex.zh: 商店在街道右侧。

ex.en: She is my right-hand helper in the office.
ex.zh: 她是我在办公室的得力助手。

tip: right-hand 是“右侧的”；right-hand side 右侧。
scene: A street with shops lined up on the right-hand side.

senses.en: a flower with layered petals, often growing on thorny stems
past tense of rise: moved upwards or increased

ex.en: She placed a single rose in a glass vase.
ex.zh: 她把一枝玫瑰插进了玻璃花瓶。

ex.en: Demand for public transport rose sharply after the city introduced cheaper fares and more frequent services.
ex.zh: 该市降低票价并增加班次后，公共交通需求大幅上升。

col: a bunch of roses｜一束玫瑰
tip: rose也可作rise的过去式；过去分词是risen。

senses.en: A small control you press to operate something
A small object that fastens clothing through a hole
Fasten clothing using buttons

ex.en: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
ex.zh: 按绿色按钮启动洗衣机。

ex.en: Emergency buttons on public transport allow passengers to alert staff quickly when assistance is needed.
ex.zh: 公共交通工具上的紧急按钮让乘客能够在需要帮助时迅速通知工作人员。

col: button up a coat｜扣好外套
sew on a button｜缝上纽扣
tip: button up指扣好纽扣；拉链用zip，不用button。

senses.en: Farm animals kept for their milk or meat.

ex.en: The cattle gathered under a tree during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中，牛群聚集在一棵树下。

ex.en: Raising cattle requires substantial land and water, which can place pressure on local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 养牛需要大量土地和水，这可能给当地生态系统带来压力。

tip: cattle是复数集合名词，用are；单头牛不用a cattle。

senses.en: the part of a country's military that uses planes

ex.en: His uncle is a pilot in the air force.
ex.zh: 他叔叔是空军飞行员。

ex.en: The air force held an air show at the airport.
ex.zh: 空军在机场举行了飞行表演。

tip: air force 是空军；navy 海军，army 陆军。
scene: Military jets flying in formation over an airfield.

senses.en: A plant substance used to add flavour to food.
To add spices to food.
Something that makes an experience more interesting or exciting.

ex.en: This warming spice gives the soup a lovely flavour.
ex.zh: 这种带来暖意的香料让汤的味道十分美妙。

ex.en: The historical spice trade connected distant societies and encouraged the exchange of agricultural knowledge and cooking techniques.
ex.zh: 历史上的香料贸易连接了遥远的社会，并促进了农业知识与烹饪技术的交流。

tip: spice不一定辣；spice up也可指增添趣味。

senses.en: a person who plays the guitar

ex.en: The guitarist played a beautiful solo.
ex.zh: 吉他手演奏了一段优美的独奏。

ex.en: She is a guitarist in a rock band.
ex.zh: 她是一支摇滚乐队的吉他手。

tip: guitarist 是吉他手；pianist 钢琴手。
scene: A guitarist playing an acoustic guitar on a small stage.

senses.en: Unwanted material that makes something unclean
Loose earth, especially on the ground

ex.en: Please wipe the dirt off your shoes before entering.
ex.zh: 进来之前，请把鞋上的泥污擦掉。

ex.en: Regular handwashing removes dirt and reduces the spread of infections in schools and other shared spaces.
ex.zh: 经常洗手可以去除污垢，减少学校及其他公共场所的感染传播。

tip: 通常不可数；表示“泥土”时多见于美式英语。

senses.en: a person who supports a team or an idea

ex.en: The football supporters cheered loudly.
ex.zh: 足球迷们大声欢呼。

ex.en: She is a strong supporter of the environment.
ex.zh: 她是环保的坚定支持者。

tip: supporter 是“支持者”；体育场景中指球迷。
scene: Football supporters cheering with scarves in a stadium.

senses.en: A glass or plastic device that produces electric light.
A rounded underground plant part that stores food and grows shoots.

ex.en: The kitchen bulb failed while I was washing dishes.
ex.zh: 我洗碗时，厨房的灯泡坏了。

ex.en: Replacing traditional bulbs with energy-efficient alternatives can reduce household electricity consumption and lower long-term costs.
ex.zh: 用节能灯泡替换传统灯泡可以减少家庭用电量，并降低长期成本。

tip: 既指灯泡，也指洋葱、水仙等植物的鳞茎。

senses.en: a tall crop with large heads of yellow edible seeds
grain crops such as wheat or barley, especially in British English

ex.en: We grilled fresh corn and served it with butter.
ex.zh: 我们烤了新鲜玉米，配着黄油一起吃。

ex.en: Farmers growing corn may need more efficient irrigation systems as droughts become increasingly frequent.
ex.zh: 随着干旱日益频繁，种植玉米的农民可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。

tip: 美式corn通常指玉米；英式也可泛指谷物。

senses.en: not true or based on facts
made to resemble something real or natural
intended to hide someone's real feelings or intentions

ex.en: That rumour about our neighbour is completely FALSE.
ex.zh: 那条关于我们邻居的传闻完全不实。

ex.en: Claims that all online information is reliable are FALSE, so students should learn to evaluate sources critically.
ex.zh: 声称所有网络信息都可靠是错误的，因此学生应学会批判性地评估信息来源。

tip: false指不真实；fake更强调刻意仿冒。通常写作小写。

senses.en: to demand something firmly despite disagreement
to state firmly that something is true

ex.en: My grandparents insist on paying for lunch every time.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母每次都坚持要付午餐钱。

ex.en: Many parents insist that schools provide regular physical education, even when academic subjects compete for classroom time.
ex.zh: 即使文化课挤占课时，许多家长仍坚决要求学校定期开设体育课。

col: insist on doing something｜坚持做某事
insist on payment｜坚持要求付款
tip: 用insist on doing，不用insist to do。

senses.en: to visit briefly, or to phone in

ex.en: She called in to see us on her way home.
ex.zh: 她回家路上顺便来看我们。

ex.en: Listeners can call in to the radio show.
ex.zh: 听众可以打电话进广播节目。

tip: call in 表示“顺便来访”或“打电话进来”。
scene: A friend popping by the front door with a small gift.

senses.en: Fine, dry particles that settle on surfaces or float.
To remove dust from a surface.
To cover something lightly with a powder.

ex.en: A thick layer of dust covered the old piano.
ex.zh: 那架旧钢琴上积了厚厚一层灰。

ex.en: Construction dust can reduce local air quality and cause breathing difficulties among nearby residents.
ex.zh: 施工扬尘会降低当地空气质量，并导致附近居民呼吸困难。

col: a layer of dust｜一层灰尘
dust the shelves｜掸去架子上的灰
dust with flour｜撒上少量面粉
tip: dust作动词既可指除尘，也可指撒粉，看宾语判断。

senses.en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth.
The projecting edge of a container, opening, or hollow.

ex.en: My lips felt dry after walking in the wind.
ex.zh: 在风中走了一阵后，我觉得嘴唇很干。

ex.en: Clear face coverings can improve communication for people who rely on watching lips to understand speech.
ex.zh: 透明面罩可以帮助那些依靠观察嘴唇来理解话语的人更顺畅地交流。

col: the lip of a cup｜杯口边缘
tip: 上下嘴唇合称lips；lip也可指容器等的边沿。

senses.en: travel for pleasure and the businesses serving people who travel

ex.en: Tourism brings many visitors to our village each summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天，旅游业都会为我们村带来许多游客。

ex.en: Sustainable tourism can generate income for local communities while protecting the natural landscapes that attract visitors.
ex.zh: 可持续旅游能为当地社区创造收入，同时保护吸引游客的自然景观。

tip: tourism通常不可数；表示一个游客用a tourist。

senses.en: a person who shares a room or flat with you

ex.en: My roommate is from Italy.
ex.zh: 我的室友来自意大利。

ex.en: She gets on well with her roommate.
ex.zh: 她和室友相处得很好。

tip: roommate 是室友；英式分房间共享说 flatmate/housemate。
scene: Two roommates chatting in a shared bedroom.

senses.en: wide; including many things

ex.en: They crossed a broad river by boat.
ex.zh: 他们乘船渡过一条宽阔的河。

ex.en: The course covers a broad range of topics.
ex.zh: 这门课程涵盖广泛的主题。

tip: broad 与 wide 都指“宽”；broad 也引申为“广泛的”。
scene: A wide river with a boat crossing under a bridge.

senses.en: To take money or property illegally from someone or somewhere.
To unfairly take away something valuable or important.

ex.en: Someone tried to rob the shop near our house.
ex.zh: 有人试图抢劫我们家附近的商店。

ex.en: Long working hours can rob parents of valuable opportunities to spend time with their children.
ex.zh: 过长的工作时间可能使父母失去与孩子共度时光的宝贵机会。

col: rob someone of something｜抢走某人某物
rob someone of opportunities｜剥夺某人的机会
tip: rob接人或地点；steal接被偷的物品。

senses.en: To be real or present in the world.
To stay alive, especially with very limited resources.

ex.en: Do you think creatures like these really exist?
ex.zh: 你觉得这样的生物真的存在吗？

ex.en: Significant differences in access to healthcare still exist between rural communities and major urban centres.
ex.zh: 农村社区与主要城市中心在医疗服务的可及性方面仍存在显著差异。

col: exist in nature｜存在于自然界
exist on limited resources｜靠有限资源维生
tip: 是不及物动词，不用被动语态；“不存在”用does not exist。

senses.en: To a noticeable degree, often more than expected.
Used with would to express a preference.
Used to correct or make a previous statement more accurate.

ex.en: This soup is rather salty, but the bread is delicious.
ex.zh: 这汤有点咸，不过面包很好吃。

ex.en: Many commuters would rather cycle to work if safer routes were available throughout the city.
ex.zh: 如果全市都有更安全的骑行路线，许多通勤者会更愿意骑车上班。

tip: would rather后接动词原形；rather than意为“而不是”。

senses.en: not important

ex.en: The colour of the box is unimportant.
ex.zh: 盒子的颜色不重要。

ex.en: Don't worry about unimportant details.
ex.zh: 别为无关紧要的细节担心。

tip: unimportant 是 important 的反义词“不重要的”。
scene: A person ignoring small unimportant papers on a desk.

senses.en: a man whose job is to deliver letters and parcels

ex.en: The postman left a parcel beside our front door.
ex.zh: 邮递员把一个包裹放在了我们家门旁。

ex.en: In remote villages, a postman may provide an essential link between residents and public services.
ex.zh: 在偏远村庄，邮递员可能是连接居民与公共服务的重要纽带。

col: work as a postman｜当邮递员
the postman's round｜邮递员的投递路线
tip: 英式常用；美式常用mail carrier，且不限定性别。

senses.en: to refer to someone or something briefly
a brief reference to someone or something

ex.en: Did you mention the broken window to the landlord?
ex.zh: 你向房东提过那扇坏了的窗户吗？

ex.en: Reports on urban transport often mention congestion but overlook the needs of people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 城市交通报告经常提到拥堵，却忽视行动不便人群的需求。

col: mention something to someone｜向某人提及某事
tip: 直接接所提内容：mention sth，不用 mention about。

senses.en: Luckily, especially when something bad could have happened.

ex.en: Fortunately, I found my keys before the bus arrived.
ex.zh: 幸好，我在公交车到站前找到了钥匙。

ex.en: Fortunately, improvements in water treatment have helped many communities reduce the spread of preventable diseases.
ex.zh: 幸运的是，水处理技术的改进帮助许多社区减少了可预防疾病的传播。

col: fortunately for us｜对我们来说幸运的是
fortunately, nobody was hurt｜幸好无人受伤
tip: 常置于句首，后加逗号，评价整件事令人庆幸。

senses.en: an area protected from direct sunlight
a particular form of a colour
to protect something from direct light

ex.en: We rested in the shade beneath a large tree.
ex.zh: 我们在一棵大树下的阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Planting trees along urban streets provides shade and can reduce residents' exposure to extreme summer heat.
ex.zh: 沿城市街道种树可以提供荫凉，减少居民受到夏季酷热的影响。

col: a shade of blue｜一种蓝色调
shade your eyes｜遮住眼睛挡光
tip: shade常指阴凉区域；shadow指物体投下的影子。

senses.en: To move or make something move by turning over repeatedly
To form something into a curved or cylindrical shape
Material wound around itself, or a small individual bread

ex.en: The orange rolled off the table and under my chair.
ex.zh: 橙子从桌上滚下来，滚到了我的椅子底下。

ex.en: Workers roll sheets of recycled material into compact bundles to simplify storage and transportation.
ex.zh: 工人把再生材料薄片卷成紧实的捆，以便储存和运输。

col: roll down a hill｜滚下山坡
roll up your sleeves｜卷起袖子
tip: roll强调翻转滚动；卷起常用roll up。

senses.en: the process of turning waste into materials usable again
waste materials collected to be processed and used again

ex.en: Our building has separate bins for recycling and food waste.
ex.zh: 我们这栋楼分别设有回收物桶和厨余垃圾桶。

ex.en: Effective recycling programmes require convenient collection services as well as clear public guidance on sorting household waste.
ex.zh: 有效的回收利用计划既需要便利的收集服务，也需要向公众明确说明如何分类生活垃圾。

tip: 通常不可数；表示回收活动或待回收的物品。

senses.en: to become something different

ex.en: The old factory turned into a museum.
ex.zh: 旧工厂变成了博物馆。

ex.en: Water turns into ice when it freezes.
ex.zh: 水结冰时变成冰。

tip: turn into 表示“变成”；turn A into B 把A变成B。
scene: An old factory building converted into a museum with visitors.

senses.en: actually; used to give more information

ex.en: I thought he was a teacher; in fact, he's a doctor.
ex.zh: 我以为他是老师，事实上他是医生。

ex.en: In fact, the city is quite small.
ex.zh: 事实上，这座城市很小。

tip: in fact 用来纠正或补充事实。
scene: Two people talking, one correcting the other with a fact.

senses.en: a dangerous and exciting sport

ex.en: Skydiving is an extreme sport.
ex.zh: 跳伞是一项极限运动。

ex.en: He loves extreme sports like rock climbing.
ex.zh: 他喜欢攀岩之类的极限运动。

tip: extreme sport 是极限运动，如跳伞、攀岩、冲浪等。
scene: A rock climber scaling a steep cliff face.

senses.en: always telling other people what to do

ex.en: Her older sister is a bit bossy.
ex.zh: 她姐姐有点爱发号施令。

ex.en: Don't be so bossy; let everyone decide.
ex.zh: 别这么专横，让大家自己决定。

tip: bossy 是形容词，形容喜欢指挥别人的人。
scene: A girl pointing and giving orders to friends in a playground.

senses.en: a room or building equipped for scientific work

ex.en: We wore safety glasses inside the school laboratory.
ex.zh: 我们在学校实验室里戴着护目镜。

ex.en: Investment in laboratory equipment enables university students to develop practical skills and conduct reliable experiments.
ex.zh: 投资实验室设备能让大学生培养实践技能并开展可靠的实验。

tip: 常缩写为lab；英美发音的重音位置不同。

senses.en: If this does not happen or is not done.
In all other ways apart from the one mentioned.
In a different way or with a different result.

ex.en: Take an umbrella; otherwise, you will get wet.
ex.zh: 带把伞吧，否则你会淋湿的。

ex.en: Cities must invest in reliable public transport; otherwise, more residents may choose to drive.
ex.zh: 城市必须投资建设可靠的公共交通，否则更多居民可能选择开车。

col: unless otherwise stated｜除非另有说明
otherwise healthy｜除此之外身体健康
tip: 表示“否则”时，书面语常在前面用分号。

senses.en: Give someone confidence or support to do something
Make an activity or development more likely

ex.en: My sister encouraged me to join the swimming club.
ex.zh: 姐姐鼓励我加入游泳俱乐部。

ex.en: Local governments can encourage cycling by providing safer routes and secure bicycle parking near workplaces.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以通过提供更安全的路线和工作场所附近的安全自行车停车设施来鼓励骑行。

col: encourage someone to do something｜鼓励某人做某事
tip: 用encourage sb to do sth表示鼓励某人做某事。

senses.en: So surprising or unlikely that it is hard to believe.
Extremely good or bad, causing strong surprise.

ex.en: The view from the mountain was unbelievable at sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出时山上的景色美得令人难以置信。

ex.en: Some online advertisements promise unbelievable results, making it difficult for consumers to distinguish evidence from exaggeration.
ex.zh: 一些网络广告承诺令人难以置信的效果，使消费者难以区分实证与夸大宣传。

col: an unbelievable story｜难以置信的故事
tip: 既可表示不可信，也可口语强调极好或极糟。

senses.en: a medicine that stops pain and fever

ex.en: She took an aspirin for her headache.
ex.zh: 她吃了片阿司匹林治头痛。

ex.en: Aspirin can help with a fever.
ex.zh: 阿司匹林有助于退烧。

col: take an aspirin｜吃一片阿司匹林
tip: take an aspirin 吃阿司匹林；服药说 take medicine。
scene: A hand taking a white medicine tablet out of a small packet.

senses.en: to be formed from particular parts or members
to have something as the essential feature

ex.en: Our picnic lunch consists of sandwiches, fruit, and juice.
ex.zh: 我们的野餐午饭有三明治、水果和果汁。

ex.en: An effective recycling programme consists of convenient collection services and clear guidance for local residents.
ex.zh: 有效的回收计划包括便捷的收集服务和面向当地居民的明确指引。

tip: consist of表组成，不用被动；consist in表在于。

senses.en: Happening once a year or relating to a whole year
A book or magazine published once each year
A plant that completes its life cycle within one year

ex.en: Our annual family picnic was held beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们一年一度的家庭野餐在湖边举行。

ex.en: The annual report provides useful evidence of how public funding has improved local transport services.
ex.zh: 年度报告提供了有用的证据，说明公共资金如何改善了当地交通服务。

tip: annual 表示每年的；annually 是副词，意为每年。

senses.en: Hair growing above the upper lip.

ex.en: My uncle carefully trims his moustache every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我叔叔每个星期天都会仔细修剪他的小胡子。

ex.en: In historical portraits, a carefully styled moustache often reflected contemporary ideas about fashion and social status.
ex.zh: 在历史肖像画中，精心打理的小胡子往往反映了当时关于时尚和社会地位的观念。

col: a thick moustache｜浓密的小胡子
tip: moustache指上唇胡须；beard指下巴等处的胡须。

senses.en: Choose someone or something carefully from available options.
Carefully chosen for special quality or suitability.

ex.en: Please select a fresh apple from the basket.
ex.zh: 请从篮子里挑选一个新鲜的苹果。

ex.en: Universities should select applicants using a range of criteria rather than relying entirely on examination results.
ex.zh: 大学应依据多种标准选拔申请者，而非完全依赖考试成绩。

col: select from a list｜从列表中选择
select someone for a role｜选某人担任角色
a select group｜精选的一群人
tip: select 比 choose 正式，常强调仔细挑选。

senses.en: a relationship between people, things, or ideas
a link that allows devices or systems to work together
a further bus, train, or flight taken during a journey

ex.en: Our internet connection stopped working during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间，我们的网络连接中断了。

ex.en: Researchers have found a strong connection between regular physical activity and improved mental health among young adults.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现，经常进行体育活动与年轻成年人心理健康改善之间存在密切联系。

tip: 表示两者的联系用connection between A and B。

senses.en: doing a job, or functioning

ex.en: The working hours here are nine to five.
ex.zh: 这里的工作时间是九点到五点。

ex.en: Is the machine still working?
ex.zh: 机器还在运转吗？

tip: working 是“工作的/运转的”；working hours 工作时间。
scene: People working at desks in an open office.

senses.en: An empty space between things or within something.
A difference between people, groups, or situations.
A period when something stops or does not happen.

ex.en: The kitten squeezed through a gap in the fence.
ex.zh: 小猫从篱笆的一个缺口钻了过去。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable education could narrow the gap between wealthy households and disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 让更多人获得负担得起的教育，可以缩小富裕家庭与弱势社区之间的差距。

col: a gap in the fence｜篱笆上的缺口
tip: 两者间的差距用 gap between A and B。

senses.en: A dry substance consisting of very small loose particles.
To put a layer of powder on something.

ex.en: Stir the cocoa powder into a little warm milk.
ex.zh: 把可可粉搅入少量温牛奶中。

ex.en: Some manufacturers turn surplus fruit into powder to extend its shelf life and reduce food waste.
ex.zh: 一些生产商将多余的水果制成果粉，以延长保质期并减少食物浪费。

tip: powder通常不可数；一勺粉用a spoonful of powder。

senses.en: attach something above the ground, or remain suspended
fall or bend downwards loosely

ex.en: Please hang your wet coat beside the front door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿外套挂在前门旁边。

ex.en: Museums often hang paintings at different heights to make their collections accessible to visitors of all ages.
ex.zh: 博物馆常将画作挂在不同高度，方便各年龄段的参观者欣赏馆藏。

col: hang on a wall｜挂在墙上
tip: 悬挂的过去式、过去分词均为hung；绞死则用hanged。

senses.en: Someone whose work involves politics, especially an elected government member.

ex.en: A local politician visited our neighbourhood to discuss transport.
ex.zh: 一位当地政治人物来到我们社区讨论交通问题。

ex.en: Politicians should consult local communities before making decisions that could affect access to public services.
ex.zh: 政治人物在作出可能影响公共服务获取的决定前，应征求当地社区的意见。

col: a local politician｜地方政治人物
an elected politician｜民选政治人物
a senior politician｜资深政治人物
tip: politician指从政者，本身不一定含贬义。

senses.en: An open container with a handle, or the amount it holds.

ex.en: She filled a bucket with water to wash the windows.
ex.zh: 她装了一桶水，准备用来擦窗户。

ex.en: Collecting rainwater in a bucket can help households reduce the amount of drinking water used for gardening.
ex.zh: 用桶收集雨水可以帮助家庭减少园艺活动中的饮用水用量。

tip: 一桶水用a bucket of water，of后接所装物。

senses.en: Causing worry or mental strain

ex.en: Moving house was stressful, but our friends helped.
ex.zh: 搬家让人压力很大，但朋友们帮了忙。

ex.en: Long commutes can make working life more stressful and leave less time for family activities.
ex.zh: 长时间通勤会增加工作生活的压力，并减少与家人活动的时间。

col: a stressful situation｜令人紧张的处境
a stressful job｜压力大的工作
a stressful experience｜令人紧张的经历
tip: stressful形容压力来源；stressed形容人的感受。

senses.en: Show that something is true using evidence
Turn out to be a particular thing or quality

ex.en: These photos prove that our dog opened the cupboard.
ex.zh: 这些照片证明是我们的狗打开了橱柜。

ex.en: Long-term studies may prove that regular exercise improves concentration as well as physical health.
ex.zh: 长期研究可能证实，经常锻炼既能改善注意力，也能增强身体健康。

col: prove a point｜证明一个观点
prove someone wrong｜证明某人错了
tip: prove可接that从句，也可直接接形容词。

senses.en: to make something more attractive by adding beautiful things
to paint walls or cover them with wallpaper

ex.en: We decorated the balcony with colourful pots and tiny lights.
ex.zh: 我们用彩色花盆和小灯装饰了阳台。

ex.en: Allowing students to decorate shared learning spaces may increase their sense of ownership and responsibility.
ex.zh: 允许学生装饰公共学习空间，可能增强他们的主人翁意识和责任感。

tip: decorate A with B表示用B装饰A。

senses.en: A large sea fish, or its white flesh eaten as food.

ex.en: We baked the cod with lemon and fresh herbs.
ex.zh: 我们用柠檬和新鲜香草烤了鳕鱼。

ex.en: Strict fishing limits can help cod populations recover while protecting the long-term livelihoods of coastal communities.
ex.zh: 严格的捕捞限额可以帮助鳕鱼种群恢复，同时保障沿海社区的长远生计。

tip: 鱼的单复数均为cod；指鳕鱼肉时不可数。

senses.en: An organised journey made for exploration or a specific purpose.
A group of people travelling together to explore or investigate.

ex.en: We packed warm clothes for our expedition into the mountains.
ex.zh: 我们为进山探险打包了保暖衣物。

ex.en: A scientific expedition to the polar regions collected valuable evidence of changes in sea ice.
ex.zh: 一支前往极地的科学考察队收集了海冰变化的重要证据。

col: an expedition to Antarctica｜南极考察
tip: expedition多指有组织、有特定目的的远行。

senses.en: someone who creates a device or process not previously existing

ex.en: The inventor showed us a lamp powered by sunlight.
ex.zh: 这位发明家向我们展示了一盏太阳能灯。

ex.en: Inventors often need financial support to turn promising ideas into practical technologies that benefit society.
ex.zh: 发明者往往需要资金支持，才能把有前景的想法转化为造福社会的实用技术。

col: a brilliant inventor｜杰出的发明家
an aspiring inventor｜有志成为发明家的人
tip: inventor创造新事物；discoverer发现已有事物。

senses.en: Go somewhere with someone.
Exist or happen together with something else.
Play music to support a singer or another musician.

ex.en: My sister will accompany me to the clinic tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天姐姐会陪我去诊所。

ex.en: Investment in public transport should accompany urban expansion to prevent congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 城市扩张应配合公共交通投资，以防止交通拥堵并改善就业可达性。

col: accompany on the piano｜用钢琴伴奏
tip: 直接接人作宾语，不说accompany with someone。

senses.en: a competition to decide the best player or team
the position or title of being a champion

ex.en: Our school team reached the final of the championship.
ex.zh: 我们校队打进了锦标赛的决赛。

ex.en: Hosting an international championship can attract visitors, but the cost of new facilities may burden local taxpayers.
ex.zh: 举办国际锦标赛可以吸引游客，但新建设施的费用可能加重当地纳税人的负担。

tip: 既可指争夺冠军的赛事，也可指冠军头衔。

senses.en: a particular time when something happens
an important or special event
a suitable opportunity to do something

ex.en: I have met your sister on several occasions.
ex.zh: 我见过你姐姐好几次。

ex.en: Community festivals provide an occasion for residents from different backgrounds to share traditions and build friendships.
ex.zh: 社区节庆让不同背景的居民有机会分享传统、建立友谊。

col: rise to the occasion｜成功应对挑战
tip: 表示“在某次场合”用on，不用in。

senses.en: A period or distance between events or objects.
A short break between parts of a performance.

ex.en: There was a short interval between the two calls.
ex.zh: 两通电话之间隔了一小会儿。

ex.en: Taking breaks at regular intervals can help students maintain concentration during long periods of study.
ex.zh: 长时间学习时，定时休息有助于学生保持专注。

col: at regular intervals｜每隔固定时间或距离
during the interval｜在幕间休息时
tip: at intervals表示每隔一段时间或距离。

senses.en: a choice made after considering different possibilities

ex.en: Moving closer to work was a good decision.
ex.zh: 搬到离工作地点更近的地方是个明智的决定。

ex.en: Governments should base every major transport decision on reliable evidence and consultation with the communities affected.
ex.zh: 政府的每项重大交通决策都应以可靠证据及与受影响社区的协商为基础。

col: informed decision｜基于充分了解的决定
tip: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。

senses.en: a relationship between people who like and support each other

ex.en: Our friendship began when we shared a school desk.
ex.zh: 我们的友谊始于上学时做同桌的日子。

ex.en: Close friendship can improve mental health by providing emotional support during periods of stress.
ex.zh: 亲密的友谊可以在压力时期提供情感支持，从而改善心理健康。

col: a bond of friendship｜友谊的纽带
tip: 泛指友谊不可数；具体一段友谊可数。

senses.en: Working well without wasting time, energy, or resources.

ex.en: Our new washing machine is quieter and more efficient.
ex.zh: 我们的新洗衣机更安静，也更节能。

ex.en: An efficient public transport network allows cities to move more people while consuming less energy.
ex.zh: 高效的公共交通网络使城市能够以更低的能耗运送更多乘客。

col: efficient use of resources｜高效利用资源
tip: efficient强调少浪费；effective强调达到预期效果。

senses.en: warmth or a high temperature
to make or become warmer
a race that decides who enters the next round

ex.en: We rested under a tree to escape the heat.
ex.zh: 我们在树下休息，躲避酷热。

ex.en: Cities can reduce extreme heat by planting trees and replacing dark surfaces with materials that reflect sunlight.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过植树以及用反射阳光的材料替换深色表面来缓解酷热。

tip: heat作名词指热，hot作形容词指热的。

senses.en: the way someone or something looks
an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present

ex.en: A fresh coat of paint transformed the room's appearance.
ex.zh: 重新刷了一层漆，房间的面貌焕然一新。

ex.en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
ex.zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。

col: improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

senses.en: Images or designs used on screens or in printed materials.

ex.en: The game's colourful graphics looked amazing on our new screen.
ex.zh: 这款游戏色彩鲜艳的画面在我们的新屏幕上看起来棒极了。

ex.en: Clear graphics can make complex scientific information easier to understand for audiences without specialist knowledge.
ex.zh: 清晰的图示能让没有专业知识的受众更容易理解复杂的科学信息。

tip: 指多个图像时用复数谓语：the graphics are。

senses.en: In a way that has no faults or mistakes.
Completely; used to emphasize a description.

ex.en: The new curtains match our sofa perfectly.
ex.zh: 新窗帘和我们的沙发非常相配。

ex.en: It is perfectly reasonable for residents to expect reliable public services in return for their taxes.
ex.zh: 居民纳税后期望获得可靠的公共服务，是完全合理的。

tip: perfectly clear意为十分清楚，不译作完美地清楚。

senses.en: The leader of a team or person commanding a vessel.
To lead a team or command a ship.
An officer holding a particular rank in the armed forces.

ex.en: Our captain gathered the team before the final match.
ex.zh: 决赛前，我们的队长把全队召集到一起。

ex.en: A team captain can encourage cooperation by ensuring that every player feels valued and included.
ex.zh: 队长可以通过确保每位队员都感到受到重视和接纳来促进合作。

col: captain a team｜率领一支队伍
tip: 军衔含义随军种变化；海军中通常指上校。

senses.en: Suitable or correct for a particular purpose or situation.
Real or satisfactory, rather than incomplete or inadequate.
Strictly understood, excluding surrounding or related things.

ex.en: You need proper shoes for walking on rocky paths.
ex.zh: 在碎石小路上走，你需要穿合适的鞋。

ex.en: Workers should receive proper training before operating machinery that could pose a risk to their safety.
ex.zh: 工人在操作可能危及自身安全的机器前，应接受适当培训。

col: a proper meal｜一顿像样的饭
tip: 表示“本身的”时放名词后，如the city proper。

senses.en: An unpleasant feeling about danger or something bad happening.
To feel afraid or worried about someone or something.

ex.en: She held my hand because of her fear of heights.
ex.zh: 她因为恐高而握住了我的手。

ex.en: Fear of failure may prevent students from asking questions, especially in highly competitive learning environments.
ex.zh: 对失败的恐惧可能使学生不敢提问，在竞争激烈的学习环境中尤其如此。

col: fear for someone's safety｜担心某人的安全
tip: fear sth是害怕某事；fear for sb是为某人担忧。

senses.en: To like or choose something more than another option.

ex.en: I prefer fresh fruit to cake after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，比起蛋糕，我更喜欢吃新鲜水果。

ex.en: Some employees prefer working from home because it offers greater flexibility and eliminates daily commuting.
ex.zh: 一些员工更喜欢居家办公，因为这样更灵活，也免去了每天通勤。

col: prefer A to B｜比起B更喜欢A
tip: 用prefer A to B；过去式preferred双写r。

senses.en: A long vegetable with green skin and crisp, watery flesh.

ex.en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
ex.zh: 她把一根黄瓜切成片，加入沙拉。

ex.en: Growing cucumbers in greenhouses can provide a reliable food supply, but heating these structures requires energy.
ex.zh: 在温室中种植黄瓜可以提供稳定的食物供应，但为这些设施供暖需要消耗能源。

col: as cool as a cucumber｜非常镇定
tip: 通常可数：a cucumber；表示食材时也可不可数。

senses.en: Lasting indefinitely rather than for a limited time.
Employed without a fixed end date.

ex.en: The hot pan left a permanent mark on the table.
ex.zh: 滚烫的锅在桌上留下了无法去除的印痕。

ex.en: Investment in flood prevention can reduce the risk of permanent damage to homes and public infrastructure.
ex.zh: 投资防洪措施可以降低住房和公共基础设施遭受永久性损害的风险。

tip: permanent job指无固定结束日期的工作，不保证终身任职。

senses.en: an event or struggle in which people compete to win
to formally challenge a decision, claim, or result
to compete for a position, prize, or political seat

ex.en: My cousin won a baking contest with her lemon cake.
ex.zh: 我表姐凭她做的柠檬蛋糕赢得了烘焙比赛。

ex.en: Citizens should have access to affordable legal advice when they wish to contest an official decision.
ex.zh: 公民希望对官方决定提出异议时，应能获得价格合理的法律咨询。

col: a close contest｜势均力敌的比赛
contest a decision｜对决定提出异议
tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: a simple drawing showing how something works or is arranged
to explain or represent something using a simple drawing

ex.en: The diagram shows how to put the shelves together.
ex.zh: 这张示意图展示了如何组装架子。

ex.en: A clear diagram can help students understand complex biological processes more effectively than a lengthy explanation.
ex.zh: 一张清晰的示意图能比冗长的讲解更有效地帮助学生理解复杂的生物过程。

col: a labelled diagram｜带标注的示意图
tip: 侧重结构或原理的图解，不等同于数据图表。

senses.en: The quality of being pleasing to see, hear, or experience.
A particularly useful or attractive feature of something.

ex.en: We stopped to admire the beauty of the lake.
ex.zh: 我们停下来欣赏湖泊的美景。

ex.en: Protecting the natural beauty of coastal areas can support tourism while preserving valuable habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 保护沿海地区的自然美景既能促进旅游业，也能保全珍贵的野生动物栖息地。

col: the beauty of something｜某事物的妙处
tip: 表示“美”通常不可数；the beauty of也指妙处。

senses.en: to draw a line through something written

ex.en: Cross out the wrong answers on the list.
ex.zh: 把清单上错误的答案划掉。

ex.en: She crossed out a sentence and rewrote it.
ex.zh: 她划掉了一个句子重写。

tip: cross out 表示“用线划掉”。
scene: A hand crossing out a word with a pen on a paper.

senses.en: located a short distance away
at or to a place a short distance away

ex.en: We bought fresh bread from a nearby bakery.
ex.zh: 我们从附近的一家面包店买了新鲜面包。

ex.en: Access to nearby parks encourages urban residents to exercise regularly and spend more time outdoors.
ex.zh: 附近有方便前往的公园，能鼓励城市居民经常锻炼，并增加户外活动时间。

tip: nearby不用作介词：说near the school，不说nearby the school。

senses.en: An old object valued for its age, beauty, or rarity
Old and valuable because of age, beauty, or rarity

ex.en: We found a beautiful antique in a small shop.
ex.zh: 我们在一家小店里发现了一件漂亮的古董。

ex.en: Preserving antique furniture helps future generations understand traditional craftsmanship and the everyday lives of people in the past.
ex.zh: 保存古董家具有助于后代理解传统工艺以及过去人们的日常生活。

tip: antique强调古老且有收藏价值，不只是旧。

senses.en: a strap that keeps you safe in a car

ex.en: Please fasten your seat belt before we drive.
ex.zh: 开车前请系好安全带。

ex.en: Everyone in the car must wear a seat belt.
ex.zh: 车里每个人都要系安全带。

col: fasten your seat belt｜系安全带
tip: fasten/put on your seat belt 是“系安全带”。
scene: A hand fastening a seat belt in a car.

senses.en: extremely impressive to see or experience
unusually great or impressive in degree

ex.en: We watched a spectacular sunset from the hilltop.
ex.zh: 我们在山顶看了一场壮观的日落。

ex.en: The region's spectacular mountain scenery attracts tourists, creating jobs but also increasing pressure on fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 该地区壮观的山景吸引着游客，创造了就业机会，但也加重了脆弱生态系统的压力。

tip: 既可形容壮观景象，也可修饰growth等抽象名词。

senses.en: Pay someone to work for you.
Use a method, skill, or resource for a purpose.

ex.en: The bakery employs three people from our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这家面包店雇用了我们街区的三个人。

ex.en: Teachers can employ a range of practical activities to help students understand complex scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 教师可以采用一系列实践活动，帮助学生理解复杂的科学概念。

col: employ someone as｜雇用某人担任
tip: employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。

senses.en: the way someone feels at a particular time
the feeling that a place, event, or artwork creates

ex.en: A short walk usually puts me in a better mood.
ex.zh: 散一小会儿步通常就能让我的心情好一些。

ex.en: Access to green spaces can improve residents' mood and encourage more positive interactions within urban communities.
ex.zh: 能够享用绿地可以改善居民心情，促进城市社区内更积极的互动。

col: in the mood for｜有心情做……
tip: in the mood for后接名词；接动词用to do。

senses.en: The ability to see.
The act of seeing or the area that can be seen.
Something seen, especially something impressive or worth visiting.

ex.en: Her sight improved after she got new glasses.
ex.zh: 她配了新眼镜后看得更清楚了。

ex.en: Regular eye examinations can help preserve sight by detecting problems before they cause permanent damage.
ex.zh: 定期眼部检查能在问题造成永久损伤前将其发现，从而帮助保护视力。

tip: 视力通常不可数；表示名胜常用复数sights。

senses.en: finally, after everything

ex.en: In the end, we decided to stay home.
ex.zh: 最后我们决定待在家里。

ex.en: Everything worked out well in the end.
ex.zh: 最后一切都很顺利。

tip: in the end 表示“最终结果”；at the end 是“在…的末尾”。
scene: A family relaxing at home after deciding to stay in.

senses.en: a person who writes a blog

ex.en: She is a food blogger who posts recipes online.
ex.zh: 她是一位在网上分享食谱的美食博主。

ex.en: The blogger wrote about her trip to Japan.
ex.zh: 博主写了她的日本之旅。

tip: blogger 是写博客的人；blog 是博客。
scene: A young woman typing on a laptop at a café table with a camera.

senses.en: to put equipment or software in place for use
to formally place someone in an important position

ex.en: We hired an electrician to install the new ceiling fan.
ex.zh: 我们请了一位电工来安装新吊扇。

ex.en: Schools need sufficient funding to install reliable internet connections and maintain essential digital equipment.
ex.zh: 学校需要充足的资金来安装可靠的网络连接，并维护必要的数字设备。

col: install solar panels｜安装太阳能板
tip: 下载是download；下载后安装才是install。

senses.en: cooked food bought to eat at home

ex.en: We ordered a takeaway for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们点了外卖当晚餐。

ex.en: The takeaway round the corner sells pizza.
ex.zh: 拐角的外卖店卖披萨。

tip: takeaway 是英式“外卖”；美式说 take-out。
scene: A takeaway box with pizza being carried out of a shop.

senses.en: Happening or existing at the beginning
The first letter of a person's name
To mark a document with the first letters of your names

ex.en: My initial excitement faded when I saw the price.
ex.zh: 看到价格后，我最初的兴奋消退了。

ex.en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
ex.zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。

tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。

senses.en: To make someone feel slightly angry or irritated.

ex.en: Those dripping taps annoy me when I try to sleep.
ex.zh: 我想睡觉时，那些滴水的水龙头让我心烦。

ex.en: Frequent online advertisements can annoy users and discourage them from returning to otherwise useful educational websites.
ex.zh: 频繁的网络广告会让用户感到烦躁，使他们不愿再次访问原本有用的教育网站。

tip: 人感到烦用annoyed；事物令人烦用annoying。

senses.en: In a way that shows pleasure or enjoyment.
Willingly and without objection.
With a fortunate or pleasing result.

ex.en: The children chatted happily while making sandwiches together.
ex.zh: 孩子们一起做三明治，开心地聊着天。

ex.en: Many residents would happily use public transport if services were more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 如果公共交通服务更可靠、价格更实惠，许多居民都会乐意乘坐。

tip: 句首Happily可表“幸好”，不只表示开心。

senses.en: Feeling worried and unable to relax
Pronounced with greater emphasis than surrounding sounds
Experiencing physical force that may cause strain or damage

ex.en: I felt stressed before my first driving lesson.
ex.zh: 第一次上驾驶课之前，我感到很紧张。

ex.en: Students who feel stressed during examinations may benefit from regular exercise and adequate sleep.
ex.zh: 在考试期间感到焦虑的学生，可能会从规律运动和充足睡眠中受益。

col: highly stressed components｜承受高应力的部件
tip: 也可作stress的过去式或过去分词，表示“强调”。

senses.en: Giving pleasure or making you feel happy

ex.en: The cooking class was enjoyable, especially making fresh pasta.
ex.zh: 这堂烹饪课很有趣，尤其是制作新鲜意面的时候。

ex.en: Making physical activity enjoyable can encourage children to develop healthy habits that continue into adulthood.
ex.zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童养成延续至成年的健康习惯。

tip: 形容活动令人愉快用 enjoyable，不用 enjoyed。

senses.en: to enter a place or vehicle

ex.en: Get in the car; we are leaving now.
ex.zh: 上车吧，我们现在就走。

ex.en: The train gets in at ten.
ex.zh: 火车十点到达。

tip: get in 表示“进入/上车”；车到达也说 get in。
scene: A person getting into a car through the open door.

senses.en: to say firmly that you will do something
a firm statement that you will do something
signs that someone or something may succeed

ex.en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
ex.zh: 我保证晚饭前把自行车还给你。

ex.en: Although renewable technologies show considerable promise, further investment is needed to make them widely affordable.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源技术展现出巨大潜力，但仍需进一步投资，使其价格能被大众接受。

col: promise to do something｜承诺做某事
tip: 用promise to do，不用promise doing。

senses.en: several related things or events following one another
a set of programmes or books sharing characters or a subject

ex.en: A series of small delays made us miss lunch.
ex.zh: 接连几次小耽搁让我们错过了午饭。

ex.en: The university introduced a series of workshops to help students evaluate information found on social media.
ex.zh: 这所大学推出了一系列研讨课，帮助学生评估社交媒体上的信息。

col: a series of events｜一连串事件
a television series｜电视系列节目
tip: 单复数同形：a series；two series。

senses.en: used to refer to one specific person, thing, or situation
greater or more noticeable than usual
having strong preferences and being difficult to satisfy

ex.en: Are you looking for any particular book today?
ex.zh: 你今天是在找某一本特定的书吗？

ex.en: Schools should pay particular attention to students who lack access to digital resources at home.
ex.zh: 学校应特别关注那些在家中无法获得数字资源的学生。

col: a particular reason｜某个特定原因
tip: in particular意为尤其；be particular about表示对……讲究。

senses.en: to chase wild animals to catch or kill them
to search carefully for someone or something
an organised search or an activity involving chasing wild animals

ex.en: We hunted for my keys under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们在沙发底下找我的钥匙。

ex.en: When natural habitats shrink, predators may hunt closer to farms, increasing conflict between wildlife and local communities.
ex.zh: 自然栖息地缩小时，捕食动物可能到更靠近农场的地方捕猎，加剧野生动物与当地社区的冲突。

col: hunt wild animals｜猎捕野生动物
tip: 猎捕动物可直接接宾语；寻找物品常用hunt for。

senses.en: A business that arranges services for people or other businesses.
An organisation responsible for a particular area of work.
The ability to make choices and act independently.

ex.en: The travel agency booked our flights and hotel.
ex.zh: 旅行社为我们预订了航班和酒店。

ex.en: A national environmental agency should monitor industrial pollution and ensure that factories comply with safety regulations.
ex.zh: 国家环境机构应监测工业污染，并确保工厂遵守安全规定。

col: individual agency｜个人自主行动能力
tip: 表示机构时可数；表示自主行动能力时通常不可数。

senses.en: Pay no attention to someone or something

ex.en: Please don't ignore that strange noise from the engine.
ex.zh: 请别忽视发动机发出的那种怪声。

ex.en: Governments cannot ignore the long-term effects of air pollution on children's health and development.
ex.zh: 政府不能忽视空气污染对儿童健康与发育的长期影响。

tip: 直接接宾语；不表示法律上的“驳回诉讼”。

senses.en: often or at repeated intervals
with equal spaces or a consistent pattern

ex.en: We regularly walk along the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们经常晚饭后沿着河边散步。

ex.en: People who exercise regularly are more likely to maintain good physical health as they grow older.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼的人随着年龄增长，更有可能保持良好的身体健康。

tip: 可表示经常，也可表示固定间隔；不一定指每天。

senses.en: Someone who temporarily looks after children while their parents are away.

ex.en: The babysitter read a story while the children ate.
ex.zh: 孩子们吃东西时，临时保姆给他们读了一个故事。

ex.en: Finding a reliable babysitter can help parents balance occasional evening commitments with their childcare responsibilities.
ex.zh: 找到可靠的临时保姆，可以帮助父母兼顾偶尔的晚间事务和照顾孩子的责任。

col: hire a babysitter｜雇用临时保姆
find a babysitter｜找人临时照看孩子
tip: 通常指临时照看孩子的人，不只照顾婴儿。

senses.en: Needing immediate attention or action

ex.en: The plumber came quickly because the leak was urgent.
ex.zh: 漏水急需处理，所以水管工很快就赶来了。

ex.en: There is an urgent need for affordable housing as urban populations continue to grow.
ex.zh: 随着城市人口持续增长，人们迫切需要负担得起的住房。

col: urgent medical attention｜紧急医疗救治
tip: urgent强调必须立即处理，不仅是重要。

senses.en: light and warmth coming from the sun

senses.zh: 欢乐；带来快乐的人或事
senses.en: happiness, or someone or something that brings happiness

ex.en: We ate our breakfast outside in the warm sunshine.
ex.zh: 我们在外面温暖的阳光下吃了早餐。

ex.en: Access to parks and sunshine can improve residents' wellbeing, especially in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 能够享用公园和阳光可以改善居民的身心健康，在人口密集的城市地区尤其如此。

col: a ray of sunshine｜带来快乐的人或事
tip: sunshine通常不可数；表示晴天可说a sunny day。

senses.en: to close or attach something securely

ex.en: Please fasten your seat belt before we leave.
ex.zh: 出发前请系好安全带。

ex.en: Passengers must fasten their seat belts during takeoff and landing to reduce the risk of injury.
ex.zh: 乘客在飞机起飞和降落时必须系好安全带，以降低受伤风险。

col: fasten a seat belt｜系好安全带
tip: t不发音；反义词unfasten表示解开。

senses.en: The function or responsibility someone or something has.
A character played by an actor in a performance.

ex.en: My role is to welcome guests at the door.
ex.zh: 我的职责是在门口迎接客人。

ex.en: Public libraries play an important role in providing equal access to information and educational resources.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆在提供平等获取信息和教育资源的机会方面发挥着重要作用。

col: play a role in｜在……中起作用
take on a role｜承担职责
tip: 表示“在……中起作用”用play a role in。

senses.en: To break rules dishonestly to gain an unfair advantage.
To deceive someone to obtain something unfairly.
A person who acts dishonestly to gain an advantage.

ex.en: My cousin cheated by hiding cards under the table.
ex.zh: 我的表亲把牌藏在桌子下面作弊。

ex.en: Schools can discourage students from cheating by designing assessments that reward original thinking rather than memorisation.
ex.zh: 学校可以设计注重独立思考而非死记硬背的考核，减少学生作弊。

col: cheat in an exam｜考试作弊
cheat someone out of money｜骗取某人的钱
tip: cheat someone out of something指骗走某人的某物。

senses.en: The act of leaving a place.
A change from what is usual or expected.

ex.en: We packed our bags the night before departure.
ex.zh: 我们在出发前一晚收拾好了行李。

ex.en: The new housing policy represents a significant departure from previous approaches to urban development.
ex.zh: 这项新的住房政策与以往的城市发展思路有了显著不同。

col: a departure from tradition｜对传统的突破
tip: departure from可指“从……出发”或“背离……”。

senses.en: Protection against danger, crime, loss, or unwanted access
People or activities responsible for protecting a place
Freedom from worries about losing money, work, or essential support

ex.en: We fitted stronger locks to improve our home security.
ex.zh: 我们安装了更坚固的锁，以加强家中的安全防护。

ex.en: Organisations must strengthen data security to protect personal information as more services move online.
ex.zh: 随着更多服务转移到线上，各机构必须加强数据安全，以保护个人信息。

tip: security侧重防范威胁；safety更广指免受危险。

senses.en: the shared beliefs, customs and ways of life of a group
activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work
cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions

ex.en: Sharing traditional meals helps children learn about their culture.
ex.zh: 分享传统餐食有助于孩子了解自己的文化。

ex.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
ex.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.en: to win against someone in a competition or conflict
an occasion when someone loses a competition or conflict
to prevent a plan or aim from succeeding

ex.en: Our team defeated the champions in a thrilling final.
ex.zh: 我们队在一场激动人心的决赛中击败了冠军队。

ex.en: Although electoral defeat can damage a political party, it may also encourage necessary changes in leadership and policy.
ex.zh: 尽管选举失利会对政党造成打击，但也可能促使其对领导层和政策作出必要调整。

tip: defeat后接对手；win后接比赛、奖项等。

senses.en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces
having many things close together or being difficult to see through
flowing slowly rather than easily, like heavy cream

ex.en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
ex.zh: 她把一条厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。

ex.en: Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
ex.zh: 厚厚的隔热层可以减少热量流失，降低冬季家庭能源开支。

tip: 形容液体时指黏稠，不一定表示味道浓。

senses.en: a disease, or the state of being unwell

ex.en: She missed our picnic because of a sudden illness.
ex.zh: 她突然生病，没能参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: Early access to medical care can prevent minor illnesses from developing into serious health problems.
ex.zh: 及早获得医疗服务可以防止小病发展为严重的健康问题。

col: recover from an illness｜病后康复
tip: 泛指生病时不可数；指具体疾病时可数。

senses.en: a statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory
an illness or physical problem

ex.en: She made a complaint about the cold soup.
ex.zh: 她投诉汤是凉的。

ex.en: Local authorities should investigate residents' complaints about noise before approving new entertainment venues in residential areas.
ex.zh: 地方政府在批准住宅区内的新娱乐场所前，应调查居民关于噪声的投诉。

col: a common complaint｜常见病症；常见抱怨
tip: complaint是名词，complain是动词；投诉某事用about。

senses.en: to cut something into small pieces

ex.en: Cut up the vegetables before cooking.
ex.zh: 烹饪前把蔬菜切碎。

ex.en: She cut up the paper into small squares.
ex.zh: 她把纸剪成小方块。

tip: cut up 是“切碎/剪碎”。
scene: Hands chopping vegetables on a cutting board in a kitchen.

senses.en: Move earth to make a hole or uncover something
Search carefully for hidden information
An organized activity to uncover ancient objects in the ground

ex.en: We dug a deep hole for the young apple tree.
ex.zh: 我们为这棵苹果树苗挖了一个深坑。

ex.en: Researchers dig into historical records to understand how earlier societies responded to periods of rapid environmental change.
ex.zh: 研究人员深入查阅历史记录，以了解过去的社会如何应对环境迅速变化的时期。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为dug；dig into可指深入调查。

senses.en: the process of making or growing things for use
the making of a film or play, or the resulting work

ex.en: The factory has increased production to meet summer demand.
ex.zh: 工厂已增加产量，以满足夏季需求。

ex.en: Cleaner energy production can reduce air pollution while supporting the development of a modern economy.
ex.zh: 更清洁的能源生产可以减少空气污染，同时支持现代经济的发展。

tip: production通常不可数；指一部演出作品时可数。

senses.en: where something is or how a body is arranged
a job, social rank, or opinion on an issue
to put someone or something in a particular place

ex.en: Can you move the lamp to a better position?
ex.zh: 你能把灯挪到一个更合适的位置吗？

ex.en: The report explains the government's position on providing affordable housing for young families.
ex.zh: 这份报告阐明了政府在为年轻家庭提供可负担住房方面的立场。

col: apply for a position｜申请职位
take a position on｜对……表明立场
tip: 表示立场常用position on；表示职位为可数名词。

senses.en: To become visible or come into view.
To seem to be a certain way.
To take part in a performance or attend court formally.

ex.en: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
ex.zh: 天空渐渐变暗，星星开始出现。

ex.en: Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。

tip: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: not in or to any place

ex.en: There was nowhere to sit on the crowded train.
ex.zh: 拥挤的火车上没有地方可坐。

ex.en: Without affordable housing, some low-income families have nowhere to live despite having regular paid employment.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏可负担的住房，一些低收入家庭即使有固定工作，也无处居住。

col: in the middle of nowhere｜在偏僻之地
tip: 本身含否定意义：I have nowhere to go。

senses.en: A regular or repeated way something happens or is done.
An arrangement of shapes, lines, or colours forming a design.

ex.en: My cat follows the same sleeping pattern every day.
ex.zh: 我的猫每天都遵循相同的睡眠规律。

ex.en: Researchers analyse patterns of energy consumption to identify opportunities for reducing waste in households.
