A difficult struggle to achieve something or overcome a problem.
To struggle hard against someone or something.

ex.en: The museum displays armour from a famous battle.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了某场著名战役中使用的盔甲。

ex.en: The battle against air pollution requires coordinated action from governments, businesses, and individuals across urban areas.
ex.zh: 对抗空气污染需要城市各地的政府、企业和个人协调行动。

col: battle against pollution｜与污染作斗争
battle for survival｜为生存而斗争
tip: battle可指具体战斗，也常比喻与疾病或困难抗争。

senses.en: Not needed or serving no useful purpose.

ex.en: Bring a light jacket, but heavy boots are unnecessary.
ex.zh: 带一件薄外套吧，但厚靴子就没必要了。

ex.en: Clear instructions can prevent unnecessary delays and help public services operate more efficiently.
ex.zh: 清晰的指引可以避免不必要的延误，帮助公共服务更高效地运作。

col: avoid unnecessary delays｜避免不必要的延误
tip: 表示“没必要做”可用 it is unnecessary to do。

senses.en: To make something less enjoyable, useful, or attractive.
To give someone excessive attention or everything they want.
To become, or make food become, unfit to eat.

ex.en: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.
ex.zh: 请别告诉你姐姐，免得破坏这份惊喜。

ex.en: Poorly planned construction can spoil natural landscapes and reduce their appeal to both residents and tourists.
ex.zh: 规划不当的建设会破坏自然景观，降低其对居民和游客的吸引力。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均可用spoiled或spoilt。

senses.en: To lose blood from a wound or inside the body.

ex.en: My finger started to bleed after a small paper cut.
ex.zh: 我的手指被纸轻轻划了一下，开始流血了。

ex.en: First aid courses teach people how to respond safely when minor injuries cause someone to bleed.
ex.zh: 急救课程教人们在轻伤导致出血时如何安全应对。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bled；blood是名词“血”。

senses.en: despite the fact that

ex.en: Although it was raining, we still walked home.
ex.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是走回了家。

ex.en: Although renewable energy requires substantial initial investment, it can lower electricity costs in the long term.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源需要大量前期投资，但从长远来看，它能降低电力成本。

col: although it is true that｜虽然确实……
although not always｜虽然并非总是
tip: 引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

senses.en: to prevent something from happening or refrain from doing something
to stay away from someone or something

ex.en: We left early to avoid the morning traffic.
ex.zh: 我们很早就出发了，以避开早高峰的车流。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to avoid further increases in traffic congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 城市应改善公共交通，以避免交通拥堵和空气污染进一步加剧。

tip: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。

senses.en: Able to produce original ideas, or involving imagination.

ex.en: My creative sister turned old jars into colourful lamps.
ex.zh: 我富有创意的姐姐把旧罐子变成了彩色灯具。

ex.en: Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.
ex.zh: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。

col: a creative solution｜创新的解决方案
tip: 形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。

senses.en: to make something completely full

ex.en: We filled up the car with petrol.
ex.zh: 我们把汽车加满了油。

ex.en: Fill up the bottle with water, please.
ex.zh: 请把瓶子装满水。

col: fill up the tank｜加满油箱
tip: fill up 是“装满/加满”；加油时也说 fill it up。
scene: A car being filled with petrol at a station, tank full.

senses.en: An area defined by its features or official boundaries.

ex.en: We found a small bakery in the old market district.
ex.zh: 我们在老市场区找到了一家小面包店。

ex.en: Improving public transport in suburban districts can reduce car dependence and widen access to employment.
ex.zh: 改善郊区的公共交通可以减少对汽车的依赖，并增加就业机会。

tip: 可指行政划分，也可指具有特定功能的城区。

senses.en: affecting or involving most people, things, or situations
describing main points rather than particular details
an officer with a very high rank in the army

ex.en: There was general agreement that the kitchen needed repainting.
ex.zh: 大家普遍同意厨房需要重新刷漆。

ex.en: Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.
ex.zh: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。

tip: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

senses.en: informal way of saying yes

ex.en: 'Are you coming?' 'Yeah, I'll be there.'
ex.zh: “你来吗？”“嗯，我会去的。”

ex.en: Yeah, I really like this song.
ex.zh: 是啊，我真的很喜欢这首歌。

tip: yeah 是 yes 的口语形式，非正式场合用。
scene: A person nodding and saying yeah while talking with a friend.

senses.en: To consider someone or something responsible for a problem.
Responsibility for something bad that has happened.

ex.en: Don't blame me for the broken kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 别把厨房椅子坏了的事怪到我头上。

ex.en: It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.
ex.zh: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。

col: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人
blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人
tip: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。

senses.en: a machine that gives cash (British English)

ex.en: There's a cashpoint around the corner.
ex.zh: 拐角处有一台取款机。

ex.en: I need to find a cashpoint to get money.
ex.zh: 我需要找台取款机取钱。

tip: cashpoint 是英式说法，等于 ATM。
scene: A cashpoint machine on a shop wall with a person using it.

senses.en: Relating to education after primary school and before higher education.
Less important than something else.

ex.en: My sister starts secondary school after the summer holidays.
ex.zh: 暑假过后，我妹妹就要上中学了。

ex.en: Access to quality secondary education can improve employment prospects for young people in rural communities.
ex.zh: 获得优质中等教育的机会可以改善农村年轻人的就业前景。

tip: 表示“次于”用secondary to，不用secondary than。

senses.en: Directly below something, often covered or hidden by it.
In a lower position, often beneath a covering.

ex.en: Your slippers are underneath the chair by the bed.
ex.zh: 你的拖鞋在床边那把椅子下面。

ex.en: Insulation installed underneath floors can reduce heat loss and improve energy efficiency in older homes.
ex.zh: 在地板下面铺设保温材料，可以减少老房屋的热量流失并提高能源效率。

tip: 后接名词时是介词；单独使用时是副词。

senses.en: for all future time
very often, especially in an annoying way

ex.en: I wish these sunny afternoons could last forever.
ex.zh: 我希望这些阳光明媚的午后能永远持续下去。

ex.en: Without effective conservation measures, some rare animal species could disappear forever within the next few decades.
ex.zh: 如果没有有效的保护措施，一些珍稀动物物种可能在未来几十年内永远消失。

tip: be forever doing常表示不满：老是做某事。

senses.en: allowed something; the past tense and past participle of permit

ex.en: We were permitted to feed the goats at noon.
ex.zh: 我们获准在中午给山羊喂食。

ex.en: Students should be permitted to use digital tools when these genuinely support learning rather than distract from it.
ex.zh: 当数字工具确实有助于学习而非分散注意力时，应允许学生使用。

col: be permitted to do something｜获准做某事
tip: permit过去式双写t；被动式后接to do。

senses.en: A structure built to honour a person or important event.
An old structure valued for its historical importance.

ex.en: We left flowers beside the monument in the town square.
ex.zh: 我们把鲜花放在镇广场的纪念碑旁。

ex.en: Protecting ancient monuments can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting employment in local communities.
ex.zh: 保护古迹既能增强文化认同，又能吸引游客，为当地社区创造就业机会。

tip: 纪念某人或某事用a monument to。

senses.en: to secure something so it cannot open, move, or be accessed
a device that keeps something shut until opened correctly
a small section of someone's hair

ex.en: Please lock the back door before you go upstairs.
ex.zh: 上楼前请把后门锁好。

ex.en: Employees should lock their computers whenever they leave their desks to prevent unauthorised access to confidential information.
ex.zh: 员工离开办公桌时应锁定电脑，以防机密信息被未经授权的人查看。

col: a lock of hair｜一绺头发
tip: lock是锁上，unlock是解锁；两者不可混用。

senses.en: forming curls or curved shapes, especially when describing hair

ex.en: Her curly hair bounced as she ran upstairs.
ex.zh: 她跑上楼时，一头卷发随着步伐上下弹动。

ex.en: Advertising should represent people with diverse appearances, including those with curly hair and different skin tones.
ex.zh: 广告应展现外貌各异的人，包括卷发者和不同肤色的人。

tip: curly卷曲程度明显；wavy通常指轻柔的波浪状。

senses.en: To cook food using direct heat from above or below.
A cooking device that exposes food to direct heat.
To question someone intensely, often for a long time.

ex.en: We grilled some peppers and ate them with rice.
ex.zh: 我们烤了些甜椒，配米饭吃。

ex.en: Grilling vegetables with little oil can be a practical way to prepare healthier meals at home.
ex.zh: 用少量油烤蔬菜，是在家制作更健康餐食的一种实用方法。

col: under the grill｜在烤架热源下
grill someone about something｜就某事盘问某人
tip: 英式grill常指从上方加热；美式常指从下方烤。

senses.en: to damage something so badly that it loses its value
the remains of a building that has been badly damaged
the complete loss of money, success, or good condition

ex.en: Heavy rain ruined the picnic we had planned.
ex.zh: 大雨毁掉了我们计划好的野餐。

ex.en: Uncontrolled tourism can ruin fragile natural habitats unless visitor numbers and construction activities are carefully managed.
ex.zh: 除非严格管理游客数量和建设活动，否则无序旅游可能毁掉脆弱的自然栖息地。

col: ruin someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划
tip: 表示建筑遗迹常用复数ruins，如ancient ruins。

senses.en: Repeated activity done to improve a skill.
A usual or established way of doing something.
The actual use of an idea, method, or skill.

ex.en: Daily practice helped me play the guitar more confidently.
ex.zh: 每天练习让我弹吉他时更加自信。

ex.en: Schools should give students opportunities to put scientific knowledge into practice through experiments and practical projects.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生有机会通过实验和实践项目，将科学知识付诸应用。

tip: 英式名词用practice，动词用practise；美式均用practice。

senses.en: A friend or someone you share an activity with
An animal's partner for breeding
To breed, or bring animals together to breed

ex.en: I'm meeting a mate for lunch near the station.
ex.zh: 我要在车站附近和一个朋友吃午饭。

ex.en: Some bird species stay with the same mate for years, sharing responsibility for raising their young.
ex.zh: 某些鸟类会与同一配偶相伴多年，共同承担养育幼鸟的责任。

tip: 表示朋友时属英式非正式用语，正式写作宜用friend。

senses.en: an arrangement with a bank to keep your money

ex.en: She opened a bank account to save her pocket money.
ex.zh: 她开了个银行账户存零花钱。

ex.en: You need your ID to open a bank account.
ex.zh: 开银行账户需要身份证件。

col: open a bank account｜开银行账户
tip: open a bank account 是“开户”；save money 存钱。
scene: A person signing a form at a bank counter.

senses.en: having little distance from one side to the other
limited in range or achieved by only a small margin
to become or make something less wide or extensive

ex.en: The narrow path only allows us to walk single file.
ex.zh: 这条狭窄的小路只容得下我们排成一列走。

ex.en: Governments should invest in rural schools to narrow the educational gap between urban and remote communities.
ex.zh: 政府应投资乡村学校，缩小城市与偏远社区之间的教育差距。

col: narrow down the options｜缩小选择范围
tip: narrow down表示缩小选择范围，不指道路变窄。

senses.en: To help someone do something.

ex.en: A friendly librarian assisted me with the printer.
ex.zh: 一位友善的图书管理员帮我使用了打印机。

ex.en: Local volunteers can assist older residents with online services, making essential information more accessible.
ex.zh: 当地志愿者可以帮助老年居民使用在线服务，让他们更容易获取重要信息。

col: assist someone with something｜帮助某人处理某事
assist in doing something｜协助做某事
assist someone to do something｜帮助某人做某事
tip: 比help正式；常用assist someone with something。

senses.en: if; on condition that

ex.en: You can borrow the book as long as you return it.
ex.zh: 只要你归还，就可以借这本书。

ex.en: We'll play football as long as it doesn't rain.
ex.zh: 只要不下雨，我们就踢足球。

tip: as long as 引导条件从句，表示“只要”。
scene: Children playing football in a park while the sky stays clear.

senses.en: the need for food or suffering caused by its lack
a strong desire for something
to want something very strongly

ex.en: A bowl of warm soup quickly satisfied my hunger.
ex.zh: 一碗热汤很快就让我不饿了。

ex.en: Reducing global hunger requires reliable food supplies as well as better access to education and employment.
ex.zh: 减少全球饥饿既需要可靠的食物供应，也需要更多受教育和就业的机会。

tip: 名词通常不可数；渴望某物用hunger for。

senses.en: a body temperature higher than normal, usually caused by illness
intense excitement shared by a person or group

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
ex.zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。

ex.en: A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.
ex.zh: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。

tip: 表示发烧常说have a fever，也可说have a temperature。

senses.en: Hard natural material from the ground, or a piece of it.
A hard mass that forms inside an organ.
The hard central part of some fruits containing the seed.

ex.en: She picked up a smooth stone beside the lake.
ex.zh: 她在湖边捡起了一块光滑的石头。

ex.en: Buildings constructed from local stone can preserve regional character and reduce the environmental costs of transporting materials.
ex.zh: 使用当地石料建造的建筑可以保留地域特色，并降低运输建材带来的环境成本。

tip: 石料用不可数stone；一块石头用a stone。

senses.en: a small cupboard for keeping personal belongings secure

ex.en: I left my trainers in a locker at the gym.
ex.zh: 我把运动鞋留在健身房的储物柜里了。

ex.en: Providing each student with a locker can reduce the weight of bags carried around school.
ex.zh: 为每位学生配备储物柜，可以减轻他们在校园内携带的书包重量。

tip: locker通常是存放个人物品的小柜，不指上锁的人。

senses.en: the rise in the earth's temperature

ex.en: Global warming is caused partly by pollution.
ex.zh: 全球变暖部分是由污染造成的。

ex.en: Many countries are working to stop global warming.
ex.zh: 许多国家正在努力阻止全球变暖。

tip: global warming 是“全球变暖”，与 climate change 相关。
scene: A hot sun over melting ice with factories in the distance.

senses.en: On the subject of someone or something.

ex.en: I called the hotel regarding our missing suitcase.
ex.zh: 我给酒店打了电话，询问我们丢失的行李箱一事。

ex.en: Schools should consult parents before making major decisions regarding changes to the curriculum or assessment methods.
ex.zh: 学校在就课程或评估方式的调整作出重大决定之前，应征求家长意见。

tip: regarding直接接名词，不加to；比about正式。

senses.en: during the recent period up to the present

ex.en: Have you been sleeping well lately, or feeling tired?
ex.zh: 你最近睡得好吗，还是觉得疲倦？

ex.en: Lately, researchers have paid greater attention to the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health.
ex.zh: 近来，研究人员更加关注绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

tip: 常与现在完成时连用；不要与表示迟到的late混淆。

senses.en: very dark blue

ex.en: She wore a navy blue jacket to the interview.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件藏青色夹克去面试。

ex.en: The school uniform is navy blue.
ex.zh: 校服是藏青色的。

tip: navy blue 是深蓝/藏青色。
scene: A navy blue jacket hanging on a hanger.

senses.en: to look after someone or something

ex.en: She takes care of her younger brother.
ex.zh: 她照顾弟弟。

ex.en: Please take care of the problem before Friday.
ex.zh: 请在周五前处理这个问题。

tip: take care of 是“照顾/处理”，等于 look after。
scene: A girl giving water to a plant she takes care of.

senses.en: Easy to notice or understand.

ex.en: The muddy footprints made the dog's hiding place obvious.
ex.zh: 泥脚印让狗的藏身处一目了然。

ex.en: The environmental benefits of cycling are obvious, but safer routes are needed to encourage more people to cycle.
ex.zh: 骑自行车的环境效益显而易见，但还需更安全的路线来鼓励更多人骑行。

col: for obvious reasons｜出于显而易见的原因
obvious to everyone｜人人都看得出来
tip: 常用It is obvious that…表示“显然……”。

senses.en: to arrive, or to increase sound

ex.en: He turned up at the party with his friends.
ex.zh: 他和朋友们出现在聚会上。

ex.en: Turn up the radio; I can't hear it.
ex.zh: 把收音机调大声，我听不见。

tip: turn up 表示“出现”或“调高”。
scene: A guest arriving at a party door with a gift.

senses.en: not suitable or good enough for a particular purpose
not physically healthy or strong, often through lack of exercise

ex.en: The rusty bicycle was unfit for the long journey.
ex.zh: 那辆生锈的自行车不适合用来长途骑行。

ex.en: Poor maintenance can make public housing unfit for occupation, putting additional pressure on local authorities.
ex.zh: 维护不善可能使公共住房不宜居住，给地方政府带来额外压力。

col: unfit for purpose｜不符合用途要求
unfit for human consumption｜不宜供人食用
tip: 常用unfit for sth或unfit to do sth。

senses.en: To officially accept or allow something.
To think that someone or something is good or acceptable.

ex.en: My manager approved my request for a day off.
ex.zh: 经理批准了我请一天假的申请。

ex.en: Local authorities should approve housing developments only when adequate transport and essential services are available.
ex.zh: 地方政府应仅在交通和基本服务充足的情况下批准住宅开发项目。

tip: 批准某事用approve；赞成某事用approve of。

senses.en: a talk that explains something to an audience
the way something is arranged, shown, or expressed
the formal act of giving something to someone

ex.en: I practised my presentation in front of my sister.
ex.zh: 我在姐姐面前练习了一遍报告。

ex.en: Giving a group presentation allows students to develop communication skills and learn how to divide responsibilities.
ex.zh: 进行小组报告能让学生培养沟通能力，并学习如何分工。

tip: 作报告用give a presentation；注意present作动词的重音。

senses.en: the greatest amount or level that is allowed or possible
to control how much something can increase or happen

ex.en: There is a limit to what this bag can hold.
ex.zh: 这个包能装的东西是有限的。

ex.en: Governments should limit industrial emissions while providing financial support for businesses adopting cleaner production methods.
ex.zh: 政府应限制工业排放，同时为采用更清洁生产方式的企业提供资金支持。

col: limit something to｜将某事物限制在
tip: limit A to B意为将A限制在B范围内。

senses.en: Someone whose job is to design buildings
Someone who plans and develops an important change or project

ex.en: The architect showed us a model of our future home.
ex.zh: 建筑师给我们看了未来新家的模型。

ex.en: Architects can reduce energy consumption by designing buildings that make better use of natural light.
ex.zh: 建筑师可以通过设计更充分利用自然光的建筑来降低能耗。

col: chief architect｜首席建筑师；主要设计者
the architect of reform｜改革的设计者
tip: architect指人，architecture指建筑学或建筑风格。

senses.en: An object kept to remember a place, person, or event.

ex.en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
ex.zh: 我们买了一只小木船作为纪念品。

ex.en: Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.
ex.zh: 购买当地制作的纪念品可以支持传统工艺，并为依靠旅游业的社区带来收入。

tip: 常用a souvenir of表示某次旅行或活动的纪念品。

senses.en: either side of the face below the eyes
rude behaviour that shows a lack of respect

ex.en: A cold raindrop landed on my cheek outside.
ex.zh: 在外面，一滴冰凉的雨水落在了我的脸颊上。

ex.en: Protective clothing should cover exposed areas, including the cheeks, when people work in extremely cold environments.
ex.zh: 在极寒环境中工作时，防护服应遮住包括脸颊在内的裸露部位。

col: a kiss on the cheek｜脸颊上的一吻
have the cheek to｜竟厚着脸皮做
tip: 脸颊义可数；无礼义通常不可数，多用于英式口语。

senses.en: A strong desire to achieve a particular goal.
Determination to become successful, powerful, or highly skilled.

ex.en: Her childhood ambition was to design bridges across rivers.
ex.zh: 她儿时的志向是设计跨河大桥。

ex.en: Schools should nurture students' ambition while helping them set realistic goals and develop practical skills.
ex.zh: 学校应培养学生的进取心，同时帮助他们设定切实可行的目标并发展实用技能。

col: ambition to succeed｜追求成功的雄心
tip: 具体志向可数，进取心不可数；常接to do。

senses.en: Kept hidden from people who should not know.
Information known only to a limited group of people.
An important way of achieving a particular result.

ex.en: We planned a secret picnic for our grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们悄悄为祖父母策划了一次野餐。

ex.en: Governments must balance the need to keep information secret with the public's right to know.
ex.zh: 政府必须在信息保密的需要与公众的知情权之间取得平衡。

col: the secret to success｜成功的秘诀
tip: 秘诀常用the secret to，to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: To move upwards or become greater in amount or level.
To get up from sitting or lying down.
An increase in amount, level, or value.

ex.en: Warm air rises above the heater beside my desk.
ex.zh: 我书桌旁的暖气上方，热空气向上升腾。

ex.en: A sharp rise in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
ex.zh: 住房成本大幅上涨，迫使许多年轻人推迟搬出去独立居住。

col: a rise in prices｜物价上涨
tip: rise不及物，过去式rose，过去分词risen；raise及物。

senses.en: A polite way to address a man or male teacher.
A title used before a knight's or baronet's name.

ex.en: Excuse me, sir, you left your umbrella behind.
ex.zh: 打扰一下，先生，您忘拿伞了。

ex.en: In some schools, students address male teachers as sir to show respect during lessons.
ex.zh: 在一些学校，学生上课时用 sir 称呼男教师，以示尊重。

col: excuse me, sir｜打扰一下，先生
Dear Sir｜尊敬的先生（信函称呼）
tip: 爵士头衔用Sir加名字或全名，不单加姓氏。

senses.en: made smaller or cheaper

ex.en: The reduced prices attracted many customers.
ex.zh: 降价吸引了许多顾客。

ex.en: She bought the jacket at a reduced price.
ex.zh: 她以折扣价买了这件夹克。

tip: reduced 表示“减价/降低的”；at a reduced price 打折价。
scene: A shop rack with red reduced price tags on clothes.

senses.en: not working (about machines)

ex.en: The lift is out of order, so use the stairs.
ex.zh: 电梯故障，请走楼梯。

ex.en: The ticket machine is out of order today.
ex.zh: 售票机今天出故障了。

tip: out of order 表示机器“故障/不能使用”。
scene: A lift with an out of order sign and people using the stairs.

senses.en: to hand things to people, or to produce

ex.en: The teacher gave out the test papers.
ex.zh: 老师分发了试卷。

ex.en: The fire gives out a lot of heat.
ex.zh: 火散发出很多热量。

tip: give out 是“分发”或“发出（光热）”。
scene: A teacher handing out papers to students in class.

senses.en: to move smoothly across a surface without lifting
a single image or page shown during a presentation
a sloping structure that children slide down

ex.en: She slid the plate across the table towards me.
ex.zh: 她把盘子沿着桌面推滑到我面前。

ex.en: Teachers can use a carefully designed slide to explain complex scientific processes more clearly.
ex.zh: 教师可以用精心设计的幻灯片更清楚地解释复杂的科学过程。

tip: 动词过去式和过去分词均为slid。

senses.en: being the greatest amount or level possible or allowed
the greatest amount or level possible or allowed

ex.en: This lift has a maximum capacity of eight people.
ex.zh: 这部电梯最多可容纳八人。

ex.en: Governments should set maximum limits on industrial emissions to protect public health and improve air quality.
ex.zh: 政府应对工业排放设定上限，以保护公众健康并改善空气质量。

tip: a maximum of表示“最多”；反义词是minimum。

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition
someone who strongly supports a cause or group
to actively support or defend a cause or person

ex.en: The new champion lifted her trophy with both hands.
ex.zh: 新冠军双手举起了奖杯。

ex.en: Local organisations can champion affordable housing by working with residents and presenting practical proposals to councils.
ex.zh: 地方组织可以与居民合作，向地方议会提交切实可行的提案，推动提供可负担住房。

col: a champion of equality｜平等的拥护者
champion a cause｜支持一项事业
tip: 作动词直接接宾语：champion a cause。

senses.en: A small electric light carried in the hand.
A stick with burning material at one end, providing light.

ex.en: I used a torch to find my missing keys.
ex.zh: 我用手电筒寻找丢失的钥匙。

ex.en: Hikers should carry a torch and spare batteries when exploring remote areas after sunset.
ex.zh: 徒步者在日落后探索偏远地区时，应携带手电筒和备用电池。

col: switch on a torch｜打开手电筒
a torch beam｜手电筒的光束
tip: 手电筒英式叫torch，美式叫flashlight。

senses.en: For a particular person or group, not for everyone.
Owned or managed independently of the government.
Not intended to be known or shared with others.

ex.en: Each guest has a private bathroom beside their bedroom.
ex.zh: 每位客人的卧室旁都有一间专用浴室。

ex.en: Private companies can improve public transport, but governments must ensure that fares remain affordable.
ex.zh: 私营公司可以改善公共交通，但政府必须确保票价仍在民众承受范围内。

tip: in private表示私下地；in public表示公开地。

senses.en: Feeling or showing happiness and a positive attitude.
Making a place or experience feel bright and pleasant.

ex.en: Our cheerful neighbour waved as we left the house.
ex.zh: 我们出门时，开朗的邻居向我们挥了挥手。

ex.en: A cheerful classroom atmosphere can encourage younger learners to participate more actively in group discussions.
ex.zh: 愉快的课堂氛围能鼓励年幼的学习者更积极地参与小组讨论。

tip: 既可形容人心情开朗，也可形容环境明快。

senses.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought
Playfully funny in a way that is not serious

ex.en: It was silly to leave my umbrella at home.
ex.zh: 把伞留在家里真是不明智。

ex.en: Teachers should avoid calling any question silly, as this may discourage students from participating in class.
ex.zh: 教师应避免说任何问题愚蠢，因为这可能打击学生参与课堂的积极性。

tip: 语气通常比stupid轻，也可表示逗趣、不正经。

senses.en: Feeling extremely afraid.

ex.en: I was terrified when thunder shook the windows last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚雷声震得窗户发抖时，我吓坏了。

ex.en: Students who are terrified of public speaking may benefit from practising presentations in small, supportive groups.
ex.zh: 极度害怕公开演讲的学生，可以通过在互相支持的小组中练习展示而受益。

col: terrified at the thought of｜一想到就惊恐
tip: 人感到害怕用terrified；事物吓人用terrifying。

senses.en: people or things arranged in a straight line
to move a boat through water using oars
a noisy argument or loud disturbance

ex.en: We found two empty seats in the front row.
ex.zh: 我们在前排找到了两个空座位。

ex.en: Planting a row of trees beside busy roads can help reduce noise and improve local air quality.
ex.zh: 在繁忙道路旁种植一排树木，有助于降低噪声并改善当地空气质量。

col: in a row｜排成一排；连续
tip: “排、划船”读/rəʊ/；“争吵”英美均读/raʊ/。

senses.en: Money paid to the government to fund public services.
Require someone to pay money to the government.
Put heavy demands on someone's strength or abilities.

ex.en: The tax on my monthly salary has gone up.
ex.zh: 我每月工资要缴的税增加了。

ex.en: Governments can use tax revenue to improve public transport and make healthcare more accessible.
ex.zh: 政府可以利用税收改善公共交通，让医疗服务惠及更多人。

tip: tax可作名词或动词；taxing常指费力的、累人的。

senses.en: The parts or substances that something consists of
A piece of writing or music
The activity of creating music or written work

ex.en: We tested the composition of soil in our garden.
ex.zh: 我们检测了自家花园土壤的成分。

ex.en: Changes in the composition of household waste can reveal how consumer habits develop over time.
ex.zh: 生活垃圾构成的变化可以反映消费习惯如何随时间演变。

tip: 指构成或创作过程通常不可数；指作品可数。

senses.en: to a moderate degree, but not very
in a way that treats people equally and reasonably

ex.en: The walk home was fairly short and very pleasant.
ex.zh: 走路回家的路程还算短，一路也很惬意。

ex.en: Schools should distribute resources fairly so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds receive the support they need.
ex.zh: 学校应公平分配资源，让背景不利的学生获得所需的支持。

col: distribute resources fairly｜公平分配资源
tip: 表程度时弱于very；fairly good是还不错，并非极好。

senses.en: something happened regularly in the past but not now

ex.en: I used to play the piano when I was young.
ex.zh: 我年轻时曾经常弹钢琴。

ex.en: She used to live in this street.
ex.zh: 她以前住在这条街上。

tip: used to + 动词原形表示过去的习惯；be used to doing 是“习惯做”。
scene: An old piano in a corner, remembering the past.

senses.en: covered wires carrying electricity or electronic signals
a thick strong rope, usually made of metal wires

ex.en: The charging cable was tangled beneath my desk.
ex.zh: 充电线在我的书桌下面缠成了一团。

ex.en: Undersea cable networks carry vast amounts of data, making them essential infrastructure for international communication and trade.
ex.zh: 海底电缆网络传输大量数据，是国际通信和贸易不可或缺的基础设施。

tip: 既可传电或信号，也可指承重用的钢缆。

senses.en: the main female character in a story
a woman admired for courage or remarkable achievements

ex.en: The heroine of this novel sails across the ocean.
ex.zh: 这部小说的女主角驾船横渡大洋。

ex.en: A confident heroine in children's literature can challenge stereotypes and broaden young readers' expectations.
ex.zh: 儿童文学中自信的女主角能够挑战刻板印象，拓宽小读者对未来的期待。

col: the heroine of a novel｜小说的女主角
tip: 与heroin（海洛因）同音，注意末尾的e。

senses.en: An ability to perceive through sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.
A feeling or awareness of something.
To become aware of something without being directly told.

ex.en: Dogs have a much stronger sense of smell than humans.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅觉比人类灵敏得多。

ex.en: Community gardens can strengthen residents' sense of belonging by creating opportunities for regular social interaction.
ex.zh: 社区花园可以创造日常社交机会，从而增强居民的归属感。

tip: make sense指讲得通；make sense of指理解。

senses.en: A passage built underground or through a hill.
To dig a passage underground or through something.

ex.en: The train entered a dark tunnel beneath the hill.
ex.zh: 火车驶入了山下的一条漆黑隧道。

ex.en: Building a tunnel under the river could reduce traffic congestion and improve connections between neighbouring districts.
ex.zh: 在河底修建隧道可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善相邻区域之间的交通联系。

tip: 介词 through 常表示从隧道内部穿过。

senses.en: an amount of money
the total obtained by adding amounts together
to state the main points, usually with up

ex.en: She saved a small sum for a new bicycle.
ex.zh: 她为买一辆新自行车攒了一小笔钱。

ex.en: Governments invest large sums in public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 政府在公共交通上投入巨资，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

col: a large sum of money｜一大笔钱
tip: sum up表示总结；一笔钱用a sum of money。

senses.en: to join or register for something

ex.en: She signed up for the swimming course.
ex.zh: 她报名参加了游泳课程。

ex.en: You can sign up for the newsletter online.
ex.zh: 你可以在网上注册订阅新闻通讯。

tip: sign up for 是“报名参加”。
scene: A person filling in a registration form at a sports centre.

senses.en: To take off your own clothes or someone else's clothes.

ex.en: I undressed behind the curtain and put on pyjamas.
ex.zh: 我在帘子后脱下衣服，换上睡衣。

ex.en: Healthcare staff should provide private spaces where patients can undress comfortably before a physical examination.
ex.zh: 医护人员应提供私密空间，让患者在体检前安心脱衣。

tip: undress可不接宾语；脱某件衣服用take off。

senses.en: to place something down, or to write down

ex.en: Put down your bag and sit down.
ex.zh: 放下包，坐下来。

ex.en: Put down your name on the list.
ex.zh: 在名单上写下你的名字。

tip: put down 表示“放下”或“记下”。
scene: A person putting a heavy bag down on the floor.

senses.en: to connect someone on the phone

ex.en: Please put me through to the manager.
ex.zh: 请帮我接通经理。

ex.en: She was put through to the wrong department.
ex.zh: 她被接到了错误的部门。

tip: put through 是电话用语“接通”。
scene: A receptionist on the phone connecting a caller.

senses.en: a view or situation that you see
the place where an event happens
a short part of a play or film

ex.en: The children playing by the lake made a peaceful scene.
ex.zh: 孩子们在湖边玩耍，构成了一幅宁静的画面。

ex.en: The film's opening scene highlights the challenges faced by families living in crowded urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 影片的开场片段突出了居住在拥挤城市社区的家庭面临的挑战。

tip: scene可数；scenery指整体风景，不可数。

senses.en: a soft warm quilt for a bed

ex.en: I bought a new duvet for the winter.
ex.zh: 我买了一条新羽绒被过冬。

ex.en: The bed has a white duvet and soft pillows.
ex.zh: 床上有白色羽绒被和柔软的枕头。

tip: duvet 是英式说法，指羽绒被。
scene: A cosy bed with a thick white duvet and pillows.

senses.en: Studying material again to prepare for an examination
The process or result of changing something to improve it

ex.en: I do my revision at the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我在厨房的餐桌旁复习。

ex.en: Regular revision helps students retain knowledge more effectively than studying intensively just before an examination.
ex.zh: 定期复习比考前突击学习更能帮助学生牢固掌握知识。

tip: 复习义主要用于英式英语；美式常用review。

senses.en: on holiday (American English)

ex.en: They are on vacation in Hawaii.
ex.zh: 他们在夏威夷度假。

ex.en: The office is closed because the boss is on vacation.
ex.zh: 老板去度假了，办公室关门。

tip: on vacation 是美式说法；英式说 on holiday。
scene: A couple with beach bags walking on a tropical beach.

senses.en: In most cases or at most times.
By most people or across most places.

ex.en: I generally walk to work unless it rains.
ex.zh: 除非下雨，否则我通常步行上班。

ex.en: Public transport is generally more energy-efficient than private cars, especially when services carry large numbers of passengers.
ex.zh: 公共交通通常比私家车更节能，尤其是在载客量较大的情况下。

tip: generally表示多数情况，并非毫无例外；句首可用generally speaking。

senses.en: Objects placed together, often one on top of another.
To put things together in a heap.

ex.en: A pile of dirty dishes filled the sink.
ex.zh: 一堆脏餐具塞满了水槽。

ex.en: When waste collection services are inadequate, piles of rubbish can threaten public health in densely populated neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 垃圾清运服务不足时，成堆的垃圾可能威胁人口密集社区的公共卫生。

col: pile plates on a table｜把盘子堆在桌上
tip: a pile of后接所堆之物；pile up表示积聚。

senses.en: old, especially when describing people

ex.en: An elderly neighbour showed me how to grow tomatoes.
ex.zh: 一位年长的邻居教我如何种番茄。

ex.en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that elderly residents can remain active and independent.
ex.zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让老年居民能够保持活跃并独立生活。

tip: 指人年老，不指中年；older people通常更中性。

senses.en: having no doubt about something
definitely going to happen
particular but not named or fully described

ex.en: I'm certain I left my keys on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我确信自己把钥匙放在厨房桌上了。

ex.en: Certain types of public transport are more suitable for densely populated cities than rural areas.
ex.zh: 某些类型的公共交通更适合人口密集的城市，而非农村地区。

tip: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

senses.en: Normal or usual, without special or unusual features.

ex.en: It looked like an ordinary box until we opened it.
ex.zh: 打开之前，它看起来就是一个普通盒子。

ex.en: Urban planning should reflect the needs of ordinary residents rather than focus exclusively on attracting wealthy investors.
ex.zh: 城市规划应反映普通居民的需求，而不是只顾吸引富有的投资者。

tip: ordinary强调不特别；不等于表示平均水平的average。

senses.en: A small cloth used for wiping your nose or face.

ex.en: She pulled a clean handkerchief from her coat pocket.
ex.zh: 她从外套口袋里掏出一块干净的手帕。

ex.en: Using a washable handkerchief instead of disposable tissues can reduce everyday household waste.
ex.zh: 使用可清洗的手帕代替一次性纸巾，可以减少日常生活垃圾。

tip: 指擦脸、擦鼻子的手帕，一般不指头巾。

senses.en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells
a tool shaped like a gun that releases a substance

ex.en: The old gun was displayed behind glass at the museum.
ex.zh: 那支旧枪陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。

ex.en: Strict gun storage regulations can help prevent accidents and improve safety within local communities.
ex.zh: 严格的枪支存放规定有助于预防事故，提高当地社区的安全水平。

col: a loaded gun｜装有弹药的枪
tip: gun也可指枪状工具，如glue gun（胶枪）。

senses.en: very interested in something or eager to do it
quick to notice or understand things
very strong or intense

ex.en: Leila is keen to join our weekend hiking group.
ex.zh: 莱拉很想加入我们的周末徒步小组。

ex.en: Students who are keen on science benefit from practical experiments that connect theory with everyday experience.
ex.zh: 热爱科学的学生能从将理论与日常经验相结合的实践实验中受益。

col: a keen eye for detail｜敏锐的细节观察力
tip: keen on后接名词或动名词；keen to后接动词原形。

senses.en: Support and attention given to someone who needs help
To feel concern or consider something important
Attention given to avoiding mistakes or damage

ex.en: My grandmother receives excellent care at the local clinic.
ex.zh: 我奶奶在当地诊所得到很好的照料。

ex.en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to remain employed while ensuring that young children receive appropriate care.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的托育服务让更多家长能够继续工作，同时确保幼儿得到妥善照料。

tip: care about指在意；care for可指照料或喜欢。

senses.en: coloured liquid used for writing, drawing or printing
to apply ink to a surface

ex.en: Blue ink leaked from my pen onto my sleeve.
ex.zh: 蓝色墨水从钢笔里漏出来，沾到了我的袖子上。

ex.en: Schools can reduce their environmental impact by using less paper and choosing refillable ink cartridges.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过减少纸张用量和选择可填充墨盒来降低对环境的影响。

col: run out of ink｜墨水用完
tip: ink作名词通常不可数；“用墨水写”用in ink。

senses.en: Feeling uncomfortable or ashamed about something others notice.

ex.en: I felt embarrassed when my phone rang during dinner.
ex.zh: 吃饭时手机响了，我感到很尴尬。

ex.en: Students may feel embarrassed about making mistakes, so teachers should create a supportive classroom environment.
ex.zh: 学生可能因犯错而感到难为情，因此教师应营造支持性的课堂环境。

col: too embarrassed to ask｜难为情而不敢问
tip: 人感到尴尬用embarrassed；事令人尴尬用embarrassing。

senses.en: Causing suffering without caring about others' feelings.
Causing great suffering or disappointment.

ex.en: It was cruel to laugh at her mistake.
ex.zh: 嘲笑她的错误很刻薄。

ex.en: Schools should address cruel behaviour early to ensure that every child feels safe and respected.
ex.zh: 学校应及早处理伤害他人的行为，确保每个孩子都感到安全并受到尊重。

col: be cruel to animals｜虐待动物
tip: 表示对某人或动物残忍，用be cruel to。

senses.en: A long walk, usually through the countryside or mountains.
To walk a long distance, especially in natural surroundings.
A large increase in a price, cost, or rate.

ex.en: Our weekend hike ended beside a clear mountain lake.
ex.zh: 我们周末的徒步旅行在一片清澈的山间湖泊旁结束。

ex.en: A sharp hike in public transport fares could discourage commuters from choosing buses over private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通票价大幅上涨可能会降低通勤者选择公交车而非私家车的意愿。

tip: hike通常指较长的户外步行，也可指价格猛涨。

senses.en: someone you do not know
someone unfamiliar with a particular place or community

ex.en: A kind stranger helped me carry my heavy suitcase.
ex.zh: 一位好心的陌生人帮我提了沉重的行李箱。

ex.en: Community events can encourage residents to interact with strangers and develop a stronger sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 社区活动可以鼓励居民与陌生人交流，增强归属感。

col: stranger to the area｜初到这一地区的人
tip: stranger是陌生人，不等于foreigner外国人。

senses.en: to remain in a place after others leave

ex.en: A few students stayed behind to ask questions.
ex.zh: 几个学生留下来问问题。

ex.en: Please stay behind after the meeting for a moment.
ex.zh: 会后请留一下。

tip: stay behind 表示“留在原处（别人走后）”。
scene: A student staying behind to talk to the teacher after class.

senses.en: a process in which people vote to choose representatives
the act of being chosen for a position by voting

ex.en: Our club is holding an election for its next chair.
ex.zh: 我们俱乐部正在举行选举，选出下一任主席。

ex.en: A fair election requires transparent procedures and equal opportunities for candidates to present their policies.
ex.zh: 公平的选举需要透明的程序，并让候选人有平等机会介绍其政策。

tip: elect强调投票选出；select泛指挑选。

senses.en: A dark shape or area where something blocks light.
To follow someone closely, often to learn about their work.

ex.en: The cat chased its shadow across the sunny kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 猫在阳光照着的厨房地板上追逐自己的影子。

ex.en: Allowing students to shadow experienced nurses can help them understand the practical demands of a healthcare career.
ex.zh: 让学生跟随经验丰富的护士学习，有助于他们了解医疗职业的实际要求。

tip: shadow指具体影子；shade多指遮阳的阴凉处。

senses.en: not treating people equally or reasonably

ex.en: It seems unfair that I always wash the dishes.
ex.zh: 总是让我洗碗，这似乎不公平。

ex.en: Unfair hiring practices can prevent qualified applicants from accessing employment opportunities and reduce diversity in the workplace.
ex.zh: 不公平的招聘做法可能使合格的求职者失去就业机会，并降低职场的多样性。

col: unfair to someone｜对某人不公平
tip: 表示“对某人不公平”用unfair to someone。

senses.en: a school for young children

ex.en: My son goes to the local primary school.
ex.zh: 我儿子在本地小学上学。

ex.en: Primary school starts at nine in the morning.
ex.zh: 小学早上九点上课。

tip: primary school 是英式“小学”；美式说 elementary school。
scene: A primary school building with young children at the gate.

senses.en: good wishes sent to someone

ex.en: Please give my regards to your parents.
ex.zh: 请代我向你父母问好。

ex.en: With best regards, Anna.
ex.zh: 此致最美好的祝愿，安娜。

col: best regards｜致以最美好的祝愿
tip: best regards 是信件结尾敬语；give my regards to 是“代我问候”。
scene: A person signing a letter with best regards at a desk.

senses.en: to find how many things there are
to matter or have an important effect
the act of counting, or the total found

ex.en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来之前数一下盘子。

ex.en: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
ex.zh: 评估教育成效时，学生的自信和创造力应与考试成绩同样重要。

col: lose count｜数不清；忘记数到哪里
every minute counts｜每分钟都很重要
tip: count on意为依靠；count作“重要”时不及物。

senses.en: The conditions and events affecting someone or something at a time.

ex.en: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
ex.zh: 汽车抛锚时，我们陷入了困境。

ex.en: The housing situation has become increasingly difficult for young people living in major cities.
ex.zh: 对居住在大城市的年轻人来说，住房形势已变得日益严峻。

col: deal with a situation｜应对某种情况
tip: 表示处于某种情况，用in a situation。

senses.en: Not giving enough attention to avoid mistakes or damage.

ex.en: I was careless and left my keys in the door.
ex.zh: 我一时粗心，把钥匙留在了门上。

ex.en: Careless disposal of household waste can pollute local waterways and create serious risks for wildlife.
ex.zh: 随意丢弃生活垃圾会污染当地水道，并给野生动物带来严重风险。

col: a careless mistake｜粗心造成的错误
tip: careless是粗心的；carefree才是无忧无虑的。

senses.en: A picture made using a camera.

ex.en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们在那座老桥旁拍了张照片。

ex.en: Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
ex.zh: 历史照片为研究城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵证据。

tip: photo是photograph的常用简称；复数为photos。

senses.en: in the beginning, before later

ex.en: At first, the maths problem seemed difficult.
ex.zh: 起初这道数学题看起来很难。

ex.en: At first I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
ex.zh: 一开始我不喜欢这座城市，现在我很喜欢。

tip: at first 表示“最初”，常与 later/now 形成对比。
scene: A student frowning at a maths problem, then smiling after solving it.

senses.en: Someone whose job is to investigate crimes or discover facts

ex.en: The detective found a muddy footprint beside the window.
ex.zh: 警探在窗边发现了一个带泥的脚印。

ex.en: Modern detectives increasingly rely on digital evidence, which raises important questions about privacy and data protection.
ex.zh: 现代警探越来越依赖数字证据，这引发了有关隐私和数据保护的重要问题。

tip: detective novel中detective作名词定语。

senses.en: A vehicle driven forward by powerful gases, often into space
Rise or increase very quickly

ex.en: We watched the rocket rise above the clouds.
ex.zh: 我们看着火箭升到云层上方。

ex.en: As housing demand continues to grow, rents may rocket in cities with limited space for new development.
ex.zh: 随着住房需求持续增长，新开发空间有限的城市可能出现租金飞涨。

tip: 作动词常描述价格等猛涨，比increase语气更强。

senses.en: to stop briefly before continuing
a short break in an activity or speech

ex.en: She paused at the door to check her bag.
ex.zh: 她在门口停下来检查了一下包。

ex.en: Teachers should pause after asking questions to give students enough time to develop their answers.
ex.zh: 教师提问后应稍作停顿，让学生有足够的时间组织答案。

col: pause for a moment｜稍停片刻
tip: pause指暂时停下，通常暗示还会继续。

senses.en: Written works valued for their artistic qualities.
Written material about a particular subject.

ex.en: My sister studies literature and always recommends wonderful novels.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学文学，总能推荐很棒的小说。

ex.en: A review of the scientific literature suggests that regular exercise can improve mental health.
ex.zh: 对科学文献的综述表明，经常运动可以改善心理健康。

col: English literature｜英国文学；英语文学
tip: 通常不可数；表示多篇文献时也不用加s。

senses.en: A covered vehicle used to carry goods or people.

ex.en: We loaded the boxes into a small white van.
ex.zh: 我们把箱子装进了一辆白色的小型厢式货车。

ex.en: Replacing diesel delivery vans with electric vehicles could help reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 用电动车替换柴油送货车，有助于减少人口密集城市的空气污染。

col: hire a van｜租一辆厢式货车
load a van｜往厢式货车上装货
tip: 常指载货的封闭式车辆；不要与敞篷货车混淆。

senses.en: The process of expressing meaning in another language.
A spoken or written version in another language.

ex.en: This translation of the story is easy to understand.
ex.zh: 这个故事的译文很容易理解。

ex.en: Accurate translation allows researchers from different countries to share findings and collaborate more effectively.
ex.zh: 准确的翻译使不同国家的研究人员能够分享研究结果，并更有效地合作。

tip: 翻译成某语言用into；从某语言翻译用from。

senses.en: Not expected to happen or be true.
Surprising because someone or something does not seem suitable.

ex.en: With such dark clouds, sunshine seems unlikely this afternoon.
ex.zh: 云层这么黑，今天下午看来不太可能有阳光。

ex.en: Public transport use is unlikely to increase unless services become more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 除非服务变得更可靠、票价更实惠，否则公共交通的使用量不太可能增加。

col: unlikely to happen｜不太可能发生
an unlikely friendship｜出人意料的友谊
tip: 常用be unlikely to do或It is unlikely that。

senses.en: The front window of a car or other vehicle.

ex.en: Heavy rain splashed against the windscreen throughout our journey.
ex.zh: 一路上，大雨不断拍打着汽车的挡风玻璃。

ex.en: A damaged windscreen can reduce visibility, so regular vehicle inspections are essential for maintaining road safety.
ex.zh: 受损的挡风玻璃会影响视野，因此定期检查车辆对维护道路安全至关重要。

tip: 英式英语用windscreen，美式英语通常用windshield。

senses.en: The particular way someone forms words when writing by hand.

ex.en: Your handwriting is much neater with this new pen.
ex.zh: 你用这支新笔写的字工整多了。

ex.en: Although digital devices are common in classrooms, clear handwriting remains useful for examinations and personal communication.
ex.zh: 虽然数字设备在课堂上很常见，但清晰的手写字在考试和个人交流中仍然有用。

tip: 通常不可数；优美书法这门艺术用calligraphy。

senses.en: to end a relationship, or to divide

ex.en: They split up after five years.
ex.zh: 他们五年后分手了。

ex.en: Let's split up and search the park.
ex.zh: 我们分开搜索公园吧。

tip: split up 表示“分手/分开”。
scene: Two people going different ways at a park path fork.

senses.en: the chance that something might happen or be true

senses.zh: 可考虑的选择；可能的事
senses.en: something that might happen or could be chosen

ex.en: There is a possibility of snow later tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚些时候可能会下雪。

ex.en: Improved public transport increases the possibility that commuters will leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通会增加通勤者不开车出行的可能性。

col: a real possibility｜确实存在的可能性
explore the possibilities｜探索各种可能的选择
rule out the possibility｜排除可能性
tip: 常用possibility of doing或possibility that从句。

senses.en: not one or the other of two
not either of two people or things
used to add another negative statement

ex.en: Neither jacket fits me, so I will keep looking.
ex.zh: 两件夹克都不合身，所以我会继续挑选。

ex.en: Neither approach can solve traffic congestion alone, so cities need a combination of investment and regulation.
ex.zh: 两种方法都无法单独解决交通拥堵，因此城市需要将投资与监管相结合。

col: neither of them｜他们两个都不
tip: neither只用于两者；接单数名词，常与nor搭配。

senses.en: to join things together or link them electronically
to recognize or establish a relationship between things
to develop a good relationship with someone

ex.en: Connect your phone to the speaker using this cable.
ex.zh: 用这根线把手机连接到音箱上。

ex.en: New rail services can connect rural communities with cities, improving access to education and employment.
ex.zh: 新的铁路服务可以连接农村社区与城市，让人们更容易获得教育和就业机会。

col: connect to the internet｜连接互联网
connect A with B｜把A与B联系起来
connect with people｜与人建立联系
tip: 连接设备常用connect A to B。

senses.en: Put your arms around someone and hold them close
An act of holding someone close with your arms

ex.en: Lena hugged her grandmother before leaving for school.
ex.zh: 莉娜上学前拥抱了奶奶。

ex.en: A reassuring hug from a parent can help young children manage stress in unfamiliar situations.
ex.zh: 父母一个令人安心的拥抱能帮助幼儿应对陌生环境中的压力。

col: give someone a hug｜拥抱某人
hug someone tightly｜紧紧拥抱某人
tip: 过去式hugged、现在分词hugging均双写g。

senses.zh: 有历史意义的；历史著名的
senses.en: Important in history or likely to be remembered in history.

ex.en: We crossed the historic bridge just before sunset.
ex.zh: 我们在日落前走过了那座历史名桥。

ex.en: Protecting historic buildings helps cities preserve their cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting local businesses.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市保留文化特色，同时吸引游客并支持当地商业。

col: historic agreement｜具有历史意义的协议
tip: historic强调历史意义；historical泛指与历史有关。

senses.en: buildings, rooms or equipment for a purpose

ex.en: The hotel has great sports facilities.
ex.zh: 这家酒店有很棒的运动设施。

ex.en: The school's facilities include a library and a gym.
ex.zh: 学校的设施包括图书馆和体育馆。

tip: facilities 常用复数，指场所提供的设施。
scene: A modern sports centre with a gym and swimming pool signs.

senses.en: a sport where you jump as far as possible

ex.en: He broke the school record in the long jump.
ex.zh: 他打破了学校跳远纪录。

ex.en: The long jump competition starts at ten.
ex.zh: 跳远比赛十点开始。

tip: long jump 是跳远；high jump 是跳高。
scene: An athlete jumping far into a sand pit at a sports field.

senses.en: an infectious illness causing fever, aches, and tiredness

ex.en: She stayed in bed all weekend with the flu.
ex.zh: 她得了流感，整个周末都卧床休息。

ex.en: Annual flu vaccinations can help protect vulnerable people and reduce pressure on hospitals during winter.
ex.zh: 每年接种流感疫苗有助于保护易感人群，并减轻冬季医院的压力。

tip: flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。

senses.en: the sport or activity of riding horses

ex.en: She goes horse-riding every weekend.
ex.zh: 她每周末去骑马。

ex.en: Horse-riding is popular in the countryside.
ex.zh: 骑马在乡村很受欢迎。

tip: horse-riding 与 riding 都指骑马运动。
scene: A rider on a horse trotting through a green field.

senses.en: A metal container, especially for food, or its contents.
A soft, silver-coloured metal used to coat other metals.

ex.en: There is a tin of beans in the cupboard.
ex.zh: 橱柜里有一罐豆子。

ex.en: Reusing a metal tin for storage can reduce household waste and the need for new containers.
ex.zh: 重复利用金属罐储物，可以减少生活垃圾以及对新容器的需求。

tip: 罐子义可数，英式常用tin，美式常用can；锡不可数。

senses.en: A scientist who studies chemicals and how they react.
A pharmacist, or a shop that sells medicines, in British English.

ex.en: The chemist carefully poured the liquid into a glass tube.
ex.zh: 化学研究员小心地把液体倒进玻璃试管。

ex.en: Chemists are developing safer materials that could reduce the environmental impact of industrial production.
ex.zh: 化学家正在研发更安全的材料，以减轻工业生产对环境的影响。

tip: 英式中还指药剂师；chemist's常指药店。

senses.en: An unrestricted speech sound, or a letter representing such a sound.

ex.en: Our teacher stretched the vowel sound as we listened.
ex.zh: 老师把元音拉长，让我们仔细听。

ex.en: Recognising differences between vowel sounds can help language learners understand unfamiliar accents and communicate more clearly.
ex.zh: 辨别元音之间的差异有助于语言学习者理解陌生口音，并更清晰地交流。

tip: a或an的选择看后接词的首音是否为元音，不看字母。

senses.en: the worth, price, or importance of something
consider something important or estimate how much it is worth
beliefs about what is right and important in life

ex.en: This sturdy backpack offers excellent value for the price.
ex.zh: 这个结实的背包非常物有所值。

ex.en: Governments should recognise the value of public parks in improving physical health and strengthening community relationships.
ex.zh: 政府应认识到公共公园在改善身体健康和加强社区联系方面的价值。

col: place a high value on｜高度重视
tip: 表示“价值观”用复数values。

senses.en: A formal talk given to an audience.
The ability or act of expressing thoughts through spoken words.

ex.en: Leila practised her speech in front of the mirror.
ex.zh: 莱拉对着镜子练习演讲。

ex.en: In his speech, the researcher explained how access to green spaces can improve children's mental health.
ex.zh: 研究人员在演讲中解释了接触绿地如何改善儿童的心理健康。

tip: 一次演讲用a speech；说话能力通常不可数。

senses.en: The art and practice of designing buildings.
The style and appearance of buildings.
The way a computer system or other complex structure is organised.

ex.en: My brother studies architecture and builds tiny house models.
ex.zh: 我哥哥学建筑设计，还制作小房子模型。

ex.en: Sustainable architecture can reduce energy consumption by making better use of natural light and ventilation.
ex.zh: 可持续建筑设计可以更充分地利用自然采光和通风，从而降低能耗。

tip: architecture通常不可数；architect指建筑师。

senses.en: Caring about your own needs without considering other people

ex.en: It was selfish to take the whole cake.
ex.zh: 把整个蛋糕拿走太自私了。

ex.en: Selfish behaviour in shared housing can create tension and undermine trust among residents over time.
ex.zh: 合租住房中的自私行为会造成矛盾，并逐渐损害住户之间的信任。

col: selfish of someone｜某人这样做很自私
tip: 评价某人的行为用It is selfish of sb to do。

senses.en: a card you need to get on a plane

ex.en: Please show your boarding pass at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在登机口出示登机牌。

ex.en: She printed her boarding pass at home.
ex.zh: 她在家里打印了登机牌。

tip: boarding pass 是登机牌；boarding 是登机/上船。
scene: A hand holding a boarding pass at an airport gate.

senses.en: Older than another person, especially within the same family
An older person, especially one respected within a community

ex.en: My elder sister taught me how to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我姐姐教会了我骑自行车。

ex.en: Community elders can help preserve local traditions by sharing their knowledge and experiences with younger generations.
ex.zh: 社区长者可以通过向年轻一代分享知识和经历，帮助传承当地传统。

tip: elder 多放在亲属名词前；比较年龄用 older than。

senses.en: Inside a particular area, period, or limit.
Inside something rather than outside it.

ex.en: Your parcel should arrive within the next three days.
ex.zh: 你的包裹应该会在接下来的三天内送达。

ex.en: Local authorities should ensure that essential services are available within walking distance of residential areas.
ex.zh: 地方政府应确保居民区步行可达的范围内有基本服务设施。

tip: within强调不超出某范围；within a week指一周内。

senses.en: make someone face an unpleasant consequence for doing wrong

ex.en: The referee punished the player for breaking the rules.
ex.zh: 裁判因那名球员违反规则而对其作出处罚。

ex.en: Schools should explain why behaviour is unacceptable rather than simply punish students without offering guidance.
ex.zh: 学校应解释为何某种行为不可接受，而不是只惩罚学生却不给予引导。

col: punish someone for something｜因某事惩罚某人
tip: punish sb for sth表示因某事惩罚某人。

senses.en: An opportunity to do something.
The likelihood that something will happen.
Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.

ex.en: Can you give me another chance to explain?
ex.zh: 你能再给我一次解释的机会吗？

ex.en: Affordable training gives unemployed adults a chance to gain new skills and return to the workforce.
ex.zh: 费用可负担的培训让失业的成年人有机会掌握新技能，重返职场。

col: a chance to learn｜学习的机会
a good chance of｜很有可能
tip: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

senses.en: to put your hand or another body part against something
the sense of feeling things through skin, or physical contact
to make someone feel a strong, often tender emotion

ex.en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
ex.zh: 请别碰锅，它还很烫。

ex.en: Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.
ex.zh: 即使工作或学习使家人分居不同国家，数字通信也能帮助他们保持联系。

tip: 保持联系用keep in touch with someone。

senses.en: to feel a steady pain that is usually not sharp
a steady pain that lasts for some time
to want something very deeply

ex.en: My legs ache after walking up all those stairs.
ex.zh: 爬完那么多级楼梯后，我的双腿酸痛。

ex.en: Office workers whose backs ache regularly may benefit from adjustable desks and more frequent movement breaks.
ex.zh: 经常背痛的办公室职员可能会受益于可调节办公桌和更频繁的活动休息。

tip: ache多指持续钝痛；pain可泛指各种疼痛。

senses.en: a place serving meals in a school or workplace
a container used to carry drinking water outdoors

ex.en: We usually eat lunch together in the school canteen.
ex.zh: 我们通常一起在学校食堂吃午饭。

ex.en: Providing affordable healthy meals in the workplace canteen can improve employee wellbeing and productivity.
ex.zh: 在工作场所的食堂提供价格实惠的健康餐食，可以改善员工的身心健康并提高生产力。

tip: 英式英语中常指食堂；美式英语常用cafeteria。

senses.en: Find an answer to a problem or mystery

ex.en: We solved the puzzle together after dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们一起解开了那道谜题。

ex.en: Improving public transport could help solve traffic problems in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通有助于解决快速发展城区的交通问题。

tip: solve直接接问题；“溶解”用dissolve。

senses.en: The same in amount, value, status, or opportunity.
To be the same in quantity, value, or quality.
Someone with the same status, ability, or rights as another.

ex.en: We divided the cake into equal pieces for everyone.
ex.zh: 我们把蛋糕切成大小相等的小块，分给大家。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that children from all backgrounds have equal access to quality education and essential healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应确保各种背景的儿童都能平等地获得优质教育和基本医疗服务。

col: treat as an equal｜平等对待
tip: 形容词常接to；动词equal直接接宾语，不加to。

senses.en: To have a different opinion from someone else.
To give different information or results.

ex.en: We disagree about which colour to paint the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们对于厨房该刷什么颜色意见不一。

ex.en: Experts disagree on whether free public transport is the most effective way to reduce urban traffic.
ex.zh: 专家对于免费公共交通是否是减少城市交通流量的最有效方法意见不一。

col: disagree with someone｜不同意某人的看法
disagree about something｜在某事上意见不合
tip: 不同意某人用disagree with；争议话题用on或about。

senses.en: to stop doing something or leave a job

ex.en: He quit his job to travel around the world.
ex.zh: 他辞职去环游世界。

ex.en: She quit smoking last year.
ex.zh: 她去年戒烟了。

tip: quit 是“放弃/辞职/停止”；过去式 quit。
scene: A person handing in a letter at an office desk.

senses.en: To stop working permanently, usually because of age.
To leave a competition before finishing it.

ex.en: My aunt plans to retire and spend more time gardening.
ex.zh: 我姑姑打算退休，多花些时间种花种菜。

ex.en: As life expectancy increases, some governments encourage people to retire later to reduce pressure on pension systems.
ex.zh: 随着预期寿命延长，一些政府鼓励人们推迟退休，以减轻养老金制度的压力。

col: retire from a race｜退出比赛
tip: retire是动词；“退休”这一名词用retirement。

senses.en: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works.
To write a book, report, or other written work.

ex.en: The author answered questions about her new adventure novel.
ex.zh: 这位作者回答了有关她新出版的冒险小说的问题。

ex.en: An author can challenge social attitudes by presenting familiar problems through the experiences of unfamiliar characters.
ex.zh: 作者可以借助陌生人物的经历呈现熟悉的问题，从而挑战社会观念。

col: the author of a novel｜一部小说的作者
tip: “……的作者”用the author of；也可作动词。

senses.en: to get rid of something

ex.en: Don't throw away the box; we can reuse it.
ex.zh: 别扔掉盒子，我们可以再利用。

ex.en: She threw away the old newspapers.
ex.zh: 她扔掉了旧报纸。

tip: throw away 是“扔掉”；注意环保，减少乱扔。
scene: A hand throwing a paper box into a recycling bin.

senses.en: To have to pay money back to someone.
To have a duty to give someone something.
To have something because of someone's help or another cause.

ex.en: I still owe my sister money for the tickets.
ex.zh: 我还欠姐姐买票的钱。

ex.en: Many successful students owe their progress to consistent practice rather than exceptional natural ability.
ex.zh: 许多优秀学生的进步归功于持续练习，而非非凡的天赋。

col: owe an apology｜应向某人道歉
owe a debt of gratitude｜深受恩惠
owe success to｜把成功归功于
tip: owe A to B可指欠B东西A，也可指把A归功于B。

senses.en: to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or playing music
to carry out a task, action, or duty
to work or achieve results in a particular way

ex.en: Our choir will perform at the community centre tonight.
ex.zh: 我们的合唱团今晚将在社区中心演出。

ex.en: Students often perform better academically when schools provide regular feedback and access to individual support.
ex.zh: 学校提供定期反馈和个别支持时，学生的学业表现往往更好。

tip: 既可指表演，也可接task、duty表示执行。

senses.en: The quality of having great value or a strong effect.

ex.en: Losing my keys taught me the importance of a spare.
ex.zh: 丢了钥匙后，我才明白备用钥匙有多重要。

ex.en: Schools should emphasise the importance of critical thinking rather than focusing only on examination results.
ex.zh: 学校应强调批判性思维的重要性，而不是只关注考试成绩。

col: recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: importance不可数；重视某事用attach importance to。

senses.en: A small, round, green seed eaten as a vegetable

ex.en: She added frozen peas to the vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 她往蔬菜汤里加了些冷冻豌豆。

ex.en: Growing peas and other vegetables at school can help children understand where their food comes from.
ex.zh: 在学校种植豌豆和其他蔬菜，可以帮助孩子了解食物的来源。

tip: 可数名词；泛指食用的豌豆通常用复数peas。

senses.en: To have a plan or purpose in mind.
To mean something or design it for a particular purpose.

ex.en: I intend to finish painting the kitchen this weekend.
ex.zh: 我打算这周末刷完厨房。

ex.en: The council intends to expand public transport services to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 地方议会打算扩大公共交通服务，以减少人们对私家车的依赖。

col: intend to do something｜打算做某事
tip: intend to do表示打算做；be intended for表示供……用。

senses.zh: 色彩鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的
senses.en: Having many bright colours

senses.zh: 生动有趣的；丰富多彩的
senses.en: Full of interesting, unusual or exciting details

ex.en: Colourful balloons floated above the tables at the party.
ex.zh: 聚会上，五彩缤纷的气球飘浮在桌子上方。

ex.en: Colourful public murals can transform neglected urban spaces and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 色彩鲜艳的公共壁画能改变被忽视的城市空间，增强居民对社区的自豪感。

col: a colourful character｜有趣独特的人物
a colourful history｜丰富多彩的历史
tip: 英式拼写colourful，美式拼写colorful。

senses.en: rising or falling at a sharp angle
describing a sharp change or an unusually high price
to leave something in liquid to release flavour or soften it

ex.en: We pushed our bikes up the steep hill.
ex.zh: 我们推着自行车爬上了陡坡。

ex.en: A steep rise in housing costs can force young workers to move away from major cities.
ex.zh: 住房成本急剧上涨可能迫使年轻劳动者离开大城市。

tip: steep既形容坡陡，也形容价格高或变化剧烈。

senses.en: as stated or reported by someone or something
following a rule, plan, or particular standard

ex.en: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this afternoon.
ex.zh: 据天气预报，今天下午会下雨。

ex.en: According to recent research, regular physical activity can improve concentration and reduce stress among university students.
ex.zh: 根据近期研究，经常进行体育活动可以提高大学生的专注力并减轻压力。

col: according to the rules｜按照规则
tip: 引述他人观点用according to；自己的观点用in my opinion。

senses.en: To crush something flat or squeeze into a small space
An indoor racket sport played by hitting a ball against walls
A vegetable with thick skin and a soft, seed-filled centre

ex.en: Don't squash the bread under those heavy shopping bags.
ex.zh: 别把面包压在那些沉重的购物袋下面。

ex.en: Playing squash regularly can improve cardiovascular fitness, although beginners should increase the intensity of exercise gradually.
ex.zh: 经常打壁球可以增强心肺功能，不过初学者应逐步提高运动强度。

tip: 英式英语中还可指需加水稀释的浓缩果汁饮料。

senses.en: Very unpleasant to experience, taste, smell, or see.
Deliberately unkind or hurtful towards another person.
Severe or painful, especially describing an illness or injury.

ex.en: A nasty smell came from the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。

ex.en: Nasty comments on social media can discourage young people from participating in otherwise valuable online discussions.
ex.zh: 社交媒体上的恶意评论可能使年轻人不愿参与原本有价值的网络讨论。

tip: 比bad更带厌恶感；形容人时通常指刻薄、不友善。

senses.en: to interrupt someone's activity, rest, or peace
to make someone feel worried or upset
to move or change something from its usual position

ex.en: Please close the door quietly so you don't disturb Dad.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门，别打扰爸爸。

ex.en: Construction noise can disturb nearby residents and reduce their quality of life over time.
ex.zh: 施工噪声可能打扰附近居民，并逐渐降低他们的生活质量。

col: disturb someone's sleep｜打扰某人睡眠
tip: disturb强调打扰或使不安；interrupt强调中断。

senses.en: painful, especially when touched or moved
a painful damaged area on the skin
upset or annoyed about something unfair or disappointing

ex.en: My legs are sore after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很远的路，我的腿现在酸痛。

ex.en: Office workers may develop sore muscles if they remain seated without taking regular breaks.
ex.zh: 上班族如果久坐而不定时休息，可能会出现肌肉酸痛。

tip: sore常修饰身体部位，如a sore throat。

senses.en: The distance from a surface to the bottom.
The degree of detail, understanding, or seriousness.

ex.en: Check the depth before you jump into the pool.
ex.zh: 跳进泳池前先确认水深。

ex.en: University courses should encourage students to explore complex environmental issues in greater depth.
ex.zh: 大学课程应鼓励学生更深入地探讨复杂的环境问题。

tip: in depth表示“深入地”，不是“在深处”。

senses.en: a number expressing an amount, especially in official information
a person, their outline, or the shape of their body
to think or decide something after considering it

ex.en: She checked the final figure on the bill.
ex.zh: 她核对了账单上的最终金额。

ex.en: Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.
ex.zh: 近期就业数据显示，投资公共交通能为当地劳动者创造大量机会。

tip: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

senses.en: a piece of furniture with drawers for clothes

ex.en: My socks are in the chest of drawers.
ex.zh: 我的袜子在五斗柜里。

ex.en: The wooden chest of drawers stands by the bed.
ex.zh: 木抽屉柜放在床边。

tip: chest of drawers 是带多个抽屉的衣柜。
scene: A wooden chest of drawers with open drawers showing folded clothes.

senses.en: A member of the police.
A member of the armed forces with authority to command.
Someone with an official role in an organisation or government.

ex.en: A police officer helped us find the station.
ex.zh: 一位警察帮我们找到了车站。

ex.en: A local housing officer can advise residents on applying for affordable accommodation and accessing financial support.
ex.zh: 当地住房事务官员可以指导居民申请可负担住房并获取经济援助。

tip: officer可指警察或军官，具体含义看搭配。

senses.en: A wide-mouthed container, often glass, with a lid.
To feel unpleasant or clash with something.
To shake suddenly and sharply, sometimes causing pain.

ex.en: She keeps homemade jam in a small glass jar.
ex.zh: 她把自制果酱装在一个小玻璃罐里。

ex.en: Reusing glass jars for food storage can help households reduce their reliance on disposable plastic packaging.
ex.zh: 重复使用玻璃罐储存食品可以帮助家庭减少对一次性塑料包装的依赖。

col: a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜
jar with the surroundings｜与周围环境不协调
tip: jar 常指有盖广口罐；a jar of 后接所装物。

senses.en: Successfully reach a goal or result through effort.

ex.en: With daily practice, she finally achieved her swimming goal.
ex.zh: 通过每天练习，她终于实现了自己的游泳目标。

ex.en: Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资清洁能源和改善公共交通，大幅减少空气污染。

tip: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。

senses.en: on a ship, plane or vehicle

ex.en: All passengers are now on board the plane.
ex.zh: 所有乘客都已登机。

ex.en: Welcome on board the train to London.
ex.zh: 欢迎乘坐开往伦敦的火车。

tip: on board 表示“在交通工具上”，如 get on board 登机/上船。
scene: Passengers boarding a plane through the door.

senses.en: containing a lot of moisture in the air

ex.en: It feels so humid that my shirt sticks to me.
ex.zh: 天气湿热得我的衬衫都贴在身上了。

ex.en: In humid climates, buildings require effective ventilation to prevent mould growth and protect residents' health.
ex.zh: 在潮湿气候中，建筑物需要有效通风，以防止霉菌滋生并保护居民健康。

tip: humid主要形容空气或气候潮湿，不用于湿衣服。

senses.en: the period of life when someone is young
young people considered as a group
a young man, especially a teenager

ex.en: My grandmother spent her youth in a seaside village.
ex.zh: 我祖母的青年时代是在一个海边村庄度过的。

ex.en: Investment in youth services can give young people valuable skills and strengthen their sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 对青年服务的投资能让年轻人掌握实用技能，并增强他们的归属感。

col: in one's youth｜在某人年轻时
tip: 表示青春通常不可数；a youth指一名年轻男子。

senses.en: a traditional or usual way of behaving
made to meet a particular customer's needs
the business customers give to a shop or company

ex.en: Sharing a meal is an important custom in our family.
ex.zh: 一起吃饭是我们家的一项重要惯例。

ex.en: Schools can introduce children to local customs while encouraging respect for traditions from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学校可以向孩子们介绍当地风俗，同时鼓励他们尊重其他文化的传统。

tip: custom指风俗或惯例；customs还可指海关。

senses.en: Become greater in amount or size, or make something greater
A rise in the amount, size, or level of something

ex.en: The bakery increased its prices again this week.
ex.zh: 这家面包店本周又涨价了。

ex.en: An increase in public transport investment could reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in cities.
ex.zh: 增加公共交通投资可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

col: an increase in demand｜需求的增长
tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；by接增量，to接终值。

senses.en: an official card that allows you to drive

ex.en: He passed his driving test and got a licence.
ex.zh: 他通过了驾驶考试，拿到了驾照。

ex.en: She forgot her driving licence at home.
ex.zh: 她把驾照忘在家里了。

tip: driving licence 是英式拼写；美式是 driver's license。
scene: A driving licence card lying on a car seat.

senses.en: a person walking rather than travelling in a vehicle
intended for or relating to people travelling on foot
ordinary and lacking imagination or excitement

ex.en: The driver stopped to let a pedestrian cross.
ex.zh: 司机停车让一位行人过马路。

ex.en: Wider pavements and safer crossings can protect pedestrians and encourage residents to walk instead of driving.
ex.zh: 更宽的人行道和更安全的过街设施可以保护行人，鼓励居民步行而非开车。

tip: 作名词指行人；作形容词也可指作品平庸乏味。

senses.en: One or the other of two; each of two sides.
One or the other of two people or things.
Also not, used after a negative statement.

ex.en: You can borrow either umbrella; both are dry.
ex.zh: 两把伞你随便借哪把都行，都是干的。

ex.en: Students can choose either vocational training or university education, depending on their interests and career goals.
ex.zh: 学生可以根据自己的兴趣和职业目标，选择职业培训或大学教育。

col: either side｜两边中的任一边；两边各自
either of them｜他们两者中的任一个
tip: either…or…表二选一；否定句末either表“也不”。

senses.en: in or to any place, regardless of where
used in questions to express surprise about a place

ex.en: You can sit wherever you feel most comfortable.
ex.zh: 你觉得哪里最舒服，就可以坐在哪里。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that children receive a good education wherever they live, including in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府应确保儿童无论住在哪里，包括偏远农村地区，都能接受良好教育。

col: wherever possible｜在任何可能的地方
wherever you go｜无论你去哪里
wherever you live｜无论你住在哪里
tip: 表示“无论哪里”时，相当于no matter where。

senses.en: Your name written in your own distinctive way
Distinctive and closely associated with a particular person or place

ex.en: The delivery driver asked for my signature at the door.
ex.zh: 送货司机在门口请我签名。

ex.en: Electronic signatures allow businesses to complete agreements remotely, reducing delays and the need for paper documents.
ex.zh: 电子签名让企业能够远程签订协议，减少延误和纸质文件的使用。

tip: signature通常指签名；名人纪念签名常用autograph。

senses.en: completely or without any doubt
used to express strong agreement with someone

ex.en: The kitchen was absolutely spotless after we cleaned it.
ex.zh: 我们打扫后，厨房一尘不染。

ex.en: Reliable internet access is absolutely essential for students participating in online courses from remote communities.
ex.zh: 对于偏远社区参加在线课程的学生来说，可靠的网络连接必不可少。

tip: 常修饰essential等极限形容词，不常说absolutely good。

senses.en: A change that fixes an error, or the act of fixing it.

ex.en: I made a correction before sending the email.
ex.zh: 我在发送邮件前改正了一处错误。

ex.en: Timely correction of factual errors helps news organizations maintain public trust and prevent misinformation from spreading.
ex.zh: 及时纠正事实错误有助于新闻机构维持公众信任，并防止错误信息传播。

tip: 具体一处修改可数；泛指纠正过程时常不可数。

senses.en: written with a pen, not a pencil

ex.en: Please write your name in ink on the form.
ex.zh: 请用墨水笔在表格上写名字。

ex.en: The exam must be answered in ink.
ex.zh: 考试必须用墨水笔作答。

tip: in ink 是“用钢笔写”；in pencil 用铅笔写。
scene: A hand writing with a blue pen on a form.

senses.en: a loving relationship or the excitement and affection surrounding love
a story or film mainly about love

ex.en: Their romance began during a walking holiday in the mountains.
ex.zh: 他们的恋情始于一次山间徒步假期。

ex.en: Popular films often portray romance in idealised ways, which may shape young people's expectations of relationships.
ex.zh: 流行电影常以理想化的方式描绘爱情，这可能影响年轻人对恋爱关系的期待。

col: a whirlwind romance｜迅速发展的恋情
tip: 泛指爱情常不可数；指一段恋情或一部作品可数。

senses.en: a way taken to get from one place to another
to send someone or something along a particular path

ex.en: We took a different route home to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我们换了一条路线回家，以避开拥堵。

ex.en: Expanding bus routes to rural communities would improve access to employment and essential public services.
ex.zh: 将公交线路延伸至农村社区，有助于居民获得就业机会和基本公共服务。

tip: 美式也读 /raʊt/；route 强调行进路线。

senses.en: Very useful or important for a particular purpose.
Worth a large amount of money.

ex.en: My neighbour gave me valuable advice about growing tomatoes.
ex.zh: 邻居给了我一些种番茄的宝贵建议。

ex.en: Work placements provide valuable experience that helps students develop practical skills before entering full-time employment.
ex.zh: 实习提供宝贵经验，帮助学生在正式就业前培养实践技能。

tip: 贵重物品用复数valuables；invaluable意为极宝贵的。

senses.en: connected with history or events in the past

ex.en: We found historical photographs of our street in the library.
ex.zh: 我们在图书馆找到了这条街过去的照片。

ex.en: Historical records help researchers understand how earlier societies responded to environmental change and economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 历史记录帮助研究人员了解过去的社会如何应对环境变化和经济不确定性。

tip: historical指与历史有关；historic强调具有历史意义。

senses.en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body.
The functioning or management of a machine, system, or business.
A planned activity involving several people working together.

ex.en: My aunt is recovering well after her knee operation.
ex.zh: 我姑姑膝盖手术后恢复得很好。

ex.en: The successful operation of public transport systems depends on reliable funding and careful long-term planning.
ex.zh: 公共交通系统的成功运作有赖于可靠的资金支持和周密的长期规划。

tip: 手术部位用on连接：an operation on the knee。

senses.en: Belief that someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe.
To believe someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe.
An arrangement or organisation managing money or property for others.

ex.en: I trust my neighbour to feed our cat.
ex.zh: 我信得过邻居，放心让他喂我们的猫。

ex.en: Public trust in scientific advice depends partly on how clearly researchers communicate uncertainty and evidence.
ex.zh: 公众对科学建议的信任，部分取决于研究人员能否清晰地说明不确定性和证据。

col: trust someone to do something｜相信某人会做某事
a charitable trust｜慈善信托机构
tip: trust sb to do sth表示相信某人能可靠地做某事。

senses.en: a period spent doing a particular activity
a formal meeting or period when an official body meets

ex.en: Our first swimming session starts early tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我们的第一次游泳课明天一早开始。

ex.en: Regular revision sessions help students retain information more effectively than studying intensively just before examinations.
ex.zh: 定期复习比临考前突击学习更能帮助学生有效记住知识。

col: in session｜正在开会；正在开庭
tip: session强调一段活动时间；semester才通常指学期。

senses.en: needed for a particular purpose or situation

ex.en: Take a warm coat if you think it's necessary.
ex.zh: 如果你觉得有必要，就带上一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Investment in public transport is necessary to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通对于缓解交通拥堵和改善城市空气质量是必要的。

tip: 常用it is necessary to do；necessarily意为“必然地”。

senses.en: To offer an idea or possible action for consideration.
To indicate that something may be true.

ex.en: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 我建议带把伞，因为那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Recent studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among urban residents.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，能够接触绿地可能有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: suggest a solution｜提出解决方案
tip: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

senses.en: In most cases or on most occasions.
In a way that shows the usual qualities of something.

ex.en: Our neighbours typically walk their dog before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居通常在早餐前遛狗。

ex.en: Cities with reliable public transport typically experience less traffic congestion than those dependent on private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通可靠的城市通常比依赖私家车的城市交通拥堵更少。

tip: 通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: a system that cools the air in a room

ex.en: The office has air conditioning, so it's cool in summer.
ex.zh: 办公室有空调，夏天很凉快。

ex.en: Please turn on the air conditioning; it's so hot.
ex.zh: 太热了，请打开空调。

tip: air conditioning 常缩写为 A/C；air-conditioned 是“有空调的”。
scene: A wall air conditioning unit blowing cool air in a hot room.

senses.en: Untidy or dirty, with things scattered or out of place.
Complicated and difficult to deal with.

ex.en: His desk was messy after an afternoon of painting.
ex.zh: 画了一下午画后，他的书桌变得脏乱不堪。

ex.en: Without clear responsibilities, cooperation between public agencies can become messy and delay the delivery of essential services.
ex.zh: 如果没有明确的职责，公共机构之间的合作可能变得混乱，延误基本服务的提供。

tip: messy可指物品脏乱，也可指局面复杂难处理。

senses.en: Happening without being expected or predicted.

ex.en: An unexpected visitor arrived just as we finished lunch.
ex.zh: 我们刚吃完午饭，一位意想不到的客人就来了。

ex.en: Governments need emergency funds to manage unexpected events without reducing essential spending on healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 政府需要应急资金来应对意外事件，避免削减医疗和教育方面的必要支出。

tip: unexpected强调未料到，不一定表示突然发生。

senses.en: To formally express a choice in an election or decision.
A formal expression of choice, or the process of choosing.

ex.en: We voted to hold the picnic in the park.
ex.zh: 我们投票决定在公园里野餐。

ex.en: Allowing residents to vote on local projects may increase public participation in community development.
ex.zh: 允许居民就地方项目投票，可能提高公众参与社区发展的积极性。

tip: vote for表示支持；vote against表示反对。

senses.en: mainly, or for the largest part

ex.en: My weekend was mostly spent cooking and reading.
ex.zh: 我的周末大部分时间都用来做饭和看书了。

ex.en: In many rural areas, residents rely mostly on private vehicles because public transport services are limited.
ex.zh: 在许多农村地区，由于公共交通服务有限，居民主要依靠私家车出行。

tip: mostly指大部分情况；almost指差一点或几乎。

senses.en: at the correct time

ex.en: The train arrived on time.
ex.zh: 火车准点到达。

ex.en: Please be on time for the meeting.
ex.zh: 请准时参加会议。

tip: on time 是“准时”；in time 是“及时”。
scene: A station clock showing the exact time as a train arrives.

senses.en: to continue doing something

ex.en: Carry on with your work; I'll wait outside.
ex.zh: 继续你的工作，我在外面等。

ex.en: She carried on talking even after the bell rang.
ex.zh: 铃响后她还在继续说。

tip: carry on (with) 是“继续做某事”。
scene: A student continuing to write notes while others pack up.

senses.en: to move quickly back and forth, or cause this movement
to upset someone deeply or weaken their confidence
a quick movement back and forth

ex.en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
ex.zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。

ex.en: Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.
ex.zh: 公共交通反复出现故障，可能动摇通勤者对城市服务可靠性的信心。

tip: 不规则变化：shake—shook—shaken。

senses.en: Stop blaming someone or feeling angry about what they did.
Officially allow someone not to repay a debt.

ex.en: Can you forgive me for breaking your favourite mug?
ex.zh: 我打碎了你最喜欢的杯子，你能原谅我吗？

ex.en: International lenders may forgive some debts to help poorer countries invest more in healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 国际贷款机构可能减免部分债务，帮助较贫困国家增加医疗和教育投入。

col: forgive someone for something｜原谅某人某事
tip: 用forgive sb for doing sth；过去式forgave，过去分词forgiven。

senses.en: a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment
a person or company that runs a business or service
a person who connects calls or provides telephone assistance

ex.en: The crane operator carefully lowered the beam into place.
ex.zh: 起重机操作员小心地把横梁降到指定位置。

ex.en: Every public transport operator should ensure that its services remain accessible to passengers with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 每家公共交通运营商都应确保行动不便的乘客能够使用其服务。

col: mobile network operator｜移动网络运营商
tip: 既指操作设备的人，也指经营服务的公司。

senses.en: the bags and suitcases you take when travelling
past experiences or feelings that continue to cause difficulties

ex.en: Our baggage arrived on the next flight this afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们的行李今天下午随下一班飞机到了。

ex.en: Airlines often charge additional fees for checked baggage, increasing the overall cost of travel.
ex.zh: 航空公司常对托运行李额外收费，从而增加旅行的总费用。

tip: 不可数；一件行李说a piece of baggage。

senses.en: willing to give money, time, or help freely
larger or more plentiful than usual or expected

ex.en: Our generous neighbour shared her fresh vegetables with us.
ex.zh: 我们那位大方的邻居把新鲜蔬菜分给了我们。

ex.en: Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.
ex.zh: 当地企业的慷慨捐助可以帮助社区中心为儿童和老年居民提供价格实惠的活动。

col: generous with your time｜不吝惜时间
tip: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。

senses.en: a place open at night for music and dancing

ex.en: The nightclub was very crowded on Friday.
ex.zh: 周五夜店非常拥挤。

ex.en: You must be over eighteen to enter the nightclub.
ex.zh: 年满十八岁才能进夜店。

tip: nightclub 是夜店；注意未成年人禁止进入。
scene: A neon-lit nightclub entrance with music signs at night.

senses.en: Water covering land that is normally dry.
To cover with water or become covered with water.
A large amount of something arriving at once.

ex.en: The flood left our garden covered in thick mud.
ex.zh: 洪水退去后，我们的花园覆满了厚厚的淤泥。

ex.en: Restoring wetlands can reduce flood risks by allowing excess rainwater to spread and drain naturally.
ex.zh: 恢复湿地可以让多余雨水自然扩散和排走，从而降低洪灾风险。

col: a flood of complaints｜大量涌来的投诉
tip: 读音与 blood 的元音相同，不与 food 押韵。

senses.en: television

ex.en: We watched the match on TV.
ex.zh: 我们在电视上看了比赛。

ex.en: The TV is in the living room.
ex.zh: 电视在客厅里。

tip: TV 是 television 的缩写；watch TV 看电视。
scene: A family watching a match on TV in a living room.

senses.en: An act of cutting hair, or the resulting hairstyle.

ex.en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
ex.zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。

ex.en: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
ex.zh: 在社区中心提供价格实惠的理发服务，能让实习理发师在服务当地居民的同时积累实践经验。

tip: 说get或have a haircut，不说cut a haircut。

senses.en: having the usual features of a particular group or situation
showing the behaviour or qualities usually associated with someone

ex.en: A typical weekday starts with breakfast and a walk.
ex.zh: 平常的工作日都是从吃早餐和散步开始的。

ex.en: Long commuting times are typical of large cities where housing near employment centres is expensive.
ex.zh: 在就业中心附近住房昂贵的大城市，通勤时间长是常见现象。

tip: 用typical of表示具有某人或某物的典型特征。

senses.en: the state of having no job

ex.en: Unemployment in the town has risen this year.
ex.zh: 今年这个镇的失业率上升了。

ex.en: The government is trying to reduce unemployment.
ex.zh: 政府正努力降低失业率。

tip: unemployment 是“失业/失业率”；unemployed 是“失业的”。
scene: A job centre with people reading vacancy boards.

senses.en: to believe that something will probably happen
to regard something as necessary or reasonably required
to believe someone or something will arrive soon

ex.en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
ex.zh: 我们预计会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。

ex.en: Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.
ex.zh: 雇主越来越期望毕业生既展现实践技能，又具备扎实的专业知识。

col: expect to do something｜预计做某事
expect someone to do something｜期望某人做某事
tip: expect偏重认为会发生，hope偏重希望发生。

senses.en: a tropical fruit with rough skin and sweet yellow flesh

ex.en: She sliced a fresh pineapple for our picnic.
ex.zh: 她为我们的野餐切了一个新鲜菠萝。

ex.en: Growing pineapple for export can support rural incomes, but intensive farming may damage local soils.
ex.zh: 种植菠萝用于出口可以增加农村收入，但集约化种植可能损害当地土壤。

tip: 整个菠萝可数，作为食物的菠萝果肉常不可数。

senses.en: the feeling or mood of a place or situation
the mixture of gases surrounding a planet

ex.en: Soft lighting gave the little restaurant a relaxed atmosphere.
ex.zh: 柔和的灯光为这家小餐馆营造了轻松的氛围。

ex.en: A supportive classroom atmosphere encourages students to ask questions and participate more actively in discussions.
ex.zh: 相互支持的课堂氛围鼓励学生提问，并更加积极地参与讨论。

tip: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

senses.en: certainly; used to agree

ex.en: 'Can you help me?' 'Of course!'
ex.zh: “你能帮我吗？”“当然！”

ex.en: Of course, I'll come to your party.
ex.zh: 我当然会来参加你的聚会。

tip: of course 表示“当然”，是肯定回答。
scene: A person nodding and smiling while saying of course.

senses.en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame.
To remove the bones from meat or fish.

ex.en: He broke a bone in his wrist while skating.
ex.zh: 他滑冰时摔断了手腕的一块骨头。

ex.en: Regular weight-bearing exercise helps maintain bone strength and can reduce the risk of fractures in older adults.
ex.zh: 规律的负重运动有助于保持骨骼强度，并能降低老年人骨折的风险。

tip: bone作动词指去骨；boneless表示无骨的。
